chapters.title: Chapter 1 - 1:Have You Ever Been Kicked At The Speed Of Light.
chapters.content:
"It's actually the Konoha White Fang? How scary!"
Zenkichi squinted at the Konoha ninjas surrounding them and shouted exaggeratedly, reminiscent of Admiral Kizaru from the pirate world.
"Zenkichi, be serious. The Konoha White Fang is not easy to deal with—we're in real danger."
Terumi Mei reminded Zenkichi with a solemn expression, clearly unsettled by the situation.
The person leading the encirclement was none other than Hatake Sakumo, the White Fang of Konoha, a famed shadow-level powerhouse who had slain countless elite shinobi with his short white blade.
Even the higher-ups in Kirigakure had issued standing orders: if you encounter the Konoha White Fang on a mission, abort immediately if possible.
"This is the Third Ninja War. What are Kirigakure ninjas doing in the Land of Fire?"
Sakumo stood at the front of the Konoha formation, staring coldly at Zenkichi and his team.
"We're on a mission, of course! With the four great villages clashing all over the continent, our Kirigakure can't just sit back on the island—we came to scout the situation."
Zenkichi answered nonchalantly. Even surrounded, he appeared totally relaxed.
"In that case, there's nothing more to discuss."
Sakumo gestured forward. Instantly, the Konoha ninjas shifted into a combat stance.
"Please, forgive me! I came here in a good mood—how about we all pretend this never happened?"
Zenkichi grinned with a playful, almost mocking air.
Sakumo's face remained grim. He clearly had no intention of letting them go. The Konoha shinobi lunged forward without hesitation.
"There's no other choice... Infinite Light!"
"The Art of Blinding a Dog's Eyes!"
(Made up)
Zenkichi curled his lip, and a blinding golden light erupted from his body.
He seemed to transform into a miniature sun, emitting a radiant, intense glow.
The Konoha ninjas, who had been fixated on him, cried out in pain as their vision was overwhelmed by the light. Eyes squeezed shut, they stumbled back, disoriented.
"What kind of ninjutsu is this?"
Sakumo's eyes widened behind closed lids. The technique was terrifying.
If deployed on the battlefield, it could completely cripple an enemy's ability to see, disrupting formations and communication. It was a strategic-level jutsu.
"We have to eliminate him."
Sakumo made his decision and closed his eyes, relying on sensory perception to locate Zenkichi.
He was an expert assassin and highly skilled at tracking targets even without vision.
In a blink, he appeared beside Zenkichi, his short blade flashing with white light as it slashed down.
But it missed.
Despite his senses telling him otherwise, his blade hadn't struck true.
"How scary. The Konoha White Fang really is a monster."
"But light can't be cut. Now it's my turn."
Zenkichi spoke with casual ease, raising one long leg as a golden cross-shaped flash lit up beneath his heel.
"Speed is weight. Konoha White Fang, have you ever been kicked at the speed of light?"
The glowing heel spun and crashed toward Sakumo like a cannonball.
Sakumo barely dodged. The blast of light struck a nearby tree, slicing it clean in half.
"Retreat!"
Sakumo barked the order. The Konoha squad quickly turned away from the blinding light and began falling back.
Though still recovering from temporary blindness, they were able to escape with their backs to the light source.
Ding! Achievement unlocked – Defeated Konoha White Fang. Template character: Borsalino (Kizaru) unlocked – 11% synchronization!
Well,as you all probably guessed, Zenkichi isn't from this world. To be specific, he's a transmigrator.
He had been reborn in Kirigakure as a civilian orphan.
At first, he wasn't thrilled with where he had landed.
After all, this world's protagonist was clearly in Konoha, while Kirigakure was often the punching bag.
And judging by the timeline, it wouldn't be long before Uchiha Obito manipulated the village into becoming the infamous "Bloody Mist," turning it into a battleground of internal slaughter.
Zenkichi had felt pretty hopeless—until he awakened his golden finger: the God-Level Imitation System.
The system allowed him to unlock powerful templates by mimicking characters.
Currently, he was imitating Admiral Kizaru from the pirate world, a logia-type user of the Glint-Glint Fruit and an incredibly powerful figure.
To unlock Kizaru's template, he had to act like him in everyday life, but greater progress could be made by imitating him during important moments.
Like just now—by repelling the White Fang in true Kizaru fashion, his synchronization rate had leapt forward significantly.
"Zenkichi, are you going to chase them down?"
Terumi Mei looked at him, clearly fired up. She hadn't expected the usually lazy Zenkichi to be this strong.
"Chase them? Nah. I came here in a chill mood. I'm not doing something so troublesome."
Zenkichi replied lazily, embodying Kizaru's laid-back, lazy attitude.
"What a waste of a golden opportunity…"
Their teammate Ao looked frustrated, clearly thinking they could have gained more from the situation.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on
"Konoha's White Fang couldn't touch me, but I also couldn't kill him. More importantly, I can't guarantee your safety."
Zenkichi's expression turned more serious. He genuinely cared about his teammates.
They had worked together for years. That bond meant something.
Though he could imitate Kizaru, that didn't make him Kizaru.
True imitation required capturing the spirit of the person, and for Zenkichi, this was more like a form of spiritual training.
"Our mission was just reconnaissance. Now that we've encountered Konoha's White Fang, our job here is done."
Zenkichi yawned and spoke with indifference.
There was no denying it—Kizaru's approach to life had its perks.
Immense power, paired with an easygoing attitude, made everything much more manageable.
"Alright. Meeting Konoha's White Fang is reason enough for us to head back and report."
Terumi Mei nodded, and the trio began their return to the frontline base of Kirigakure.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 - 2:Seven Ninja Swordsmen.
chapters.content:
"You said you encountered the White Fang of Konoha?"
The commander-in-chief of the frontline base of Kirigakure Village, Master Genji—a highly respected elder—asked calmly. In the original timeline, he lived until Terumi Mei succeeded as the Fifth Mizukage.
"Yes," Terumi Mei nodded, then cast a slightly complicated look at Zenkichi.
"The reason we were able to return alive from the hands of Konoha's White Fang was because Zenkichi displayed incredible strength."
She didn't hesitate to report Zenkichi's impressive performance to Genji. Talents like his couldn't afford to be overlooked.
"Oh?"
Master Genji raised an eyebrow and cast a scrutinizing gaze toward Zenkichi.
He was well aware of Zenkichi's reputation—a classic underachiever in Kirigakure. But ever since Zenkichi acquired the Kizaru template, he had inherited a terrifying degree of natural talent.
Although the full extent of the Kizaru template had yet to be unlocked, its sheer potential was immediately evident. Kizaru's raw ability ranked among the highest-tier in his original world.
Where others clawed their way to the top with endless effort and danger, Kizaru reached general-level power with a laid-back, almost lazy demeanor. He was living proof that natural talent could rival the harshest training regimens.
It wasn't just the Light Fruit—Kizaru had fought on par with legendary warriors like Silvers Rayleigh and Z, even relying on swordsmanship alone. His physical prowess and technique were undeniably at a quasi-admiral level.
(According to Google, Kizaru is highly skilled in swordsmanship.)
Now that talent resided in Zenkichi, making him one of the top prodigies in Kirigakure.
While his ninjutsu was unremarkable, his physical capabilities and kenjutsu were astounding.
Elsewhere, such a skill set might be overlooked. But in the land of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen—Kirigakure—it was a coveted trait.
Unfortunately, Zenkichi had been mimicking Kizaru's personality a little too well: that detached, uninterested attitude made him look like a slacker. His "salty fish" demeanor bred hesitation among the higher-ups.
The bloody legacy of Kirigakure wasn't solely Obito Uchiha's doing. He may have manipulated the Mizukage, but no one enforced the Blood Mist policies without support from within.
Kirigakure traditionally valued brutality and ferocity. Zenkichi's chill persona made the elders uneasy.
Still, if Terumi Mei claimed he had driven off Konoha's White Fang, they couldn't ignore him.
"In that case, let the Seven Ninja Swordsmen test his strength," Master Genji said after a long pause.
"The Seven Ninja Swordsmen?"
Zenkichi's face twitched. "Each one of them is a freakishly strong monster. That's terrifying."
He shot Terumi Mei a side glance, clearly blaming her for dragging him into this.
Understanding his meaning, Terumi Mei replied firmly, "You have talent and strength. It would be a waste to let that go unused."
Terumi Mei was ambitious. Without that drive, she never would've become the Fifth Mizukage.
Seeing Zenkichi's strength sparked some jealousy in her. If she had that level of ability, she'd already be contending for the title of Fourth Mizukage.
The current Mizukage—the Third, Shirakawa—was aging. Once this war ended, he was expected to step down.
Knowing she couldn't win that race herself, Terumi Mei decided to support Zenkichi instead. Backing the next Mizukage would earn her significant influence—a path to fulfilling her ambitions.
Zenkichi curled his lip. "But I just want a chill life—show up to missions, clock in, clock out. That's the dream."
Terumi Mei was fuming. "Is that something a real person would say?!"
"No way," she snapped. "You can't waste your potential."
Zenkichi shrugged, too lazy to argue. Of course, if he didn't have any talent, he wouldn't bother. But to keep growing, he had to maintain the façade.
Ah… hypocrisy. The true mark of a high-level ninja village.
The path to power was always full of complications.
---
"Master Genji, you want us to fight this kid?"
Fuguki Suikazan, Samehada slung over his shoulder, looked Zenkichi up and down with a smirk.
The Kirigakure ninja system was chaotic—riddled with infighting. The Seven Ninja Swordsmen, despite their strength, barely respected the chain of command.
Zenkichi wasn't surprised. Hands in pockets, he stood facing the Seven Ninja Swordsmen calmly.
"Don't underestimate him," Genji said coldly. "He repelled Konoha's White Fang. Even if all of you go together, you might not beat him."
Fuguki snorted. "This brat? Repelled the White Fang? You're kidding me, right?"
Juzo grinned wickedly. "Alright, no need for chatter. We're all busy. I'll take care of him myself. Don't blame me if I cut him in half."
Genji glanced at Zenkichi, who muttered, "Cut me in two? That's scary… Juzo-san really is a monster."
Laughter broke out among the others—the Seven Ninja Swordsmen were definitely a strange bunch.
"You're asking for it," Juzo snarled.
With a flicker, he used the Body Flicker Technique and appeared right beside Zenkichi. The Executioner's Blade swung down mercilessly—
Slice!
Zenkichi's body split in half—top and bottom separated cleanly, falling limply to the ground.
"How scary! You really cut me in two… that's so mean!"The most update n0vels are published on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Zenkichi exclaimed dramatically as he lay motionless.
Everyone's expression changed in an instant.
There was no blood.
Where he was "cut," golden light shimmered. The severed pieces broke into glimmering particles, reformed, and Zenkichi stood again—completely unharmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 - 3:Power Of The Glint Glint Fruit.
chapters.content:
"Similar to the Hydrification Technique of the Hōzuki clan... a Light Transformation Technique?"
Because the Hōzuki clan of Kirigakure Village is known for their Hydrification Technique—which allows them to liquefy their bodies—many quickly made assumptions.
"Similar to the Hydrification Technique?"
Juzo's eyes narrowed, and he stabbed the Executioner's Blade into the ground beside him.
As a member of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist, Juzo was intimately familiar with the Hōzuki clan's jutsu. The Hydrification Technique turns one's body into liquid, making physical attacks nearly useless.
But it had a weakness—Lightning Release.
Juzo speculated that Zenkichi's "Light Transformation" might have similar vulnerabilities, so he decided to test it with various elemental ninjutsu.
"Water Style—Great Waterfall Technique!"
He swiftly weaved hand seals and unleashed a massive wave of water that crashed toward Zenkichi.
In other worlds, Devil Fruit users were notoriously weak against water—but Zenkichi lacked that flaw.
Although he had inherited Kizaru's abilities through a character template, it wasn't an actual Devil Fruit.
If he later obtained another Devil Fruit-based template, he could even wield two types of Devil Fruit-like powers simultaneously.
The wave surged forward—only to pass cleanly through Zenkichi's body, which had become radiant golden light particles.
"Water Style doesn't work? Then... Lightning Style—Thunderbolt!"
Juzo formed another set of seals. A sphere of crackling lightning formed in his hand and discharged into the water-drenched battlefield.
Bolts of electricity arced across the terrain, seeking Zenkichi.
Still, Zenkichi stood in the water unmoved. The lightning passed harmlessly through his light-composed body.
"Water and Lightning... this guy really is one of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen. Scary," Zenkichi muttered sarcastically, clearly unimpressed.
Zenkichi's "Glint-Glint Fruit" ability had virtually no conventional weaknesses. Once fully transformed into light particles, his body became nearly immune to both physical and energy-based attacks.
In the original One Piece world, even Enel, a lightning user, was immune to laser swords and energy blasts. That said a lot about how difficult it was to injure elemental-type abilities through standard means.
"Damn it! Fire Style—Dragon Flame Jutsu!"ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ
Frustrated, Juzo fired off a serpentine stream of fire that surged toward Zenkichi.
Boom!
It, too, passed harmlessly through him.
Zenkichi lazily curled his lip. "That's three jutsu now, huh? The Seven Ninja Swordsmen really are persistent."
Fuguki Suikazan burst out laughing from the sidelines. "Juzo, looks like this one's outta your league!"
"Shut up!" Juzo snapped. "I've still got Wind and Earth Style. Don't count me out yet!"
He launched a Wind Style technique—razor-sharp wind blades screamed toward Zenkichi.
As an elite jōnin, Juzo had trained in all five basic nature transformations.
Even if some weren't his innate chakra nature, he could perform basic ninjutsu in each—though his proficiency varied.
That versatility was expected of high-level shinobi, who needed to counter elemental weaknesses in battle. Unlike genin or chūnin, elite jōnin had the chakra reserves and training to master a full range of elemental jutsu.
"Wind-style jutsu can slice through solid objects... maybe it'll work on his light form," someone speculated.
"I doubt it."
"Why?"
"Because Zenkichi isn't even dodging."
From the sidelines, Terumi Mei and Ao exchanged glances—equal parts amazement and excitement.
They'd once fought beside Zenkichi. Seeing his overwhelming strength now filled them with pride.
The other Kirigakure ninja stood frozen. No one had expected a chūnin to stand toe-to-toe with the Seven Ninja Swordsmen.
And win.
Zenkichi, still ignoring the attack, smiled faintly.
"Juzo... is it my turn now?"
"Speed... is weight."
"Have you ever been kicked... at the speed of light?"
He raised one leg. Golden light spiraled around his foot, forming a glowing, rotating cross-shaped halo.
"Danger!" Juzo's instincts screamed.
Zenkichi didn't waste time with taunts. He launched the golden kick—light exploded outward as it rocketed toward Juzo.
Even at just 11% of his Kizaru template's full power, a light-speed kick carried the destructive force of high-level ninjutsu.
Ninjas were typically glass cannons—massive offensive power, but poor durability. Even legends like Uchiha Madara could be brought down with the right strike.
Zenkichi's attack wasn't godlike—but it was more than enough to rival an A-rank technique.
And unlike most taijutsu users, who needed rest between big moves, Zenkichi could fire them off repeatedly. His chakra pool, amplified by the template system, was absurd.
Boom!
The kick hit like a meteor. A crater burst open. Juzo broke into a cold sweat.
Before he could recover, another flash of golden light reformed behind him. Zenkichi had used his photon body to teleport.
BAM!
A blinding kick landed squarely on Juzo's back. He flew into a tree, crashing with a sickening thud. He collapsed—injured and motionless.
"What a disgrace," someone muttered.
"You've tarnished the Seven Ninja Swordsmen's name, Juzo."
"But... for the sake of our title, I'll avenge you!"
Fuguki Suikazan cracked his knuckles with a grin.
He gripped Samehada tightly and vanished in a blur—reappearing beside Zenkichi with a heavy downward swing.
He had a reason to be confident.
Samehada could absorb chakra.
That was his ace.
All ninjutsu relied on chakra. Fuguki believed that no matter how Zenkichi transformed his body, Samehada could shred it apart.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 4 - 4:A Threat To Konohagakure.
chapters.content:
"Samehada? How terrifying."
Looking at Fuguki Suikazan rushing toward him, Zenkichi said casually and fired a laser without ceremony.
The golden light, condensed from countless particles, resembled a high-pressure beam with immense cutting power.
Moreover, after hitting the target, the highly concentrated light particles rapidly expanded—causing a powerful explosion.
Fuguki assumed that Zenkichi's abilities were chakra-based, so he didn't take the laser seriously.
He swung Samehada in his hand, attempting to absorb Zenkichi's laser.
Samehada could devour chakra-based techniques, even terrifying ones like the Tailed Beast Ball.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs
However, Zenkichi's laser wasn't formed from chakra. Samehada had no effect against it.
Pfft!
A dull sound echoed as the laser pierced through Samehada's body, triggering a sharp explosion behind it.
Samehada thrashed violently and let out a painful screech—the laser had clearly inflicted serious damage.
Not only had Zenkichi's laser penetrated Samehada, but the residual burning also intensified its pain.
"Samehada, what's wrong with you? Calm down!"
Fuguki, unaware of the internal damage, assumed the attack had only grazed the weapon.
After all, the explosion hadn't directly hit Samehada.
Trying to calm it, Fuguki gripped the hilt more tightly—
But that only provoked a violent reaction.
Sharp barbs burst out from the handle, piercing his palm and drawing blood.
Samehada wasn't a normal weapon. It was a sentient creature that had once accompanied the Three-Tails.
If its wielder displeased it, it would retaliate without hesitation.
At that moment, Samehada bit back against Fuguki.
"Hmm~ Fuguki Suikazan, looks like you've got a problem!"
Zenkichi's voice rang out as his body flickered into light particles, instantly appearing behind his opponent.
With a casual motion, he raised his leg—wrapped in shimmering light—and kicked Fuguki away.
Boom!
"What a troublesome ability..."
The remaining Seven Ninja Swordsmen looked grim. Despite their ferocity, none of them acted recklessly after witnessing Zenkichi's display.
"Elder Genji, is that enough?"
Zenkichi placed his hands in his pockets and glanced casually at Genji.
Genji had intended to test Zenkichi's strength through the Seven Ninja Swordsmen—to verify the claim that he'd repelled the White Fang of Konoha.
Zenkichi had welcomed the opportunity to show force—to deter any future challengers.
If there hadn't been such a public battle, the Kirigakure ninjas at the base wouldn't be convinced.
Rather than let others come after him in secret, it was better to crush them openly—to make them lose hope.
Letting Jūzō try multiple nature transformations wasn't just about Kizaru's temperament—it was a warning against further probing.
After all, the current Kirigakure was far from a united village.
Master Genji took a deep breath, suppressed the excitement in his chest, and nodded.
"All right. I now believe that you truly repelled Konoha's White Fang."
"I'll report this to Lord Mizukage. You'll be rewarded according to your merit."
Zenkichi said casually, "Fine by me. I'm curious what kind of arrangement the Mizukage will make for me."
---
Konoha.
After returning from the mission, Konoha's White Fang immediately reported his encounter with Zenkichi to the Third Hokage.
Upon hearing the report, the youthful and powerful Third Hokage frowned in disbelief.
"Is what you said true? That sounds impossible."
A sixteen- or seventeen-year-old possessing strength to rival the White Fang? It was hard to accept.
The White Fang confirmed firmly, "Everything I said is true. That young man's abilities are… bizarre."
"Though I can't gauge his exact strength, he absolutely has the power to threaten a Kage-level shinobi."
Sarutobi Hiruzen said gravely, "You're right. I may have underestimated him. Perhaps his actual level isn't quite Kage-class, but the nature of his abilities gives him equivalent combat potential."
"To ignore your White Fang blade… That sounds like the Hydration Technique of the Hōzuki clan. Perhaps a lightning technique could counter it."
The White Fang shook his head.
"I'm afraid not. The Hydration Technique is countered by lightning because water conducts electricity."
"But that boy's body didn't turn into water—it turned into light. I doubt Lightning Release would work."
"And more than his individual strength, his impact on the battlefield is what concerns me most."
"He can emit intense light that affects vision. That's a battlefield-level strategic weapon."
"If he shines that light while facing Konoha's shinobi troops, they could go blind instantly."
"Meanwhile, Kirigakure's troops—facing the other way—wouldn't be affected. That's a major tactical advantage."
The Third Hokage tapped his pipe, fell silent, then said, "You're right. We must treat this with utmost seriousness. A power like that could change the course of a war."
---
Kirigakure.
While Konoha was already embroiled in battle with Sunagakure and Iwagakure, Kirigakure and Kumogakure remained on standby—deploying troops to the front lines without yet engaging directly.
Still, their intent to intervene was clear.
The aging Third Mizukage picked up Genji's battle report with a pleased smile.
He hadn't expected a genius like Zenkichi to emerge from Kirigakure's civilian ninja population.
Excellent. Truly excellent.
The Third Mizukage contemplated promoting Zenkichi to a high-ranking post.
Kirigakure had far too many kekkei genkai clans, monopolizing resources and deepening the rift with civilian ninjas.
It was this growing conflict that would eventually give rise to the infamous "Bloody Mist Village."
If the kekkei genkai clans hadn't become so tyrannical, their eventual purging might never have happened.
Even so, the complete eradication of those clans was like amputating an arm—a loss few could accept.

chapters.title: Chapter 5 - 5: Going To Konoha.
chapters.content:
"Zenkichi, Lord Mizukage has accepted your appointment."
"Master Mizukage promoted you to elite jōnin and ordered you to go to Konoha Village to discuss the alliance."
Terumi Mei rushed into Zenkichi's tent, her voice filled with excitement.
Zenkichi set down the teacup in his hand, blinked, and said to Mei casually, "Promoting me to elite jōnin makes sense."
"But sending me to Konoha to discuss an alliance… what's going on with that?"
Elder Genji entered from outside, speaking in a calm tone. "Lord Mizukage believes now is not the time to start a war with Konoha."
"Moreover, Konoha has requested an alliance. Lord Mizukage intends to send someone to negotiate."
Zenkichi shook his head. "This job doesn't sound very safe. You're not going to get me killed halfway through, are you?"
He thought of Pakura of the Scorch Release from Sunagakure. She was killed when she went to Kirigakure to discuss an alliance.
Poor woman. As far as he knew, she was the only shadow-level kunoichi to die from mere shuriken.
Elder Genji said calmly, "There is a risk, but not because of fear. I suspect Konoha's request for an alliance is because of you."
"Lord Mizukage wants you to come along and intimidate the Leaf. War is just another means of diplomacy. If we can avoid bloodshed, all the better."
Zenkichi thought for a moment, then shrugged indifferently. "When do we leave? Who else is going?"
Elder Genji smiled. "We depart tomorrow. It will be you, me, Terumi Mei, and Yagura."
As one of the Third Mizukage's closest advisors, Elder Genji understood his intentions clearly. This trip to Konoha was a political opportunity—for both Zenkichi and Yagura.
No village leader wants a ninja clan growing too powerful—like a nation within a nation.
Ninjas from powerful clans often prioritize their family over the village. They're strong, but their loyalty is divided.
Because of this, most Kage suppress clan power and support talented civilians.
Kirigakure's clans had grown too powerful. The Third Mizukage would never hand the village to someone from a clan.
That left only two civilian-born candidates: Zenkichi and Yagura.
The Mizukage believed the trip to Konoha was safe enough to allow both to go and earn political merit.
Konoha was already deeply embroiled in its war with Sunagakure and Iwagakure. There was no way they'd declare war on Kirigakure now.
Elder Genji left.
Terumi Mei looked at Zenkichi sipping his tea, her expression mixed with annoyance and admiration. "Do you realize how big this opportunity is?"
Zenkichi glanced at her, then shook his head.
She continued, "Yagura is already a strong candidate for Fourth Mizukage. But your recent performance may have caught the Mizukage's eye."
"I wouldn't be surprised if you're now considered a serious contender. You're on the same level as Yagura!"
Zenkichi sighed. "Fourth Mizukage, huh? Sounds like a hassle."
Terumi Mei's eye twitched. "A hassle? Do you have any idea how many people in the village would kill for this opportunity?"
"They'd do anything for a shot at this, and here you are calling it 'trouble'? You really piss me off!"
Zenkichi leaned back in his chair and said lazily, "Aw, is Mei-chan mad? How scary."
Terumi Mei: ??(◣д◢)??
Zenkichi dug around in his robes and pulled out a pair of nail scissors, trimming his nails casually. "Being Mizukage is tempting, sure. I've thought about it."
"But… life's meant to be enjoyed. If you live just chasing status, you'll wear yourself out. I like this slow, peaceful life better."
He sighed.
At first, the system told him to emulate Kizaru. He refused—it was too tiring. But now, the life of a slacker had grown on him.
"If it comes to that, I'd rather quit being a ninja."
Terumi Mei snapped, "That's sloth talking! A ninja who seeks a life of ease is in the wrong profession!"
Zenkichi just smirked.
"There are a lot of pirates in the Land of Water. Maybe I'll become one. With my power, I could be the Pirate King."
"Or maybe I'll convince the daimyō to establish a navy. I could be the admiral—or better yet, the fleet marshal."
"If all else fails, I'll just be the personal bodyguard of the daimyō's daughter. How about that?"
He leaned back in his chair, grinning.
Terumi Mei →_→
Zenkichi shrugged. "It's not like I planned this. When I wanted to fight back, I didn't have the power. Now that I do…"
He sighed again, quieter this time. "I've started to enjoy this."
Terumi Mei: "..."
Seeing her speechless expression, Zenkichi chuckled. "Relax."
"I may hate trouble, but I won't slack on my responsibilities."
"I'll do what needs to be done. If that includes competing for the Mizukage's seat, I'll do it. Don't worry—it's not a big deal."
Terumi Mei raised an eyebrow and huffed. "With that attitude, how are you supposed to beat Yagura?"
Zenkichi replied lazily, "Who says I can't?."
"I don't try too hard. I just happen to be that good."
He glanced at his system template.

chapters.title: Chapter 6 - 6: Weakness? I Don't Have Any.
chapters.content:
---
"Are you Zenkichi?"
A young boy, no older than twelve or thirteen, stood in front of Zenkichi, eyeing him from head to toe.
"It's me. Are you Yagura?"
Zenkichi looked at the boy casually and replied in a calm tone.
Today was the day they were to depart for Konoha. Zenkichi, Yagura, Terumi Mei, and Elder Genji had assembled and were preparing to leave the Kirigakure base.
"I'll prove that I'm stronger than you."
Yagura clenched his fists, speaking to Zenkichi with passion burning in his eyes. "I'm determined to become Mizukage!"
Zenkichi: →_→
He casually touched the sealing scroll on his waist and let out a long sigh.
If only I had a straw hat...
I'd put it on this kid without hesitation.
"What's with that look on your face?"
Seeing Zenkichi shaking his head and sighing, Yagura frowned in irritation.
"Let me tell you—I'm not younger than you! Don't underestimate me!"
Yagura sounded angry. Clearly, his short stature had caused him plenty of frustration.
"I'm not underestimating you," Zenkichi said in a placid tone.
"A man with such a mighty physique... terrifying."
He said it with a composed voice, as though he had become some ancient seer.
Yagura's face darkened at Zenkichi's sarcastic praise.
"Can I hit him?"
Yagura pointed furiously at Zenkichi and turned to Elder Genji for permission.
"No."
Elder Genji sighed and looked at Yagura helplessly.
Do you think I don't want to hit him?
This guy is even stronger than I am!
But Elder Genji chose to preserve Yagura's pride. He didn't outright say Zenkichi was untouchable. Yagura, however, mistook the silence for silent support and grew even more agitated.
Terumi Mei glanced at Zenkichi with a mixture of frustration and helplessness.
He has the talent, the strength, the resources... Why does he waste them like this?
If I had your advantages, I'd already be Mizukage!
---
Konoha.
After entering the Land of Fire, the four-person team from Kirigakure was escorted all the way by Konoha ninjas.
"Remember," Elder Genji said seriously to the group—and to the hidden ANBU watching them—
"Don't act arrogant when we arrive in Konoha, but don't bring shame to the name of Kirigakure either."
"Don't start trouble, but if trouble comes to you, don't back down. Kirigakure isn't afraid of war."
He made sure the hidden Konoha observers heard that too.
Right now, Konoha was at odds with both Sunagakure and Iwagakure. They weren't likely to provoke Kirigakure unnecessarily.
Kirigakure, for its part, didn't want to escalate things either. This mission was more of a military display than a true diplomatic negotiation.
Bring a few strong, promising young shinobi to show off Kirigakure's strength—without actually starting a war.
If possible, they hoped to gain bargaining power through peaceful means.
After all, if you can't destroy a nation outright, war's real goal is to gain leverage at the negotiating table.
---
"Welcome, messengers from Kirigakure."
A Konoha ninja appeared in front of the group, smiling politely. He looked remarkably similar to the Third Hokage.
"I am Sarutobi Shinnosuke. I'll be your liaison during your stay."
"Shinnosuke?" Zenkichi looked him up and down. "If I'm not mistaken, you're part of Konoha's ANBU. Why aren't you in uniform or wearing a mask?"
Shinnosuke's smile stiffened slightly, but he kept his tone light.
"I'm not here in an ANBU capacity today. I'm here as a regular Konoha shinobi."
Zenkichi nodded thoughtfully. "I see. So even the Third Hokage is sending out his own son. Seems like Konoha is taking us pretty seriously."
The Hokage's biological son?!
Terumi Mei and Yagura were visibly surprised, and even Elder Genji raised an eyebrow.
Shinnosuke's lips twitched. "Seems you're well-informed. You know quite a bit."
"Not many people know I'm both a former ANBU and the Hokage's son."
Zenkichi chuckled and waved his hand. "That just means you've got a leak in your upper ranks. Better have the Third Hokage investigate. Might even be someone from Suna."
Shinnosuke: "..."
I'm just here to greet you. Why are you giving me political headaches already?
He shot a glance at Zenkichi, thoroughly annoyed.
This was no ordinary guest—he was a walking problem.
As he watched Zenkichi, Shinnosuke mentally noted a few key things.
First: Zenkichi seemed to have access to sensitive information about Konoha. Whether that information was real or bait, it was alarming.
Second: He might know things that even Kirigakure's leadership doesn't. That made him a potential goldmine—or a dangerous liability.
Third: And this was the most important—
This guy has an absolutely infuriating personality. I really want to punch him.
Shinnosuke silently added those three points to Zenkichi's file in his mind and gave the boy a sideways glare.
"Whoa! What's with the look?"
Zenkichi raised his brows and gave an exaggerated gasp.
"The angry Konoha ninja is so scary!"Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs
Shinnosuke: ??(◣д◢)??
I really can't take this guy…
"Ahem! Right. Let's get you to your accommodations first," Elder Genji cut in smoothly, redirecting the conversation before things escalated.
Then he turned to Zenkichi with a satisfied look.
They hadn't come to Konoha for sightseeing. Testing the waters and touching nerves was exactly what they were here for.
Elder Genji had expected Konoha to probe Zenkichi first.
But unexpectedly, Zenkichi struck first.
Good. Very good.
---
Under Shinnosuke's lead, the Kirigakure delegation entered Konoha. After settling them into the guesthouse, Shinnosuke left.
Elder Genji turned to Zenkichi and said seriously, "In the coming days, someone will definitely test your abilities. Stay calm and don't reveal your weaknesses."
Zenkichi scoffed. "Weaknesses? I don't have any."
Elder Genji said nothing more, only shaking his head.
Even he wasn't sure if Zenkichi had any weaknesses.
That kind of thing was taboo in shinobi circles. Even high-level village leaders wouldn't investigate carelessly.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 7 - 7: Genjutsu.
chapters.content:
"Zenkichi, let's go for a walk together!"
"The Land of Fire is the richest among the Five Great Nations, and Konoha is much better than our Kirigakure."
Before Zenkichi could return to his room and enjoy a cup of afternoon tea, Terumi Mei ran over happily.
"Wandering around Konoha? Sounds like a pretty good idea."
Zenkichi thought for a moment and readily agreed to Terumi Mei's proposal.
To put it simply, the Land of Fire is the most developed of the five great nations.
It may not be entirely accurate to call it a "developed country," but it helps illustrate the gap between it and the others.
The Land of Wind is a vast desert, the Land of Earth is rocky and harsh, the Land of Lightning is mostly mountainous plateaus… only the Land of Fire is located on fertile plains, with lush fields and a favorable environment.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
The Land of Water, composed of countless islands, is the weakest among the five. Despite other countries having difficult terrain, they are domestically unified. The Land of Water, however, suffers from poor transportation and scattered territories, making it difficult to fully unite.
Because of this, the economy of the Land of Fire is the most advanced among the Five Great Nations. In terms of development, Kirigakure is like a third- or fourth-tier city, mainly functioning as a military outpost. The village economy is poor, riddled with internal conflict, and not suited for business. There aren't even many shops.
But these things didn't matter much to Zenkichi. Right now, all he wanted was to take a stroll through Konoha.
In terms of combat strength, if ranked in levels, Konoha would be able to tie with the other four nations combined—though not indefinitely. They could fight the world alone for a time, but eventually, they would be worn down.
Without the developed economy of the Land of Fire backing it, Konoha wouldn't be able to maintain such formidable strength.
"Yo! Yagura, heading out too?"
Zenkichi and Terumi Mei walked out of the room and spotted Yagura just about to leave, so they greeted him.
Yagura snorted and turned away coldly.
Zenkichi curled his lips into a mischievous grin and said loudly, "I heard there are a lot of beauties in Konoha's bathhouses. Don't go using your 'size' to sneak in!"
Yagura staggered, his face flushing red. He turned and snapped, "What nonsense are you spouting!?"
Zenkichi blinked innocently. "Huh? You looked like you were in such a hurry, I thought maybe you wanted to pretend to be a kid and peek in the women's bathhouse. Am I wrong?"
Veins popped on Yagura's temple, and dark lines appeared on his face. "I… I wouldn't do something that stupid!"
Zenkichi picked at his ear nonchalantly. "You don't sound too confident about that."
Yagura fumed, "Just wait! When we get back to Kirigakure, you're dead!"
Zenkichi just chuckled and brushed it off. He's just a kid—what could he really do?
---
Konoha Streets
Terumi Mei hesitated, then gently reached out and held onto Zenkichi's arm.
Zenkichi glanced at her, surprised.
Terumi Mei looked away and said, "Konoha really is a lot more prosperous than our village."
Zenkichi sighed internally. His charm lately had been a little too effective. He was attracting beautiful women at a pace that felt… overwhelming.
This was a burden no one his age should have to bear—but it was something he'd have to get used to.
Zenkichi's expression turned serious, radiating a dignified aura. He had a strong sense of righteousness. With the power of the Glint-Glint Fruit (Pika Pika no Mi), he had to maintain his image.
"This looks great!"
Zenkichi's attention was caught by an eyewear store nearby.
He walked in and picked up a pair of brown-tinted sunglasses—classic Kizaru style.
"These are the ones!"
Zenkichi put the sunglasses on, looked in the mirror, and found they suited him perfectly.
Unlike Kizaru's slightly sleazy vibe, he looked sharp—cool even.
Zenkichi stared at himself in the mirror, then curled his lips into a sarcastic smile.
Hmm… very Kizaru.
This smile wasn't hard to learn, but it wasn't for amateurs—it could easily cause misunderstandings.
"I'll take these."
He pointed at the sunglasses and addressed the shop owner.
"Twenty ryō."
The shopkeeper glanced up and gave the price.
"I've got it."
Terumi Mei stepped forward and paid with a smile.
"Isn't that a bit inappropriate?" Zenkichi asked, a little conflicted.
Wouldn't that make him look like he was being kept?
A high-ranking shinobi being treated like a sugar baby? Even Kizaru wouldn't accept that.
"If you feel bad, just treat me to a meal sometime," Mei offered casually.
"That's fair."
Zenkichi nodded. Terumi Mei was being so proactive—it would be harsh to shut her down completely. That might hurt her pride.
He couldn't help it… he was just too kindhearted!
---
Just then, a massive tree materialized behind them. Vines shot out, wrapping around Zenkichi and binding him tightly.
As Zenkichi and Terumi Mei stepped out of the shop, the world suddenly shifted—the street warped around them, and the environment changed in an instant.
"An illusion?"
"The test from Konoha's side already?"
"Interesting."
Zenkichi smiled, clearly entertained.
Back in Kirigakure, Loquat Jūzō had tried all kinds of techniques, including every chakra nature, and none of it worked on him. There had been plenty of onlookers then—perhaps Konoha had acquired some intel.
Even if they hadn't, there was no way they'd try something flashy like elemental attacks in the middle of a crowded street.
An illusion, quiet and subtle, was a smarter move.
"Too bad."
"Genjutsu is useless on me—unless it's something like Tsukuyomi or Kotoamatsukami."
A smirk appeared on Zenkichi's face as he activated his ability—body elementalization.
The simplest way to break out of genjutsu is to disrupt one's chakra flow.
Whether it's disrupting it yourself or getting a teammate's help, that's standard practice.
Zenkichi, thanks to his light-form transformation, naturally disrupted his chakra every time he shifted between flesh and energy.
He was completely immune to basic illusions.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 8 - 8: Observation Haki.
chapters.content:
Achievement achieved – Immune to illusions! Template character: Kizaru unlocked at 20%. Skill obtained – Observation Haki.
Previously, his resistance to genjutsu was only theoretical. But after being tested by Konoha's shinobi, Zenkichi could now confirm it: he was highly resistant to illusions.
This achievement helped him further unlock the Kizaru template, granting him access to Kizaru's Haki abilities.
A mysterious, subtle sensation welled up inside Zenkichi's chest. The entire Hidden Leaf Village seemed to come into focus.
This was Kizaru's Kenbunshoku Haki (Observation Haki), which easily encompassed the entire village.
Don't be mistaken—while Kizaru may not have been portrayed as someone who excelled in Observation Haki, any admiral in the Navy wouldn't have glaring weaknesses.
The Glint-Glint Fruit gave him immense speed and long-range offensive power, but when fighting Rayleigh, Zephyr, or even Whitebeard, Kizaru also demonstrated strong close-quarters skills.
Without powerful physical strength, martial arts, and Haki, engaging a swordsman like Rayleigh in melee would've been suicide.
"What sharp Haki… I've found you!"ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Zenkichi sensed something in the village. A smirk crept across his face.
Not far from him, on the roof of the optical store, a man with red eyes silently watched Zenkichi's back.
"Did it work?"
The red-eyed man murmured to himself, unsure if the illusion had taken effect.
Just then, Zenkichi's body transformed into light particles and vanished.
The man's expression changed instantly. Before he could react, a calm, melodious voice came from behind him.
"Hmm~ I guess I should be a little flattered. Your genjutsu wasn't half bad."
The man instantly flickered away a few meters, reappearing with caution in his eyes as he stared at Zenkichi.
Zenkichi chuckled. "You're the one Konoha sent to test me? That genjutsu was pretty decent."
Expressionless, the red-eyed man replied, "I don't know what you're talking about. I was ordered to protect you in secret."
Zenkichi curled his lip. "So that's why you chose to 'protect' me with a genjutsu test? Since there's no evidence, you're just going to deny it? Real classy, Konoha."
"I'd advise you not to make false accusations," the man responded flatly. "Konoha won't tolerate slander."
Zenkichi widened his eyes in mock panic. "No way! Not only did Konoha shamelessly test me, now you're flipping it back on me? That's terrifying!"
The red-eyed man's expression darkened. Zenkichi's exaggerated tone wasn't just banter—it was a clear message.
You don't scare me.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Several Konoha ANBU appeared on the rooftop. Terumi Mei also arrived in a flash.
Zenkichi's expression turned serious. "What's this? Konoha's going to ambush me now? Mei, turn around."
Terumi Mei was slightly startled, but trusting Zenkichi, she obediently turned her head.
The red-eyed man and the ANBU were momentarily confused, about to speak, when Zenkichi calmly said:
"I'll be fair. I'll let you use both your hands and feet. One strike decides it."
As soon as he finished speaking, brilliant golden light exploded from Zenkichi's body. It was as if a second sun had appeared above the village.
At that moment, countless villagers of Konoha looked up… only to squint and quickly avert their eyes.
Light Release – Blinding Flash Technique!
---
Hokage's Office
Third Hokage, Hiruzen Sarutobi, shut his eyes in frustration and sighed. The test had failed.
As Konoha's White Fang had warned, this ability was extremely troublesome. If this blinding power was used on the battlefield, it could be more disruptive than anything else.
"Wait… is there any way to counter this? Sunglasses, maybe?"
The Third Hokage's eyes lit up as he considered this new idea. If wearing sunglasses could nullify the light's effects…
He waved over an ANBU and instructed them to test the sunglasses theory.
Then, pipe in hand, he quietly waited for Kirigakure's representatives to arrive.
Though he had ordered the test, the Third Hokage wasn't worried.
Konoha's forces were strong, and even if Kirigakure opened another front, they wouldn't be able to break through easily.
Both sides would suffer in a war, and that's why the Third Mizukage had agreed to this fragile peace.
---
Zenkichi's dazzling counterattack left the red-eyed man and the ANBU stunned. Only then did they realize that the blinding light was the effect of his elemental form, not an actual attack.
After Zenkichi explained everything, Elder Genji arrived and said coldly, "Konoha must give us an explanation for this."
Zenkichi asked, "You're going to see the Third Hokage?"
Genji nodded. "You two, come with me."
Zenkichi and Terumi Mei followed him to the Hokage's office. The pipe-smoking Third Hokage greeted them warmly.
"This was all a misunderstanding," Hiruzen said with a smile. "Zenkichi wasn't harmed. Let's not dwell on it."
Genji wasn't satisfied and started arguing with the Hokage.
The two elders argued back and forth—neither yielding—until Zenkichi began to lose patience.
He interrupted, "Third Hokage, if I tried to assassinate you and failed, would we also just 'forget it'?"
The Hokage's face stiffened. "That's different. Genjutsu isn't lethal. It's not the same as attempted assassination."
Zenkichi lazily responded, "Enough nonsense. Just tell me what compensation you're offering."
The Third Hokage relented. "Very well. As an apology, Konoha is willing to offer three million ryō in compensation. Consider it a gesture of goodwill."
The secret test had ended in failure, so the Hokage used this excuse to meet them directly.
Then he added, "To foster understanding between our villages, I propose a friendly competition between Konoha and the three young shinobi of Kirigakure."
After thinking it over, Zenkichi accepted the idea.
It wasn't realistic to expect Konoha to bleed over this. Times were tough, even for them. Three million wasn't much—it was only a tenth of the bounty on Asuma's head.
Elder Genji silently lifted his teacup and gave the Hokage a pointed look, as if to say: He's not wrong.
The Third Hokage choked on his pipe and glared at Genji, silently asking him to keep his student in check.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 9 - 9: Konohagakure Vs Kirigakure.
chapters.content:
Elder Genji agreed to the proposal of the Third Hokage, Sarutobi Hiruzen.
Back at the guest house, Elder Genji gathered Zenkichi and the other two, giving them a serious warning about what to pay attention to during the upcoming competition.
"Konoha has always been famous in the ninja world for its abundance of geniuses. You must not take tomorrow's match lightly."
"Your performance directly affects the leverage our Kirigakure Village has when negotiating with Konoha."
Elder Genji looked stern, clearly taking the match seriously.
Zenkichi waved his hand casually and said, "Don't worry! Even if Sarutobi Hiruzen showed up himself, I'm confident I wouldn't lose!"
Elder Genji smiled slightly. "Zenkichi, you've got some special abilities—I'm not too worried about you. What concerns me more are Yagura and Terumi Mei."
Not to be outdone, Terumi Mei replied, "I've mastered the limits of both my kekkei genkai. As long as my opponent isn't too monstrous, I'm confident I can win."
The Terumi clan could be considered a bloodline family, though a small one. Their numbers were limited, and in comparison to large-scale kekkei genkai clans like the Kaguya or the Yuki clan, they were closer to a civilian ninja clan.
For decades, the Terumi clan had produced no kekkei genkai users—until Terumi Mei. She was the first in generations to awaken such power.
She not only inherited Lava Release (a corrosive, acidic type), but also developed Boil Release (acid mist), placing her strength among the top of the younger generation in Kirigakure.
Given all this, her pride was understandable.
Without the ability to back it up, she wouldn't even dream of competing for the position of Mizukage.
Yagura stayed silent for a moment, then said slowly, "I may not have special abilities or kekkei genkai, but I believe I'm strong enough to deal with most young shinobi."
Elder Genji nodded slightly, recognizing the strength in both of them.
These two were future Fourth and Fifth Mizukage. Their talent and ability were unquestionable.
Zenkichi glanced at Yagura and Terumi Mei, falling into thought.
Could he afford to relax, just riding on the strength of these two?
But then he shook his head inwardly.
Relax?
He couldn't rely entirely on others. If he wanted peace, he had to earn it himself.
As expected… only I can revitalize Kirigakure Village.
---
The next day.
Konoha Stadium.
This was the same arena where the Chūnin Exams were held in the original timeline. A vast battlefield, perfect for shinobi combat.
The surrounding stands were already packed with Leaf Village spectators. The crowd buzzed with anticipation.
"So many people? Don't tell me Konoha is letting them watch for free?" Zenkichi asked, squirming in his front-row seat and looking around restlessly.
Terumi Mei, standing beside him, replied, "I saw it. Konoha's charging for admission."
"What? That's ridiculous!" Zenkichi frowned. "We came all the way from Kirigakure just to make money for Konoha?"
Elder Genji shot Zenkichi a glance. "Then what do you want to do about it?"
"This concerns Kirigakure's interests," Zenkichi said with a serious face. "If the Leaf wants to profit off our fight, they should give us half the earnings."
Elder Genji thought for a moment, then nodded. "I'll bring it up with the Third Hokage later."
Just then, a young girl's voice nearby shouted, "You're just trying to cheat Konoha's money! You bad guys from Kirigakure!"
Zenkichi turned his head and saw a little red-eyed girl glaring angrily at him.
Although she was clearly directing her insults at all of Kirigakure, her gaze was locked on Zenkichi alone.
He stroked his chin, narrowing his eyes. He recognized the girl—Naruto fans would too. The future beauty: Yuhi Kurenai.
"You seem to hate me..." Zenkichi muttered, puzzled, looking at the man standing beside her.
The middle-aged man wore dark sunglasses and had a cold expression. Zenkichi realized he was likely Kurenai's father.
"Wait a second… that chakra. You... you were the one who tested me with genjutsu the other day!"
Zenkichi suddenly understood why Kurenai looked so hostile—it wasn't just a first impression.
"And the sunglasses—are you wearing those because you admire me, or are you still recovering from my light-based jutsu?" he teased, raising an eyebrow at Yuhi Mahong.
"Hmph!" Mahong grunted, clearly annoyed, but didn't reply.
"Jerk!" Kurenai snapped, baring her teeth at him in childish anger.
"Little brat, you know nothing," Zenkichi shot back, rolling his eyes.
He then formed a water clone with a hand seal and sent it off on a separate mission.
Elder Genji frowned. "The match is about to begin—why are you dispersing chakra?"
Zenkichi gave a lazy smile. "I just remembered something important. The clone is handling it. Don't worry—it won't affect the match."
---
Hokage's Office.
The Third Hokage observed the three young men standing before him with satisfaction.
Namikaze Minato, Uchiha Fugaku, and Hyūga Hizashi—each a rising star in Konoha, and more than capable of representing the village in the matches ahead.
"Today's match is very important to Konoha," the Third Hokage said. "Your performance will directly affect the village's standing."
After giving them a few more instructions, he led them to the stadium.
---
"Remember to bring up the payment when the time comes."
"Are we drawing lots? I bet it's all rigged."
"They'll definitely send someone who counters our fighting styles."
"At worst, they'll find some excuse to nerf us."
Zenkichi leaned lazily on his chair, muttering to himself as he watched the Third Hokage on the platform above.
"First match: Terumi Mei vs. Namikaze Minato!"
After some movements on the high platform, the first round was announced.
Zenkichi looked up at the big screen. Both participants were familiar names.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 10 - 10: Flying Thunder God.
chapters.content:
Terumi Mei said solemnly, "Minato Namikaze? I've heard of him."
"Konoha is really shameless! They actually sent a Kage-level ninja to deal with me, a regular Chuunin."
At this point, Namikaze Minato had already made quite a name for himself on the battlefield.
The name "Yellow Flash" had been spreading across Iwagakure. His reputation had grown tremendously.
However, the current Namikaze Minato hadn't yet developed the Rasengan, and most of his kills relied on his kunai.
He became a Kage-level threat primarily due to the Flying Thunder God Technique and his unmatched speed. His raw destructive power wasn't particularly overwhelming.
But after all, most ninjas are high-offense, low-defense types. For most, even a kunai is deadly enough.
Moreover, Minato's Flying Thunder God Technique made him practically untouchable to ordinary Chuunin and Genin. He completely outclassed them.
His ability to dispatch them was like mowing down grass, and his threat level was far higher than most Kage-tier shinobi.
"Don't worry! At worst, you'll just lose faster," Zenkichi said, trying to comfort Terumi Mei.
She rolled her eyes and said with a bitter expression, "Minato Namikaze earned the name Yellow Flash on the battlefield."
"They say his Flying Thunder God Technique is so fast, his entire body becomes a golden blur—and he can kill in an instant."
"Aren't you worried that if he makes a mistake or goes rogue, I'll be dead?"
Zenkichi smiled casually. "You don't have to worry. As long as I'm here, nothing will happen to you."
Although Namikaze Minato was strong, Zenkichi's observation skills and laser-like precision were no joke.
With his sensory prowess and light-speed attacks, Zenkichi was fully confident he could protect Terumi Mei.
Even if Minato had been assigned to assassinate her during the match, Zenkichi was certain he could keep her safe.
Terumi Mei exhaled deeply and said, "Since you're so confident, I'll go."
She stepped down from the spectator seats and entered the stadium.
Minato Namikaze, with his signature blond hair, entered with a warm smile on his face.
Many of the older women in the crowd applauded him enthusiastically.
"What a charming man!"
"Hard to believe someone with such a gentle smile is a killer on the battlefield!"
"The Flying Thunder God Technique he uses to slaughter enemy ninjas is terrifying!"The source of thɪs content is ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Zenkichi nonchalantly pulled out a pair of nail scissors and began trimming his nails.
"Yellow Flash? Honestly, I think that name would suit you better," he remarked casually.
Master Genji, seated next to Zenkichi, chuckled and responded, "Yellow Flash?"
"Namikaze Minato earned that title with his technique and that rare blond hair."
"Flash refers to his speed with the Flying Thunder God. Yellow, for that brilliant hair. It fits."
"Too bad he got the name first."
Zenkichi smirked lazily. "Not really interested in the name Yellow Flash."
"With my strength, I could earn a title of my own."
Yagura scoffed. "Even if I wanted a title, it wouldn't be something like 'Yellow Flash.'"
"That doesn't capture the full extent of my power."
"Flash? That's just sparkle. I don't just shine—I radiate. How about… 'Golden Sun'?"
"I am the sun!"
Zenkichi smiled as he said it, in such a relaxed tone that it didn't even sound like he was serious.
"Forget it," he added. "Nicknames like that are better left to your enemies."
Genji shook his head, ending the conversation.
As they chatted, Terumi Mei and Minato Namikaze began to engage in fierce combat inside the arena.
Minato pulled out several special kunai from his ninja pouch—each one inscribed with the Flying Thunder God seal.
He scattered them across the stadium—some on the ground, some embedded in the walls.
"Namikaze Minato? What a handsome guy…"
"Too bad he's a little too… pretty-boy for my taste."
Terumi Mei looked at Minato, formed hand seals, then suddenly spat a stream of acid from her mouth.
"Lava Release: Dissolving Jutsu!"
The corrosive liquid surged toward Minato. But with a flicker of motion, he used the Flying Thunder God Technique to teleport instantly—appearing behind Terumi Mei.
He calmly picked up one of his marked kunai and threw it toward her without hesitation.
Terumi Mei narrowly dodged by leaning aside—barely avoiding the kunai.
But Minato's combat instincts were razor sharp. The moment she dodged, he appeared beside another of his kunai, grabbed it mid-air, and swept it toward her neck.
Terumi Mei didn't panic. Instead, she smirked slightly—then her body exploded into a crashing wave.
Water Clone!
The real Terumi Mei hadn't been hit. That was just a clone made of water.
Minato immediately teleported to the edge of the stadium using another kunai.
In the original series, even the Fourth Raikage pushing his physical limits couldn't corner Minato. His reflexes and reaction speed were among the best in the ninja world.
As the water clone exploded, the surge of liquid rushed to trap Minato inside a prison of water.
Water Style: Water Prison Jutsu!
The clone hadn't been a decoy—it had used all its chakra to cast the jutsu as it burst.
"Water Style: Hidden Mist Jutsu!"
Another Terumi Mei emerged from the ground, then burst into mist, rapidly filling the arena with dense fog.
The real Terumi Mei was still hiding underground. She already knew some of Minato's abilities and understood that a direct clash would be suicide.
"Winning is hard… but maybe I can at least go down fighting," she thought to herself. "I just can't afford to lose too badly."

chapters.title: Chapter 11 - 11:Hyuga's Byakugan.
chapters.content:
Water mist filled the center of the stadium, and the audience erupted in an uproar.
They had come to witness the results of the ninja battle, but Terumi Mei's jutsu blocked their view, leaving them frustrated.
"Wind Release—Typhoon Breakthrough!"
Namikaze Minato decided to show his hand. Possessing Wind-nature chakra, he was highly proficient in Wind Release.
He unleashed the jutsu, and the powerful gust blew away the mist Terumi Mei had created, revealing Minato standing alone at the center of the stadium.
"Earth Style—Hiding Underground? Earth Release—Ground Ripple!"
Minato formed hand seals. The earth beneath him rippled like waves.
Underground, Terumi Mei felt the disturbance. No longer able to hide, she was forced to emerge.
A kunai flew through the air—Minato vanished in a flash. In an instant, he reappeared with the kunai pressed against Terumi Mei's back.
"…I lost."
Terumi Mei had no choice but to admit defeat.
Cheers erupted from the Konoha crowd.
After all, they were Konoha villagers—and what they wanted to see was a Konoha ninja standing victorious.
"The Yellow Flash… so terrifying!"
"That speed, that teleportation! His reaction time isn't even human—he's already at Kage-level… what a monster!"
A greasy voice interrupted, drawing glances from the surrounding audience.
Master Genji gave Zenkichi a quick look, but his face remained neutral, though faint disappointment flickered in his eyes.
It didn't matter whether Terumi Mei or Yagura lost. Truthfully, they had only come to Konoha to participate.
The one Kirigakure truly had high hopes for… was always Zenkichi.
"Let them have their moment," Master Genji thought. "They'll regret it soon enough."
"You lost!"
A cheerful voice rang out. The young Kurenai Yuhi, sitting not far from Zenkichi, waved at him triumphantly.
To her, this guy—who made her father act all awkward and wear those tacky silver sunglasses—was a source of endless resentment.
"I see now. Konoha… really is strong."
Zenkichi replied calmly, lips curling with mild indifference.
"I lost," Terumi Mei muttered as she returned to him, disappointment written across her face.
"Don't be too hard on yourself. Losing to Namikaze Minato is no disgrace."
Zenkichi consoled her. Minato's Flying Thunder God Technique was indeed incredible.
If this were a game, Minato would easily be the top assassin in the canon.
No doubt.
"Not a shame to lose to Namikaze Minato? Does that include you?" Terumi Mei asked, eyes sparkling with interest.
Zenkichi shrugged. "Of course not. No one can beat me easily—not even Minato."
At that moment, the second match of the day was announced.
After some behind-the-scenes decisions, the next match was set: Yagura vs. Hiashi Hyuga.
Zenkichi leaned forward with interest. "Let's go, Yagura! Show them the terrifying power hiding in that little body of yours."
Yagura's eye twitched slightly. He was starting to regret provoking Zenkichi.
Yagura and Hiashi Hyuga stood in the center of the arena, facing each other with calm expressions.
Zenkichi watched closely, especially curious about Yagura's strength without the aid of the Three-Tails.
"Water Release—Great Water Jet!"
As the match began, Yagura didn't hesitate. A massive surge of water burst from his mouth, forming a towering wave that crashed toward Hiashi.
Hiashi's expression sharpened. He leapt into the air and used chakra to tread on the water, swiftly charging toward Yagura.
The Hyuga clan specialized in taijutsu. Their Gentle Fist style, combined with the Byakugan, was their signature.
Though their Byakugan could see over great distances, the clan excelled at close-quarters combat.
"Eight Trigrams: Vacuum Palm!"
Hiashi rapidly approached and fired a burst of compressed chakra from his palm—like an invisible cannonball—straight at Yagura.
"Water Release—Water Formation Wall!"
Using the water now flooding the arena, Yagura quickly formed seals and summoned a thick wall of water that rose to meet Hiashi's attack.
It blocked the chakra burst with a splash.
"Water Release—Five Feeding Sharks!"
Yagura pressed his palm against the water. Five liquid sharks surged upward and charged toward Hiashi with vicious speed.
"Eight Trigrams: Rotation!"
Hiashi remained calm. He spun on the spot, releasing chakra in a dome-like shield that repelled the sharks with force. They shattered into harmless spray.
"The Hyuga clan… Konoha's strongest!"
Hiashi gritted his teeth at the thought but didn't dare speak it aloud.
After all, the Uchiha clan was considered the strongest in Konoha these days. The Hyuga were strong, but they couldn't compare.
"Kirigakure and the Hyuga have clashed many times over the years," Zenkichi observed. "The Hyuga's Rotation is powerful—nearly impenetrable—but it's not without flaws."
Yagura stared at Hiashi mid-spin. His sharp eyes flickered with insight.
The Eight Trigrams Rotation couldn't guard against attacks from below.
Yagura formed seals again.
Suddenly, the water beneath Hiashi surged. A high-pressure water spear shot up from the surface—right toward him.
"What a huge chakra… and that Water Release is terrifying!"
Zenkichi's eyes lit up.
Yagura's ability to become the Fourth Mizukage wasn't just because of the Three-Tails. In fact, being a Jinchūriki might've been a hindrance to that goal.
"A small frame… with the soul of a monster," Zenkichi muttered, shaking his head.
Terumi Mei, nearby, glanced at him and resisted the urge to hit him.
If she didn't already know Zenkichi's strength, she might have thought he was admiring Yagura too much.
But after everything, she knew better.

Yagura's sneak attack caught Hiashi off guard.
Luckily, the Hyuga clan had refined their techniques over generations. The Eight Trigrams Rotation had built-in contingencies.

chapters.title: Chapter 12 - 12: Countermeasures.
chapters.content:
Yagura and Hyuga Hiashi fought fiercely, and the Konoha residents in the audience watched with excitement.
Compared to the battle between Minato and Mei Terumi, the battle between Hiashi and Yagura was more engaging.
After all, Namikaze Minato is a pure assassin. He darts around during battle, leaving only a blur of golden light in the field.
Mei Terumi, on the other hand, was evasive during the previous fight. As a ranged-type shinobi, she hid at a distance and continuously cast ninjutsu to attack Minato.
All in all, although their battle was intense, it lacked the thrill of a direct clash.
But Hiashi and Yagura were different.
Though Hiashi also uses chakra, his style leans heavily toward close combat.
Yagura, while skilled in Water Release, also has solid taijutsu and can be considered a balanced fighter in both ninjutsu and hand-to-hand combat.
Their battle was a mix of close-quarters fighting and ninjutsu, intense and full of highlights. There wasn't a dull moment throughout the match.The most update n0vels are published on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Of course, this was just the opinion of the Konoha villagers—people like Zenkichi saw it differently.
Zenkichi found their fight so boring that he took out his nail clippers and began trimming his nails for what must've been the tenth time.
After tidying up his nails, Zenkichi pulled a sealing scroll from his robe under Mei Terumi's stunned gaze, unsealing a thermos from within.
He calmly unscrewed the cap and took a sip of tea, glancing lazily at Terumi Mei.
"I lost to you," Terumi Mei said with a helpless sigh.
Not long after, the battle between Yagura and Hiashi also concluded. Although Hiashi was strong, he couldn't close the gap between himself and someone like Yagura, a shinobi capable of becoming a Mizukage.
For example, against someone like Senju Hashirama, no number of counter techniques could stop the overwhelming force of a Forest Release. Counters can help close a gap—but only to a point. A significant power difference still determines the outcome.
Even clever planning or backstage manipulation can only go so far—you still need strength to win!
Yagura sneered.
Yagura, worthy of being the future Fourth Mizukage, defeated Hiashi at the cost of sustaining some injuries.
"Congratulations," Zenkichi said with a small smile as Yagura returned, looking battered but proud.
Yagura scoffed. "Worry about yourself! Your opponent is from the Uchiha clan. In a one-on-one fight, they always come out on top."
"To be chosen by Konoha to face you, your opponent probably already awakened the Sharingan."
Just then, an announcement rang out from the high platform.
"The third match: Arakawa Zenkichi vs. Uchiha Fugaku!"
A boy wearing a standard Konoha flak jacket stepped into the arena. On the back of his uniform was a fan symbol—the crest of the Uchiha clan.
"Uchiha Fugaku, huh?" Zenkichi looked at the father of future legends like Itachi and Sasuke. At this point in time, Fugaku was still a young shinobi.
Well, "young" was relative. The three-tomoe Sharingan swirling in his eyes said plenty about his strength.
A burst of golden light exploded from Zenkichi's body as he transformed into particles of light and shot toward the center of the stadium.
The countless golden particles reassembled opposite Uchiha Fugaku, revealing Zenkichi's form.
"A young Uchiha prodigy, huh?"
"It's scary to awaken the three-tomoe Sharingan at this age," Zenkichi said casually, his tone laced with sarcasm.
"Are you looking down on the Uchiha? That's only because you haven't seen our true power yet," Fugaku replied coldly. His three tomoe rotated rapidly, his gaze sharp and intense.
Up in the stands—
Young Uchiha Obito turned excitedly to Nohara Rin. "Did you see that, Rin? That's the Sharingan—our Uchiha bloodline's power, admired and feared by many!"
"As an Uchiha, I'll awaken my Sharingan too! And I'll carry on this power!"
As he spoke, Obito stole a shy glance at Rin.
Rin smiled kindly, and Obito's face turned bright red, his vision swimming.
He imagined a future where he and Rin had a child together—one who would also inherit the Uchiha blood and awaken the Sharingan...
Back in the arena—
"Uchiha Fugaku, I hope you can figure out what Zenkichi's true ability is," muttered the Third Hokage as he smoked his pipe thoughtfully.
The Uchiha's Sharingan is famed for analyzing enemy weaknesses, even the flaws in ninjutsu.
Arranging Fugaku as Zenkichi's opponent wasn't just about competition—it was also a test for Konoha.
"Evil-eyed Fugaku… He's not to be underestimated," the Third Hokage said quietly.
"Young Uchiha," Zenkichi said as he looked at Fugaku, "do you know what I really am?"
"I am the sun."
As his words rang out, a blinding golden light burst from Zenkichi's body.
Fugaku instinctively closed his eyes, and the Konoha villagers in the stands quickly looked away.
"So bright!"
"I can't even look directly at it!"
Gasps of surprise echoed across the stadium. Many in the crowd couldn't even watch the fight anymore.
"I can keep fighting like this. Can you?"
"You Uchiha rely so much on your eyes. If even the Sharingan can't bear to look at me, how will you fight me?"
Zenkichi's expression was calm as he observed his opponent.
He wanted to see if Konoha had developed any countermeasures to this ability.
"It's just bright light. I'll wear sunglasses."
Fugaku scoffed and pulled out a pair of oversized black shades, slipping them on to shield his eyes from the blinding glare.
With the sunglasses acting as a filter, Fugaku was no longer affected by the intense light. His three tomoe continued spinning behind the tinted lenses, locked on Zenkichi.
"Tch. What a pity."
"The Sharingan's greatest strength is its ability to cast genjutsu through eye contact."
"That kind of instant illusion is hard to defend against—it's one of the main reasons people fear the Uchiha."
"But with those sunglasses on… can you still use that power, young Uchiha?"
Zenkichi chuckled.
Konoha's little sunglasses trick might help against the glare, but it wouldn't affect him much at all.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 13 - 13: Making Money.
chapters.content:
There was a lot of chatter in the audience.
Zenkichi suddenly shone brightly, making the Konoha villagers feel uncomfortable.
Endless golden light enveloped the center of the stadium, and the villagers couldn't see Zenkichi or Uchiha Fugaku at all.
"Why is it like this?"
"Yeah! We can't even see the fight. We didn't buy tickets just to stare at a wall of light!"
"Refund! Refund!"
…
The crowd started to get restless, causing the Third Hokage to furrow his brows in confusion.
"Anyone want to buy sunglasses? Just put them on and you'll be able to see everything!"
"Relax! This fight's just getting started. The real show begins once everyone's got their sunglasses!"
A playful voice called out from the stands. Everyone turned and saw Zenkichi standing in the audience—selling sunglasses enthusiastically.
The Third Hokage: "..."
Looking at the golden light shrouding the center of the stadium, then back at Zenkichi—who was smiling and selling sunglasses among the spectators—the Third Hokage was momentarily speechless.
Konoha's White Fang narrowed his eyes. As the head of the ANBU, he moved swiftly and appeared next to Zenkichi.
"Why are you here?" he asked sharply.
Zenkichi grinned. "Don't worry, this is just a water clone. It's doing what I told it to do earlier."
At the same time, the ANBU members who had been monitoring Zenkichi earlier reported his activity to the Third Hokage.
Zenkichi had created a water clone in advance and sent it to buy out every pair of sunglasses in Konoha.
With the money compensated by the Third Hokage, no less.
The sunglasses that had originally been ordered by the Hokage's office were meant for crowd distribution. Now, thanks to Zenkichi buying out the remaining stock, they were sold out across the village.
The sunglasses that had been officially distributed couldn't be recalled, and no new pairs could be issued to the spectators.
In other words—Zenkichi now held a monopoly on all available sunglasses in Konoha. Shamelessly, he sold them at inflated prices.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
He priced them the same as the original ticket price.
The Third Hokage's eyelid twitched.
"This must be a violation, right?"
Watching Konoha villagers reluctantly paying Zenkichi for sunglasses, the Hokage opened his mouth but hesitated to speak.
Even though Zenkichi wasn't profiting much from this, the sheer nerve of it all made him deeply uncomfortable.
"How could this be a foul? I didn't use anything extra to gain an advantage in the fight," Zenkichi's clone replied with a smile as it suddenly appeared beside the Third Hokage.
"I just made a clone in advance. There are no rules against that, are there?"
"Before the tournament, did anyone say we're not allowed to prepare in advance?"
The ANBU tensed up beside the Hokage, treating Zenkichi like a potential threat.
Zenkichi, of course, didn't seem to care at all. He smiled nonchalantly and said, "Lord Hokage, you know… I actually did this for Konoha."
"Terumi Mei's Hidden Mist Jutsu earlier already upset the spectators."
"In the next round, I'm going to be flashing around constantly. There's no way regular people can follow that kind of speed."
"If that happens, the audience will be disappointed. They might demand refunds after the match."
"But now I'm selling them sunglasses—so they can actually enjoy the fight instead of going home angry."
He sounded casual, but the logic made the Third Hokage pause.
The Hokage didn't say much more. After a moment, he nodded slightly and took out a pair of sunglasses.
Most of the batch bought by the village had been issued to ANBU and senior officials. Naturally, the Hokage had a pair himself.
---
Back in the arena—
Zenkichi split and reformed effortlessly, engaging Fugaku while letting enemy attacks phase right through him. With his body transformed into light, he could slip through attacks or shift his condition at will.
Uchiha Fugaku looked grim. The kunai in his hand kept passing through Zenkichi's body, doing no damage at all.
With the sunglasses filtering out the glare, the audience could finally see the battle unfold in the center of the stadium.
Zenkichi's sunglasses sold out quickly, and soon everyone was wearing them, watching with excitement.
"It's useless."
"Those attacks are too boring. You can't hurt me, Uchiha boy."
Zenkichi gave Fugaku a playful look, then paused thoughtfully.
"Here, let me show you something fun."
"Look into my eyes!"
Zenkichi's teasing expression pushed Fugaku's anger to the edge. The Uchiha heir leapt back.
His hands formed seals rapidly, and he exhaled:
"Fire Style: Fireball Jutsu!"
A massive fireball surged forward, easily over two meters wide, blazing with intense heat.
It roared toward Zenkichi—
—but he didn't dodge.
The fireball swept straight through his glowing body, hitting nothing.
"Is that… a special ability? Or space-time ninjutsu?" Fugaku's expression grew tense.
The ability to become intangible and phase through attacks—it was infuriating.
"Maybe it's a special ability. Maybe space-time. Who knows?"
"Work harder if you want to beat me, Uchiha boy!"
Now that his sunglasses stock was sold out, Zenkichi raised a glowing finger and pointed at Fugaku.
A brilliant cross of light gathered at his fingertip and began to spin. A glowing circle formed in the center.
One thing's for sure—the Pika Pika no Mi would rank top-tier in visual appeal. Especially the way it gathers energy at the fingertip before launching. Cool, flashy, and totally over-the-top.
"Not good!"
Fugaku's three-tomoe Sharingan spun rapidly as he threw himself flat against the ground.
The cross-shaped beam shot forward with a sharp whoosh, striking the stadium wall.
BOOM!
A massive explosion shook the arena. The reinforced wall cracked and buckled.
"Yikes… that might've been a little too much."
"But honestly, this attack's still kind of weak."
Zenkichi blinked in surprise, then chuckled with no intention of apologizing.
"If we're here to show off our strength…"
"Then why not go all out?"
