chapters.title: Chapter 14 - 14: Immune To Genjutsu.
chapters.content:
The stadium wall was shattered with a single strike. The power of this attack… it must be at least on the level of an S-rank jutsu.
When the Third Hokage saw the devastation caused by Zenkichi's attack, his expression darkened.
"When I fought against him, he didn't seem to have such terrifying strength," he murmured. "Otherwise, we wouldn't have escaped unscathed back then."
"But at this rate, something feels off… How could his power increase so drastically in such a short period?"
Konoha's White Fang stood beside him, equally puzzled. "It doesn't make sense…"
---
In the Arena
Uchiha Fugaku wasn't intimidated by Zenkichi's overwhelming power. Instead, he seized the opportunity.
Using the Body Flicker Technique, he vanished and reappeared directly in front of Zenkichi. His sunglasses had already been discarded, revealing the spinning three-tomoe Sharingan in his eyes.
Genjutsu – Demonic Illusion: Shackling Stakes!
With a flash of the Sharingan, Fugaku cast a powerful illusion that locked Zenkichi's mind. Giant stakes of stone manifested, pinning his body mid-air.
"What a dull trick," Zenkichi muttered.
His body instantly turned to light, dispersing the illusion. Just then, he noticed Fugaku lunging at him with a dagger, aiming straight for his heart.
"Using genjutsu to open an opportunity for attack?" Zenkichi's expression twisted into a smirk. "It's pointless."
Fugaku had assumed that under genjutsu, Zenkichi wouldn't be able to reactivate his light-form—his moment to strike. But Zenkichi's speed in breaking free had far exceeded expectations. The illusion was undone almost instantly.
"Uchiha boy," Zenkichi said lightly. "Speed is weight."
"Have you ever been kicked at the speed of light?"
Golden particles gathered on his leg. He raised it slowly—calm, focused—and then, in an instant, it struck with explosive velocity.
Boom!
Fugaku was launched across the battlefield, crashing into the stadium wall. Cracks spread across the stone.
"Substitution?" Zenkichi narrowed his eyes.
Among the debris, only a splintered wooden log remained—proof that Fugaku had used the Substitution Technique at the last second.
The log, struck by light-speed force, splintered into fragments as it hit the wall.
"Impressive… To use a Substitution Technique that quickly," Zenkichi said calmly. "Uchiha brat… you're not bad."
(Bro's acting like he's not 16, calling fugaku a brat. Lol)
He turned his head, glancing toward a patch of ground nearby.
"You think you can escape me by hiding underground?"
He raised his hand.
Laser Beam.
A concentrated beam of golden light shot from his fingertip and struck the ground with a deafening explosion. The pressure rocked the arena.
Underground, Fugaku felt the crushing weight of collapsing earth. Desperate not to be buried alive, he leapt upward and burst out of the soil.
Laser. Laser. Laser…
Dodge. Dodge. Dodge…
Zenkichi smiled and casually clicked his fingers. More golden lasers erupted from his hand, each one dodged narrowly by Fugaku.
"I've heard the Sharingan can predict an opponent's movements," Zenkichi mused. "Is that how you're dodging every one of my attacks?"
He grinned.
"Truly, the Uchiha clan is terrifying."
The power of the Sharingan was undeniable—Zenkichi acknowledged that much. The Uchiha bloodline had created legendary shinobi whose mastery of genjutsu and battle perception was unparalleled.
---
Fugaku's face twisted with anger. Zenkichi's calm remarks grated at his pride.
The Sharingan—capable of casting illusions with a glance, seeing chakra flow, copying jutsu and taijutsu, and reacting with unmatched clarity—was indeed a fearsome kekkei genkai.
But against Zenkichi's abilities… it suddenly seemed lacking.
Yes, the Sharingan was powerful. Fugaku had awakened the three-tomoe form at a young age and took pride in his heritage.
But comparing it to Zenkichi's power? It was like comparing a candle to the sun.
The blinding light alone could disrupt vision and instantly neutralize most Uchiha fighters unprepared for the brightness.
Even the sunglasses that protected the spectators now dulled the Sharingan's signature genjutsu. The instant illusion, usually triggered by eye contact, was rendered useless when no one could even see the tomoe beneath the lenses.
Without the ability to make direct eye contact, the Sharingan's strongest tool—visual genjutsu—was sealed away.
Though its insight and predictive ability remained, Zenkichi's "Glint Glint Fruit" power wasn't just about radiance.
Turning into light, becoming intangible, firing devastating lasers, immunity to most illusions… Zenkichi had counters for nearly everything.
Fugaku wasn't even sure if Zenkichi's resistance to genjutsu was because of his transformation ability or something else entirely. Either way, he had dispelled Fugaku's illusions instantly every time.
Zenkichi was like a force of nature—unstoppable, brilliant, untouchable.

chapters.title: Chapter 15 - 15:Zenkichi vs. Minato.
chapters.content:
"Are you glaring at me? Such a scary look."
"Evil-eyed Fugaku, is this how you got your title?"
Zenkichi smiled as he spoke, his fingers constantly moving, emitting golden lasers.
Uchiha Fugaku was worn down from constantly dodging. He had spent too much energy, and each narrow escape drained him further.
Looking at the increasingly fatigued Fugaku, Zenkichi said with a smile, "Want to admit defeat, Uchiha kid?"
Although Fugaku knew he had lost, Zenkichi's mocking tone triggered his rebellious spirit.
"What a joke!" Fugaku growled bitterly, determined to resist to the end.
"Really? Then I'll kill you now."
Zenkichi's voice was flat as he raised a hand and fired a laser that pierced Fugaku's shoulder, dropping him to the ground with a scream.
"How... how is this possible?"
Fugaku was shocked—the Sharingan had predicted the attack wouldn't hit there.
"Surprised? What a disappointment."
"Do you think you're the only one who can predict attacks?"
Zenkichi stared at him with amusement.
"You should've noticed by now—I haven't been serious at all."
Prediction isn't exclusive to the Sharingan. Zenkichi's Kenbunshoku Haki (Observation Haki) could also foresee movements.
Fugaku predicted Zenkichi. Zenkichi predicted Fugaku.
When both fighters have predictive abilities, the stronger one wins.
"Predicting your prediction..." Zenkichi muttered, the familiar cross-shaped flash forming at his fingertips again.
"Since you refuse to surrender—then die."
The cross-shaped laser fired.
Whoosh!
At the critical moment, a white flash shot across the field—
Konoha's White Fang, Hatake Sakumo, suddenly appeared, cleaving the laser beam apart with his blade.
"Ahhh—!"
"Are you joining too, Konoha's White Fang—Hatake Sakumo?" Zenkichi asked lazily.
"Of course not. I won't participate in a match like this," Sakumo replied, his tone calm but serious.
"I stepped in because today's match wasn't meant to be a fight to the death."
"If this continues, someone will die. This match ends here."
"Oh? The game's over? I don't mind," Zenkichi replied with a shrug.
"But who wins and who loses? It can't be a draw."
Zenkichi looked at Sakumo with a lazy smile.
"You win this match," Sakumo said. "But you haven't won the final victory yet. There's still one Konoha contestant you haven't defeated."
Zenkichi smirked. "Namikaze Minato? I'm looking forward to that fight."
His body dissolved into particles of light as he returned to his seat. Terumi Mei greeted him with a congratulatory smile.
The fourth match was set: Zenkichi versus Yagura.
"You really want two Kirigakure shinobi to fight each other? How shameless!"
"Yagura, withdraw from this match!" grumbled Elder Genji, expressing his disapproval at Konoha's behind-the-scenes manipulation.
But he didn't challenge the Third Hokage. Both he and the Hokage understood this match wasn't truly about victory or loss—it was about showcasing the strength of each village's next generation.
Even so, it was against the spirit of the exam for two contestants from the same village to fight each other.
Yagura nodded calmly, showing no strong reaction. He had clearly assessed the gap between his power and Zenkichi's. There was no way he could win right now.
---
"You've given up? That's fine."
"It's a bit much to have Kirigakure's shinobi fighting each other in Konoha's arena anyway."
"Not that I ever intended to let them fight each other."
----
"Minato has a good chance of defeating Zenkichi. Letting Zenkichi waste energy on Yagura first would be wise."
The Third Hokage murmured to himself, then gave the order to announce the final matchup.
---
Inside the Arena
A special kunai was embedded at the center of the arena. Namikaze Minato appeared next to it instantly via the Flying Thunder God Technique.
Zenkichi's appearance was even more dramatic. Countless light particles gathered across from Minato and condensed into Zenkichi's shining form.
"So it's really you in the final round," Zenkichi said. "Didn't expect Konoha to stoop so low, pitting me and Yagura against each other first."
"So you'd be at your peak for this fight—Konoha really has no shame."

"Doesn't matter."

Zenkichi looked at him calmly. "You mean you already know you'll lose?"
Minato's expression darkened. "You mean... you're certain you'll win?"
"Of course," Zenkichi replied. "I know you've prepared some tricks for me—but they're meaningless."
Without a word, Minato pulled out a large handful of special kunai and threw them in all directions, scattering them around the stadium.

chapters.title: Chapter 16 - 16: Sealing Jutsu.
chapters.content:
"Namikaze Minato, what are you doing?"
Zenkichi looked at Namikaze Minato with a puzzled expression. At this moment, Minato was attacking Zenkichi with a special kunai. The kunai kept phasing through Zenkichi's body without causing any damage. But Minato didn't seem discouraged and continued using the kunai to attack as if nothing was wrong.
Zenkichi observed him quietly. After a moment, he suddenly smiled and said, "I understand what you're doing. Fine—I'll give you your answer." With that, Zenkichi punched Minato without hesitation. Minato's eyes flashed, and he responded in kind, colliding his fist with Zenkichi's.
"He has a physical form!"
Minato was thrilled—Zenkichi had a tangible body when he attacked.
This had only been a theory on Minato's part, so he'd tried different methods to provoke Zenkichi into attacking, just to test his guess. And he was right.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Next, I'll show you my improvements to the Flying Thunder God."
Minato took a deep breath. It was time to show his real skills.
—
In the stands, the Third Hokage watched the battle between Minato and Zenkichi with a calm expression, but his heart was far from calm.
He desperately hoped Minato could defeat Zenkichi—if only to give Konoha more leverage in negotiations with Kirigakure.
Of course, he didn't want Zenkichi—someone from an enemy village—to continue being this uncontainable.
"Minato, go for it!"
In the stands, a red-haired girl shouted loudly.
She was Uzumaki Kushina, the Nine-Tails' Jinchūriki of Konoha—and Minato's lover.
Earlier, when Minato had the upper hand against Terumi Mei, Kushina hadn't felt the need to cheer. But now that Minato was clearly at a disadvantage, she didn't hold back.
"Uzumaki Kushina?"
Zenkichi glanced at her briefly, then looked away.
Just another hothead. He wasn't the least bit interested.
"Hm?"
At that moment, Zenkichi noticed Minato's movement—Minato had rushed toward him again with killing intent.
This time, his attack failed deliberately—leaving an opening as bait to provoke Zenkichi.
Zenkichi's lips curled. He instantly realized Minato's ploy and chuckled.
"You fell for it."
Minato grinned internally, then slashed Zenkichi's arm with his kunai without hesitation.
The kunai met solid resistance—like cutting through real flesh. That sensation made Minato thrilled.
A golden arm with a bright gash flew off in the air.
"He cut off my arm just like that... How ruthless."
"Namikaze Minato... what a terrifying man."
Zenkichi looked at his severed arm and made a joking comment.
But the arm that had been cut off immediately disintegrated into light particles and floated back to him—reforming into a perfect limb.
"How did you..."
Minato stared in shock.
"Surprised?"
"When you struck me earlier, did you think I had a real body?"
"When light particles are condensed enough, they're no different from flesh and blood. Who said I have to be in solid form to attack?"
"Everything was your assumption, Minato."
"You want to know why I did this? Because only when you experience it for yourself... can you understand despair."
Zenkichi spoke calmly, his tone laced with amusement.
His ability to elementalize his body was far beyond Uchiha Obito's Kamui.
Obito's technique had a cooldown. Zenkichi's didn't.
Obito had to activate Kamui, but Zenkichi's elementalization was instant—triggered by thought, even by instinct.
In the original timeline, Obito was overwhelmed by Minato using Flying Thunder God. But if it were Zenkichi, there would've been no such opening.
Obito didn't react in time to Minato's attack. Zenkichi, however, could do so instinctively.
Like a reflex, his body would automatically shift into its elemental form when damaged—avoiding harm like a knee-jerk reaction.
"I don't know if fighting me will help you deal with Obito in the future... Probably not."
"As long as I exist, neither that guy nor Uchiha Madara will ever be as arrogant as they were in the original timeline."
Zenkichi muttered quietly, casting a glance toward Uchiha Obito in the audience.
"Despair? I haven't even started!"
Minato wasn't fazed. He formed a rapid sequence of hand seals, black patterns emerging across his body.
These were sealing techniques—preparations for a powerful fūinjutsu.
Zenkichi frowned.
"Sealing jutsu? How boring. You really think something like that will work on me?"
There was no doubt—sealing techniques could be a threat to Zenkichi.
But they were just that: a threat. Not something he feared.
Like how in the pirate world, Admiral Zephyr wore a giant Sea Prism Stone arm to counter Devil Fruit users. It could suppress them, but no Devil Fruit user would be defeated just by the Sea Stone.
"Time to end this!"
Minato let out a low growl and charged forward.
He threw a special kunai toward Zenkichi, and in the blink of an eye, teleported to its location. Dark sealing lines erupted from his body like lightning.
These black lines formed a massive net, aiming to trap and seal Zenkichi.
"Too slow."
Zenkichi snorted. His body turned to light and instantly slipped through the gaps, escaping the sealing net.
"Your sealing technique is decent. But it's way too slow."
"That kind of clumsy attack won't work on someone who moves at the speed of light."
Zenkichi reappeared some distance away, perfectly calm.

chapters.title: Chapter 18 - 18:Kekkei Genkai.
chapters.content:
Konoha White Fang said solemnly: "So, Zenkichi is not only immune to physical attacks and ninjutsu, but also immune to genjutsu?"
Namikaze Minato said: "His ability is definitely unusual, but there are ways to counter it. Even if he turns into light, sealing techniques should be able to restrain him."
The sealing techniques in the Naruto world are indeed powerful. Even the god-like Otsutsuki Kaguya was sealed using the Six Paths — Chibaku Tensei.
Zenkichi can turn himself into light by elementalizing his body, but pure energy still can't escape the restraints of fūinjutsu.
Ordinary sealing marks can't be imprinted on a body made of light, but sealing techniques have strong attraction and can potentially swallow him up.
Shimura Danzo grunted: "Judging by what we've seen so far, sealing doesn't seem to work well against Zenkichi. His speed is simply too fast—the sealing technique can't catch him."
Mitokado Homura said: "If we want to seal him, we'll have to restrain him first. If genjutsu doesn't work, what about the shadow techniques of the Nara clan or the mind techniques of the Yamanaka clan?"
The Nara clan's Shadow Imitation Technique and the Yamanaka clan's Mind Transfer Jutsu are both powerful secret techniques that excel in controlling targets.
Koharu Utatane shook her head: "Zenkichi can emit light and actively destroy his own shadow. The Nara clan's techniques probably won't work."
The Third Hokage said: "The Yamanaka clan's Mind Transfer Jutsu has a downside—it needs precise aim—but if used unexpectedly, it might be able to control Zenkichi."
Though both the Nara and Yamanaka clans use powerful Yin Release techniques, they each come with limitations.
The Nara clan's shadow techniques can only work when both the user and the target have shadows that can connect.
The Yamanaka clan's Mind Transfer Jutsu requires a straight-line aim and fails completely if the target dodges.
Because of their limited attack style, the Yamanaka are often labeled the "Boar" in the Ino-Shika-Cho trio, symbolizing a slow, direct style.
Shimura Danzo narrowed his eyes: "Aside from those, what about the Spiritual Possession Technique?"
This technique allows the user's soul to separate from their body and enter an enemy's body directly, killing them from the inside.
The Third Hokage frowned: "But… only Kato Dan has mastered that technique in all of Konoha."
Shimura Danzo said indifferently: "Exactly. Too few possess these abilities. It's a serious problem."Google seaʀᴄh NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"But there are still other options. What about barrier ninjutsu?"
"We could trap Zenkichi in a barrier, cut him off from food and water for days—eventually he'd be done."
(Imagine if he was actually listening to them with Observation Haki)
The Third Hokage thought for a moment, then nodded with a smile: "That's one possibility. We should test it if we get the chance."
His mood had clearly improved.
Though they still had no one who could face Zenkichi one-on-one, the Third Hokage felt that, with enough strategies and secret techniques, they had a fighting chance.
After chatting a little longer with Uchiha Fukuyama and the others, he dismissed them.
With these methods to counter Zenkichi, the Third Hokage felt confident enough to negotiate with the Mizukage.
Uchiha Fukuyama and the others left—but Shimura Danzo remained.
Among Konoha's elders, Danzo held the most authority and influence.
His bond with Sarutobi Hiruzen ran deeper than anyone else's.
Many even considered Danzo the "dark hand" of the Hokage, handling the village's most shameful and dangerous affairs.
The Third Hokage represented the light of Konoha. Danzo was the darkness that protected it.
The ANBU training facility under Danzo's control—Root—was steadily becoming the Root of Darkness from the original series.
The Third Hokage looked at Danzo and asked: "You stayed behind. Is there something else?"
Shimura Danzo said: "Regarding Zenkichi… how do you plan to handle him?"
The Third Hokage replied calmly: "Handle? Zenkichi is a ninja of Kirigakure. As Hokage, I have no right to handle another village's shinobi."
Shimura Danzo scoffed: "Don't play dumb. You know full well how dangerous his ability is."
"If it's a kekkei genkai, then Kirigakure may have a bloodline more terrifying than the Uchiha or Senju."
"If it's a secret technique, they could train an entire force of users."
"His threat to Konoha is too great—we must eliminate him preemptively."
The Third Hokage frowned: "We're already dealing with Sunagakure and Iwagakure. If we add Kirigakure to that…"
Danzo interrupted: "I understand all that. But this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity."
"If we weren't distracted by the other villages, do you think Zenkichi would dare to show himself in Konoha so boldly?"
A dangerous gleam flashed in Danzo's eyes.
He continued: "Eliminating the threat is only part of it. Studying his abilities is more important."
"If we can unlock the secrets of his power and replicate it among our own shinobi..."
"An army of Konoha shinobi with Zenkichi's ability could dominate the entire ninja world."
Danzo had always been greedy for kekkei genkai and forbidden jutsu.
Under his control, Root had recruited talents from every major clan in Konoha and obtained their hidden techniques.
Even the Senju clan's Wood Release and the Uchiha's Sharingan—he was secretly researching both.
Unfortunately, since these matters had to remain hidden, progress was slow.
This was one reason Danzo looked down on the Third Hokage.
If he were Hokage, he would have forced the clans to hand over their techniques, dissolved their family structures, and centralized power.
Clans with kekkei genkai would be forced into marriages with civilians to dilute and spread their bloodlines.
Their techniques and bloodlines would be studied intensely so even ordinary people could use them.
To Danzo, kekkei genkai and secret techniques were not personal possessions—they belonged to Konoha.
Every shinobi should obey orders and serve the village without question.
Hmm...
All in all, Danzo's ideals were both extreme and naïve.

chapters.title: Chapter 19 - 19: Exposed Plan, Leaving Konoha.
chapters.content:
The Third Hokage took a deep look at Danzo and warned:
"Although this is a rare opportunity, it will put Konoha in a dangerous situation.
I don't allow you to do this, do you understand? I absolutely don't agree with you doing this kind of thing."
"Now I have to negotiate with Elder Genji from Kirigakure. I will be busy arguing with him for a long time.
Don't be idle. You will be responsible for the personnel transfers in Konoha and the frontline army."
After saying this, the Third Hokage picked up his pipe, took a puff, and waved his hand for Danzo to leave.
A gloomy smile appeared on Danzo's face. He turned around and walked out of the Third Hokage's office.
Sarutobi, am I a joke to you? Danzo cursed in his heart. It was obvious that the Third Hokage wanted to betray him.
Damn it!
Fortunately, Danzo was used to this kind of thing, and he wasn't too disappointed.
If other shinobi were to take the blame in such a situation, they'd likely be doomed.
But Shimura Danzo wasn't like others. Sarutobi Hiruzen was never willing to let Danzo die.
Even in the original timeline, Danzo made countless mistakes, yet Hiruzen chose to forgive him.
Even when Danzo tried to assassinate Hiruzen Sarutobi, the Third Hokage still forgave him.
Hiruzen Sarutobi truly had deep affection for Danzo Shimura.
---
"All personnel transfers within Konoha and the frontline troops will be handed over to Danzo? Isn't this basically giving him free rein?"
In the Konoha guest house, Zenkichi, who had been basking in the sun with his eyes closed, suddenly opened them.
He hadn't expected the Third Hokage to release a mad dog like Shimura Danzo.
Zenkichi groaned.
If he wanted to leave, he, Elder Genji and the others could escape before Konoha finished preparing.
But… leaving like that felt like running away with his tail between his legs. Zenkichi felt reluctant.
He imitated Kizaru, but he wasn't truly Kizaru.
The imitation depended on his intent—partial or full.
He wasn't controlled by the template and didn't follow Kizaru's mindset.
"How about staying here and enjoying myself for a while?"
"With so many strong ninja in Konoha, they might help me unlock a higher level of the template, right?"
The corner of Zenkichi's mouth curled up with a playful smile.
The Third Hokage and Shimura Danzo had no idea that Zenkichi's Observation Haki could cover the entire village, easily eavesdropping on their plans.
(Hehe..)
---
"Elder Genji!"
Zenkichi approached the elder, who had just returned from negotiating with Sarutobi Hiruzen.
"Zenkichi, what is it? I've been busy arguing with Hiruzen lately. If there's nothing urgent, you and Terumi Mei can enjoy yourselves."
Elder Genji smiled, looking as kind as an ordinary old man.
But in truth, he didn't dare treat Zenkichi like a normal ninja anymore.
Zenkichi said seriously, "According to the intel I received, Konoha is planning to attack us."ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Elder Genji was shocked. "What did you say? That's impossible. Where did you learn this?"
Zenkichi replied firmly, "Don't ask how. Just know that the intel is accurate."
"Hiruzen is negotiating with you on the surface, but Danzo is secretly moving troops."
"They haven't acted yet only because the forces meant to deal with me are still returning from the front lines."
"Of course, my threat is also a big reason they're rushing to act."
After listening, Elder Genji's expression turned grim. He said with urgency, "If that's true, we must leave immediately."
Zenkichi shook his head. "Not we—you. You go first. I'll stay behind."
Elder Genji's face hardened. "No! If someone must stay behind, it'll be the three of us, not just you."
"You may not understand your value, but I'll tell you clearly—Lord Mizukage sees you as the key to Kirigakure's future."
"Your strength, your potential—you're the one who must be protected."
Zenkichi replied calmly, "Don't be ridiculous. Why would I need protection? I'm staying because I know I can get out."
"If I want to leave, no one in this world can stop me. Not even Konoha."
"Don't mention that they're focused on Sunagakure and Iwagakure. Even if they mobilized their entire army, they still couldn't touch me."
Zenkichi spoke with confidence—and he had every right to.
His ability to transform into light made him immune to nearly all attacks in the shinobi world. His speed was unmatched.
Combined with his Haki, which allowed him to sense and predict opponents' movements, Zenkichi was nearly untouchable.
He smiled. "Tell Sarutobi Hiruzen that Kirigakure will let me handle negotiations.
Also, let me be clear: based on my strength, I'm more than capable of eliminating any enemy that comes."
Zenkichi's tone was unshakable, and Gen could see the truth in it.
After a moment of thought, Elder Genji finally nodded in reluctant agreement.
Let's see how this unfolds. Let's see how Zenkichi fights his way out of this.
Just a mere Konoha dares to oppose him?
---
"You take Terumi Mei and the others with you. I'll send a clone to escort you and make sure no one tries to intercept you."
"They're after me, not you. You'll be fine."
Elder Genji nodded silently and left the guest house.
Shortly after, Sarutobi Hiruzen stared at him in shock.
"Elder Genji, are you serious?"
Elder Genji replied calmly, "What's the issue? With Zenkichi's strength, he's more than qualified to negotiate on behalf of Kirigakure."
"To be honest, he's the best candidate to become the next Mizukage. His words hold weight."
"As for us… something has come up in the village. We must return. We leave tomorrow."
Sarutobi Hiruzen said nothing more. At this point, he had no room to argue.
At least Zenkichi would remain.
Still, Hiruzen couldn't shake a growing unease, a feeling that all his plans had been seen through.
No… it's just my imagination, he tried to reassure himself.

chapters.content:
"Zenkichi, are you really not coming with us?"
At the entrance of Konoha Village, Terumi Mei looked at Zenkichi with a worried expression.
Zenkichi smiled and said, "Konoha is very enthusiastic. I decided to stay and play with them a bit. Besides, I never said I wouldn't go with you!"
He created a clone and added casually, "This clone also has considerable strength—enough to protect you on the way back to Kirigakure."
Not far away,
Uchiha Fugaku's Sharingan spun with three tomoe as he said calmly, "The real Zenkichi stayed. The one who left only carries about one-tenth of his chakra."
Uchiha Fukuyama frowned. "What exactly is Kirigakure doing? Why are they leaving so suddenly?"
"Leaving is fine, but why is Zenkichi's real body staying behind? This feels like something bad is about to happen."
Fugaku pondered aloud, "Could it be that Konoha's higher-ups had a plan that was somehow discovered by Kirigakure?"
Fukuyama suddenly added, "That makes sense! Anbu came by earlier today and mobilized some Uchiha clan members."
Just as they were discussing this, golden light suddenly erupted nearby.
Zenkichi's figure appeared beside them. He smiled. "You two, what are you doing here?"
Fukuyama's expression shifted. He spoke sharply, "Zenkichi, what are you doing here?"
"Do you know how rude it is to suddenly appear like that? You're not even a Konoha ninja. What if you overheard confidential information?"Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Zenkichi exaggeratedly replied, "Oh, you were talking about secrets? That's serious! I didn't expect it to be that bad—how scary!"
Fukuyama frowned and was about to speak again, but Zenkichi continued casually, "I just felt someone watching me, so I came to check."
"It was rude of me to appear so suddenly—but isn't it equally questionable for you to be secretly observing me?"
"Konoha ninjas! Could you please stop with the double standards? Talking about secrets doesn't scare me."
Fugaku's face changed slightly. Even his expression turned awkward.
They had indeed been ordered to observe Zenkichi—and Zenkichi had caught them. It wasn't a good look.
"Forget it. Let's drop the subject," Zenkichi said with a wave, clearly uninterested in pursuing it further.
He was already prepared for a confrontation with Konoha. There was no point in fussing over minor things.
With his Observation Haki, he enveloped all of Konoha and was aware of every movement and personnel change in the village.
Earlier that morning, White Fang, Mitokado Homura, and Koharu Utatane had set off with their teams to the frontlines, replacing Orochimaru, Jiraiya, and Tsunade.
Well, Kato Dan was among them…
Dan's Spirit Transformation Technique could be used against Zenkichi, though that was hardly a threat.
Orochimaru's snake venom might work to assassinate him—if it did, there would be no need for a direct confrontation.
Jiraiya had mastered various sealing techniques and was one of the few in Konoha skilled in them.
Many Konoha ninja knew some form of sealing, and there were even sealing divisions—but their level was average.
The one with the highest sealing proficiency in Konoha was Uzumaki Kushina. The sealing techniques of the Uzumaki Clan were unique in the shinobi world.
Because Namikaze Minato had gotten close to Kushina, he had also learned many powerful sealing methods.
Jiraiya, as Minato's teacher and the Third Hokage's student, had also gained access to powerful sealing jutsu.
Under those dual connections, Jiraiya had been exposed to many high-level techniques.
As for Tsunade...
She didn't have much to counter Zenkichi with. She was only recalled to serve as a backup for Konoha.
If they were going to move against Zenkichi, Konoha needed to be fully prepared.
Without Tsunade—the best medical ninja in the world—Shimura Danzo and Hiruzen Sarutobi wouldn't feel safe.
After all, they only had one life each.
With Tsunade around, casualties might be kept low, and the lives of Konoha's upper echelon would be protected.
As for medical needs on the front lines, they would leave those to other medical ninja. Koharu, for instance.
Although Koharu wasn't on Tsunade's level, she could handle most problems.
If something happened she couldn't fix, well, that would be unfortunate—but the safety of the village leadership came first.
Compared to the shinobi forces on the front, Konoha's leadership was more important.
Mitokado Homura, Koharu, and White Fang posed no real threat to Zenkichi.
Those with real potential—Jiraiya, Orochimaru, and Tsunade—had been called back.
Zenkichi knew all of this.
Not just the important things, but even the small ones.
For example…
"I heard your wife's pregnant? Congratulations."
"I bet it's a boy!"
"How about naming him Itachi when he's born? Uchiha Itachi!"
"I'm sure he'll be a genius someday."
"Not just powerful—his thoughts will be… terrifying."
Zenkichi grinned as he joked with Uchiha Fugaku.
Fugaku, though young, was already married and about to become a father.
In this shinobi world where kids went to war, early marriage and childbirth weren't unusual.
"How did you know my wife is pregnant?"
Fugaku's face darkened.
Not many knew about it.
If this weren't Zenkichi's first visit to Konoha, Fugaku might have questioned his wife's loyalty.
Zenkichi chuckled. "Oh, nothing much. I just have a top-tier intelligence system."
Fugaku frowned. A spy in the Uchiha clan?
But if that were true, why would Zenkichi bring it up?
He didn't seem to care what kind of doubts he stirred up—he just did whatever he wanted.
Watching Fugaku's troubled expression, Zenkichi laughed and vanished into a scattering of golden light.
Fugaku rubbed his temples.
Did he just get that info by chance—or is he deliberately trying to cause turmoil within the Uchiha clan?
Doesn't he realize the danger he puts a spy in by saying something like that?

chapters.title: Chapter 21 - 21:The Trap.
chapters.content:
"The base of Kirigakure is ahead. You're safe now."
"The mission of my clone can end here."ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Looking at the Kirigakure base in the distance, Zenkichi spoke in a relaxed tone.
Master Gen stared at him and said, "Without us slowing you down, you could've left Konoha easily, couldn't you?"
Zenkichi smiled casually. "I can leave Konoha anytime—I just don't want to leave that easily."
"Since Konoha is so determined to deal with me, shouldn't I return the favor?"
"I've decided to stir things up in Konoha."
"Speaking of which... if I do serious damage to Konoha this time, how much commission will the village give me?"
Zenkichi asked with interest.
Gen replied, "It depends on the results—the rank of the enemies you defeat, the number, and the overall impact."
"But you just extorted a hefty sum from Konoha. Do you really still care about the commission?"
Zenkichi grinned. "Of course I care! Gotta eat, right?"
"Once the commission's locked in, the Hokage is done for! Just wait for my good news. I'll bring Konoha to its knees."
His body transformed into a pool of water and dispersed—the clone dispelled.
---
Konoha Village.
Zenkichi lounged on a deck chair in the guest house yard, eyes closed, basking in the sun.
On the coffee table beside him sat Konoha's specialty snacks and a cup of tea—all bought using the hospitality funds provided by the village.
"Sigh... If Konoha hadn't tried to screw me over, I'd feel bad about attacking them after all this hospitality."
He quietly sighed, picked up the teacup, and drank it in one gulp.
Just then, his expression changed slightly.
When the clone dispelled, its memories returned to him.
"So, they really are suspicious of me. That's fine."
Zenkichi stood up and walked toward the door, smiling.
He had a mission in Konoha—and a negotiation to finish with the Third Hokage.
"Orochimaru and the others are back. That should make this negotiation much smoother."
A faint smirk tugged at Zenkichi's lips. There was no conversation in the village he couldn't hear.
The plan the Third Hokage and his advisors spent so much time crafting? Zenkichi already knew it inside and out.
Curling his lips into a teasing smile, he muttered, "Since you want to play… let's play."
---
Hokage Building — Negotiation Office
The Third Hokage wore his formal hat, a smoking pipe in hand. Smoke curled in the air as he smiled warmly at Zenkichi walking in.
"We've talked quite a bit over the past few days."
"The main issues are mostly settled, but we need to iron out the details."
He placed a thick document on the desk in front of him.
"Great."
Zenkichi nodded with a grin, sat across from the Hokage, and picked up the file.
"So many regulations... gives me a headache just looking at it."
He gave the Hokage a half-smile as he flipped through the pages.
The Third Hokage chuckled. "It concerns the entire village's interests. It's best to be thorough."
Zenkichi nodded, pulled out a cigarette, lit it, and began reading.
---
More than half an hour passed.
Zenkichi lazily looked over the last pages, eyelids drooping, nearly drooling from boredom.
"Oops—sorry!"
He suddenly snapped awake, flicked the burnt-out cigarette aside, and offered a half-hearted apology.
He was a little surprised—the Third Hokage hadn't taken the chance to strike.
"Don't worry. It is boring stuff. It's only natural to get sleepy."
The Hokage smiled understandingly and knocked on the table.
"Tea."
An ANBU stepped in and set a teacup beside Zenkichi.
The Hokage said kindly, "A bit of tea helps keep the mind sharp. I always use it when I read."
"Really? Thanks a lot," Zenkichi replied with a grin.
He glanced at the ANBU ninja with a playful smirk. "It's quite an honor to have one of the legendary Sannin personally serve me tea, don't you think, Orochimaru?"
The ANBU ninja froze.
After a moment, he turned and removed his mask.
"Genius of Kirigakure, Arakawa Zenkichi… how did you know it was me?"
Zenkichi smirked. "Want to know? Tell me what kind of snake venom's in this tea, and maybe I'll consider telling you."
The Third Hokage's face changed. He picked up the cup and smashed it on the ground.
Zenkichi blinked. "That wasn't in the script... Dramatic flair, huh?"
Still, he had to admit—dramatically smashing a cup worked in every world.
---
Whoosh! Whoosh!
As the cup shattered, two figures flashed into the room—masked ANBU operatives.
One had white hair—likely Jiraiya. The other's long black hair suggested Shimura Danzo.
Impressive. Konoha had two Shadow-level powerhouses disguised as personal ANBU.
"Ninja Art: Four Red Yang Formation!"
The moment the two ANBU arrived, the Hokage and Orochimaru moved in unison, forming a four-man team to cast an advanced barrier.
Red walls formed on all sides, boxing Zenkichi in.
---
"Barrier ninjutsu? Not bad!"
Zenkichi observed the formation with a smile, not the least bit alarmed.
"Zenkichi, it's over for you!"
"If you're willing to accept Konoha's binding seal and serve the village, we'll let you live."
Danzo took off his mask and said coldly.
"Over?"
"Danzo-sama, which eye of yours says I'm done?"
Zenkichi tilted his head with a smirk.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 22 - 22:What Good Is A Barrier If It Can't Stop Light.
chapters.content:
"The Four Red Sun Formation… A barrier ninjutsu that requires the cooperation of four Kage-level shinobi—truly terrifying."
Zenkichi glanced around at the Four Red Sun Formation. The crimson barrier flickered faintly as he raised his hand. A cross-shaped light spun lazily on his fingertips.
Laser laser!
A golden beam shot out, colliding with the barrier and making it tremble. But it held.
"As expected of a jutsu capable of containing a Tailed Beast Ball… what a terrifying defense."
Zenkichi's voice rang out with exaggerated enthusiasm, but the unshaken calm in his eyes betrayed his amusement.
"You've tested it. Now give up, won't you?"
Danzo Shimura sneered, glaring mockingly at Zenkichi.
Zenkichi yawned lazily. "Ah… that's a no from me. Sitting around and waiting to die just isn't my thing."
The Four Red Sun Formation was new to Arakawa Zenkichi, and he was still curious to examine it more closely.
He turned his gaze toward the ground and smirked. "Tell me, your barrier doesn't cover the ground, does it?"
He remembered: the Four Purple Flame Formation in the original anime enclosed from the four cardinal points and sealed the top. But the Four Red Sun Formation surrounded only the sides. The top was often sealed—especially when summoning the Myojin Gate—but the ground was another matter entirely.
According to his analysis, whether or not the base was sealed seemed to be flexible, depending on the user's intention.
Danzo scoffed. "We're on the second floor. It's not soil—you can't phase through it."
Zenkichi smiled. "Who said I'd use Earth Style to escape?"
True. The Four Red Sun Formation didn't inherently block underground escape. No ninjutsu was perfect. Even this high-level barrier had its flaws.
Upon hearing Zenkichi's words, the expressions of the Third Hokage and others changed noticeably.
Strange, Zenkichi thought. Weren't they worried someone might dig their way out?
---
"Here's some advice—next time you want to trap someone, don't pick a high-rise building."
Zenkichi lifted his leg. The golden cross-shaped light gleamed at his heel—
Lightspeed Kick!
The Hokage Building shook violently. Debris rained down. The Four Red Sun Formation wavered as the Kage fled in disarray, unable to maintain the barrier.
Zenkichi's kick had shattered the second-floor foundation—and with it, the entire Hokage Building began to collapse.
"Easier than I expected."
Watching the Hokage and others scramble for safety, Zenkichi shook his head, unimpressed.
The Four Red Sun Formation's flaw was obvious—it couldn't block the ground. If it could, its value would skyrocket.
Even then, Zenkichi reasoned, his kick likely would've shattered the floor regardless. That kind of attack could transmit force through the barrier, even deform it.
The formation, despite its strength, was flexible, not indestructible. Obito had once used an oversized Tailed Beast Ball against it, showing its elasticity.
It was like rubber—durable but not impenetrable.
And since Zenkichi could convert into light particles, he could phase through its translucent surface with ease.
Even if the ground had been sealed, it wouldn't have stopped him.
However—there was one significant downside. The red barrier radiated searing heat. Once the five directions—front, back, left, right, and top—were covered, the ground soon followed, encasing all inside in blazing chakra.
---
From the wreckage of the Hokage Building, Konoha shinobi fled in panic.
A golden flicker in the sky descended into a humanoid figure—Zenkichi—landing smoothly on the ground.
"Your plan's failed."
"What now, Konoha?"
Zenkichi smiled coldly as he faced the Third Hokage and the others.
"Uchiha Flame Formation!"
Low chants echoed around him. Konoha jōnin from the Uchiha clan appeared, surrounding the battlefield. They raised their hands, activating a clan-exclusive barrier technique.
Zenkichi scoffed and burst into shimmering light particles, hurtling toward the edge of the barrier.
What good is a barrier if it can't stop light itself?
Moments later, Zenkichi reappeared outside the formation.
"How… how is that possible?"
The Third Hokage and the others stared in disbelief. He had passed through their barrier like it was air.
"It's useless."Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
"These boring barriers do nothing to me."
Zenkichi grinned at the group. They needed to learn just how pointless their resistance really was.
From nearby, an ANBU hidden in the shadows completed a hand seal, locking onto Zenkichi.
Mind Transfer Jutsu!
A member of the Yamanaka clan launched his consciousness directly into Zenkichi's mind.
---
In Zenkichi's mental world, a figure appeared—a young ANBU with orange hair.
"So this is the spiritual space?"
"The Yamanaka clan's Mind Transfer Jutsu actually creates access to someone's mental world? That's... incredible."
Zenkichi was genuinely intrigued. This was the first time he'd become aware of such a realm.
"You're finished."
The ANBU didn't hesitate—his goal was simple: suppress Zenkichi's consciousness and take control of his body.
"Young ANBU..."
"You should really assess the power gap before attempting something like this."
Zenkichi raised a single finger—and with a flick, sent the ANBU soul flying.
Observation Haki originates in the heart.
It's not about listening with your ears—it's sensing with your soul.
After acquiring Kizaru's Kenbunshoku Haki (Observation Haki), Zenkichi's spiritual power had reached terrifying levels.
A mere Konoha ANBU was no match.

chapters.title: Chapter 23 - 23: Spirit Possession Jutsu.
chapters.content:
The Outside World
The moment Zenkichi fell into a daze, Danzo Shimura rushed toward him with a sneer.
Dark lines appeared on Danzo's hand—the technique used to activate a curse seal.
"It must be the ANBU from the Yamanaka clan who succeeded. Now that Zenkichi has a physical body, we can plant the curse seal."
Danzo looked at Zenkichi with greedy enthusiasm. A talent like this should be his to control.
Once he turned Zenkichi into a loyal weapon and fully understood his abilities, the entire ninja world would bow before him.
Just as Danzo raised his hand, about to place the curse seal—
"What do you think you're doing?"
Zenkichi suddenly opened his eyes.
His cold gaze pierced into Danzo's, who was standing right in front of him with his palm raised, covered in sealing marks.
"You think you can control me with that pathetic seal? What a stupid idea."
Zenkichi's mocking tone only deepened Danzo's fury.
"Be obedient and submit!"
Danzo roared and struck with his palm—but the moment it connected, Zenkichi's body shimmered with light and his form vanished from Danzo's grasp.
"Too slow."
With a smirk, Zenkichi appeared behind him and casually slapped Danzo across the face.
Boom!
Danzo's body was sent flying like a cannonball before vanishing in midair—just a shadow clone.
"Tch. The old coward wouldn't even show up in person. Hiding behind a clone while trying to use a seal?"
Zenkichi clicked his tongue in annoyance, then casually pointed toward the nearby ruins of the Hokage Building.
A dazzling golden beam shot from his fingertip, blasting the rubble apart.
Boom!
Whoosh!
In the explosion's flames, a figure leapt out—it was the real Danzo Shimura, who had been hiding among the ruins.
"And there's you."The source of this content ɪs
Zenkichi turned his head toward a nearby rooftop, where the ANBU from the Yamanaka clan—the one who had tried to possess him—was hiding.
Raising his leg, Zenkichi kicked at light-speed. A cross-shaped flash burst forth.
"Earth Style: Earth Flow Wall!"
A low shout echoed. The Third Hokage quickly formed seals and raised a stone wall to intercept.
Zenkichi's kick shattered the wall on impact—but the attack lost its power in the process. The Yamanaka ANBU was saved by the Third Hokage's timely intervention.
"Because of your strange body, our attacks aren't effective."
"But your attacks aren't unstoppable."
"We can withstand them—and we can strike back."
"Zenkichi of Kirigakure... you're not invincible."
The Third Hokage stood in front of Zenkichi, voice steady and firm.
Zenkichi tilted his head, then exaggeratedly widened his eyes.
"How terrifying!"
"The Leaf Village is uniting to take me down? That's scary!"
"The shinobi of Konoha are all monsters! How fearsome when they team up!"
His sarcastic tone was obvious—mocking, teasing, completely unbothered.
"Don't be arrogant, Zenkichi of Kirigakure!"
The Third Hokage's face darkened as he shouted.
Zenkichi scratched his head, pulled a small cigarette from his pocket, and lit it with a laser shot from his finger.
"The young one—no, the old one—wait, the Third Hokage in the middle of a midlife crisis!"
"Let me ask—why are you so angry?"
"You tore up our agreement and attacked me without warning."
"Shouldn't I be the one pissed off?"
"I was attacked by my own allies, wasn't I?"
His casual words made the Third Hokage visibly uneasy.
"Hmph! Your powers are too dangerous. You pose a threat not just to Konoha, but the entire ninja world."
"We attacked today in the name of peace—for everyone's sake!"
Danzo stood beside Hiruzen, speaking with self-righteousness.
"If a tree loses its bark, it dies. And if a person loses all shame—well, they become invincible."
"Shameless Danzo Shimura... truly terrifying!"
Zenkichi's mocking grin made Danzo grit his teeth in anger.
He knew it was true—but no one was allowed to say it.
If you spoke the truth, you had to pay the price.
---
Spiritual Possession Technique!
At that moment, a soul surged into Zenkichi's body.
Inside his mental space, a young man with light blue hair appeared—blade in hand—charging toward him.
"Zenkichi! Prepare to die!"
It was Kato Dan, the only Konoha ninja who had mastered the Spiritual Transformation Technique.
Zenkichi scoffed. His mental power coalesced into a massive hammer and dropped from above.
Unlike the Mind Transfer Technique of the Yamanaka clan, which only allowed body possession, the Spiritual Transformation Technique could hunt and destroy souls.
"So bloodthirsty. How terrifying."
Zenkichi smirked as the hammer slammed down, crushing Kato Dan's soul.
Poof!
Kato Dan's injured soul fled in embarrassment, escaping from Zenkichi's mind.
---
The Outside World
As Zenkichi and Kato Dan clashed mentally, Orochimaru and Danzo moved in.
Their palms glowed—covered in curse seals and venomous snakes ready to strike.
"Yata Mirror."
Zenkichi's eyes snapped open, and his body dissolved into thousands of light particles, streaking toward an ordinary house deep inside Konoha.
By now, there were no civilians left in the village.
After Zenkichi's earlier encounter with the Third Hokage, Hiruzen didn't attack immediately. Instead, they stalled for half an hour—just enough time for Orochimaru to serve the poisoned tea.
That delay wasn't just for deception—it was also used to evacuate the villagers.
Konoha's top brass weren't naive enough to assume they would win.
Before planning victory, they had calculated for defeat.
They had already made sure the villagers were safe.
Even though they hoped the preparations would be unnecessary—they weren't.

chapters.title: Chapter 24 - 24:Killing Tsunade's Lover.
chapters.content:
Among the residents.
Kato Dan spat out a mouthful of blood, his breath weak, and he looked utterly embarrassed.
Kato Dan was being guarded by several Konoha Jonin, with Tsunade sitting not far away.
Sensing the change in Kato Dan, Tsunade's expression shifted. She asked urgently, "What happened?"
Kato Dan wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and said regretfully, "The Spiritual Transformation Technique failed. Zenkichi's soul is too powerful."
Tsunade frowned. "Are you alright?"
Kato Dan gave a bitter smile. "My soul was attacked by Zenkichi. It's riddled with holes. I doubt I'll last long."
Tsunade formed a seal and summoned Katsuyu with a puff of smoke, tossing the slug to Kato Dan to begin healing.
"I can't heal soul damage," Tsunade said. "I've never studied the soul. But Katsuyu can at least treat your physical wounds."
Kato Dan accepted the treatment, took a deep breath, and said, "Thank you, Tsunade-sama…"
He looked at her earnestly. "There's something I've always wanted to say to you… But I didn't have the courage. And now, I'm afraid it's too late. Tsunade-sama, I like you…"
Tsunade froze, visibly startled. After a moment, she forced a smile and replied, "Really? I know."
If Kato Dan weren't so gravely injured, Tsunade would've surely made him taste her Super Strength Fist.
There's a reason Tsunade's been single all these years.
Even Jiraiya didn't dare confess to her outright. Who did Kato Dan think he was?
In the original timeline, they only became lovers because Tsunade took the initiative.
Who confesses, who responds, and who takes the lead—these were serious questions.
Only Tsunade confesses to others. No one dares confess to Tsunade.
Not just because of her strength, but also her temper. Disagree with her? Expect a fist in return.
"Dan Kato!"
"I never imagined you'd dare to confess to a woman stronger than yourself."
"Tsunade outclasses you in every way. Where'd you find the guts to confess?"
"Or have you abandoned your pride and dignity as a man?"
"In that case, you're pathetic!"
A smooth voice echoed through the room as golden light bloomed. Countless particles of light condensed into the form of Zenkichi.
"Zenkichi…!" Tsunade and the others snapped to attention, instantly on guard.
But Zenkichi wasn't looking at them. He eyed Kato Dan with curiosity, almost amusement. What a mess of a man.
In the original timeline, he confessed, got a cursed necklace, and died shortly after without even getting a reply.
Without saying another word, Zenkichi raised his hand and fired a laser. The golden beam shot toward Kato Dan's chest.
Seeking death, huh? Confessing during a crisis like it's a romantic drama? Disgusting.
Not to mention, Zenkichi had already damaged Kato Dan's soul earlier. Hearing the confession just made him all the more eager to finish the job.
Now, right after confessing to Tsunade, Dan was about to die again—without ever hearing her acceptance.
"Be careful!" Tsunade shouted, punching the ground to raise a barrier of stone in an attempt to block the laser.
"It's useless!" Zenkichi sneered.
He turned into particles of light and reappeared instantly—right behind Kato Dan.
"Speed is weight."
"Young Dan Kato…"
"Have you ever been kicked at the speed of light?"
Zenkichi's light-wrapped kick smashed into Dan's head, sending him crashing through a wall and flying.

chapters.content:
---
"Tsunade, are you okay?"
"Bastard Zenkichi, don't be so arrogant!"
"Kato Dan was actually killed… damn it!"
"Did Kato Dan's Spiritual Transformation Technique also fail?!"ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
The Third Hokage and others who had rushed over saw the destruction and shouted furiously.
"Yo ~ everyone's here!"
"Option 1 – Secret poisoning: failed!"
"Plan 2 – Barrier Ninjutsu blockade: failed!"
"Plan 3 – Mind Body Transfer Jutsu: failed!"
"Plan 4 – Spiritual Transformation to obliterate the soul: failed!"

Zenkichi tilted his head, looked at the Third Hokage and his group, and spoke lazily.
"Oh~ that's right! You've brought in the Yamanaka clan again. Looks like you haven't given up on Plan 3 just yet."
Zenkichi's eyes glinted as he noticed several Yamanaka clan members surrounding him.
"Stop talking nonsense!" Tsunade shouted, her expression stern, as she dashed forward.
Zenkichi, unbothered, allowed his body to become light particles. Tsunade phased right through him.
But as she passed, Zenkichi caught sight of a black seal mark on her clothes—a Flying Thunder God formula.
A playful smirk curled his lips.
He turned his gaze into the distance, and with Observation Haki, he sensed it—standing on a rooftop, Namikaze Minato was watching everything.
"Watching from up high with a telescope? You're quite the strategist."
Zenkichi's body glimmered, and in a flash, he appeared beside Namikaze Minato.
Minato, who had been monitoring the battle, immediately acted the moment Tsunade and Zenkichi came close.
"Four Symbols Seal!"
His hand glowed with sealing runes as he slammed it toward Zenkichi.
Zenkichi gave Minato a flat look, mocking smile on his face, before bursting into light particles and reappearing on a distant building.
"So this is Plan 5? Flying Thunder God combined with sealing jutsu?"
Zenkichi's voice echoed with amusement.
In a flash, his body scattered again, reappearing in a narrow alley. Golden light burst out—
Boom!
A Yamanaka ninja was blasted from the alley, crashing to the ground with a dull thud.
Zenkichi walked out with his hands in his pockets, shaking his head.
"Poor coordination."
"When Tsunade got close to me, the Yamanaka clan should've used the Mind Body Switch Technique to control me."
"Then Minato could've sealed me instantly."
"It's not a bad tactic. Wanna try again? Better than attacking while I'm still monologuing."
His voice was casual—almost helpful—but the sarcasm was biting.
The moment the sealing technique had activated, Zenkichi had already escaped using the speed of light. A sealing formation began to take shape around his previous location, black patterns lining the ground as a trap.
If they had seized the timing perfectly, maybe they could've had a shot. But without support from the Nara and Akimichi clans, the Yamanaka's chances were paper-thin.
It was always meant to be a three-part strategy—the Akimichi create an opening, the Nara restrain movement, and the Yamanaka deliver the mental strike.
Alone, the Yamanaka clan couldn't possibly restrain someone like Zenkichi.
"Sealing technique? How terrifying!"
"It's true—the Uzumaki clan's sealing arts are terrifying."
Zenkichi reformed not far away and looked at the red-haired kunoichi nearby.
Sealing techniques were powerful. In fact, they could bind almost anything—even someone like Kaguya Ōtsutsuki.
But their downside was always activation time and complexity. Even the mighty Six Paths—Chibaku Tensei had weaknesses that made it vulnerable if seen through.
The Four Symbols Seal used by Danzō in the original timeline was even worse—it broadcast its activation.
"That bastard!"
Uzumaki Kushina's hair flared with fury, floating in the air unnaturally. Her killing intent was unmistakable.
Golden chains erupted from her body—Adamantine Sealing Chains—each tipped with spearheads as they surged toward Zenkichi.
"Vajra Sealing? Interesting."
Zenkichi's eyes gleamed with curiosity. He didn't move or resist—he wanted to test something.
How different was his body's elementalization from the Hydrification Technique used by the Hōzuki clan?
The Hōzuki's technique could turn the user into water—but those chains could still bind them.
Kushina's Adamantine Chains could bypass water bodies and strike the true form.
But Zenkichi's body was light.
The golden chains passed right through him—harmlessly.
"No impact?"
"Oh, Uzumaki girl…"
"Looks like your sealing chains can't touch me."
Zenkichi smiled coolly, already having deduced the nature of his defense.
Hydrification, like most ninjutsu, was chakra-based. The Adamantine Sealing Chains could suppress and bypass chakra constructs.
But Zenkichi's elementalization had nothing to do with chakra—it was from a completely different system.
That's why even the Uzumaki clan's sealing arts couldn't restrain him.

chapters.title: Chapter 26 - 26:Nine Tails.
chapters.content:
"Young Uzumaki Kushina!"
"Do you realize how dangerous what you're doing is?"
Zenkichi drooped his eyelids and stared at Uzumaki Kushina lazily.
With a flash of light, Zenkichi's body turned into particles and instantly appeared beside Kushina. Without saying a word, he delivered a kick.
Light-Speed Kick!
Though he had restrained his power, Kushina was still sent flying.
"Tch. Both of you really have a death wish. No wonder the Senju and Uzumaki clans are practically extinct."
"If you keep this up, you'll have to apologize to the Sage of Six Paths in the afterlife."
Zenkichi raised his hand and fired a laser at Kushina.
Come to think of it, the Sage of Six Paths really had it rough. The Uzumaki clan's powerful chakra and sealing techniques could forcibly suppress the Nine-Tails and extract its chakra. But Kushina was not a perfect jinchūriki and had a poor relationship with Kurama.
Kushina leapt from the flames, red chakra surging around her as the Nine-Tails' chakra cloaked her body. The laser hit the ground, exploding fiercely.
Boom!
As a result, the Senju clan had ended up in decline, and Asura had to rely on members of the Uzumaki clan to carry on his will. For over a thousand years, his descendants had fought—mostly between the Senju and Uchiha clans. Chakra reincarnation was best done through direct descendants.
His sons ended up worse off—especially the second, Asura. Even in reincarnation, there were no direct descendants left to carry his chakra, so he turned to the Uzumaki clan.
The Sage of Six Paths had troubled his descendants for centuries, and now only a handful remained.
The Uzumaki clan was barely hanging on—Uzumaki Mito had no children, Naruto had just two, and their revival still seemed far off. The Uchiha weren't doing any better—only Sasuke and Sarada remained. And Tsunade, the last of the Senju, was an unmarried elder. Once she passed, the Senju name would vanish.
Read the original manga and you'd see—can you believe the founder of ninjutsu, the Sage of Six Paths, who still watches over the world, was nearly erased from history?
"Even if I can't hurt you, don't expect to beat me easily."
Kushina landed in front of Zenkichi, pride gleaming in her eyes.
"Nine-Tails chakra cloak? How scary~!"Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Zenkichi exaggerated with a smirk, raising his brows before his expression turned wicked.
"Young Uzumaki Kushina!"
"Ever heard of a dish called... Shrimp with Pig Heart?"
Zenkichi grinned. He had already decided how to handle Konoha.
Killing them all wasn't the best choice. But letting them off too easily? That didn't sit right either.
"Half-dead Konoha is the best Konoha."
"Konoha riddled with inner conflict is the one everyone truly loves."
Zenkichi murmured to himself, then vanished in a golden flash, reappearing in front of Kushina.
Light-Speed Kick!
Nine-Tails Chakra!
His leg shimmered with golden particles as he struck fiercely. Kushina, refusing to back down, met him head-on, the red chakra of the Nine-Tails boiling within her.
Boom!
Kushina was launched again.
"Too weak."
"Kushina, you're barely scratching the surface of the Nine-Tails' chakra."
Zenkichi's calm voice rang out as he raised a hand and fired another laser.
"You bastard…"
Tsunade charged at him, followed by the Third Hokage and others, surrounding him from all sides.
Each of them bore the mark of the Flying Thunder God Technique. They were trying to give Minato an opening.
"Cheap tactics."
Eight-Foot Mirror!
Zenkichi clapped his hands together and dissolved into light. In an instant, he reappeared above a building and knocked an ANBU from the Yamanaka clan out cold with a radiant flying kick.
"Targeting me from the shadows? Rude."
He murmured as golden light condensed at his fingertips. He launched an arrow of light at another Yamanaka ninja in the distance.
"Damn it!"
Minato gritted his teeth, then noticed the flood of golden light blanketing Konoha. He quickly pulled out a pair of sunglasses and slipped them on.
Boom!
Just as he did, Zenkichi appeared and smashed him with a light-speed kick.
Poof!
Minato coughed blood. He was seriously injured.
Zenkichi hadn't held back. Minato wasn't built to take hits—he was an assassin-type, meant to strike from the shadows.
"You guys better stop."
Zenkichi calmly pointed a rotating, cross-shaped beam of golden light directly at Minato.
"Zenkichi, don't do it!"
The Third Hokage shouted, waving his hand.
"Oh no~! The Third Hokage is threatening me? How scary!"
Zenkichi feigned fear, mocking the old man. But his face quickly darkened.
"Let me ask you this: who started this fight?"
"You tried to assassinate me and called it 'eliminating a threat.' But if I retaliate, I'm labeled the villain? Give me a break. Who made you judge and jury?"
The Third Hokage spoke solemnly. "What do you want?"
Zenkichi smirked and replied casually, "Nothing much. Just a deal."
Kushina snapped, "What kind of deal!?"
Zenkichi narrowed his eyes. "I want you to release the Nine-Tails. Let it roam free for one minute. If you do that, I'll release Minato. If not…"
He raised his hand and pointed toward the Hokage Rock. A golden cross beam blasted a massive hole in the stone.
"That's what happens."
Zenkichi said with a smirk. From the corner of his eye, he noticed something inside.
Beneath the shattered Hokage Rock, the hidden shelter of Konoha's civilians was now visible.
From the shadows, frightened faces began to emerge...

chapters.title: Chapter 27 - 27: Freeing The Nine Tails.
chapters.content:
"Release the Kyūbi? Impossible."
"The tailed beast is part of the jinchūriki's life. If it's released, the jinchūriki will die."
"Your request isn't sincere at all."
"You're mocking us and insulting our intelligence."
The Third Hokage stared at Zenkichi, speaking righteously.
"Hmm~ That's right, I didn't make myself clear enough," Zenkichi replied casually.
"What I mean is: release the Kyūbi's chakra and let it control your body."
"As long as you don't resist, the Nine-Tails' chakra should be able to manifest as a full-tailed beast, right?"
"Let it dominate everything and enjoy one minute of freedom—is that really too much to ask?"
"If you refuse... Namikaze Minato's head will be crushed."ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ
Zenkichi slowly raised his long leg, a dazzling golden light flashing at his heel.
Namikaze Minato coughed up a mouthful of blood. He opened his mouth as if to speak, but his injuries were too severe.
"Zenkichi, you're despicable!"
"Using someone's life as leverage—don't you think it's shameless to threaten Konoha's shinobi like this?"
The Third Hokage's expression changed as he scolded him.
"Breaking alliances, using poison, ambushing, sneaking attacks... Konoha has done all those things to me. And you have the nerve to call me shameless?"
"You people from the Hidden Leaf are so thick-skinned, it's terrifying."
Zenkichi curled his lip and spoke indifferently.
As he finished, he raised his hand toward a house nearby. Golden lasers bloomed from his fingertips.
"Ninjas of the Yamanaka clan, you'd better stop courting death."
"Nothing in Konoha is hidden from me—your little tricks included."
Zenkichi smiled, turning to look at Uzumaki Kushina.
"Young Uzumaki Kushina, have you made up your mind yet?"
"Namikaze Minato is seriously injured. He doesn't have time to wait."
"If you don't decide in one minute, Minato will die."
"As far as I know… you're a couple, right?"
Zenkichi spoke lazily, a playful look on his face.
"Kushina…"
The Third Hokage looked at her, hesitating.
"Does the Third Hokage want to stop Uzumaki Kushina? Oh~ I see what you're thinking."
"As a free being, the Kyūbi was cruelly imprisoned by Konoha—reduced to a weapon sealed inside a jinchūriki."
"It must be full of hatred for the village. Once it's free, even for just a minute, it will surely retaliate."
"I'm really looking forward to that!"
"That scene would be... beautiful."
Zenkichi spoke lazily, staring at the Third Hokage with amusement.
Uzumaki Kushina held her stomach, uncertain.
Shimura Danzō barked, "Uzumaki Kushina, what are you hesitating for? Don't forget—you're a Konoha shinobi."
"Namikaze Minato is also a shinobi of the Leaf. It is a shinobi's duty to lay down their life for the village."
"Minato has been seriously wounded—he may not survive. We cannot risk the disaster that releasing the Kyūbi would bring, just for his sake."
Zenkichi laughed loudly. "Well said! But I don't get it—what does your so-called bond with Konoha actually mean?"
"In Kirigakure, where I live, we don't glorify things like 'bonds.' It's cruel, but at least it's honest."
"But you in Konoha… you're different. You preach bonds and camaraderie."
"And now? You hesitate not at all in sacrificing Namikaze Minato, the 'Yellow Flash' who's done so much for your village."
"So let me ask you: where is your bond with him?"
"You preach 'bonds' while creating darkness."
"Could it be… this is Konoha's true nature?"
"Or maybe 'bonds' are just empty slogans your higher-ups use to deceive those beneath them. You use it as long as it's convenient—then abandon it when it's not."
"As long as the higher-ups say so, even shinobi who once lived by the will of bonds must switch to a new belief?"
"Hmm~ That's a pretty incredible system, Third Hokage."
"If every Konoha ninja became nothing more than a weapon—mindless, obedient—then Konoha's prosperity would be assured."
Zenkichi's mocking tone made the Third Hokage's face darken.
Shrimp with pig heart!
The Third Hokage was clearly rattled. He declared, "What nonsense! We in Konoha would never do something so foolish!"
"The bonds between Konoha shinobi are real. The will to protect the village—and each other—has never wavered."
"Kushina, do as he says. We will control the Kyūbi—we won't let it run wild."
His firm voice moved Kushina to tears.
She was deeply touched by the Hokage's resolve.
"I understand."
Kushina nodded and sent her mind into the sealed space within her.
Just like Naruto's, Kushina's seal space took the form of a sewer-like world—but with one key difference: the treatment of the Nine-Tails.
While Naruto's Kyūbi was simply locked in a cage, Kushina's was pinned—its limbs nailed to a massive volcanic rock with sharp wooden stakes. A prisoner, like a grotesque specimen.
"Hahaha! Uzumaki Kushina—so even you've reached this point!"
As soon as her consciousness entered the seal, the Kyūbi mocked her loudly.
Though its body was restrained, its consciousness was not. Through Kushina's senses, it had seen everything that happened outside.
"You want to give me a minute of freedom? I won't be polite."
The Kyūbi bared its fangs, grinning menacingly.
"Kyuubi… we will stop you."
Kushina looked at the beast with determination, then waved her hand—removing most of the seal and pulling the wooden stakes from its tails.
"Hmph."
The Kyūbi snorted hot breath. Red chakra erupted from its body, quickly flowing into Kushina and taking control.
"It's starting…"
The Third Hokage's expression turned grim as he sensed the Kyūbi's chakra swirling from Kushina's body.
Truth be told, he hadn't agreed with Zenkichi's demand at all.
But with so many spectators gathered around the Hokage Rock, he had no choice.
Refusing would be the same as admitting Zenkichi was right—that 'bonds' were nothing more than propaganda.
If the shinobi of Konoha accepted that notion… their morale would collapse.
And when that happens, it becomes impossible to lead.

chapters.title: Chapter 28 - 28:You Don't Go Anywhere Without My Permission.
chapters.content:
The red chakra filled with a menacing aura surged out of Uzumaki Kushina's body, turning her into a red, nine-tailed beast in the blink of an eye.
A Jinchuriki's tailed beast transformation generally occurs in three stages.
The first form wraps the Jinchuriki in a translucent red chakra cloak, with tails forming behind them.
The second form covers the Jinchuriki with an opaque crimson shroud, forming a shape closer to the tailed beast's appearance.
The third form is complete transformation—where the Jinchuriki fully becomes the tailed beast.
Uzumaki Kushina was currently in the second form. Although she hadn't fully transformed, her destructive power was still overwhelming and terrifying.
"Hahaha! I'm finally free. Let the bastards of Konoha suffer!"
The Nine-Tails let out a thunderous roar, shaking the sky.
"You, boy... impressive."
Kyuubi's eyes landed on Zenkichi, who stood calmly nearby. He raised his left hand and glanced at his watch.
"One minute. Timer starts now."
Zenkichi said casually, turning to look at Hiruzen Sarutobi and the others.
Hiruzen's face was grave. The oppressive chakra pouring from the Nine-Tails made him deeply uneasy.
Without hesitation, he bit his finger and slammed his palm down.
"Summoning Jutsu!"
A puff of smoke burst out, and the Monkey King Enma appeared.
"Enma, transform into the Adamantine Staff!"
Hiruzen shouted, and the monkey transformed into an iron rod that landed firmly in his hand.
Enma was Hiruzen's personal summoning beast—unique in its ability to transform into a weapon.
"Adamantine Staff—extend!"
With a powerful roar, Hiruzen launched the extended staff at the Nine-Tails, striking before the beast could react.
"Get out of Konoha!"
He yelled, channeling chakra through the staff, aiming to drive the beast out of the village.
The Nine-Tails' destructive power was immense. If it rampaged through Konoha, the damage would be catastrophic.
Though the villagers had taken shelter within the Hokage Rock, the village itself—the infrastructure and legacy—was also precious.
Worse yet, the Nine-Tails had emerged too close to the mountain. A single Tailed Beast Bomb from that distance could lead to mass casualties.
If the Nine-Tails attacked the mountain shelter directly, even hiding underground wouldn't guarantee survival.
"Everyone, attack together! We only have one minute—don't let the Nine-Tails run wild!"
Jiraiya and Orochimaru stepped forward simultaneously, biting their fingers and slamming their palms down.
"Summoning Jutsu!"
A massive toad appeared—its dark red, wart-covered skin unmistakable. It was Gamabunta, Jiraiya's most powerful summon.
Alongside him, Orochimaru summoned a massive purple snake radiating a chilling aura—Manda, his most powerful summoning beast.
The moment Gamabunta saw the Nine-Tails, his eyes widened.
"Jiraiya! Are you insane?! You summoned me to fight that?!"
Manda hissed in fury. "Orochimaru, you must have lost your mind. I won't fight the Nine-Tails—not even for a thousand sacrifices!"
Jiraiya gave a wry smile. "Now's not the time for complaints, Bunta. The situation's critical—I need your help."
Orochimaru responded coldly to Manda, "There's no need to worry. We have enough strength to suppress it. You're just supporting us."
Gamabunta hesitated, then nodded. "Alright, fine. I'll lend a hand."
Manda responded sharply, "I'll assist—but you owe me ten thousand sacrifices when this is over."
Jiraiya gratefully thanked Gamabunta, while Orochimaru gave Manda a silent, cold nod.
With a roar, Gamabunta drew his massive blade and leapt toward the Nine-Tails. Manda slithered forward, weaving around debris as he advanced.
Jiraiya and Orochimaru followed closely behind their summons, both unleashing powerful attacks.
Frustration and rage surged through them. Against Zenkichi, their attacks had been useless. His speed overwhelmed them, and his demands earlier had only deepened their humiliation.
Now, with the Nine-Tails as a new threat, they had a perfect outlet to vent their anger.
"Go, Hokage-sama!"
"Lord Orochimaru!"
"Jiraiya-sama, take him down!"
Cheers erupted from the crowd gathered on Hokage Rock. Among them were not just villagers, but also Genin, Chuunin, and elite Jonin.
Many of them had tried and failed to harm Zenkichi earlier. Under orders from the Third Hokage, they had been sent to the shelter.
Against Zenkichi, they were powerless—and worse, a liability.
But the Nine-Tails was different.
"Hokage-sama and the others are fighting! How can we just sit here?!"
Some Konoha ninjas grew restless, itching to help.
"But Hokage-sama ordered that no one interfere without his command…"
Others hesitated, remembering the Third's strict instructions.
"It was probably because of that guy from Kirigakure—Zenkichi," one said grimly. "I've seen him fight. His powers are strange. He can ignore physical and ninjutsu attacks."
"The Hokage wanted to confront him directly, so he kept us back. We would've only gotten in the way."
"But this is different. Our attacks can hurt the Nine-Tails."
A few of them began to analyze the situation, considering whether it was time to act.
"I think the Hokage and the others can handle it," one said. "We'll only get in the way."ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"But we can't stay here! This shelter's been exposed."
"We should evacuate the civilians before Zenkichi makes a move against them."
Some argued for action, while others insisted on focusing on evacuation.
——
Not far away, Arakawa Zenkichi watched the scene play out with a casual glance.
He raised his hand. A golden beam of light formed at his fingertip—and with a crackling flash, a violent explosion erupted near the Hokage Rock.
"You don't go anywhere without my permission."
---
