chapters.title: Chapter 42 - 42: Madara's Will.
chapters.content:
"You're really letting me go?"
Tsunade stared at Zenkichi, her expression laced with disbelief. She hadn't expected her release to come so easily.
"What's wrong? Can't bear to leave me?"
Zenkichi offered a playful smirk, voice tinged with amusement.
"Pooh! Don't flatter yourself, you smug bastard!"
She crossed her arms, eyes narrowing. "I just don't understand why you're letting me go so freely."
Zenkichi let the silence stretch, his tone exaggerated. "Because…"
When Tsunade leaned forward slightly, curiosity overtaking her frustration, he answered with calm indifference,
"Because Konoha is too weak. If I wanted to, I could take you back at any moment."
Tsunade: "…"
Watching her stunned silence, Zenkichi chuckled lightly.
"But don't worry too much—I have no immediate plans to act against Konoha."
"The Mizukage asked me not long ago if I wanted to launch an assault on your village. I declined. What you should be concerned about now isn't external enemies."
Tsunade exhaled, some tension leaving her shoulders, though her brow furrowed again. "You're hiding something. What exactly should I be worried about?"
Zenkichi's smile deepened, his voice low and enigmatic.
"You'll understand everything once you return to Konoha."
Tsunade scoffed. "Stop pretending you're some kind of prophet."
With a swirl of her cloak, she turned and left. Zenkichi watched her retreating form without speaking.
Moments later, the Third Mizukage emerged behind him.
"Are you certain she'll return to the village? Won't this decision cause us trouble?"
"I'm certain," Zenkichi replied with confidence. "Never underestimate Konoha. Its leadership may be fractured, but it's brimming with cunning minds."
Sarutobi Hiruzen and his council excel at internal conflict.
When it comes to self-destruction, Konoha is in a league of its own.
And with the spark I provided, their corruption will burn itself away.
Zenkichi's gaze turned distant. "I've heard Konoha's White Fang is under pressure?"
The Mizukage nodded.
"Akimichi Torifu lacks both the power and the respect White Fang commands. Many within Konoha's ranks are growing restless."
Zenkichi chuckled, stretching his arms lazily.
"If Torifu truly possessed strength and prestige, he wouldn't be Hokage."
"White Fang… what a waste. A Kage-level shinobi brought to ruin."
"If he doesn't die in battle, he'll probably be denied even the title of hero after death."
The Mizukage waved dismissively. "You've made your moves. Let's follow through. Now—what was that sensitive intel you mentioned earlier?"
Zenkichi's tone grew serious. "A few days ago, I detected an anomaly—an unfamiliar chakra signature appeared in the residence on Seventh Street, in the high-security district."
His expression darkened. If his suspicions were correct, this was Uchiha Madara's handiwork.
In the original timeline, during the Third Great Ninja War, Madara manipulated Obito by orchestrating a tragedy involving Hatake Kakashi and Nohara Rin. That entire incident had been staged using Kirigakure shinobi—and even the Three-Tails was used as a tool.
Zenkichi knew the story well. His vigilance over the village never wavered, enhanced by a formidable observation technique—something akin to Kizaru's Haki, refined to the point of nearly glimpsing the future.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Among the three Haki-like energies he wielded, his strongest was the power of perception—ideal for an assassin-type shinobi like himself.
Under his continuous monitoring, the puppet Madara had planted in Kirigakure finally revealed a weakness.
These were no loyal followers. Most were likely controlled—either through cursed seals or Sharingan-induced illusions.
Inevitably, someone had to make direct contact with these agents. And that's when Zenkichi noticed the disturbance.
The Mizukage frowned. "You believe Seventh Street is compromised?"
"I'm not just suspicious," Zenkichi said coolly. "I'm certain."
"The next time he meets with that unknown shinobi, I'll make my move."
"I'm informing you now to avoid complications or misunderstandings later."
The Mizukage was quiet for a moment before exhaling slowly.
"Understood. If you're sure, proceed."
"But… he's a high-ranking official. He's contributed much to Kirigakure. If possible, avoid disgracing him. Keep it discreet."
Zenkichi gave a half-smile. "I'll be as discreet as I can."
---
Valley of the End – Subterranean Chamber
Far beneath the Valley of the End, an enormous underground hall lay in silence.
At its center, seated atop a cold stone throne, was a frail old man. His figure was skeletal, his long white hair covering one eye. The other eye remained half-lidded, yet filled with piercing intent.
Before him stood a pale, humanoid being—reporting cheerfully in a sing-song voice.
White Zetsu.
And the man seated—Uchiha Madara.
The ancient Uchiha listened to the report, his expression shifting faintly.
"How unexpected…"
"With such remarkable power and potential, Zenkichi's temperament is so… nonchalant."
Madara opened his eye fully, lips curled in a subtle, amused smile. There was a touch of helplessness, and perhaps a hint of regret.
The more animated half of Zetsu—spoke up.
"Madara-sama, what should we do? Zenkichi's abilities are extremely valuable."
"From what we've gathered, only advanced sealing techniques pose any threat to him—and even those are ineffective because of how quickly he moves."
"If we could recruit him, the Moon's Eye Plan would become far easier to realize."
Madara clenched his hand slowly, sensing the degradation of his own power. He muttered,
"You make a compelling argument."
"Time… it is the one enemy even the Sage of Six Paths could not overcome."
"My strength is fading. I need a formidable agent to carry out my will."
"I had hoped to mold a promising youth from the Uchiha clan… but now, perhaps it's worth considering Zenkichi."

chapters.title: Chapter 43 - 43: The Spy.
chapters.content:
After Uchiha Madara heard about Zenkichi, he was very optimistic about making him his spokesperson.
After all, Zenkichi's ability was even more terrifying than that of Uchiha Obito in the original timeline. If he could be used as Madara's proxy, then the Eye of the Moon Plan could proceed flawlessly.
Madara estimated that even an Uchiha with the Mangekyō Sharingan would struggle to defeat Zenkichi.
After all, the ability to transform into light rendered most attacks useless. It essentially made him invincible.
A Fei shouted in his silly voice, "Master Madara, are we going to take action against Zenkichi?"
"Zenkichi has been in Kirigakure for a short time now and shows no signs of leaving."
"If Madara-sama can control him, I'll definitely ask him what it feels like to use the bathroom."
"Since he can turn into light, wouldn't his waste turn into photons too?"
White Zetsu A Fei's train of thought was as ridiculous as ever. He muttered seriously, "When he excretes, would it be a beam of light?"
Another White Zetsu emerged from the rock wall and snapped, "A Fei, shut up!"
A third Zetsu phased out and tried to defuse the situation with a grin. "Don't be so harsh. A Fei means well!"
Uchiha Madara, deep in thought, glanced at the bickering Zetsus around him and barked, "All of you, be quiet."
He was constantly annoyed by these White Zetsus. They were originally supposed to be perfect clones, but each one turned out to be defective.
Still, despite their flaws, they had been cultivated using Hashirama's cells—and that gave them excellent abilities.
Zetsu's weak combat power was offset by his incredible infiltration and escape techniques. He should be considered a special jōnin at the very least.
"If I recall correctly, I've planted several agents in Kirigakure. Have them probe Zenkichi for weaknesses."
Uchiha Madara pondered for a moment, then decided to let his pawns act first.
Zenkichi's unique power was valuable—but so was his political position as the next potential Mizukage.
If they could drug him and quietly place a curse seal, they could fully exploit both his strength and status.
---
Kirigakure Village.
After a full day's work, Ringo Kiru returned home and brewed himself some tea to relax.
Just as he was about to sit down, a White Zetsu phased up from the floor of his house.
"You again?"
Ringo Kiru's face darkened. He clenched his teacup tightly, eyes narrowing.
Back during the Second Shinobi War, he had been gravely injured and fell unconscious. When he awoke, he found himself in a pitch-black cave.
An old man appeared before him, branded him with a curse mark, and told him he'd receive missions periodically.
Ringo had resisted—but the moment the old man activated the seal, the agony was beyond anything he could bear. He felt like death would've been a mercy.
The curse seal was incredibly advanced—far beyond his ability to remove.
He never dared go public with it. Though he covertly tried to use Kirigakure's resources to find a way to break the seal, every attempt failed.
As a high-ranking member of the Hidden Mist, Ringo Kiru had access to many tools and people—but none could help.
The fact that Zetsu could appear and vanish at will terrified him. The curse seal terrified him more.
There was nothing he could do.
Zetsu, the old man's emissary, would appear now and then to extract intelligence from the Hidden Mist.
Eventually, Ringo Kiru was sent back into the village and successfully blended into the ranks—rising to the top of Kirigakure's leadership.
"My lord has new orders," Zetsu said with a grin.
Ringo Kiru sighed and replied flatly, "What now? More intelligence gathering?"
Zetsu chuckled, "Not this time. Do you know Zenkichi of Kirigakure?"
Ringo frowned. "He was appointed by the Third Mizukage. There's a 90% chance he'll be the next Mizukage. What are you planning? He's not someone easily dealt with."
Zetsu grinned. "Relax. We're not asking you to fight him. You'd stand no chance."
Ringo snapped coldly, "Then quit beating around the bush. What do you want?"
Zetsu replied, "Our lord is very interested in Zenkichi. He wants him under control."
Ringo sneered, "You want me to recruit him for you? I don't even know who you people are. How am I supposed to convince him?"
Zetsu smiled. "Simple. Just like you—implant a curse seal."
"With the curse mark in place, anyone will obey. Isn't that right?"
Ringo's expression twisted. He held back the urge to kill Zetsu and took a deep breath.
"That's nonsense. If you want to plant a curse seal on Zenkichi, go ahead. I won't stop you. Why come to me?"
Zetsu shook his head, utterly sincere. "I'd die. I'm no match for Zenkichi."
"That's why I'm giving you this—developed by Sunagakure. A one-day knockout drug."
"There's no antidote. The effect wears off naturally. It's perfect for subduing Zenkichi."
Zetsu produced a porcelain bottle and handed it to Ringo Kiru.
"You just need to find a chance to drug Zenkichi."
---
Eight hundred meters away, atop a building…
Zenkichi sat cross-legged on a rooftop, rubbing his temples with a troubled look.
He had heard Zetsu's appearance and rushed here, planning to take a shot—give Zetsu a taste of death from 800 meters away.
But the next words he heard left him stunned—and let Zetsu live a bit longer.
"Times have changed," he muttered.
"Madara…"
"The battlefield's rose, the Demon of the Ninja World, has now fallen to drugging people?"
Zenkichi sighed quietly. He hesitated—should he follow up and visit the legendary Rose of the Battlefield himself?
"But nah… I've got no resistance to drugs. If I really get knocked out, who knows what'll happen? Might end up losing my virginity."Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"That curse seal of Madara's… it's no joke."
After some thought, Zenkichi wisely gave up the idea of confronting him directly.
Even if he wanted to meet Uchiha Madara, this wasn't the way.

chapters.title: Chapter 44 - 44: kaguya's Clan Resistance.
chapters.content:
Dazzling golden light bloomed in Zenkichi's hands as a concentrated beam of light shot out, piercing the wall of Ringo Kiru's home from over 800 meters away.
Ringo Kiru was just about to take the porcelain bottle from White Zetsu's hand when a brilliant golden flash blinded him.
In the next instant, the White Zetsu before him was struck in the head by that golden beam and killed on the spot.
Then, an even brighter radiance illuminated the room—like a miniature sun had suddenly appeared. The golden particles condensed into the form of Zenkichi. Standing over the fallen White Zetsu, he calmly bent down and picked up the porcelain bottle.
"A sedative that knocks you out for a whole day? That's quite something," he muttered.
"Elder Kiru, care to explain yourself?"
Zenkichi pocketed the bottle, speaking in an offhand tone.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"I don't understand what you're talking about."
"And more importantly, why did you kill my guest?"
Ringo Kiru steadied himself, replying in a composed voice, "Even if you're the Mizukage's favored successor, you can't just kill someone in my home without reason."
Gaining a bit of courage, Ringo Kiru raised his voice.
"How outrageous!"
Zenkichi chuckled. "Save your indignation, Elder Kiru. It's not me you need to convince."
He gestured, and several ANBU shinobi in masks emerged, surrounding Ringo Kiru.
"Take him in. The interrogation unit can question him thoroughly."
"You can't do this!" Ringo Kiru shouted, panic rising in his voice. "I'm a high-ranking official in Kirigakure! You have no authority to arrest me like this!"
"I demand to see the Mizukage! I've bled for this village—"
He trailed off as Zenkichi stepped closer. Though he did not resist, fear had clearly overtaken him.
Zenkichi sighed, cleaning his ear with a pinky. "So much whining. You guys better get this over with."
Ringo Kiru was arrested and brought in for questioning.
Upon hearing the news, the Third Mizukage rushed to the site, personally overseeing the interrogation. It went smoothly—too smoothly.
A curse seal was found on Ringo Kiru's body, and once exposed, he had nothing left to deny.
Unfortunately, the seal was exceptionally complex—beyond Kirigakure's ability to remove. The Third Mizukage's expression turned grim.
"I never imagined our village's upper echelon could be infiltrated like this…"
He examined the notes. "This seal is similar to Danzo's Tongue Curse—perhaps even more potent. It restricts memory access and suppresses any attempt to speak."
"We need to conduct a full sweep of the village."
"There's no need to dig into memories, but we must ensure no one else carries a similar curse mark."
"Anyone under this kind of control is a puppet. If there are more like Ringo Kiru among us, Kirigakure could be in grave danger."
Zenkichi nodded. "You're right. Let's proceed."
He already suspected Madara had pawns in Kirigakure, but the extent was still unclear. If someone like Ringo Kiru was compromised, who else had slipped under the radar?
Zenkichi figured if Madara were behind it, he'd likely plant both visible and hidden agents—one in the open, one in the shadows.
The Third Mizukage made the announcement, and the village was thrown into chaos.
"Ever since the Ringo Kiru incident, the whole village has been on edge," Zenkichi muttered, lounging in the Mizukage's office, legs crossed and skimming through a newspaper.
"I knew this would happen once I exposed him. Panic was inevitable."
"But we needed a justification to inspect the entire village, especially the major clans. Without concrete evidence, they'd never agree to such scrutiny."
"And as for the panic? It's manageable."
He waved the paper in the air.
"We're not at war. The village has enough resources to handle internal problems."
The Third Mizukage looked up from his paperwork and asked, "By the way, why don't you start learning Mizukage duties? Get familiar."
He glanced at Zenkichi, whose carefree attitude gave him a headache.
"No way," Zenkichi said flatly. "A Mizukage buried in paperwork all day? Sounds miserable. When I take over, I'm assigning an entire team just for that."
The Mizukage blinked. "Huh… you know, that's not a bad idea."
He smiled bitterly. "If only I'd realized that sooner. I could've started building a team years ago."
Just then, an ANBU shinobi appeared.
"Mizukage-sama, we've run into resistance from the Kaguya clan."
The Third Mizukage furrowed his brow. The Kaguya were infamous for being uncooperative—and dangerous.
"The Kaguya clan again?"
Zenkichi folded the newspaper and stood.
"Knew they'd be trouble. Want me to handle it?"
"I've been wanting to take my disciples out for some experience anyway."
The Third Mizukage considered it. "They're still Kirigakure shinobi. Don't go overboard."

chapters.title: Chapter 45 - 45: A Real Man Fights Head On.
chapters.content:
As early as when he took action to kill White Zetsu, Zenkichi had already planned to leave Kirigakure.
Madara Uchiha had targeted him and plotted against him.
Although Madara did not succeed, Zenkichi was not the type to let things slide—he would repay Madara Uchiha one way or another.
However, the Third Mizukage wanted a thorough investigation of spies within the village—an order that ruffled many feathers.
Especially among the major clans in Kirigakure, who already had strained relations with the village's top brass.
If not for Zenkichi, a powerhouse keeping things in check, the Third Mizukage would likely feel insecure.
Now that the Kaguya clan had stepped out of line, Zenkichi didn't mind using them as an example to instill fear.
When it came to the Kaguya clan, Zenkichi had no hesitation.
The other two great families—the Oniden and the Mizunashi—had already offered goodwill.
Mizunashi Aoki and Kito Mangetsu had become Zenkichi's subordinates as a sign of alliance.
But the Kaguya clan, in contrast, remained arrogant and dismissive.
This clan was made up of hot-blooded lunatics, most of them obsessed with combat.
They were cold and conceited, incompatible with both civilian and other clan-based shinobi.
Bloodthirsty and cruel, they didn't hesitate to kill even their own kin.
They refused to follow orders—even directives from the village's top leaders fell on deaf ears.
Yet their strength was undeniable—even without awakening their Shikotsumyaku, they were still fearsome.
A clan of battle maniacs—being strong was in their nature.
Due to the Kaguya's military prowess and their sensitive relationship with the village, the higher-ups had long turned a blind eye to their conduct.
But that only made the Kaguya even more arrogant and out of control.
Just like now.
While the Mizunashi and Oniden clans had agreed to cooperate, the Kaguya clan defiantly resisted the orders of the Third Mizukage.
But this time, they were about to run into a wall.
Because Zenkichi would crush their pride—completely and absolutely.
---
At the Kaguya clan residence…
Several senior members of the Kaguya clan gathered with expressions full of disdain.
"The Third Mizukage is really losing his touch."
"Issuing such a ridiculous order? He should step down already."
"I heard he's planning to make Zenkichi the next Mizukage. That brat supposedly stirred up a storm in Konoha."
"Rumors. Let's see it to believe it."
"Exactly! With our Kaguya clan's strength, how could some brat compare?"
"I bet all he did was hang around Konoha's gates. The Mizukage is clearly exaggerating."
"The Mizunashi and Oniden clans are a disgrace—bowing to that guy over such nonsense."
"I heard they even sent their talented clan heirs to cozy up to that Zenkichi. Truly shameful."
"The Fourth Mizukage? That title should go to our Kaguya clan."
"Right! When the Third Mizukage steps down, we'll make our move."
"Will the village council agree though?"
"They'll have no choice."
...
Two Kaguya fools chatted enthusiastically, completely unaware of the reality of Zenkichi's strength.
"Patriarch! The village leaders have sent someone again!"
A Kaguya clan member burst in, shouting the report.
"Again? What a nuisance."
"Let's go."
"Elders, it's time we make our stance clear to the village."
The Kaguya clan leader sneered and rallied the elders. He wanted the village leaders to feel the pressure.
---
Outside the Kaguya Clan Residence…
Zenkichi stood casually at the gate, yawning lazily with a bored expression.
"We've already said this, haven't we?"
"The Kaguya clan will not accept inspection from the village."
"We'll examine our own people—we don't need outsiders."
"Even the top village officials might be compromised. Who's to say the inspection team isn't infiltrated too?"
"What if a spy hides among them and uses the investigation to make a move against us? We'd be the victims then."
With an arrogant strut, Kaguya Shorai, the clan leader, stepped out to meet Zenkichi.
"You are… Kaguya Shorai, head of the Kaguya clan?"
Zenkichi tilted his head and stared lazily at him, pulling a crumpled cigarette from his pocket.
A laser flickered from his fingertip—a flash of light-style chakra—and lit it up.
"That's right."
"You're Zenkichi, the one making waves lately?"
"Hmph! The Oniden and Mizunashi clans might grovel before you, but we're not like them."
Kaguya Shorai sneered, his gaze filled with scorn.
"So scary," Zenkichi replied dryly. "Everyone in the Kaguya clan is brainless."
"Especially the two morons in charge. Pathetic."
He flicked the cigarette away and smirked, oozing mockery. His disdainful expression only infuriated the Kaguya clan.
"You bastard!"
With a roar, Kaguya Shorai used the Body Flicker Technique and appeared before Zenkichi, throwing a ruthless punch toward his chest.
Zenkichi didn't even dodge.
His body absorbed the blow—the area around the impact flashing gold—his elemental form surged and neutralized the attack.
"Scary, scary," Zenkichi said sarcastically. "Your speed's no joke—definitely worthy of the Kaguya name."
"You actually pierced my body!"
He looked down at the stunned Kaguya Shorai, expression full of ridicule.
"What's with the sneaky tricks? A real man fights head-on."
Shorai froze, then barked in anger.
"Fine then! Head-on!"
"As you wish," Zenkichi said, raising his hand—then slapped him across the face.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 46 - 46: Yasakani No Magatama.
chapters.content:
Zenkichi was a very talkative person.
Since Kaguya Shorai wanted to confront him head-on, then Zenkichi would oblige.
His palm struck Shorai's face hard. Even with his thick skin, Shorai felt a jolt of pain.
Kaguya Shorai's body flew backward like a cannonball and smashed into the wall of the Kaguya clan compound with a heavy thud.
The members of the Kaguya clan fell into stunned silence. Their expressions looked as if they were questioning reality itself.
Their supposedly invincible clan leader was beaten back so easily?
"Damn it!"
Shorai climbed to his feet and shouted at Zenkichi in frustration.
"Don't be so worked up," Zenkichi replied casually. "I just gave you what you wanted. No need to get emotional."
Zenkichi looked at Shorai with a gentle smile, but the mockery in his voice only made the man angrier.
The elder of the Kaguya clan, Yan, shouted, "Zenkichi, did you come here just to provoke the Kaguya clan?"
Zenkichi picked at his ear and replied lazily, "Provoke? Me? I think I've been quite considerate."ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
"The clan leader asked for a head-on fight, so I granted his wish."
"But what about him? Look at me!" He pointed to his chest, where a large hole glowing with golden light still remained. "He pierced straight through me, and I haven't even healed yet!"
"This is a life-threatening injury! If the Kaguya clan doesn't compensate me with hundreds of millions of ryō, this won't end here!"
"Bastard!"
"You came here just to cause trouble!"
"Unforgivable!"
The three elders of the Kaguya clan shouted furiously in unison.
"Kill him!" Kaguya Shorai bellowed, charging at Zenkichi without hesitation.
A bone sword extended from Shorai's arm, and he slashed at Zenkichi with full force.
Slash!
Zenkichi's body was cut in half. His upper body was flung into the air.
"Terrifying!" he exclaimed midair, still calm. "You sliced me in half. Truly worthy of being the Kaguya clan's leader."
"We collided, so let's keep clashing!"
Despite his playful tone, Shorai struck him again and again, turning Zenkichi's upper body into ribbons of golden light.
"How ruthless."
Zenkichi's body reformed in a burst of shimmering particles, the top half merging seamlessly with the bottom.
"So this is the legendary Kekkei Genkai of the Kaguya clan, the Shikotsumyaku!"
"It really is impressive. Thanks for the demonstration."
"Now it's my turn to show you something special!"
Zenkichi's tone dropped a register. His body glowed as he vanished, reappearing instantly in front of Shorai.
"Shining Art: Blinding Light!"
With his hands in his pockets, an explosion of golden light burst from Zenkichi's body—so bright it was like a second sun had appeared.
"My eyes!"
"Closing them doesn't help—it burns!"
"Turn around!"
Even with their eyes shut, the Kaguya clan members couldn't escape the blinding brilliance. The golden light seared through their eyelids, forcing them to turn away in agony.
"Oh? You all turned around for me? I'm touched," Zenkichi said with mock emotion, raising his hand and lowering it dramatically.
He had no intention of killing needlessly—that wasn't his style.
"You bastard, die!"
Just as Zenkichi was sighing, a man wearing sunglasses burst from the Kaguya compound, brandishing a bone blade as he charged at him.
Zenkichi looked surprised. "Another one with the Shikotsumyaku?"
"No… just using a special weapon."
He shook his head, then casually raised one leg.
All the golden light around him gathered at his heel, condensing into a spinning cross-shaped flash.
"Speed is weight."
"Young Kaguya ninja…"
"Have you ever been kicked at the speed of light?"
Zenkichi swung his leg. The charging Kaguya ninja was blasted away like a ragdoll.
"Ren!"
The other Kaguya shinobi, still turned away, cried out in panic.
"You idiots…" Zenkichi muttered. "He was clearly ready to fight me, but he didn't even bring sunglasses?"
"You people are so 'clever'… If Kirigakure hadn't been protecting you, you'd have all been cannon fodder by now."
He sighed. It was a miracle the Kaguya clan had survived this long.
"Don't look down on us!"
"Even with our eyes closed, the Kaguya clan can still fight!"
"Don't think you're invincible!"
One of them tore a strip of cloth from Shorai's clothes and tied it over his own eyes. Apparently, his eyelids alone weren't enough—he needed an extra layer to block out the glare.
Zenkichi watched all this with a deadpan stare. When he saw Shorai preparing to attack him blindly, he sighed again.
He raised his hand. Golden light gathered on his fingertip.
With a hum, a spiraling cross of laser light shot from his finger and pierced through Shorai.
"What a bunch of morons."
"If you keep this up, I won't hold back anymore."
"Either you follow the village's orders from now on—or I'll crush you all right here."
Zenkichi's voice turned cold. His sharp gaze swept over the Kaguya clan.
"Kill him!"
"Avenge the clan leader!"
"Make him pay!"
Hearing Shorai collapse, the third elder roared with fury, leading the clan members into a reckless charge.
"What a bunch of hard-headed fools."
"No wonder they launched a rebellion with only their own clan in the original story…"
Zenkichi looked down at the angry Kaguya shinobi, completely unimpressed.
His body turned to light and shot into the sky.
"Yasakani no Magatama!"

chapters.title: Chapter 47 - 47: Going Overseas.
chapters.content:
Dense golden light bullets fell from the sky, overwhelming the Kaguya ninja.
The Kaguya were like warriors from the feudal era, using flesh and blood to face a hailstorm of bullets from the industrial age.
Golden bullet holes riddled their bodies—this was precisely why Zenkichi didn't go for the kill. If he had, it wouldn't have been mere penetrating damage. The golden light bullets would have torn their bodies to pieces.
On a distant rooftop, the leader of the Mizunashi clan, Yanagi Mizunashi, and the head of the Oniden clan, Oniden Heishui, stood side by side, watching from afar as Zenkichi suppressed the Kaguya clan.
"Have you given up?"
Oniden Heishui suddenly spoke.
"Go back and restrain your clan members. Try not to provoke the village. The current Kirigakure isn't something we can oppose,"
Mizunashi Yanagi sighed, speaking helplessly.
They were both deeply dissatisfied with the Third Mizukage's inspection order. Due to fear and mistrust of the higher-ups, they worried it was a ploy to weaken them.
However, unlike the Kaguya clan, they weren't foolish enough to act out and draw attention.
Now, seeing the consequences the Kaguya faced, they had wisely reined in their rebellious thoughts.
---
"Done!"Googlᴇ search
Zenkichi descended from the sky, nodding with satisfaction at the downed Kaguya ninja.
"Although they're seriously injured, they can still recover with proper treatment."
"Leave them to Lord Mizukage. He'll decide whether the Kaguya clan stays or goes."
Zenkichi turned and gave orders to the ANBU operatives behind him. Then, glancing at Mei,Yukine, Yagura, and Mangetsu:
"You four, get ready. I've got a perfect training spot. We're heading out tomorrow."
He intended to confront Uchiha Madara soon—but before that, he needed to send his apprentices and subordinates overseas for training.
Their current strength was still too low to shoulder the responsibilities of being Zenkichi's trusted allies.
---
The next day.
Wearing a yellow-striped suit, a white cloak, and brown sunglasses, Zenkichi stood proudly in front of his students.
"Zenkichi?"
Terumi Mei looked at him, clearly surprised. His outfit was far from traditional.
"I had these custom-made. What do you think?"
Zenkichi adjusted his cloak with pride.
"Very unique—and handsome!"
Mizunashi Yukine. replied quickly, prompting a wary look from Mei.
"Captain, are you taking us out to train?"
Mangetsu refocused the group.
"That's right! You're all talented, but talent without training is meaningless."
"With your current level, finding proper opponents here is hard."
"There are strong ninja in the other villages, but Kirigakure isn't at war with them. It wouldn't be wise to provoke them."
"So, I've decided to take you overseas. I've heard of a professional ninja competition happening there."
"That should be the perfect environment to test yourselves and grow quickly."
"Oh, and one more thing—we're going in an unofficial capacity. Remove all Kirigakure symbols from your gear."
Zenkichi explained casually.
"Overseas? Sounds exciting."
Terumi Mei removed her Kirigakure forehead protector. The others followed suit and dressed like wandering ninja.
---
Not long after…
A massive ship cruised across the sea. Zenkichi lounged on a deck chair, sipping tea and sunbathing—bored but relaxed.
Nearby, Kisame Hoshigaki and Momochi Zabuza sparred using wooden swords.
"Mr. Zenkichi, is it really safe to let them fight like that?"
"Even with wooden blades, their strikes could break bones."
Mizunashi Yukine walked over, frowning slightly at the brutal sparring.
"Sweat more in training, bleed less in battle."
"A broken bone now might save their life in a real mission."
"Ninja work isn't safe—we risk our lives every day."
"In our academy, graduation exams involved students fighting each other."
"This is nothing in comparison."
"If they're strong, they'll break the other's bones. If not, they'll learn their place."
Zenkichi spoke calmly without looking up from his book.
Zabuza nodded. "Teacher Zenkichi is right! Compared to graduation exams where we fought for real, this kind of sparring is tame."
Kisame agreed in his deep, gravelly voice, "Exactly."
Yukine went silent, eventually nodding in understanding.
Zenkichi glanced up with a slight smile.
"Good. You both have the right attitude."
"Once you become jōnin, I'll give each of you a ninja blade. You'll become members of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist."
Zabuza's eyes lit up. "Are you serious, teacher?"
He had a natural affinity for swordsmanship and a particular fondness for the Executioner's Blade.
"If possible, I'd like the Executioner's Blade," Zabuza added.
Kisame chimed in, "If I could choose, I'd take Samehada."
Mangetsu scoffed, "Not just anyone can handle those swords."
"The Executioner's Blade requires immense physical, arm, and wrist strength. Samehada might even turn on its wielder."
Zenkichi looked at Mangetsu calmly.
"Don't underestimate them. I believe they can—and they will—master those blades."

chapters.title: Chapter 48 - 48: In The Name Of Justice.
chapters.content:
While fighting Momochi Zabuza, Kisame said in his unique accent, "Will the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist hand over their blades?"
Zenkichi replied lazily, "You don't need to worry about that. I believe they'll give me some face."
"Speaking of which… Mangetsu Hōzuki, does your clan still have that scroll that channels the power of the ninja swords?"
Zenkichi looked curiously at Mangetsu. That kind of scroll had appeared in the original series and was used by Mangetsu after he was reincarnated by Edo Tensei.
Mangetsu nodded. "Most of the Seven Ninja Swords were acquired by our Hōzuki Clan. Our ancestors crafted a summoning scroll, but it can only be used by those of our bloodline."
Zenkichi said calmly, "Is that so? Then work hard. You've got talent—I believe you can master all seven swords."New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Mangetsu was momentarily stunned, then grinned. "That's my goal!"
Just then,Yukine's voice sounded. "I sense a large amount of chakra up ahead—looks like a fleet of ships is coming this way."
Zenkichi used Observation Haki and smiled. "Relax, they're just a bunch of pirates."
In the world of Naruto, it wasn't only shinobi—samurai, pirates, and bandits existed as well.
Moments later, several pirate ships appeared on the horizon, opposite Zenkichi's ship. The ships were armed with massive crossbows, each fitted with explosive tags.
When triggered, the explosive tags launched the bolts with devastating force, the impact amplified by the chakra-infused mechanisms.
"The bolts have destructive kinetic energy—and then the tag detonates afterward!"
"A pirate crew with ninja-level tactics... how terrifying."
Zenkichi muttered casually. A golden light sparked at his fingertips, and a cross-shaped glow began to spin.
A beam of pure light—brilliant and searing—fired from his hand, slicing through the incoming bolts midair.
"You guys, take care of the rest."
He waved lazily, signaling his students and subordinates to engage.
Training alone wasn't enough—true growth came from battle.
"A fight at last."
A flash of bloodlust crossed Zabuza's eyes. He drew his massive sword and charged toward the pirate fleet.
Kisame wasn't far behind, grinning as he leapt into the fray. The others quickly followed suit, blades drawn.
Yagura dashed across the water, forming hand signs mid-stride.
Water Release: Water Dragon Bullet Technique!
A towering water dragon erupted from the sea, bolstered by Yagura's strategic use of the surrounding water, and crashed down, obliterating an entire ship.
"Water Style, huh?"
Mangetsu glanced sideways. The pride of his clan wouldn't allow him to sit back while someone else stole the spotlight. He immediately activated the Hydrification Technique, a secret of the Hōzuki Clan.
This technique not only allowed him to transform into water but also manipulate vast amounts of it in combat.
Mangetsu controlled the ocean itself, forming a colossal, vicious sea creature from the waves. With a gaping maw, the water beast swallowed an entire pirate ship, trapping it in an aquatic prison.
Lava Release: Monster Melting Technique!
Mei Terumī spewed a torrent of corrosive acid, transforming the battlefield into a downpour of acidic rain. Pirates screamed and scrambled in panic as it burned through metal and flesh alike.
Ice Release: A Thousand Ice Senbon!
Mizunashi Yukine unleashed a hailstorm of razor-sharp ice needles that rained down on the enemy ranks with chilling precision.
"So many powerful jutsu…"
Kisame and Zabuza couldn't help but feel a twinge of envy. They were still sword specialists for now—but both were naturals. Mastering jutsu would be no problem.
Zenkichi had already prepared two training modules for them: one for silent assassination, and another focused on Water Release techniques.
Just like in the original, Zabuza would walk the path of silent killing, while Kisame would become a water-style turret.
"Ninjas?!"
"Damn it, why are they shinobi?!"
"With this kind of power, what are they even escorting?!"
"Retreat! Retreat immediately!"
The pirate captain panicked at the display of overwhelming force and ordered a hasty retreat.
Facing two Water Release experts on the open sea was suicide.
"You think you can run? Not that easy."
"If you escape, how could I live up to my cloak of justice?"
"With this get-up, I'll be promoted to Admiral for sure!"
Zenkichi glanced at his outfit and chuckled to himself. Then he soared into the sky in a burst of golden light particles, reforming high above.
Yasakani no Magatama!
A barrage of light bullets rained down like meteors, shredding the pirate ships to floating wreckage.
The surviving pirates tried to flee by jumping into the sea—only to find Kisame and the others waiting for them atop the waves.
"It's over."
Zenkichi landed gracefully, his tone calm.
[ Ding! Achievement Unlocked – Pirate Annihilation! Template Character: Kizaru. Synchronization Rate: 47%! ]
The system notification rang in Zenkichi's mind, filling him with satisfaction.
Compared to the earlier mission of suppressing the Kaguya Clan, wiping out pirates had yielded a much higher synchronization rate.
"Is it because Kizaru is a Marine?" Zenkichi mused. That seemed the only explanation.
Still, he knew the same results wouldn't come from repeating the feat endlessly. The bonus had been achieved—any more would yield diminishing returns.
"In the name of justice, confiscate all their treasure!"
He snapped out of his thoughts and shouted the order to Kisame and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 49 - 49: Going After Nagato.
chapters.content:
Overseas, Neutral Island
This is an island that does not belong to any country. It has a prosperous commercial center and a developed economy. Wealthy merchants from across the ninja world frequently gather here.
There is a particularly unique place on this island: the Arena.
Unlike traditional colosseums where beasts clash, this one pits ninjas against each other.
---
"This is your training ground. Watch carefully—the ninjas you'll face will appear down there."
"If you think you're ready, just tell me. I'll let you in."
"Don't choose opponents who are too weak… but don't pick ones too strong either."
"Select someone close to your level. That's the best way to gain experience."
"I must warn you—if you lose in the arena, you'll be taken away by others."
"Though I will retrieve you afterward, you won't enjoy the experience."
Zenkichi stood in a private box, calmly watching two ninjas battle below. He addressed the group behind him in an indifferent tone.
---
"Interesting!"
"Is this the experience Zenkichi-sensei prepared for us? Looks fun," Momochi Zabuza licked his lips. "Can we kill in the arena?"
Zenkichi responded coldly, "Of course. But it wouldn't be fun if you were the one killed."
Zabuza smirked, confident. "No worries—I'm not that fragile."
Zenkichi nodded. He believed him.
Anyone who earned a name in the original canon wasn't weak—especially not those from Kirigakure. The brutality of that village was no joke. A little training here wouldn't kill them.
---
"Another fighter's entering... he has a Kekkei Genkai," someone commented.
"That's surprising. I've already seen several Kekkei Genkai users."
"Why are there so many here?"
Terumi Mei asked with a puzzled expression, turning to Zenkichi.
---
"Because most of the spectators are rich merchants from the Five Great Nations," Zenkichi replied calmly.
"Their subordinates have raised many ninjas—and they deliberately collect Kekkei Genkai users."
"Don't underestimate the power of money. Even Kage-level experts can be bought."
"It's not unusual for such wealthy individuals to keep Kekkei Genkai users under their command."
---
"To treat ninjas like this… it's disgusting!"
"What do they think we are—beasts?!"
Hōzuki Mangetsu shouted angrily, visibly upset.
"Don't worry. This won't last much longer," Zenkichi reassured, smirking toward the spectators outside.
These wealthy merchants were already on his watch list.
If they dared provoke the anger of the ninja class, Zenkichi could confiscate their assets under just cause.
---
"A Water Release user just entered. He looks like a Jōnin-level ninja. Mind if I handle this one?"
Yagura's eyes lit up, having found a worthy opponent.
"No problem."
Zenkichi waved casually, and a staff member went out to announce the next challenger.
---
Yagura's opponent didn't possess a Kekkei Genkai, but had an enormous chakra reserve and a strong affinity for Water Release.
Water-style ninjutsu relies on both chakra volume and kinetic force to be truly effective—requiring tremendous chakra.
Yagura and Kisame were both chakra monsters, and the opponent below was on par with Yagura in chakra levels.
---
"What a fantastic Water Release duel," Hoshigaki Kisame remarked enviously while watching Yagura's battle. He hadn't yet learned that many Water-style techniques.
---
"Oh right—I nearly forgot!"
"All the ninjutsu you need to learn are right here. I've already prepared them for you."
Zenkichi reached into his cloak and pulled out several scrolls packed with jutsu.
"You'll need to adapt quickly. I won't be staying here with you."
---
Terumi Mei asked in surprise, "You're leaving?"
Zenkichi nodded. "There's a powerful enemy I must handle personally."
"The fight will be dangerous. I can't take you with me."
"Someone even you can't handle?" Terumi Mei's eyes widened. "Is it one of the Kage?"
Zenkichi smiled mysteriously. "No. But he's far more powerful than any current Kage."
"Even though he's old, I doubt any of the Five Kage could defeat him."
---
Terumi Mei was stunned and tried to press for more details, but Zenkichi only chuckled and shook his head.
"I'll tell you in time."
He stayed for two more days—long enough for Terumi Mei and the others to adjust to the island.
Then, Zenkichi departed alone by boat, headed for the mainland.
---
He trekked through the dense forest near the Valley of the End, his Observation Haki (Kenbunshoku Haki) fully activated, searching for Uchiha Madara's whereabouts.
---
"No sign of him?"
Zenkichi frowned thoughtfully and moved to investigate the area around Kannabi Bridge, but still found no trace of Madara.
Despite his advanced age and life support systems, Madara was still mobile.
A war-hardened veteran like Madara surely knew the value of backup plans. The base under the Valley of the End or Kannabi Bridge was probably just one of his many hideouts.
---
"This is a problem," Zenkichi muttered.
"If I can't find Madara, I'll go after Nagato."
"Those Rinnegan eyes… are worth collecting."
He pondered quietly, a smile spreading across his face.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 50 - 50: I Came For The Rinnegan.
chapters.content:
The Land of Rain
At this time, the Land of Rain had become a battlefield among the great powers.
Although Hanzo of the Salamander, the leader of the Rain Village, bore the title of "Demigod," he was powerless in this situation.
Even a Kage-level shinobi was no match for the full-scale war between major nations—unless they were someone like the God of Shinobi, Senju Hashirama, or the War Demon, Uchiha Madara.
No one else could shift the tide of war on their own.
However, during this period, a group known as the Akatsuki had become active within the Land of Rain.
Though not powerful in terms of military might, the organization had gained a growing number of followers through its vision of peace.
Now, they were devoting themselves to mediating conflicts between the major shinobi villages, hoping to quell the war.
---
Akatsuki Headquarters
Zenkichi walked slowly toward the Akatsuki base, holding an umbrella as the rain continued to fall.
"Halt! This is the Akatsuki's territory. Who are you? What business do you have here?"
Two guards at the entrance stepped forward, their expressions serious.
"The Akatsuki? Then I'm in the right place. Tell your leader that the envoy from Kirigakure has arrived."
Zenkichi raised his head slightly, a calm half-smile on his face.
---
Inside the Akatsuki headquarters, Yahiko, Nagato, and Konan—the three leaders—were currently hosting a white-haired, one-armed man.
This man was none other than Jiraiya. In this timeline, Zenkichi had altered the events, causing Jiraiya to come here himself.
Jiraiya had lost his arm in a confrontation with Zenkichi. With that loss, his combat power—and more importantly, his standing in Konoha—had declined sharply.
He was no longer considered fit for the battlefield. The higher-ups in Konoha had instructed him to adapt to his new limitations and recover as much strength as possible.
Though losing an arm was a major blow, it wasn't as painful as the betrayal he felt from Konoha's leadership.
After Zenkichi's departure, the decisions made in Konoha left him bitterly disappointed.
How could someone like Akimichi Torifu become the Fourth Hokage? Did they really think he couldn't see what was going on?
Did Jiraiya truly leave Konoha in the original timeline just to gather writing material?
Disillusioned and heartbroken, he left Konoha and came to the Land of Rain to visit his former students.
He still remembered the prophecy from the Great Toad Sage—that one of his students would change the world.
The Rinnegan!
Jiraiya knew he wasn't of much use to Konoha anymore. If anything, his real value now lay in focusing on Nagato.
The Rinnegan, the eyes of the Sage of Six Paths, now belonged to Nagato.
In Jiraiya's eyes, his student was perhaps the only person who could truly become the savior of the shinobi world.
---
"Leader, someone claiming to be an envoy from Kirigakure is outside and requesting an audience."
A member of the Akatsuki entered and reported the news to Yahiko.
"An envoy from Kirigakure?"
Yahiko looked puzzled. Why would Kirigakure send someone here?
Though the Akatsuki were growing in influence, they had no dealings with the Hidden Mist. There was no relationship between the two.
Kirigakure hadn't even participated significantly in the current war; they weren't one of the major forces involved.
Due to limited resources, the Akatsuki hadn't made any effort to contact the Mist Village either.
Their focus had been on mediating the conflicts involving their own country—the Land of Rain—as well as Konoha, Sunagakure, and Iwagakure.
In short, they were only involving themselves in wars that directly affected their homeland.
And rightly so—after all, it was the people of the Land of Rain who made up the Akatsuki. If their own homeland wasn't being prioritized, no one would have joined the cause.
"The Hidden Mist?"ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ
Jiraiya's expression shifted slightly, but he quickly masked it.
"Jiraiya-sensei, is something wrong?"
Konan, always attentive, noticed the change in him and asked with concern.
"It's nothing."
Jiraiya offered a small smile to reassure her.
"Even though we didn't initiate contact with Kirigakure, since they've sent someone, we should at least hear them out."
Yahiko considered the situation and smiled faintly.
Jiraiya rose to his feet. "Shall I step out?"
Yahiko shook his head. "There's nothing shameful about what we do here."
Jiraiya gave a pleased nod, then sat back down with a grin. "Good. I'm here as your former teacher—not as a representative of Konoha."
Just then, a voice echoed through the room:
"Oh? Is that so? That's surprising. From what I recall, Jiraiya-sensei was always quite loyal to Konoha."
Jiraiya's face paled. His eyes turned to the doorway—and his expression darkened as he recognized the figure entering the room.
"You... Kirigakure Zenkichi!"
Jiraiya shouted, prompting Yahiko and the others to frown slightly. Clearly, they'd heard of the man before.
"Did you come here for me?"
Jiraiya stood up, his tone unfriendly.
"Because of you, Konoha's reputation has been dragged through the mud. What more do you want?"
Despite the aggressive tone, Jiraiya was really trying to distract Zenkichi. He was worried the young man might notice Nagato's eyes—even though they were hidden behind his red hair.
Zenkichi shrugged. "Reputation? That's rich coming from you, Jiraiya."
"You Konoha turned the Land of Rain into your battleground. Did you ever stop to consider how that made the people here feel?"
"What I did to Konoha is no worse than what your village has done to the Land of Rain."
Jiraiya's expression turned awkward. The hostility in Yahiko and the others' eyes noticeably lessened.
Yahiko stepped forward, changing the subject. "Are you here for Jiraiya-sensei?"
Zenkichi chuckled. "No. I came for the Rinnegan."

chapters.title: Chapter 51 - 51: Samsara Eyes.
chapters.content:
"I am here for the Rinnegan."
As soon as those words left his mouth, the atmosphere turned icy cold.
Nagato instinctively took a step back, and Yahiko immediately stood in front of him, shielding him.
Zenkichi observed the scene with faint amusement. Yahiko truly cared for Nagato.
No wonder that after Yahiko's death, Nagato would go so far as to use his body to lead the Akatsuki and fulfill his dream.
Suddenly, Jiraiya appeared before Zenkichi and shouted in a low voice, "You're no match for him—leave now!"
Zenkichi smiled. "Jiraiya, at least you're self-aware."
"But if you're so self-aware, then you should understand... they can't escape."
"How much time can you even buy them? How far could they get in that time?"
"It's useless. No one escapes me. Relax—I never said I was here to kill anyone."
He casually pulled up a chair and sat down.
Jiraiya remained tense, staring at him. "What do you want?"
Zenkichi replied lazily, "For certain reasons, I need to take the Rinnegan."
"If you cooperate, we avoid unnecessary trouble."
"I'm only taking his eyes. I won't endanger his life."
"With how advanced medical ninjutsu is now, giving him a new pair isn't that difficult."
Yahiko stepped forward sternly. "Impossible! Nagato is a member of Akatsuki, and the Rinnegan is a divine gift to the Land of Rain."
Zenkichi waved his hand casually. "A divine gift to the Land of Rain? Don't be absurd."
"The Rinnegan is the eye of the Sage of Six Paths. Do you really think just anyone can wield it?"
"Nagato is merely an orphan from the Uzumaki clan. What qualifications does he have to awaken these eyes?"
"He's only holding onto them. I'm just here to reclaim them."Follow current novels on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
His tone was calm, relaxed, as if discussing the weather.
Yahiko was momentarily stunned. "What? You mean the Rinnegan isn't his? Are you joking? What proof do you have?"
Zenkichi shrugged. "No proof. And I don't need to provide any. Even if I had it, I wouldn't bother showing it to you."
"I'm only telling you this because I'm in a good mood. That doesn't mean you're in any position to question me."
"Naive, young Yahiko... so naive."
Yahiko's face flushed with anger as he glared at him.
Zenkichi spoke slowly. "What's wrong? Angry? You really are naive."
"You actually think creating Akatsuki will stop the wars in this world?"
"Do you know how wars even begin? Do you really believe your hope for peace will touch the hearts of the village leaders?"
"Don't be foolish."
"Only when someone strong calls for peace will others listen. When the weak call for it, they get laughed at."
"Hashirama Senju was as naive as you. But he had the power to suppress the entire ninja world."
"That's why people respected his ideals. But you… you don't have his strength."
"Jiraiya, can't you see it? Akatsuki's goals are nothing more than an idealistic farce."
He glanced lazily at Jiraiya with a mocking smirk.
Jiraiya clenched his fists. "That has nothing to do with you! Someone like you—cold-blooded and heartless—could never understand dreams!"
Zenkichi scoffed. "Dreams? You mean fantasies in daylight? Spare me. I'm not here to argue philosophy."
"Hand over the Rinnegan and no one gets hurt. Jiraiya can vouch for that. I really am a kind person."
"Konoha once plotted to kill me with every trick in the book."
"But when I saw through it and defeated them… I spared them."
He said it as if it were a casual anecdote, eyes lazily shifting back to Jiraiya.
Jiraiya gritted his teeth. "No. No matter what, we can't give you the Rinnegan."
Zenkichi tilted his head slightly. "Really? So that's your stance? Jiraiya, do you value the Rinnegan more than their lives?"
Jiraiya's face tensed. "That's not what I said! Don't twist my words!"
Zenkichi smirked. "You didn't have to say it. Your actions already spoke loud and clear."
"You knew rejecting me would cost lives, yet you did it anyway."
"Do you have plans for the Rinnegan? What exactly do you intend to do with it?"
Yahiko's face flickered with hesitation. He wanted to object, but the words caught in his throat.
If refusal meant death, then what right did he have to speak on Nagato's behalf?
After all, the Rinnegan belonged to Nagato. Yahiko wasn't the one to decide its fate.
He turned to Nagato and said quietly, "Nagato, it's your call."
Nagato hesitated, then murmured, "If... if giving up these eyes means everyone will live, then—"
"No!" Jiraiya interrupted. "Nagato, you can't give him the Rinnegan!"
"You don't understand its importance. You don't understand your mission."
"You're the child of prophecy—the one who will change the world. The ninja world is waiting for you."
"Yahiko, Nagato, Konan... Why did you create Akatsuki?"
"And now, when it truly matters—when your lives are on the line—you'd just back down?"
"Don't give up!"
Jiraiya roared and charged toward Zenkichi without hesitation.
In his hand was a sealing talisman—an instant-cast technique—and he slammed it forward without warning.
"Jiraiya, you've chosen the wrong path."
Zenkichi shook his head, raised his hand, and fired a golden laser from one finger. The beam pierced the talisman mid-air, shattering the seal technique instantly.
"Now that you've made your decision... let me respond in kind."

chapters.title: Chapter 52 - 52: Black Zetsu
chapters.content:
"Paper Release – Paper Shuriken!"
"Wind Style – Gale Palm!"
"Fire Style – Fire Bullet!"
Just as Jiraiya launched his attack against Zenkichi, the three Yahikos also acted in unison.
All three were Jiraiya's disciples and had been together for years. Their teamwork in battle was seamless.
Densely packed paper shuriken flew toward Zenkichi, followed closely by fire bullets—whose flames were intensified by the wind release.
"It's useless."
Zenkichi said casually as all three attacks passed harmlessly through his body.
Jiraiya appeared next to Zenkichi in an instant, his palm and aimed at Zenkichi with a cursed seal strike.
Zenkichi smiled with disdain. His body turned into particles of light, vanishing and reappearing behind Jiraiya in the blink of an eye.
Golden light glinted off his brown sunglasses. Zenkichi casually raised his long leg, moving slowly to Jiraiya's side.
"Jiraiya, have you ever been kicked at the speed of light?"
"Sorry—have I kicked you before? I forgot."
Zenkichi said lazily as a golden cross-shaped light flared at his heel.
Boom!
His long leg swung out in a blur. Zenkichi sent Jiraiya flying with a single light-speed kick.
Even though Jiraiya had summoned Gamaken to guard himself, it did little against the sheer force of Zenkichi's speed.
"Jiraiya-sensei!"
Yahiko and the others were shocked and immediately attacked again. One ninjutsu after another was hurled toward Zenkichi.
Zenkichi strolled toward them, voice calm:
"Don't waste your energy. You should know it's pointless by now."
Nagato stepped in front of Yahiko and Konan and shouted,
"Take the Rinnegan, but don't hurt us."
Zenkichi nodded in approval.
"A wise choice."
At that moment, his expression shifted slightly. He sensed a strange presence.
"Uchiha Madara's backup plan?"
"An unexpected variable."
Zenkichi muttered to himself, but didn't immediately move to take Nagato's eyes.
Instead, he seemed intrigued—curious to see what other tricks Madara had left behind.
A mass of black sludge rose from the ground, forming directly beneath Nagato's feet, quickly engulfing his body.
Black Zetsu.
"What?!"
Nagato shouted in horror. He could no longer move—his body slipping from his control.
Black Zetsu invaded his form, beginning to forcibly take over.
"Nagato! Don't be afraid—I'm here to help you."
"Relax. Let us take control. We'll save you."
A hoarse, eerie voice echoed. Black Zetsu was bewitching Nagato with lies.
"Nagato?!"
Yahiko and Konan were alarmed. They wanted to help, but didn't know how.
"Is this your plan?"
Zenkichi watched with growing interest.
"I've known for a long time that the Rinnegan wouldn't end up in an Uzumaki orphan by chance."
"What exactly are you? There must be some deeper connection between you and the Rinnegan."
He said casually, choosing not to reveal Madara or Black Zetsu's involvement. There was no point in creating unnecessary complications.
"Hmph... My identity is more complex than you think—and you're in serious trouble."
Black Zetsu responded ominously, seizing control of Nagato and leaping away from the building.
A White Zetsu emerged beneath Nagato, opening its hollow body and swallowing him whole.
This White Zetsu was none other than Tobi—the eccentric clone who could wear his body like a suit.
"There's a problem with Nagato. Madara-sama is going to be furious!"
"Oh, by the way—now that I've possessed Nagato, I finally understand what it means to... relieve yourself."
"Is this that 'weird feeling' humans always talk about?"
Tobi's voice echoed comically as he began dancing.
"Shut up!"
"Tobi, behave yourself!"
Black Zetsu growled in irritation, fully taking control over Nagato's body.
'Black Zetsu and White Zetsu... Has Black Zetsu already revealed himself to Uchiha Madara by this time?'
'Did Madara create Black Zetsu earlier than expected—because of me? How fascinating.'
Zenkichi's body shimmered, transforming into light particles and instantly reappearing in front of Nagato.
By now, Nagato was completely engulfed by Black Zetsu and Tobi. Only a single eye—the Rinnegan—remained visible, glowing with immense power.
Together, Black Zetsu and White Zetsu coordinated their control, wielding even the Rinnegan's power effortlessly.
"Feel the might of the Rinnegan!"
"These are the eyes of the Sage of Six Paths—unrivaled and supreme!"
"Almighty Pull!"
Nagato extended his palm, releasing a powerful gravitational force aimed at Zenkichi.
"It's useless."
"Your gravity is far too weak to affect me."
"If you want to pull in light, your gravity would have to rival a black hole."
Zenkichi shook his head, allowing his light-based body to disperse and easily evade the gravitational pull.
From his raised finger, a blinding golden beam ignited. The cross-shaped light began to rotate.
Zap!
The laser fired. Calmly, Nagato extended his hand and caught the beam.
Preta Path!ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Nagato tried to absorb the laser as chakra using the Rinnegan's preta path.
Unfortunately, he was doomed to fail. The golden laser wasn't made of chakra.
Sizzle!
The beam pierced through his hand, searing a burn around the hole it left.
"Ahhh!"
"It hurts—it burns!"
"This light—it's scorching!"
Tobi screamed and flailed, hopping around in pain.
"Shut up!"
"Tobi! Help me suppress him!"
Feeling Nagato's resistance due to the pain, Black Zetsu was beginning to lose patience.
"Trouble within?"
The golden cross on Zenkichi's fingertip spun again, charging up another devastating laser shot.

chapters.title: Chapter 53 - 53: Uchiha Madara.
chapters.content:
Tobi and Black Zetsu controlled Nagato, barely dodging Zenkichi's laser in a panic.
Zenkichi slowly released the beam—golden light flaring from his body. Nagato, under the control of Black Zetsu and White Zetsu, narrowly avoided the strike.
"How terrifying."
"They're fighting each other, yet still managing such clean dodges…"
"If you weren't fighting among yourselves, wouldn't I be dead already?" Zenkichi remarked casually. The laser at his fingertips kept firing, leaving glowing marks across A Fei's body.
…
In an underground stronghold in the Land of Rain, Uchiha Madara listened to Black Zetsu's report.
"Zenkichi from Kirigakure actually found Nagato? Damn it."
"Even the secret of the Rinnegan was exposed. Looks like I'll have to step in myself."
"If he seizes the Rinnegan… or worse, destroys it… everything I've built will be ruined."
Madara turned to the Gedo Statue behind him, forming hand seals. A tremendous wave of life force surged out from the statue, traveling through the chakra receiver tube into his body. As he absorbed the massive energy, Madara's withered white hair rapidly darkened, and his old face regained youth.
"Half an hour? That's enough."
With a cold smile, Uchiha Madara severed the tube and moved out—his destination: Nagato.
—Akatsuki Base—
Zenkichi fired off another laser, drawing a crude tattoo on Tobi—a Peppa Pig face emerging on his chest.
"Beautiful," Zenkichi nodded with mock satisfaction.
Black Zetsu and Tobi were on the brink of collapse. Zenkichi was clearly toying with them, which only heightened their fear and despair.
Suddenly, Zenkichi frowned and turned toward the land in front of Nagato.
The ground trembled—and shattered. A massive figure emerged.
Wild black hair, flowing like a mane. Seven thick black braids flowed down his back, covering one eye. His presence exuded dominance.
Uchiha Madara!
"So, you finally showed up, Uchiha Madara."
"You were surprisingly hard to track down. I searched everywhere but couldn't find you," Zenkichi said, his tone casual—but his eyes sharp.
Madara narrowed his gaze. "You knew I was alive?"
Zenkichi smiled. "Of course. Didn't you have someone drug me, trying to turn me into your puppet?"
"I haven't paid you back for that! I've been searching high and low to return the favor."
Madara glanced at Nagato and scoffed. "You even know about the Rinnegan… You know quite a lot."
Zenkichi smirked. "Naturally. The White Zetsu you sent knows all kinds of things."
Madara's tone turned low. "You extracted memories from White Zetsu? You've got tricks…"
Nearby, Jiraiya, Yahiko, and the others were stunned.
Jiraiya stared at Madara in disbelief. "That's… Uchiha Madara? Impossible!"
"Madara was killed by the First Hokage. He shouldn't be alive, much less looking so young."
Madara glanced at Jiraiya with disdain and ignored him completely.
Zenkichi commented dryly, "Hard to believe, right? But it's the truth."
"Uchiha Madara never died. He even awakened the Rinnegan—that's what Nagato's eyes are."
Tobi's head opened like a blooming flower, revealing Nagato's half-black, half-white face.
Black Zetsu and Tobi forced Nagato's hands to his face, gently pressing on the eye sockets. The Rinnegan was extracted.
Nagato screamed, struggling, but was pinned down by Tobi and Black Zetsu.
"Nagato!" Jiraiya and Yahiko looked on in panic, unable to act due to Nagato's restraint.
"Madara-sama, your eyes," Tobi said, handing over the bloody Rinnegan.
Uchiha Madara took them calmly and began the transplantation on the spot.
For someone like Madara, who possessed Hashirama cells, replacing eyes was as easy as plugging in a tool.
With the Rinnegan implanted, Madara declared calmly, "It was foolish of you not to strike earlier."
Zenkichi shrugged. "Really? Don't underestimate me. I'm practically a monster."
"The reason I let you have those eyes… is because beating you while you're using the Rinnegan has more value to me."
"Either way, it makes no difference to me. With or without the Rinnegan—you still won't win."
Madara's face twisted in fury. "Arrogant fool! Do you think I'm like those weaklings who couldn't touch you?"
Zenkichi spread his arms. "Haven't you figured it out yet? You're wasting your breath."
Without another word, Madara raised his hand and summoned a black receiver rod made with Yin-Yang Release. He flung it like a kunai.
"Interesting," Zenkichi said, raising his elementalized palm and catching the rod.
"Pointless."
"Unless you have the Truth-Seeking Orbs, you can't hurt me."
"What a pity…"
"War Demon—Uchiha Madara… your time ends here."
"The legend of the battlefield's thorn ends now."
Zenkichi clenched his fists and sneered.
"Speed is weight."
"Battlefield rose…"
"Ever been kicked at the speed of light?"
Zenkichi casually raised his leg, golden cross-light spiraling around his heel.
---

Boom!

"You possess abilities that are quite unpredictable—and you're immune to nearly every attack," Madara said coldly.

"Against Susanoo's absolute defense... there's nothing you can do."

"Jiraiya-sensei, what should we do now?"
Yahiko asked, completely at a loss. The sudden escalation left him stunned.
Jiraiya made a quick decision. "We're leaving. This battle is far beyond our capabilities."
Yahiko and Konan exchanged worried glances toward Nagato.
"But I think we should take this chance to rescue Nagato," Yahiko insisted. "This might be our only opportunity!"
Jiraiya hesitated. "That strange white creature and the black one aren't easy to deal with. Not to mention Uchiha Madara..."
Yahiko's voice rose, frustrated. "Jiraiya-sensei! Even without the Rinnegan, Nagato is still your disciple! Are you really going to just let him be taken?!"
He was clearly upset—Jiraiya's indecisiveness was deeply disappointing.
Thanks to Zenkichi's earlier reminder, Yahiko now harbored doubts. He suspected Jiraiya had ulterior motives when he chose to train them—perhaps driven by Nagato's Rinnegan, rather than genuine care.
Maybe that master-disciple bond only existed in their imaginations.
Jiraiya seemed to sense Yahiko's anger and suspicion. With a sigh, he said, "Alright. Let's try—but we retreat immediately if things go south."
With that, the three moved together, rushing toward Nagato, who was currently under the control of Black Zetsu.
Because Tobi and Black Zetsu were both latched onto Nagato, the trio couldn't risk using high-impact attacks. They charged in, hoping to seize an opening and pull Nagato to safety.
---
"Tobi, looks like we've got company," Black Zetsu's rasping voice said ominously.
Tobi's goofy tone rang out: "Three versus three, huh? Doesn't seem too unfair!"
"They're trying to take the body I'm possessing? No way! I haven't even figured out how to poop yet!"
Suddenly, wooden spikes burst from Tobi's body, stabbing into the ground. Thick vines erupted from below.
"Wood Release?!" Jiraiya exclaimed, stunned.
Today had been full of surprises. First, the legendary Uchiha Madara had appeared in his prime—now, this bizarre clown was using Wood Release, a jutsu once unique to the First Hokage.
---
"Paper Release – Paper Shuriken!"
"Fire Style – Flame Bullet!"
"Needle Jizō Technique!"
Konan's paper shuriken sliced through the vines, their sharp edges severing the wooden tendrils.
Jiraiya noted, relieved, It worked. Even though it's Wood Release, the user's strength still matters.
---
"Madara-sama! Help me!" Tobi yelled shamelessly, calling for aid without hesitation.
Madara remained expressionless. He pressed both palms together.
"Wood Style – Deep Forest Emergence!"
Massive wooden vines surged from the ground, charging toward Zenkichi. A smaller wave of vines lashed at the trio, easily capturing them and binding them with minimal effort.
"No!" Jiraiya shouted, dodging rapidly. "This enemy is on a completely different level—we have to retreat!"
Despite their reluctance, Yahiko and Konan understood—they had no choice.
---
"You're running? At least tell me what a bowel movement feels like!" Tobi screamed as vines extended from his body and connected with Madara's massive forest.
The combined vines whipped toward the trio like living creatures.
Wood Release was infamous for overpowering numbers with sheer scale—most famously with the True Several Thousand Hands technique.
Even though this was merely Deep Forest Emergence, hundreds of wooden vines attacked at once.
Even two fists can't beat four hands!
Madara frowned. Even this barrage had failed to injure Zenkichi.
Zenkichi, however, wore a mocking grin. "The First Hokage's Deep Forest Emergence? So scary."
Golden particles shimmered around him, forming his radiant silhouette. His entire demeanor ridiculed Madara's seriousness with vulgar flamboyance.
Jiraiya and the others, who only faced a fraction of the assault, were wiped out—while Zenkichi, who bore the brunt, remained completely unscathed.
The three were quickly tied up and hung from the tree branches.
---
"Wood Release originates from the God Tree—it's the power tied to the source of chakra itself."
"All chakra-based techniques should be suppressed by it."
"Yet... The vines pass through your body?" Madara muttered.
"That shouldn't be possible—unless your power doesn't come from chakra at all."
"You're turning into light... but that's not chakra-based."
Madara's eyes widened in realization.
He stared at Zenkichi, truly shaken.
---
