chapters.title: Chapter 69 - 69: Hiruzen (Bonus Chapter)
chapters.content:
Konoha Village, Hokage's Office.
As the Hokage's assistant, Hiruzen Sarutobi laughed loudly and said happily, "As expected of my disciple, Tsunade did a great job!"
Akimichi Tofaze said with a puzzled look, "Tsunade's choice to withdraw when dealing with Zenkichi has already caused dissatisfaction in Sunagakure, Iwagakure, and Kumogakure."
"They have now sent a letter asking us to give an explanation. Isn't this a bad thing that gives people a headache? It feels like you are very happy."
Sarutobi Hiruzen replied with a calm smile, "Tsunade did nothing wrong. Otherwise, we would have lost a shadow-level combat power."
"As for the letters from Sunagakure, Iwagakure, and Kumogakure—don't worry about it. Why should we in Konoha give them an explanation?"
"As long as we maintain our current strength, no matter how dissatisfied they are, they can only choose to cooperate with us."
"Joining forces to deal with Kirigakure and Zenkichi is the most important thing at the moment. They won't fight us head-on."
"Of course, they don't dare to do so because they fear that pushing us too far will drive us into an alliance with Kirigakure."
"Even if we don't side with Kirigakure, simply standing by and doing nothing will make them nervous."The source of this content ɪs
"After all, things like sitting on a mountain and watching tigers fight, taking advantage of others, and adding insult to injury aren't uncommon among the Ninja Villages."
Sarutobi Hiruzen remained calm and said, "Just wait. They will definitely send people to negotiate with us and work hard to win us over."
He was a little excited.
When Zenkichi caused a major incident in Konoha, it wasn't just the village that lost face—Hiruzen, as the longest-serving Hokage, also did.
At that time, he became the laughingstock of the entire ninja world. The Third Raikage, the Third Tsuchikage, Chiyo, and other elders of his generation all mocked him.
Hiruzen's tone turned cold. "Don't worry. To deal with Zenkichi, we specially trained a new ninja unit."
Akimichi Tofaze pondered. "Are we going to fight Zenkichi of Kirigakure again? That guy's not easy to deal with."
The Third Tsuchikage didn't fare much better. His only son was crippled by Zenkichi. The Third Raikage and Chiyo were both severely humiliated.
"What's more, the other three villages are not weaklings. They have forces capable of handling Zenkichi."
"Of course, this kind of action shouldn't be taken too hastily. We can't act without thorough preparation."
"We can't expect Zenkichi to let us off every time. That's just unrealistic."
...
Kirigakure Village.
Zenkichi requested an ANBU quota from the Third Mizukage and also a set of ANBU gear for Pakura.
Looking at the neatly dressed Pakura, Zenkichi frowned slightly and asked, "Your hairstyle is very distinctive. Won't acquaintances recognize you?"
Pakura's hair was unusual. Most of it was dark green, with two orange bangs hanging at the front.
"Hair? I thought it was interesting at first, so I dyed it like this."
"But you make a good point. It does stand out."
"Is there a hair dye shop in Kirigakure? I'll just change it."
She casually touched her hair.
"You dyed it?" Zenkichi asked in surprise.
Pakura said with annoyance, "Of course! How else would my hair be two different colors?"
Zenkichi shook his head. "No, no, no, you underestimate the magic of this world. Kirigakure has all sorts of people—it wouldn't be strange for someone to have naturally two-colored hair."
He sighed. He was already used to oddities.
From Momochi Zabuza, who had no eyebrows, to Kisame, who looked like a shark hybrid. Juzo with sharp teeth, or the Watermelon Mountain Pufferfish with mutated features...
Nothing surprised Zenkichi anymore. He saw it all as part of the Naruto world's bizarre design.
He took Pakura to a hair dye shop and had her change her hairstyle while wearing a mask.
Soon after, an ANBU ninja with light green hair stood in front of Zenkichi.
"Not bad!"
Zenkichi looked her over. Pakura appeared especially pretty now.
Her hair had become light green, replacing the heaviness of her previous look with something brighter and more vibrant.
"Very good! Let's go. Time to find my men and disciples overseas."
He nodded with satisfaction and took her on board the ship to Neutralis.
...
"Wind Release—Thousand-faced Wind!"
On the deck, Zenkichi and Pakura were sparring.
Pakura's strongest technique was her Bloodline Limit: Scorch Release.
Normally, she relied heavily on her Scorch Release, or used it to supplement her main fighting style.
But now, it couldn't be used. This was a huge handicap. She had to adapt quickly.
"Even without Scorch Release, your Taijutsu and Wind and Fire Release jutsu make you an elite Jonin."
"You truly are a genius. You have a sharp combat sense and plenty of experience."
"But even so, you're still on the lower end of the elite Jonin spectrum. That's not good enough."
"I have a special set of techniques that should help. I'll teach them to you now."
Zenkichi had decided to pass on the Naruto-verse adaptation of the Six Powers.
He didn't believe in using those he couldn't trust, nor did he trust those he couldn't use.
And with his Observation Haki, he could sense that Terumi Mei and her group were in a battle—and their enemies were strong.
With his Haki fully deployed, Zenkichi quickly located their position.
Besides, with his current strength, even if Pakura made trouble, she couldn't pose a threat.
"Interesting. Terumi Mei and the others aren't fighting shinobi—but enemies just as dangerous."
Zenkichi murmured with interest.
"Follow me."
He gave Pakura the command and led her toward the source of the battle.
Soon, they reached the edge of the Island.
Terumi Mei and her allies had fought their way there.
They faced four enemies in total—one man and three women.
The female was fierce, with a cold and bloodthirsty style. She clashed hard with Momochi Zabuza.
At that moment, Zabuza was holding a standard ninja sword and battling her.
The three women all had significant power, while the only man remained hidden behind them.

chapters.content:
The female who was fighting Momochi Zabuza was fast and agile, making it difficult for him to gain the upper hand.
Yagura and Mei Terumi watched from the sidelines, which added immense psychological pressure on the female werewolf. Without their presence, Zabuza's situation might have become even more dangerous.
"Damn you, kid!"
"If your companions hadn't interfered, I would've ripped you apart already."
"A freak with no eyebrows, always protecting his teammates."
The female growled in a deep, masculine tone.
"You have the nerve to call me a freak,when you're a werewolf?"
Zabuza snorted, quickly forming hand seals and releasing the Kirigakure no Jutsu. Thick mist poured from his mouth, cloaking the battlefield.
"Werewolf freak, want to experience Kirigakure Village's silent killing technique?"
"How will you fight when you can't even see me?"
His cold voice echoed through the mist, coming from every direction, obscuring his presence entirely.
While Zabuza battled the werewolf, Hōzuki Mangetsu was locked in a fierce clash of his own.
His opponent was a strange woman resembling an ape, with flashes of lightning sparking across her body. As thin ice needles shot from the surrounding ice mirrors, they shattered instantly on contact with her lightning-infused shield.
Mangetsu avoided close combat, instead surrounding the ape-like monster with mirrors of ice, launching waves of freezing needles like a relentless storm.
"Useless little girl!"
"With a weak ninja like you, I could finish you with one hand!"
The ape-like woman snarled arrogantly.
Elsewhere, Hoshigaki Kisame was also engaged in battle.
His opponent was a bat-like monster—a female vampire flapping her wings as she fought him from the air. Kisame, holding a standard ninja blade, kept his guard up.
Hovering in midair, the vampire gave him a charming smile.
"Shark-faced cutie!"
"You're no match for me. Why not surrender, hmm?"
"You're kind of adorable. Want to be my boyfriend?"
She giggled with flirtatious intent, but Kisame remained stone-faced, his shark-like features cold and emotionless.
With dead-fish eyes, he replied in silence: Who in their right mind would want to be with someone like you?
---
"Lord Zenkichi!"
Just as Zabuza and the others were struggling, Zenkichi and Pakura appeared beside Terumi Mei and the others.
Terumi Mei, Yagura, Mangetsu, and Ao had yet to engage in battle.
Instead, like the men accompanying the three female monsters, they stood back, monitoring the fight. The men didn't act—not because they couldn't, but because doing so recklessly might get them killed.
Yagura and the others also chose not to interfere. This was a training opportunity for Zabuza and the others. Using the three monsters to sharpen their skills was the goal.
With the four watching over them, the monsters wouldn't dare kill—otherwise, they'd face swift and deadly retaliation.
Of course, those three female monsters weren't weaklings either. Even if they fought together, it would be difficult to defeat them quickly.
It was also clear they weren't trained in traditional shinobi arts, which made Yagura and the others cautious.
"Zenkichi, you're finally back!" Mei exclaimed, immediately leaping into his arms.
Zenkichi gently patted her head and smiled. "Looks like you've made some progress."
Mangetsu nodded. "There are strong fighters here, but we're not pushovers either."
"This arena is brutal, but it helps bring out our true potential."
Zenkichi turned his gaze toward the three female monsters and the man accompanying them.
"What's with those four?"
Yagura replied, "We had a brief conflict. They're arrogant—but to be fair, they've got power to back it up. Not shinobi, but they fight like they are."
Zenkichi's brow furrowed. He raised a hand and fired a beam of golden light.
A piercing laser shot through the mist.
The werewolf let out a cry, leaping from the fog in a panicked retreat.

"Teacher Zenkichi, why did you interfere? I almost had her!"
Zenkichi shook his head. "You weren't about to beat her—she was about to kill you. Your mist may block vision, but it doesn't block scent."
With his Observation Haki, Zenkichi had tracked the werewolf's movements. She'd been sniffing constantly, homing in on Zabuza's position.
If Zenkichi hadn't stepped in, Zabuza's story might have ended then and there.

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 71: Three Clean Hits.
chapters.content:
"An ultra-ancient civilization built on the Greel Stone? I know."
"Since you're the inheritors, you must have plenty of relics from this super-ancient civilization, right?"
"I need those. Hand them over, and I might spare your lives."
Zenkichi looked at Hyde and the others, speaking with calm indifference.
"The legacy of a super-ancient civilization?"
"Friend, that's a little greedy," Hyde sneered, his eyes cold as he stared at Zenkichi.
"Friend? Who's your friend?" Zenkichi's tone sharpened. "Don't get it twisted. You're just my prisoner now."
Zenkichi glanced at Hyde dismissively, his tone flat.
"You—!"
"Attack!" Hyde shouted, unable to contain the frustration. He wanted to force Zenkichi to reveal his true strength and gave the order without hesitation.
Three of Hyde's subordinates—female warriors modified with the Greel Stone—rushed into battle. The Greel Stone, a mysterious ore, had been implanted into their bodies, granting them extraordinary powers.
The Greel Stone could turn ordinary women into supernatural beings—vampires, werewolves, and ape-like mutants. Despite its limited quantity, it was essentially a crystallization of immense chakra. Long before Kaguya Ōtsutsuki arrived on this planet, humans had already discovered the Greel Stone and used it to forge a brilliant super-ancient civilization. In that sense, calling Kaguya the "origin of chakra" was somewhat misleading.
Zenkichi found the Greel Stone intriguing. The creatures of the Three Great Sage Lands had chakra too, and these technological relics held potential to advance the shinobi world's science and power. Though now wasn't the time for theory, obtaining them early couldn't hurt.
The three women attacked together. The female werewolf, once injured by Zenkichi's laser, now glared at him and let out a terrifying roar.
The soundwave she released blasted forward like a focused beam.
"A sonic shock? How terrifying," Zenkichi said sarcastically, leaning back slightly to dodge.
The soundwave passed clean through him, creating a large hole in his torso. But instead of blood, golden light shimmered within. Light particles rushed in from all directions, instantly repairing the damage.
"No way…" the werewolf muttered in disbelief. She knew how lethal that sonic shock was—how could it have no effect?
"Something's wrong with his body," said the female vampire. She lunged at Zenkichi, claws sharp and swift. She managed to scratch him, but the wounds healed instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 72: Chunin Exam (Bonus Chapter)
chapters.content:
"Is this really a product of a super-ancient civilization? It's hard to believe."
Terumi Mei stared at the remnants of the mysterious technology, her face filled with awe.
Yagura asked calmly, "Are you planning to bring these things back to Kirigakure?"
Zenkichi shook his head. "No. Let them stay here for now. The full ruins of this Ancient civilization haven't been unearthed yet."
Ao gestured to Hyde, who stood restrained nearby. "And what about him?"
Zenkichi had initially asked Hyde to hand over the technological relics, but Hyde had refused.
It was only after a very persuasive conversation that Hyde finally agreed to cooperate.
"Him? He's useless now. Get rid of him," Zenkichi said, casting a cold glance at Hyde before signaling Ao.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
This man was a walking threat. Without Ao's ability to extract memories, he might've resisted until the very end. Better to eliminate the risk early.
"What?! You said you wouldn't kill me!" Hyde shouted, panicked.
"I did say that," Zenkichi replied indifferently. "But the condition was that you'd hand over everything willingly."
Hyde protested, "Didn't I give you everything?!"
Zenkichi shook his head. "No, you refused at first. By the time you agreed, the terms had already changed."
"You brought me here. I agreed not to invade your mind, and in return, you were to hand everything over. Fair trade, wasn't it?"
As he finished speaking, golden light glowed at his fingertips. A laser beam burst forth—Hyde's head disintegrated instantly.
---
Kirigakure Village
Zenkichi had returned to the village and was receiving updates from the mainland.
After multiple negotiations between the Four Great Shinobi Villages—Konoha, Sunagakure, Iwagakure, and Kumogakure—they had finally agreed on a ceasefire.
As a gesture of goodwill and unity, they planned to host a Joint Chūnin Exam in Konoha.
"A joint Chūnin Exam?" Zenkichi said, lips curling into a smirk. "Sounds more like a joint military exercise."
"It seems the four major villages are tightening ranks," someone noted.
"And what should we do?" another asked. "Kirigakure is overseas—easy to defend, but hard to attack."
"But if all four of them team up against us, things could get troublesome," the Third Mizukage said with a sigh.
"We never expanded our territory for a reason," he added, looking at Zenkichi. "Your ability is overwhelming, yes—but only individually. You lack the strength to defend others."
"Your offensive power is incredible, and you're nearly impossible to kill. But when it comes to defense... I worry you wouldn't be able to protect Kirigakure."
The Mizukage wasn't wrong. When Zenkichi had stormed Konoha, he hadn't tried to take it over. The Mizukage suspected it was because Zenkichi knew he couldn't hold it. Once he turned into light, his own defense dropped to near-zero. He couldn't exactly dodge attacks while maintaining that form.
Zenkichi chuckled. "After three days apart, we should look at each other with new eyes, Mizukage-sama."
"Even Uchiha Madara, the so-called Shura of the Ninja World, died at my hands. And you're still looking at me like I'm a brat?"
Zenkichi's expression remained lighthearted, as if discussing the weather.
His rise had been meteoric—faster than anyone could have predicted.
"What are you planning now?" the Third Mizukage asked, half-curious, half-concerned.
"Since all four villages are joining this exam, we might as well send our own genin to Konoha too."
"The Four Village Exam lacks impact. But if we joined, it would become a true Five Kage-level event."
Zenkichi spoke casually, though a flicker of disappointment appeared in his eyes.
He had expected a proper Five Kage Summit—not a glorified training drill.
He wondered if the other Kage would even be present for this so-called "joint military exercise."
The Mizukage thought for a moment. "Sending our genin to Konoha? That's not a bad idea."
"We've had quite a few promising recruits lately—thanks to our skirmishes with Konoha's allied forces."
"Some of them were already promoted to chūnin internally. We could simply adjust their records, list them as genin again, and let them participate."
The Mizukage chuckled darkly.
These low-intensity battles had not only eased domestic tensions in Kirigakure but also produced some impressive new shinobi.
"A small squad is fine. Quality over quantity."
Zenkichi nodded. "I'll only bring a handful with me."
The Mizukage raised a brow. "Fewer soldiers means less support. Even cannon fodder can drain an enemy's chakra reserves."
Zenkichi smiled. "No worries. I've already prepared for that. Isn't the Three-Tails and Six-Tails jinchūriki nearing their limit?"
The Mizukage sighed. "Yes. They're both from the first generation. Getting old."
The original jinchūriki of the Nine-Tails, Uzumaki Mito, had died before the Third Shinobi War. The first jinchūriki of the Eight-Tails, Seven-Tails, Five-Tails, and Four-Tails were also long gone.
Only the jinchūriki of the One-Tail, Two-Tails, Three-Tails, and Six-Tails remained.
"Even though the Three-Tails and Six-Tails are among the calmer tailed beasts, they still resist sealing."
"To prevent potential outbursts, we've had the current jinchūriki living at the edge of the village."
"I visited them recently—they both admitted they don't have much time left."
"They asked me to select their successors... but I haven't made a decision yet."
Zenkichi's eyes narrowed. "Then let me choose."
"If the jinchūriki are ready, I can handle the transfer right now."
"You've already picked replacements?" the Mizukage asked.
Zenkichi nodded. "A few of my subordinates and students would make excellent vessels."
The Mizukage frowned. "They may be talented, but jinchūriki selection isn't just about skill."
"Tailed beasts are overwhelming. Their power isn't easy to suppress."
Zenkichi smiled calmly. "And that's the problem, isn't it? The power is too concentrated."
"So why not divide the tailed beasts?"

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 73: Jinchūriki
chapters.content:
The Third Mizukage was briefly stunned.
"Divide the tailed beast? What do you mean?"
Zenkichi responded calmly, "Physically, of course."
In the original timeline, the Fourth Hokage had split the Nine-Tails into Yin and Yang halves.
But that method came at the cost of his life—and Zenkichi had no intention of dying.
The Fourth Hokage had used the Dead Demon Consuming Seal, a forbidden technique that summoned the Reaper to seal the soul of both the target and the caster. Since the Nine-Tails was a mass of chakra without a soul, the Reaper simply extracted the Yin chakra and devoured it like a soul.
People have Yin and Yang souls. Chakra, too, possesses Yin and Yang attributes.
Zenkichi couldn't split a tailed beast by soul aspects—but he had another option: physical separation.
After all, Kinkaku and Ginkaku once consumed the Nine-Tails' flesh and gained its chakra, becoming pseudo-jinchūriki.
And during the Nine-Tails' attack on Konoha, a rogue named Kazuma used residual chakra to create artificial jinchūriki.
Zenkichi's plan was to divide the Three-Tails and Six-Tails, sealing portions of their chakra into separate individuals.
It would weaken the individual jinchūriki—but make the tailed beasts far easier to control.
The Third Mizukage frowned. "Can that really work? It doesn't sound… stable."
Zenkichi shrugged. "I know the risks. That's why I want to test it first."
He smiled coldly. "Kirigakure has no shortage of death row inmates. Might as well put them to good use."
The Mizukage sighed. "If you're determined… fine. But be careful. Tailed beasts aren't immortal."
He had a point. If a tailed beast was killed, its chakra would eventually reform—but in an unknown location. Losing control could mean losing a tailed beast entirely.
Zenkichi waved it off. "Relax. I'm not killing them. Just carving off a few pieces to extract the original chakra."
The Mizukage folded his arms. "Go back for now. I'll speak with the two jinchūriki first."
Zenkichi nodded. "No problem."
---
Zenkichi Residence
"Zenkichi! Who is she?!"
Terumi Mei stood in front of him, arms crossed and fuming, glaring at Pakura, who sat calmly on the sofa.
Zenkichi replied nonchalantly, "She's… special. Nowhere else suits her, so she's staying here for now."
Terumi narrowed her eyes. "She's not just some ANBU, is she? Who is she really?"
Before Zenkichi could answer, Pakura cut in with a smirk. "Little girl, aren't you being a bit too nosy?"
Terumi's face darkened. "Shut it. This doesn't concern you."
Pakura chuckled, clearly unbothered. "Jealousy, huh? Not surprising. A flat little girl is bound to feel insecure."
Terumi exploded. "Did you just say I have no assets?!"
Zenkichi sighed. "Alright, both of you—enough."
Terumi snapped, "This is just like last time. You gave the same excuse when you brought Tsunade into your house!"
"And now? Your standards have dropped! Look at her, then look at Tsunade. No comparison."
She gave Pakura a mocking once-over.
Pakura caught the look, grinding her teeth. But… recalling Tsunade's legendary figure, she sulked in silence.
Zenkichi rubbed his forehead. "The war between women… terrifying."
"I'm going to rest. You two carry on if you want. Oh, and be prepared—one of you may become a jinchūriki soon."
He turned lazily toward his room. "But not the kind you're thinking of. This version has fewer risks."
With that, Zenkichi vanished into the bedroom.
"Jinchūriki…"
Pakura and Terumi Mei glanced at each other.
Then both scoffed and turned away, pouting in sync.
---
A Few Days Later – Outskirts of Kirigakure
The Third Mizukage guided Zenkichi toward the edge of the village. A few old cabins stood quietly—homes of the village's two tailed beast hosts.
Unlike Kumogakure, with tools like the Amber Purification Jar, or Sunagakure's sealing pot for Shukaku, Kirigakure lacked such refined weapons.
Their method was brutal.
When a jinchūriki neared death, they extracted the tailed beast from the dying body, suppressed it by force, and sealed it into a new host.
To them, a jinchūriki was a vessel. Nothing more.
"You're Zenkichi?"
An elderly man stepped out. His chakra was faint, but his smile was warm.
"Even out here, we've heard about you. It's a blessing for Kirigakure to have someone like you."
Zenkichi gave a small nod. "If not for me… maybe you'd have lived longer. I'm sorry."
The Three-Tails' jinchūriki chuckled. "No need for that. In truth, we're grateful. You're giving us release."
"We've lived long enough. The tailed beasts resent their cages. They've been thrashing against the seals for years."
"Our bodies are old. Our 'cages' are weakening. Every day, it's harder to keep them sealed."
"We've endured pain and backlash for the village's sake, but if we slip up… the destruction would be catastrophic."
"So we kept going. But if this can free us—and protect the village—then so be it."
"Better this than waiting for the seals to break. Better to go with dignity than die in failure."
The two old jinchūriki smiled—not with fear, but with pride.
They had given everything for Kirigakure. Even now, facing death, their thoughts were only for their home.
Even a village as ruthless as the Bloody Mist had shinobi willing to lay down everything—for the sake of the village.

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - 74: Isobu, the three tailed beast.
chapters.content:
Mountain forest outside Kirigakure...
The Three-Tails' jinchūriki stood calmly. A faint smile played on his lips.
"Are you ready? I'm about to release Isobu."
Zenkichi nodded. "Go ahead. We're far enough from the village—it won't be affected. And if this experiment fails, I can still suppress Isobu with my own strength."
The jinchūriki smiled and raised his hand. Chakra flames ignited across his palm as he pressed it against his stomach.
A sealing formula appeared across his abdomen, then burned away under the chakra flames. A crimson, malevolent chakra erupted from his body and surged into the clearing nearby.
Moments later, a massive turtle with three tails appeared—Isobu, the Three-Tails.
Each tail swung with terrifying force, generating winds that shook the surrounding trees.
Its enormous size and destructive potential made it clear why tailed beasts were considered living weapons. Even just its presence felt like a nightmare for any ordinary shinobi.
"Stand back," Zenkichi ordered, motioning to the Third Mizukage and the others.
The Mizukage hesitated. "Do you need backup?"
Zenkichi shook his head. "No. None of you can help. Isobu has one of the strongest defenses among all the tailed beasts."
Isobu's massive turtle body was protected by thick, rock-like shell plating—resistant to almost any ordinary attack.
What Zenkichi needed to do was cut off a portion of Isobu's body—and very few were qualified to attempt such a thing.
"Totsuka no Tsurugi!"
Zenkichi pressed his palms together. As he separated them, a golden blade of energy formed in his hands—a radiant, oversized sword of light.
He surged forward toward Isobu.
With a deafening roar, Isobu reacted, its tails sweeping toward Zenkichi. The wind from their movement howled as if tearing the sky apart.
The rage of a beast imprisoned for decades exploded outward.
Zenkichi barely flinched. "So much brute force… terrifying," he muttered casually.
He raised the sword and slashed.
A blinding wave of sword energy burst forth, like a tsunami of golden light.
---
From a distance…
The Third Mizukage stood on a cliff, surrounded by ANBU, observing closely.
Seeing Isobu's massive body thrash about, he couldn't help but mutter in awe,
"As expected of a tailed beast… just one movement matches the destructive force of an S-rank jutsu."
"But Zenkichi's ability to turn into light makes him immune to physical attacks. Still… can even he cut through that shell?"
He was worried.
Then—it happened.
Zenkichi's sword slash collided with Isobu's tail base.
Slice.
Three enormous tails were severed at the root and slammed into the ground with a thunderous crash.
Isobu let out a pained roar and collapsed, unconscious.
The ANBU stared in disbelief.
"…No way."
Even the Mizukage was speechless.
This was Isobu, the most heavily-armored tailed beast—and Zenkichi had just carved off its tails with a single slash.
But Zenkichi only shook his head.
"So much for defense. You're a disgrace among tailed beasts," he muttered.
After all, Isobu had once been knocked out by Deidara. Even with its formidable defense, it was surprisingly fragile in practice.
"Sealing team! Get those tails sealed!" Zenkichi commanded.
The Kirigakure sealing unit moved quickly, sealing the severed tails for the next stage of the experiment—implanting them into a new host.
The Third Mizukage had prepared a test subject: a death row prisoner who had betrayed the village. His reward, if he survived, was the pardon of his remaining family.
"Let's begin."
The sealing team worked swiftly, transferring the tailed chakra into the man's body.
Because the tails had been severed and were inert, the sealing was done without resistance.
"How do you feel?" the Mizukage asked.
The man took a moment to gauge himself. "The chakra's violent, but since it's not too much, the seal is suppressing it. I think I can control it—at least in small amounts."
"Let's see it," the Mizukage instructed.
The man nodded. With a simple mental command, red chakra began to seep from the seal.
Three faint chakra tails extended behind him, flicking with restrained power.
"This chakra is wild. Not easy to use in jutsu, but if I extract it slowly, it works."
The red aura vanished. Forming hand seals, the man activated a Water Release technique.
A massive waterfall erupted from thin air and came crashing down on a distant hill, smashing it to pieces.
"The chakra's quality is way higher than mine. The same technique hits way harder."
The Mizukage considered his words. "Interesting… how far can you transform?"
The man focused. The red chakra flared up, coating his entire body in a second-stage tailed form.
"In this state, I can't cast jutsu anymore. The chakra's too chaotic."
"But I don't think I need jutsu. In this form, I could crush most enemies with raw power."
Zenkichi approached, observing with satisfaction.
"It worked."
"This partial jinchūriki form is compact enough to hide easily—but powerful enough to release a Tailed Beast Bomb."

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 75: Pseudo Jinchūriki
chapters.content:
"The power of the Three-Tails?"
"No, I don't need that kind of thing."
Mangetsu shook his head after learning that he could receive chakra from the Three-Tails. Instead, he expressed his desire for the power of the Six-Tails.
"I'd prefer to share the power of the Six-Tails instead."
"Reason?" asked the Third Mizukage, his voice terse.
Mangetsu replied, "My Clan specializes in Water Release. The Three-Tails also uses Water Release."
Yagura raised a brow in surprise. "Isn't that a good thing? That means your chakra natures align."
Mangetsu shook his head. "No. It means our abilities would overlap. If I were receiving the entire Three-Tails, I'd be happy our powers complemented each other perfectly."
"But if I'm only getting a portion of the chakra, I'd prefer a new attribute. The Six-Tails has the ability to secrete corrosive acid. That could greatly enhance my Clan's Water Release techniques."
"The Three-Tails' chakra wouldn't do much for me besides replenishing my chakra reserves and granting partial transformation. But those same benefits come from the Six-Tails—plus the acid release. So the Three-Tails' chakra holds little value to me."
Zenkichi smirked from the sidelines. "A man with clear goals… how terrifying."
Mangetsu cast a sidelong glance at him.
Zenkichi shrugged. "Alright, since you've picked your favorite tailed beast's chakra, we'll go with that."
Terumi Mei cut in skeptically. "With all due respect, is just part of a tailed beast's chakra really useful?"
Zenkichi answered, "Of course it is. Even a fragment of their chakra contains more power than ten times your own."
"Not to mention, chakra of this level gives you access to abilities like the Tailed Beast Bomb—devastating in range and destructive potential."
Momochi Zabuza frowned. "But wouldn't splitting a tailed beast's chakra prevent full transformation?"
"I heard that full transformation is a jinchūriki's greatest strength. Isn't this just giving that up?"
The Third Mizukage shook his head. "No, you misunderstand. A full tailed beast is indeed powerful—but extremely difficult to control."
"When you split the chakra, you weaken the beast's will and gain better control over its power."
"Besides, full transformations are rare. They're risky, often unstable, and in most cases, uncontrollable."ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Zenkichi added, "And truthfully, full transformation isn't as powerful as people think. For most jinchūriki, going full-beast is just releasing the tailed beast."
"Is a tailed beast strong in battle? Sure. But for someone at Kage level, taking one down isn't that hard. I just defeated the Three-Tails with ease."
Momochi Zabuza raised his hand. "If Mangetsu doesn't want the Three-Tails… can I have it?"
Zenkichi looked him over, then nodded. "You want it? It's yours."
"With your talent, controlling its chakra shouldn't be a problem."
Zabuza's natural strength made him a suitable vessel. Even a portion of the Three-Tails' chakra could be mastered by someone like him.
Yagura retained the core of the Three-Tails sealed within him, while a portion of its chakra was transferred into Zabuza.
The jinchūriki of the Six-Tails released their tailed beast. A white slug-like creature—the Six-Tails—appeared in front of Zenkichi.
As soon as it materialized, it launched a spray of corrosive liquid at him.
Zenkichi smirked. "Ooh? That's dangerous!"
He turned into particles of light and reappeared behind the Six-Tails in an instant.
A golden lightsaber formed in his hand. Without hesitation, he slashed down, slicing off three of the Six-Tails' tails.
Just as he prepared to sever the remaining ones, the severed tails twitched—transforming into three smaller slugs.
They crawled toward the Six-Tails and reattached themselves, reforming its body.
"Just like Tsunade's slugs… it can split and regenerate?"
Zenkichi's eyes widened before he grinned.
The golden lightsaber flashed again. This time, he divided the Six-Tails into four distinct segments.
Lightspeed Kick!
Light surged around his feet as he delivered a kick that bypassed the acid's corrosive effects, scattering the four parts far apart.
"Seal them—quickly!"
At his command, the sealing squad sprang into action.
Black ink surged across the ground, racing toward the scattered tailed beast fragments. The seals activated, forming glowing circles that wrapped around the pieces like cages.
The power of the sealing jutsu activated, pulling the chakra portions into containment.
"I heard the number of tails reflects how much chakra a beast has," Zenkichi murmured. "Divide the Three-Tails in two. The Six-Tails into four. Seems fair enough."
He gave the order to finish sealing them.
Mangetsu received a portion of the Six-Tails, becoming a pseudo-jinchūriki. Despite it being just one-quarter, the chakra he gained vastly surpassed the reserves of the One-Tail.
Because the tailed beasts were split, their wills also fractured—making them easier to subdue than full beasts like Shukaku.
Along with Mangetsu, Ao, Terumi Mei, and Mizunashi Yukine each received a quarter of the Six-Tails' chakra, making them pseudo-jinchūriki as well.
Though they didn't possess a full tailed beast, they still held immense power—without the fatal risk.
Unlike full jinchūriki, if a pseudo-jinchūriki lost their chakra, their lives weren't endangered.
"Zenkichi-sensei…"
Kisame Hoshigaki stared at Zenkichi with his usual dead-fish eyes, his shark-like face full of grievance.
Zenkichi chuckled. "Relax. You don't need this kind of power."
"Samehada is the most special of the Seven Ninja Swords. It can absorb chakra continuously and feed it to its wielder."
"No matter the nature—Fire, Water, even a Tailed Beast Bomb—Samehada devours it all."
"I'm giving it to you. With that sword… tailed beast chakra becomes unnecessary."
Kisame's expression lightened instantly.
So… he wasn't being left out. That was good.

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 76: Tsunade & Kushina.
chapters.content:
The entrance to Konoha Village.
The Fourth Hokage, Akimichi Torifu, stood with his usual broad belly and a commanding air as he warmly welcomed Rōshi, the Four-Tails' jinchūriki and representative from Iwagakure.
Although Rōshi had long held tensions with the stubborn Ōnoki, he still retained loyalty to his village.
He had arrived with a team of Iwa shinobi to take part in Konoha's Joint Chūnin Exams.
"Lava Release Rōshi! I've heard your name for years!"
Tofaze clasped Rōshi's hands in his thick palms with hearty enthusiasm.
Rōshi looked mildly uncomfortable from the overly friendly reception. After exchanging brief pleasantries, he was led by Konoha's ANBU to his accommodations.
Once Rōshi had left, Torifu turned to Sarutobi Hiruzen, scratching his head.
"Hiruzen… the method you told me doesn't seem to be working. I was so enthusiastic, but Rōshi barely reacted."
Hiruzen chuckled. "Rōshi is just as stubborn as Ōnoki. That kind of indifference isn't unusual."
"Still, we must show sincerity. We didn't offer any explanation regarding Tsunade's departure, so we need to ensure the atmosphere doesn't sour."
"Your personal welcome as Hokage already sends a good message."
Torifu nodded. "Fair enough. Nothing to lose by being polite."
Soon after, Ebizō of Sunagakure and Buruki of Kumogakure also arrived with their respective teams. They too were greeted warmly by Tofaze.
"With the three great shinobi villages present," Hiruzen said with a smile, "the next step is coordination and cooperation for the exams—"
But he stopped mid-sentence.
From down the road, a familiar figure appeared—one Hiruzen could not forget.
Zenkichi led six figures behind him—his pseudo-jinchūriki—approaching the gates of Konoha without urgency.
Hiruzen and Torifu exchanged a solemn glance.
"I heard Konoha is hosting the Joint Chūnin Exams," Zenkichi said casually. "Naturally, Kirigakure would like to participate."
"As one of the Five Great Nations, I assume you won't reject us?"
"After all, the others are already here. It wouldn't look good to single us out."
He smiled lazily as he looked at them both.
Hiruzen took a breath, keeping his composure. "Of course we welcome Kirigakure's participation."
"Please, we've arranged a residence for your group."
---
Inside Konoha
Zenkichi stayed at a guesthouse assigned by Konoha. ANBU surrounded the building discreetly, monitoring every move.
Zenkichi didn't mind. He'd expected the surveillance and ignored it entirely.
After settling in, he went shopping with Terumi Mei.
As they strolled through Konoha's familiar yet changed streets, a wave of nostalgia washed over him.
"So much has changed," he murmured. "It hasn't even been that long…"
A cold voice cut in from behind.
"Yeah, thanks to some bastard. The old Konoha was leveled."
Zenkichi turned around and saw Tsunade, arms folded, eyes sharp.
"Princess Tsunade! Long time no see."
He offered a lazy wave and an even lazier smile.
Tsunade frowned. "What's your purpose in coming here, Zenkichi?"
He tilted his head. "Isn't that a bit much? Feels like I'm being interrogated."
"I told you—I'm here for the Chūnin Exams."
Tsunade scoffed. "You expect me to believe that?"
"Why wouldn't you? Everyone else is here for the exams. Seems like a perfectly valid reason."
She said nothing more, just snorted and walked off.
Zenkichi followed, chuckling. "You said Konoha changed because of me. Any other landmarks that owe me thanks? Take me on a tour."
Tsunade glanced over her shoulder. "The damage you did to this village wasn't just to its streets. You changed the people, too."
Just then, a flash of red hair caught his eye—Uzumaki Kushina.
She looked distant, her once-bright demeanor dimmed. Villagers nearby cast judgmental stares as she walked by.
Zenkichi's smile faded slightly.
"Looks like the higher-ups have already started tightening the leash," he muttered as he approached her.
Kushina noticed and looked up. Her eyes wavered as they locked with his.
"…It's been a while."
Zenkichi nodded. "Konoha doesn't seem to be treating you well lately."
"Need help?"
Kushina took a slow breath. "Everything I've become… is thanks to you. Or should I say, because of you."
Zenkichi shrugged. "Come on. I just helped you see the truth a little sooner."
"If not for me, you'd still be living in a pretty lie. You should thank me."
Kushina gave him a complicated glance, then turned and walked away without a word.
"…Boring."
Zenkichi turned back and noticed several kids peeking at him from a distance.
In a golden flash, he appeared behind them.
Kakashi Hatake, Asuma Sarutobi, Obito Uchiha, Rin Nohara, and Kurenai Yuhi—all future elites—stared up at him with wide eyes.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
"You've all been watching me. Need something?"
He crouched slightly, casting a long shadow over the group.
Dressed in a striped yellow suit and a justice cloak, his brown sunglasses gave off a nonchalant glint.
The kids froze.
"Don't scare the children!" Tsunade marched over, glaring at him.
Zenkichi laughed. "Come on. This is the most fun I've had all day."
"The guesthouse is boring. Let me stay at your place instead."
"You lived at my place for a long time in Kirigakure, remember? Now it's your turn to host me."
Tsunade blinked. "What?"
Before she could react, Terumi Mei jumped in, furious.
"If you're moving in with this cow, then I'm coming too!"
Zenkichi rubbed his chin. "Isn't that a bit fast? I was going to give you more time to get used to it."
---

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - 77: Danzo's New Arm.
chapters.content:
Konoha Guesthouse
Ebizo, the leader of the Sunagakure delegation, grew visibly agitated upon receiving the latest intel from Konoha's operatives.
"Zenkichi from Kirigakure? That bastard dared to come here? This is… perfect!"
"Sister-sama, just watch! I will avenge you. I swear, I'll be the one to end that man."
Ebizo clenched his fists tightly, his voice a low growl as fury flared in his eyes.
At the same time, the team leaders from Iwagakure and Kumogakure had also received the news.
Roshi muttered to himself, his expression calm but laced with disdain.
"Zenkichi from Kirigakure Village? So he showed up after all. Was he the one who took Kitsuchi's arm?"
"Annoying as that fool Kitsuchi is—just like his father Onoki—he's still one of ours. It's not up to Kirigakure to handle Iwagakure's problems."
As he spoke, red chakra surged from his body—the unmistakable power of the Four-Tails. He had already achieved partial mastery over it.
"Onoki… I'll kill Zenkichi myself. Maybe then you'll realize how worthless your son is. Not that you're any better."
He let out a cruel laugh.
"Master Roshi, sealing techniques are the only reliable way to deal with Zenkichi. And... you're not exactly proficient in them, are you?"
A Jōnin beside him spoke up carefully.
"Shut your mouth!" Roshi barked. "You think I don't know that? I've got my own plans!"
---
Meanwhile, Burubi, the leader of the Kumogakure team, appeared far more composed.
"Zenkichi… did you really think we wouldn't anticipate your move?"
A glint of menace flashed through his eyes.
"We've prepared quite the welcome for you."
Burubi's ties to both the Third and Fourth Raikage ran deep—blood ties, in fact. And the Third had died by Zenkichi's hand. His resolve to kill the man was ironclad.
---
Underground—Hidden Konoha Facility (Root HQ)
Beneath Konoha, a vast underground complex spread out in secret. This was the Root division of the Anbu—now under Shimura Danzo's control after Akimichi Tofaze became the Fourth Hokage.
(changed to: after Akimichi Torifu became the Fourth Hokage.)
Camouflaged structures lay within powerful sealing barriers, invisible to all but a select few. Inside, high-level lab equipment lined the space, and bookshelves were stacked with advanced research material.
"The Second Hokage's forbidden jutsu research notes are here. I've also given you the First Hokage's cells," Danzo said as he entered, his bandaged arm and face partly shrouded in shadow.
"How's the progress? I'm done living like a cripple."
Orochimaru, absorbed in his experiment, barely glanced up. He had once been a top contender for Hokage—a dream now long abandoned. The betrayal still stung, but he had turned to something greater: the pursuit of eternal life.
When Danzo recognized Orochimaru's genius, he wasted no time offering him full resources. Orochimaru accepted swiftly. Together, they became a force of ambition and intellect—Orochimaru the mind, Danzo the patron.
Their first focus: the Hashirama cells.
Danzo's official reason was simple—he wanted his arm back. But his true motives? Much darker. The unparalleled vitality of Hashirama's cells, the secrets of Wood Release—Danzo wanted it all.
Torifu, the new Hokage, remained blissfully unaware of their actions. But the old man, Sarutobi Hiruzen, definitely knew.
And yet, he did nothing.
He wouldn't soil his own hands with forbidden science. But neither would he stop others. In his mind, Konoha needed results—no matter how they were achieved.
---
"My tech can regenerate Hashirama's cells into a fully functional arm," Orochimaru explained, his voice clinical.
"But your body might not handle the arm's power. These cells are... monstrous. Ordinary people can't survive their chakra output."
"I'm trying to suppress the excess energy to make them usable."
Danzo narrowed his eyes. "Do you have any leads?"
Orochimaru paused, then replied, "The issue lies in the imbalance—too much physical energy from Hashirama's cells. If we had a way to counter it with spiritual energy, that might work."
Danzo murmured, "Yin Release… The Nara and Yamanaka clans specialize in that. Could their cells work?"
Orochimaru shook his head.
"Not strong enough. You can't compare their chakra to the First Hokage's."
"If anything can match it, it's the Mangekyō Sharingan of the Uchiha."
"You've seen the report, haven't you? About Zenkichi killing Uchiha Madara? He used Wood Release."
Danzo's expression darkened.
"Then Madara must've implanted Hashirama's cells. That would explain his unnatural longevity."
Orochimaru sighed.
"Unfortunately, Kirigakure took Madara's body. If I could study it… the possibilities would be endless."
Danzo grunted, "We'll make do. If the Mangekyō Sharingan can suppress Hashirama cells, then we have our blueprint."Thɪs Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"But ordinary Sharingan won't be enough," Orochimaru warned. "They lack the potency. However..."
"I could design a Hashirama-arm with multiple eye sockets—insert several Sharingan. Quantity over quality."
Danzo smirked.
"Root still has some Sharingan stockpiled. But if it's not enough, I'll take what we need."
"Damn it... if only we had Madara's Rinnegan!"
"I heard from Jiraiya that Madara summoned it elsewhere before he died. No one knows where."
Orochimaru, still poring over data, responded coldly,
"Speculation is pointless. We need to move. Prepare everything."
---

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 78: Attacking Konoha.
chapters.content:
"Come stay at my house? No."
"Your identity is too sensitive right now. I have to keep my distance," Tsunade said flatly, rejecting Zenkichi's proposal.
"After all, your relationship with Konoha isn't exactly... warm."
Terumi Mei let out a small smile, while Zenkichi responded dramatically, "Women really are heartless."Googlᴇ search ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"If I can't stay at your house, at least treat me to a meal. Let's celebrate the decades since Konoha was founded with a bowl of longevity noodles!"
He smirked.
"Long life to the Hidden Leaf, and long life to everyone in it."
Tsunade's face darkened.
"You…"
She glared at him helplessly, then sighed and led him—alongside Mei Terumi—to Ichiraku Ramen.
It was there that Zenkichi encountered the so-called legendary Ichiraku. But reality was disappointing—The chef was just an ordinary ramen maker.
Meanwhile, members of the Hyuga clan were monitoring the situation closely.
"Besides Zenkichi and the one named Hoshigaki Kisame, there's something off about the chakra signatures of the other Kirigakure ninjas."
"They're radiating immense chakra—special chakra, likely tailed beast chakra."
"Uzumaki Kushina. Kumogakure's Blue B, and Iwagakure's Roshi... the pattern is similar to what we're seeing in most of the Kirigakure team."
A Hyuga Anbu knelt before Sarutobi Hiruzen and the other Konoha elders, reporting calmly.
"You're joking," muttered one of the council.
"If they're all jinchūriki... that would mean Kirigakure controls six tailed beasts. That's impossible."
Hiruzen shook his head. "Whether or not they are jinchūriki, this is serious."
"Think about it—if those six from Kirigakure really are jinchūriki, then all nine tailed beasts are currently gathered in Konoha."
"If anything happens, the entire village could be wiped out in a flash."
Akimichi Torifu said gravely, eyes wide.
Shimura Danzo scoffed.
"If you ask me, negotiations should never have taken place here in Konoha."
"You knew Kirigakure might use the Chūnin Exams as cover to sabotage us—why host them here?"
He glared at Hiruzen.
"If anything goes wrong, you'll be the one held accountable."
"This isn't the time to point fingers," Hiruzen replied coolly, shooting a sharp look at Danzo. "We need to coordinate with the other three major villages and come up with a way to eliminate Zenkichi."
"They've likely made preparations of their own. If we work together, we might just pull this off."
Koharu Utatane nodded from beside Homura, both still key figures among Konoha's leadership.
---
At that very moment, while the high council discussed how to eliminate him, Zenkichi had already finished his meal at Ichiraku and returned to the guesthouse with Mei Terumi.
Behind closed doors, his disciples and subordinates were already gathered.
With a faint smile, Zenkichi asked, "You've had time to look around Konoha. What did you learn?"
Ao stepped forward. "As a sensory-type ninja, I've detected an abnormal concentration of chakra throughout the village. There's also a heavy presence of chakra signatures around our guesthouse. It's clear they've assigned people to monitor us."
Zenkichi nodded.
"Don't worry about them. They won't attack us—not here."
Momochi Zabuza grinned. "Maybe not here... but they'll probably strike during the Chūnin Exams."
Hoshigaki Kisame shook his head. "If we can guess that, don't you think the Leaf can too?"
Mangetsu chimed in, "Exactly. During the exams, Konoha will be on high alert. It's more likely they'll act beforehand."
Mizunashi Yukine frowned. "That gives us a window of about seven or eight days before the exams begin."
Terumi Mei added, "That's too long. The longer they wait, the more likely we are to lower our guard."
Zenkichi smirked.
"You're all overthinking this. Who says we have to wait for them to make the first move?"
"If the other villages didn't give Kirigakure any respect by excluding us from the planning of these joint exams, then we don't need to give them any either."
Zabuza's eyes lit up.
"So when do we strike?"
Zenkichi chuckled.
"Soon. Once they're all in one room, trying to figure out how to deal with me—that'll be the perfect time."
---
The following night...
After much back and forth, Konoha's top brass and the three other great village leaders finally reached a consensus. They convened at the Hokage Building to finalize their plan.
Hiruzen, acting as Hokage's advisor, stood to address the room and spoke at length for over half an hour before getting to the point.
But before any decisions could be made, a blinding golden light erupted in the distance.
A massive beam shot into the sky—brilliant gold and silver streaks cutting through the night. All of Konoha lit up as if it were daytime.
Leaders scrambled, shielding their eyes with sunglasses or chakra-infused gear.
"That's Zenkichi's ability! What is he doing?!"
"Prepare for battle!"
"Get ANBU on the scene—now!"
"Move! Someone check it out!"
Commanders from the four great villages immediately deployed their shinobi to investigate.
---
Meanwhile, far outside Konoha, Kirigakure's main force lay in wait.
Elder Genji, accompanied by the Seven Ninja Swordsmen and a host of elite troops, stood ready.
"Sir! Movement from the direction of Konoha!" one of the scouts shouted.
Genji looked toward the horizon.
"That golden light... unmistakable. That's the signal Zenkichi and I agreed upon."
A smile broke across his face.
"Mobilize the entire force! We attack Konoha now!"
---

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 79: War against konoha
chapters.content:
Monitoring the entire Konoha with Observation Haki, Zenkichi could even hear Hiruzen Sarutobi's speech at the meeting.
Realizing that the meeting was about to get serious, Zenkichi shifted his body and transformed into light particles, reappearing outside the guest house.
His body reformed on the rooftop, and a brilliant golden light beamed into the sky.
The ANBU assigned to surveillance were stunned. They appeared around Zenkichi, sunglasses on, encircling him.
"How stupid," Zenkichi said flatly.
"Do you really think that tactic works on me?"
He sighed leisurely—and the roof beneath him crumbled as his students burst out from below.
"Sensei Zenkichi, leave them to us!"
Ao stepped forward eagerly, eyes burning as he stared down the ANBU before him.
"No problem," Zenkichi said with a faint smile, his body dissolving into light particles as he flew toward the Hokage Building.
Inside, the clandestine meeting came to a sudden halt. Zenkichi's arrival had thrown the talks into disarray.
Standing by the glass, the Kage-level figures saw the streak of golden light hurtling toward them. In an instant, it stopped just outside.
Light particles condensed into Zenkichi's figure. He stood before them, smiling.
"Hello everyone," he greeted lazily, waving without care.
"Zenkichi, what are you trying to do?"
"You've stirred unrest in Konoha. Are you trying to provoke a war between Konoha and Kirigakure?"
Hiruzen stepped forward, his tone righteous.
"Third Hokage, don't you think what you just said is laughable?"
"I've never had a good relationship with Konoha, so why can't I cause unrest here?"
"If I recall correctly, the last time I visited, you Konoha attacked me."
"You're not afraid of starting a war—why should I be?"
"You're in first grade, and I'm in fifteenth. I think that's fair."
"And besides, aren't you discussing how to deal with me right now?"
"I simply struck first. If anyone's to blame, it's you—for being too stupid and too weak."
Zenkichi glanced lazily at Hiruzen, his tone casual.
"Hokage-sama! Senior officials!"
A Konoha ANBU appeared beside them. "A large Kirigakure force was just sighted heading toward the village. Requesting orders!"
"Kirigakure troops?! You bastard! What is your real objective?"
Hiruzen's face darkened, and he glared at Zenkichi.
"If nothing unexpected happens," Zenkichi said indifferently,Follow current novᴇls on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
"Then very soon… there will no longer be a village called Konoha."
Everyone's expression turned grim.
Zenkichi smirked and continued, "You're still not attacking? Looks like you're unsure."
"Is it because I disrupted your strategy? Or because the means you prepared to deal with me haven't arrived yet?"
"Or maybe…" he narrowed his eyes, "…my power terrifies you. You know you can't beat me."
"Well, this is getting boring. How about this—I'll refrain from using my light-based abilities. We'll fight fair."
Hiruzen's expression hardened. "Are you joking?"
Zenkichi shook his head and chuckled. "Not at all. That's my promise."
He added silently to himself: Whether I can keep that promise is another matter entirely…
Without a word, Hiruzen summoned his contract beast—the Monkey King Enma—who transformed into the Adamantine Staff.
Zenkichi summoned the Sword, a blade of golden light, and swung it at the Hokage Building below. An overwhelming wave of sword energy surged forward.
"If I don't show you my true strength, you'll keep underestimating my taijutsu."
Konoha was his stage.
After today, the name Konoha would be erased from the world.
And he, the next Mizukage of Kirigakure, needed a legend attached to his name.
His ability to become light made the world think he relied solely on elementalization. But today, he'd show everyone—even without his light-based form—he was still one of the strongest shinobi alive.
The roaring sword energy raced forward.
Hiruzen roared, charging in with the Adamantine Staff. The unbreakable staff met the sword slash—and wasn't destroyed.
But a deep scar formed along the staff, and Hiruzen himself was sent flying by the immense force.
Boom!
Hiruzen crashed into the Hokage Building, and the wave of sword energy split the entire structure in two.
Zenkichi floated down from the sky, landing softly with his sword held horizontally.
"Come," he muttered.
"Human Boulder Attack!"
A deep voice boomed as Akimichi Torifu—the Fourth Hokage in this alternate timeline—shouted and rolled forward like a massive boulder.
"Out of my way."
Zenkichi swung his sword, and a tremendous wave of sword energy blasted forth, slicing through Torifu's enormous form.
Torifu cried out in pain as the attack left deep gashes across his body, knocking him aside.
Even with enhanced physical defenses, Zenkichi's devastating sword technique tore through him like paper.
Had his battle instincts not warned him in time, that sword would've cleaved him in two.
Even the Three-Tails, armored in natural shell, had been severed by this blade. The Adamantine Staff, as tough as diamond, had been damaged.
What chance did Torifu's flesh and bone have?
"Damn it…"
Sensing his condition worsening, a fierce gleam flashed in Torifu's eyes. He pulled out a red pill and swallowed it without hesitation.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - 80: Danzo flees.
chapters.content:
Zenkichi's sword had gravely wounded Akimichi Torifu.Google seaʀᴄh ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Surrounded and under pressure, Torifu realized there was no hope for a safe retreat.
Gritting his teeth, he retrieved his clan's secret medicine and swallowed it.
The red pill—the Akimichi Clan's ultimate medicine—could forcefully unlock latent power, massively increasing his strength at the cost of his life.
"Partial Expansion Jutsu!"
Chakra erupted violently from his body. His strength surged. Torifu's arms thickened and extended as he roared and launched a punch at Zenkichi.
Zenkichi glanced at him coldly. The golden lightsaber in his hand stabbed forward.
Torifu's body trembled, his earlier wounds detonated at once. Blood burst from his mouth as he was hurled backward, limbs flailing.
The clash between fist and blade exploded in a shockwave that rippled outward in all directions.
"Even drug-fueled strength isn't enough to bridge the gap," Zenkichi said calmly.
A golden glow radiated from his raised finger—Condensed Light Arrow.
With a flash, the arrow streaked toward Torifu.
Boom!
A fiery explosion swallowed Torifu's figure.
"Gotcha!"
A deep voice rang out. Shimura Danzo appeared behind Zenkichi and struck his back with an open palm.
"You thought Torifu was trying to kill you? He was just a feint."
"I'm the real threat. Now you're finished."
Dark ink-like lines spread from Danzo's hand, crawling over Zenkichi's body.
Reaper Curse Mark Binding Technique.
One of Danzo's signature jutsu—it immobilized the target through direct touch, sealing their movements with cursed inscriptions.
Danzo once used it against Uchiha Sasuke.
"Sealing jutsu, huh?" Zenkichi muttered, allowing the marks to spread across his body. "Not bad."
Hiruzen sighed nearby. "Torifu… was a true Hokage. A flame of the Will of Fire."
Zenkichi suddenly shouted, mockingly, "Oi oi oi! You already giving a eulogy? Sounds like you think the battle's over!"
"Let me offer a tip—strategy means nothing without power."
"Sealing techniques are one of the few methods that can threaten me. But let's be clear—not just any seal will work."
His body erupted in golden light. Radiance poured out, shattering the curse marks crawling over him.
Even Sasuke had broken this technique using an incomplete Susanoo.
For Zenkichi, breaking free was effortless.
After gaining access to the remains of an ancient civilization and splitting the Tailed Beasts, Zenkichi's synchronization with the Kizaru template had reached 73%.
Now, he faced the Third Hokage and the others with amused detachment.
"Zenkichi!"
A deep voice echoed. Zenkichi recognized it by Haki alone. He smirked.
Burubi appeared, pulling out the Amber Purification Bottle from a sealing scroll.
Zenkichi knew its power well—he didn't respond. Instead, he casually countered with a backhand laser beam.
Burubi dodged swiftly, weaving through the air with the bottle in hand.
"Sealing Jutsu!"
This time, Ebizō emerged with a different sealing tool—a great cauldron, once used to suppress Shukaku.
He formed hand seals as golden runes erupted from the cauldron. Glowing chains shot toward Zenkichi.
"Pathetic."
Zenkichi lazily raised his lightsaber and slashed. The air howled with sword energy as the incoming chains were obliterated.
"Zenkichi!!"
Hiruzen roared, charging in with the Adamantine Staff—his summon Enma transformed.
He wanted to create an opening for Burubi to activate the bottle.
Zenkichi recognized the object for what it was—the Amber Purification Bottle, a relic of the Sage of Six Paths.
Said to seal anything that responds to its call, it was once wielded by Ginkaku and Kinkaku of the Hidden Cloud.
Though they turned rogue, the Third Raikage recovered the bottle and returned it to Kumogakure.
Its sealing power was immense—capable of imprisoning even the Eight-Tails.
But it only worked if the target responded when called by name.
If Zenkichi answered, the artifact would unleash the power of the Six Paths and drag him in.
Without voice activation, it couldn't seal someone of his caliber.
Ebizō had just proven that with his failed attempt.
Even though the bottle surpassed the cauldron in strength, it still wasn't enough to contain Arakawa Zenkichi.
"Again?"
Zenkichi's expression didn't change as Hiruzen rushed him. He moved in a flash, brushing past the aged Hokage.
A golden arc of sword light exploded from his weapon.
The Adamantine Staff was cleaved in two.
The severed staff reverted to the unconscious form of Enma, the Monkey King.
Blood burst from Hiruzen's body as he collapsed lifelessly.
"...You…"
Zenkichi turned to Danzo and the remaining elders, his eyes full of scorn.
Compared to Sarutobi Hiruzen and Akimichi Torifu, Danzo, Homura, and Koharu weren't even worth the effort.
When they saw Hiruzen fall, they fled without hesitation.
"Your second grandfather died to protect these cowards."
"Don't you think that's… beneath him?"
Zenkichi spoke indifferently, glancing toward the shadows.
From them, Tsunade stepped forward.
Her gaze met his, eyes filled with complicated emotions.
She looked at the fleeing silhouettes of Danzo and the others, then sighed softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - 81: Samehada.
chapters.content:
"Water Style – Exploding Water Colliding Wave!"
"Water Style – Great Exploding Water Wave!"
Mangetsu and Yagura moved in unison, both unleashing a massive surge of water that surged like a tsunami, flooding the battlefield and overwhelming the surrounding Konoha ninja.
Being water-style users, they were at a disadvantage in a dry environment, so they first created one suitable for aquatic combat. This tactic, extravagant yet effective, was frequently used by Kisame Hoshigaki in the original series.
Now that both Mangetsu and Yagura possessed tailed beast chakra sealed within them, they had more than enough energy to sustain this approach. After all, the tailed beast chakra within them could regenerate over time.
"I'm suddenly having second thoughts,"
Kisame muttered helplessly. The sheer power of tailed beast chakra was overwhelming.
"Kisame, Zenkichi Sama instructed me to give you this."
Mangetsu retrieved a scroll and summoned Samehada, tossing the great sword to Kisame.
"Samehada? Wouldn't this be more useful in the hands of Fuguki Suikazan?"
Kisame hesitated for a moment, unsure.
"Who knows?"
"Zenkichi-Sama believes you're the most suitable wielder."
"Maybe you lack confidence, but don't let him down."
Mangetsu shook his head and replied firmly.
"I get it."
Kisame gripped Samehada, and his expression changed instantly.
He could feel his chakra being rapidly drained. Samehada was devouring it.
"This sword…"
Kisame's eyes widened as his voice grew weak. Samehada was absorbing his chakra at an alarming rate, quickly reducing him to a dry husk.
Unlike other ninja tools, Samehada was alive—and dangerous. If the wielder wasn't compatible, it would turn on them.
Fortunately, Kisame was gifted. His chakra wasn't just vast—it was high in quality.
After absorbing Kisame's chakra, Samehada recognized his strength and returned it, now refined and even more potent.
"This sword is incredible!"
Feeling the chakra flow back, enhanced and pure, a grin spread across Kisame's face.
"You tamed it already?"
"As expected of Lord Zenkichi. He has an eye for talent."
Mangetsu looked at him in awe.
"I'm gonna wreck them!"
Kisame roared as he charged forward, swinging Samehada with confidence, cutting down Konoha's Anbu one after another.
Kisame's talent had never been ordinary. He didn't earn the nickname "Tailless Tailed Beast" for nothing.
His body was physically mutated, and his chakra reserves rivaled those of an Uzumaki. Combined with Samehada and Zenkichi's training in the Six Styles—his personal ninjutsu-based version—plus a library of Water Style jutsu, Kisame could now stand toe-to-toe with elite Jonin.
"Let's move!"
Terumi Mei shouted to Ao, her voice filled with fighting spirit. Crimson tailed beast chakra began to flow around her.
Ninjas often had high offense but low defense. As Zenkichi's pseudo-jinchūriki, however, their weaknesses had been patched.
The tailed beast cloak alone was enough to resist most A-rank ninjutsu.
Mangetsu and the others activated their tailed beast cloaks as well, no longer fearing sneak attacks. They now functioned as warriors, assassins, mages, supports—and tanks, something rare among shinobi.
"Six jinchūriki? Ridiculous!"
"Shurikens won't work! Use ninjutsu to break through their defenses!"
After failing to penetrate the cloaks with projectiles, the Konoha ANBU resorted to ninjutsu.
"Ninjutsu? We've got that too!"
Mangetsu sneered, forming seals. A massive water dragon surged from the water beneath him, striking the enemy.Thɪs updatᴇd by ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
"Water Style – Water Dragon Bullet!"
"Water Style – Great Waterfall Jutsu!"
Yagura followed up with his own technique, sending a towering wave crashing down upon the Konoha ninja.
---
Within the heart of Konoha Village, chaos unfolded.
While Zenkichi's jinchūriki squad wreaked havoc inside, the ninja forces outside the village closed in rapidly.
Among the Konoha forces, the Watermelon Mountain Pufferfish had a sour expression.
As one of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist, he had just lost Samehada.
Judging from how the blade vanished, it was clear it had been summoned via scroll from the village. Even though Master Yuan had warned him, he hadn't expected it to happen so suddenly.
Still, knowing Zenkichi was the one behind it, he held back his rage—and instead unleashed it on the Konoha defenders.
---
Inside Konoha Village…
Zenkichi stood tall, watching Danzo Shimura and the others attempt to flee. He raised his golden energy blade and slashed down.
A torrent of sword energy, as massive as a tsunami, roared forward. It caught Danzo and his allies almost instantly.
Golden beams of condensed energy burst from Zenkichi's hands, cutting through the air like pressurized jets.
Mitokado Homura couldn't dodge in time—he was sliced clean in two.
Danzo's leg was severed, and he limped away in agony. Koharu Utatane was surprisingly nimble and escaped mostly unharmed. Burubi and Ebizo had long vanished.
Zenkichi didn't worry. He already knew no one would get far.
His Observation Haki blanketed all of Konoha, and with light-speed movement, no one could truly escape.
Still, if they wanted to play hide-and-seek, he'd humor them.
"I don't think they really intend to escape,"
Tsunade said coolly, watching their retreating figures.
"They're probably rallying their remaining forces, trying to concentrate their strength against Zenkichi."
"And with Konoha in chaos, someone needs to keep their men from falling apart."

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - 82: Swordsmanship.
chapters.content:
Konoha's Guest House — Sunagakure Delegation
Although Konoha Village was already in chaos, the Sunagakure shinobi stationed at the guest house remained calm. They stayed in formation, adopting a defensive posture, choosing not to intervene in the current turmoil.
Ebizo returned carrying the sealing artifact—the Cauldron—and immediately rallied the Sand shinobi to prepare to rendezvous with the Kumo-nin.
Both Sunagakure and Kumogakure possessed sealed artifacts. Ebizo believed that joining forces was the best strategy under the circumstances.
Soon after, Ebizo, Roshi, and Killer B regrouped with their respective squads.
From a distance, Arakawa Zenkichi approached slowly, walking beside Tsunade. Seeing the gathering, he chuckled.
"Tsunade, looks like you were wrong," he said.
"The shinobi of Suna, Kumo, and Iwa have some spine. But the Konoha shinobi…"
He glanced sideways at Tsunade with a smirk. She snorted, clearly irritated.
"Maybe they're just not ready yet," she replied, but even she didn't sound convinced.
Killer B narrowed his eyes and questioned sharply, "Tsunade-hime, what's the meaning of standing beside Zenkichi?"
"Has Konoha sided with Kirigakure now? Are you speaking for the Leaf?"
Zenkichi replied casually, "No need to overthink it. Right now, she only represents herself."
Tsunade gave a faint nod, her expression unreadable as she glanced at Zenkichi.
"Be good and wait on the sidelines," Zenkichi said, patting her head with a grin. "Let me handle this rabble."
"Don't get cocky!" Ebizo snapped.
He pulled out a sealing scroll, and barrel-shaped puppets spilled from it, connecting end to end until they formed a massive serpent-like construct.
A blade protruded from the puppet python's mouth, glowing with a poisonous blue hue.
Ebizo's chakra threads extended from his fingertips as he controlled the massive puppet, lunging it toward Zenkichi.
"Remember your promise—not to use your light powers!" Ebizo shouted, trying to provoke him.
"You really think I need that to beat you? How naive."
Zenkichi sighed and dashed forward, a golden lightsaber forming in his hand. In a flash of light, the puppet python was cleaved cleanly in two, its parts clattering to the ground.
"What swordsmanship!"
"Even without his light-speed ability, he's still top-tier!"
"Don't forget, he killed the Third Hokage with that sword!"
"Stay alert!"
Killer B's voice boomed across the battlefield.
"Zenkichi, are you keeping your word?" he asked.
Zenkichi didn't respond. Instead, he swung his sword with a backhand motion, unleashing a wave of energy like a tsunami.
"Trying to catch me off-guard with that amber purification pot trick? Think I wouldn't notice?"
"Damn it!"
Killer B cursed as crimson chakra surged from his body—the Eight-Tails' power awakened.
Even so, his tailed beast cloak in its first form was no match for Zenkichi's attack. A fierce shockwave forced him into his second form, where the cloak turned a deeper, denser red, offering better protection.
The enhanced defense barely withstood the sword energy, but Killer B was still sent skidding backward under the impact.
"It's not over yet!"
Ebizo roared. Chakra threads shot out from his fingers as he hastily reassembled the broken puppet.
Once restored, the serpent puppet charged again, its jaws open wide.
Inside its mouth were intricate black markings—sealing jutsu.
"So that was your plan," Zenkichi said coolly. "Then I'll smash it completely."
He danced forward with a flurry of sword strikes, his golden lightsaber slicing the puppet into hundreds of pieces.
The sealing technique embedded within it was shattered alongside the puppet.
"Puppet Formation—Seal!"
Though his primary puppet was destroyed, Ebizo didn't falter.
He barked an order, and his subordinates—all puppet masters—summoned their own constructs. Strange and varied puppets emerged around him, quickly combining into a unified formation.
Each puppet bore sealing markings, revealing Ebizo's plan to restrain Zenkichi using a coordinated seal array.
"A puppet formation?" Zenkichi scoffed. "How terrifying."
With a mocking tone, he raised his golden blade and brought it down.
"Thanks for the effort. But it's useless."
"As a reward for trying—let me wipe them all out."
In a blink, he appeared before the formation. His blade swung in a shining arc, unleashing a radiant wave of energy that lit the night sky.
The sword energy tore through the puppet formation instantly, reducing it to rubble.
"Seal—"
Ebizo activated the cauldron artifact, releasing spell-forged chains aimed directly at Zenkichi.
"Still not giving up? Your will is impressive."
"Do you hate me that much? So scary."
Zenkichi smirked dramatically and with a single slash, shattered the incoming spell chains.
Then, raising a hand, golden light particles condensed into a piercing arrow.
It shot forward, piercing Ebizo's chest and ending his life in an instant.
"Since you miss your sister Chiyo so much…" Zenkichi muttered indifferently, "I'll send you to see her."

chapters.content:

"Roar!"
The chakra cloak around Roshi deepened in color—his light-red shroud turned crimson, and four burning tails erupted from behind him.
He had entered the second form of the Tailed Beast Cloak.
With a fierce snarl, he charged straight at Zenkichi.
Bang!
Zenkichi blocked Roshi's claw with a horizontal sweep of his lightsaber.
Though the claw, strengthened by Four-Tails' chakra, could tear through steel, it was no match for Zenkichi's strength—or the unbreakable edge of his golden lightsaber.
The attack was halted with ease.
"The power granted by a Tailed Beast transformation really is something else," Zenkichi remarked lazily.
He opened his mouth slightly, and a radiant golden cross began to form from condensed light particles.
"Roshi of Iwagakure…"
"Have you ever felt the weight of words?"
Zenkichi's voice was calm, but as he spoke, the glow in his mouth grew more intense, radiating destructive energy.
Boom!
A golden light cannon erupted from his mouth and blasted Roshi point-blank, sending him flying in a blaze of golden energy.
Even in his second cloak form, Roshi was no match for the blast—his cloak was ripped open, a massive hole tearing through it.
Coughing up blood, Roshi finally understood the vast difference in strength.
"I remember when you first came to Konoha, all fired up, wanting to kill me…"
"What happened? Having second thoughts now?"
Zenkichi eyed Roshi with a bored expression.
"Zenkichi!"
A loud roar echoed as Killer B of Kumogakure leapt into action.
Zenkichi immediately shut his mouth—the Amber Purification Bottle's sealing ability was not something he could risk triggering.
Instead, lightsaber in hand, he slashed toward Killer B, and an enormous surge of sword energy shot toward him like a tsunami.
Killer B's body was wrapped in the second form of the Tailed Beast Cloak, its red armor glistening.
This same form, in the original timeline, had allowed Naruto to block Orochimaru's Kusanagi blade.
Now, Killer B held his ground, withstanding the blow—barely—while the others launched their own coordinated assault.
The elite ninja sent from Iwagakure, Sunagakure, and Kumogakure were not just strong leaders. Their comrades were rare elites as well.
The combined attack was immense.
"So many people ganging up on me? How scary~" Zenkichi shouted in mock horror, then vanished using Six Styles – Shave.
In a blur, he retreated ten meters in an instant, dodging every strike.
"Now... it's my turn."
His body shimmered and turned into light particles, rising into the air. Mid-flight, the particles reformed his human shape.
"Yasakani no Magatama!"
From his hands, countless golden light bullets materialized and rained down like a torrential storm, bombarding Killer B and the others.
"Damn it!"
Killer B cursed as his body pulsed with even more chakra. He fully transformed into the Eight-Tails — an enormous ox-headed, octopus-tailed beast.
The monstrous creature glared down at Zenkichi from within the village, its tentacles spread wide, shielding the other Kumo-nin from the barrage.
"You're still worried about others?"
"Don't be greedy—just take what's yours."
Zenkichi raised his leg. The heel shimmered with golden energy.
"Speed is weight."
"Young Eight-Tails Jinchūriki… ever felt a light-speed kick?"
With a lazy smirk, he launched a devastating golden beam from his heel. It slammed directly into the Eight-Tails' forehead like a cannonball.
The impact sent the beast crashing into the ground with a thunderous boom, flattening buildings under its weight.
After knocking it down with a single strike, Zenkichi appeared next to the Amber Bottle and casually claimed it for himself.
"Zenkichi…"
The Eight-Tails tried to rise. But before it could react, a golden flash lit its vision.
Zenkichi stood before it, the tip of his index finger glowing.
The light condensed into a golden cross, spinning with incredible energy.
"Sayōnara."
The golden laser pierced the beast's forehead cleanly. The Eight-Tails howled, its massive body melting away, dispersing into pure chakra that faded into the air.
Killer B collapsed, barely alive—but not dead. Neither was the Eight-Tails, because what had been destroyed was only a chakra-formed projection.
The true beast remained sealed.
"The Eight-Tails is a fine bijū. It'd be a waste to leave it with someone like you…"
Zenkichi murmured.
Fiery chakra flames danced on his fingers as he pressed his hand to Killer B's abdomen, tearing through the Iron Armor Seal.
He extracted a swirling orb of crimson chakra—the essence of the Eight-Tails.
Activating the Amber Purification Bottle, Zenkichi sealed the chakra essence inside.
It was not just residual power. This was the core of the Eight-Tails—the substance from which the beast could be reborn.
In effect, Zenkichi had just sealed a complete Eight-Tails inside the artifact.
