chapters.title: Chapter 98 - 98: Dragon's Vein.
chapters.content:
The secret base where Orochimaru was located.
Shimura Danzo sat on the sofa with a scowl on his face, watching Orochimaru conduct his experiments.
"Orochimaru, how long until the Impure World Reincarnation is perfected?" he demanded.
While analyzing experimental data, Orochimaru replied calmly, "Scientific research cannot be rushed."
"Any small error renders previous efforts meaningless."
"If a single step goes wrong, the entire process must be restarted."
"So if you truly want this technique perfected quickly, stop pestering me."
Danzo let out a frustrated sigh. "I'm not here to pressure you, but time isn't on our side."
"You've been holed up here for so long you don't realize what's happening in the world outside."
"I have to admit, Zenkichi is a genius. He's united the entire ninja world under his rule."
"His strategies worked perfectly—conflicts between shinobi are nearly nonexistent now."
"And somehow, he's introduced technology that's drastically improved daily life for civilians."
"The people are getting richer. His approval is rising. The longer you delay, the more unshakable his power becomes."
Of course, what Danzo said was total hypocrisy. A man like him, who treated Konoha shinobi as disposable tools, never cared for the common people.
In truth, Danzo only craved control. Whether ninja or civilian, he wanted them beneath his feet.
What truly bothered him was the passing of time. He feared that if Orochimaru's research dragged on, he would never live to reap the rewards.
If the Reanimation Jutsu took a lifetime to perfect, would he just die a failure?
Even if the research succeeded after his death, the benefit would go to Orochimaru, not him.
Danzo also knew that, at present, he wasn't confident in defeating Orochimaru.
If he waited a few more years, the gap between them would only grow—eventually, Orochimaru would control everything. Danzo couldn't allow that.
"I have more bad news," said Koharu as she entered, face grim from sleep.
"Zenkichi has issued a global warrant for us."
"He's also formed a special shinobi unit to track us down."
"They're experts in sensory-type ninjutsu. It's only a matter of time before they find this base."
Danzo clenched his fists. "Damn it. We need to relocate—somewhere safe."
Just then, a dark figure emerged from the shadows nearby. It was Black Zetsu, slithering up from the ground.
"I might have a suggestion," he rasped, "if you're interested in finding a new hiding place."
Danzo turned sharply, killing intent flashing in his eyes. "You again? Last time you showed up, I lost some of my best operatives."
Black Zetsu remained calm. "And I lost a Rinnegan. Who do you think paid the greater price?"
"This proves I never intended to betray you. If anything, it's Zenkichi's absurd strength that ruined everything. That's why we need to unite against him."
Danzo growled, "What do you propose?"
"There's a hidden Dragon Vein in the Land of Wind. It holds near-limitless chakra."
Black Zetsu's voice lowered, almost reverent. "Legend says it can even bend space and time. If true, it could be our key to evading Zenkichi."
Orochimaru's golden eyes sparkled. "Time-space travel…?"
"Yes," Black Zetsu confirmed. "Though unverified, it's worth investigating."
"But the Dragon Vein isn't something that can be tapped easily. It requires substantial chakra to awaken. I'll need your assistance."
"Our goals align. Survival. Escape. Regroup."
Orochimaru closed his eyes for a moment, then nodded. "This Dragon Vein intrigues me. Let's go."
Danzo hesitated. "But…"
"There is no 'but'," Orochimaru cut him off. "The resources under Zenkichi's control are already far beyond ours. He will find us eventually."
"Perfecting the Reanimation Jutsu isn't a simple task. Even the Second Hokage abandoned it halfway. It's time-consuming."
"If we can travel to another timeline, we can finish our work there—then return and rewrite everything."
"If we're lucky, we might even travel far enough back to eliminate Zenkichi before he becomes a threat."
Danzo and Koharu said no more. At this point, there was nothing left but to agree.
---
Elsewhere...
"So Danzo and the others have finally been exposed? How unexpected," Arakawa Zenkichi murmured as he scanned the intelligence reports.
Tracing their escape route, his expression turned thoughtful.
"The Land of Wind?"
"Are they using the desert for cover... or do they know about the Dragon Vein?"
Zenkichi stood from his seat and headed outside.
Life as the King of the Ninja World had grown dull.
So if Orochimaru and the others wanted to make things interesting, Zenkichi was more than happy to indulge them.Thɪs
---
Land of Wind – Desert Region
As Orochimaru and the others traveled across the dunes, they suddenly came to a halt.
A lone figure stood in their path—Zenkichi, smiling gently.
"Well, well... long time no see."
"Run!" Orochimaru barked, his body instantly dispersing into hundreds of slithering snakes.
Danzo, Koharu, and the others turned and fled in a panic, not daring to waste even a second.
"Come now... you're the last remnants of Konoha."
"Is this really how you uphold the Will of Fire?"
Zenkichi sighed as he looked at their retreating figures.
"Hado #99: Goryūtenmetsu – Five Dragons of Destruction!"
A burst of immense spiritual pressure surged from Zenkichi's body. Five dragons formed and roared through the air, their destructive power tearing across the sand.
This was Zenkichi's latest large-scale technique—an indiscriminate annihilation move.
The snakes that had made up Orochimaru's clone were instantly obliterated. Even the surrounding terrain seemed to vanish under the blast.
But Zenkichi's expression darkened.
"That wasn't the real Orochimaru."
---

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - 99: Six Paths. [Bonus]
chapters.content:
The Ancient Kingdom of Rōran.
Orochimaru and Black Zetsu stood near the Dragon Vein. Not far from them were several guards of the Rōran Kingdom.
At this moment, Black Zetsu and White Zetsu had fused together into a half-black, half-white entity.
White Zetsu's right eye socket housed a Rinnegan, its power suppressed by the Hashirama cells infused within him.
Orochimaru cast a subtle glance at the Rinnegan before quickly forming hand seals to activate the Dragon Vein.
Though he had sent a snake clone to mislead Shimura Danzo and the others, he wasn't certain how long the ruse would hold. If Arakawa Zenkichi arrived before the portal was open, Orochimaru would have no choice but to face him.
Suddenly, Black Zetsu's face changed. "Zenkichi is almost here. Hurry!"
But Orochimaru merely smiled, his voice laced with pride. "Relax. We'll make it."
As he finished speaking, golden light erupted from the Dragon Vein, and immense chakra surged outward in waves.
"So the Dragon Vein is active… how interesting."
Zenkichi felt the shift from afar, a slight smile tugging at his lips.
His body transformed into golden light and raced toward the disturbance.
He had already arranged everything in his world. Leaving it temporarily posed no risk.
Now, guided by the energy of the Dragon Vein, he would descend into another time and space—to see what surprises awaited him there.
---
Shinobi World No. 2 — The Ancient Kingdom of Rōran
Blinding light poured from the Dragon Vein, and Orochimaru emerged, his expression unreadable.
Without wasting a second, he vanished at top speed, darting off into the distance.
Black Zetsu had not yet emerged, but Orochimaru had no intention of waiting. Zenkichi was close behind—every second mattered.Google seaʀᴄh NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Some hours later, the Dragon Vein shimmered again, and Black Zetsu surfaced.
He immediately slipped into the earth and vanished without delay.
Truth be told, he didn't want to see Orochimaru again. The way Orochimaru looked at the Rinnegan unnerved him—he always feared the man would try to take it.
After leaving Rōran, Black Zetsu found a thriving oasis within the Land of Wind.
Many small towns dotted the oasis, nurtured by its rare water supply.
Disguised as a civilian, Black Zetsu wandered into one of the settlements to gather intel on this strange version of the world.
To his growing surprise, he soon discovered that twenty years had passed—and Zenkichi didn't exist in this timeline.
"This… this is fantastic!"
Black Zetsu's voice trembled with excitement. A world untouched by Zenkichi's rule? Truly a blessing.
Meanwhile, Zenkichi stepped out of the Dragon Vein and arrived in the ancient land of Rōran.
Listening to the locals speak of a Dragon Vein anomaly, a curious smile appeared on his face.
"Not just time travel… space travel, too?"
"This is a whole different world."
"I've arrived. I've seen. Now I'll conquer."
"Two shinobi worlds… double the victory."
Intrigued, Zenkichi decided to explore further.
---
Elsewhere…
Orochimaru appeared near Konohagakure in the Land of Fire.
Using genjutsu, he manipulated several Konoha shinobi and extracted detailed information about this timeline.
"Incredible… So in this world without Zenkichi-kun, I still betrayed Konoha?"
"I even joined Sunagakure in launching the Konoha Crush Plan… and killed Sarutobi-sensei?"
He chuckled bitterly. "I thought Zenkichi-kun's interference had caused the rift between me and Sarutobi-sensei. But it seems… that was always my path."
Releasing the genjutsu-bound Konoha shinobi, Orochimaru left quietly, determined to find the other version of himself.
"He has twenty more years of experience. That alone will make him vastly different."
"If I rely on my own instincts, it will be like looking for a needle in a haystack."
"Unless…"
After some thought, he formed hand seals and summoned a large blue serpent with the Summoning Technique.
---
At the same time...
Black Zetsu from Shinobi World No. 1 met his counterpart from this world.
Zetsu No. 1 had used the White Zetsu network and their plant root system, which spanned underground across the world, to contact this world's version of himself.
These underground roots acted as high-speed transmission channels for information and movement.
Black Zetsu No. 2 looked at his counterpart in disbelief. He struggled to process what he was seeing.
"I'm the mastermind behind the shinobi world. So why… is there another me?"
Black Zetsu No. 1 calmly spoke. "I know you have questions. Let me explain what happened in my world. Afterward, things might become clearer."
He recounted everything. When he finished, Zetsu No. 2 frowned deeply.
"Your story is nearly identical to mine—up to one point."
"The only difference is… in my world, Zenkichi doesn't exist. And that changed everything."
"Before he showed up, our experiences were practically the same."
Zetsu No. 2 looked conflicted—then somewhat pleased.
"I sympathize with your situation."
"Since we're the same, just from different timelines, I'll help you."
"When I resurrect my mother, I'll send her to your world too. She'll save yours as well."
At that, Black Zetsu No. 2's eyes gleamed with excitement.
"Two Kaguyas—double happiness!"
"Thankfully, Zenkichi isn't in my world. If he was, saving Mother would be impossible."
He grinned, basking in his supposed good fortune.
But Zetsu No. 1 hesitated for a moment before speaking.
"I have bad news."
"Orochimaru and I weren't the only ones who came through the Dragon Vein…"
"…Arakawa Zenkichi is here too."
Zetsu No. 2: "…"
Zetsu No. 2: ??(◣д◢)??
What?! Zenkichi came to this world too?!
Zetsu No. 2 glared at his counterpart, suspicion thick in his gaze.
"Wait… don't tell me you brought him here?"
"No," Zetsu No. 1 said firmly. "Zenkichi controls our world. He discovered the Dragon Vein's secret on his own. He was coming either way."
"Now's not the time to point fingers. We need to focus on how to stop him."
"There's only one being who can beat him—our mother."
"Uchiha Madara won't be enough. To face a man who turns into light itself, we need the power of the Six Paths."
---

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - 100: Time Travel.
chapters.content:
Above the Hidden Sand Village, the night sky was lit up by a fierce battle.
A blond man rode atop a giant white clay bird, clashing with a red-haired shinobi hovering on a cloud of sand.
The blond was none other than Deidara of the Akatsuki. He molded clay from his pouch into various explosive creatures and hurled them directly at his opponent—Gaara, the Fifth Kazekage.
On a nearby sand dune just outside Sunagakure, Arakawa Zenkichi stood watching the confrontation from afar, an unreadable expression on his face.
The scene confirmed his suspicions—Shippuden had begun, and the Akatsuki had already started their hunt for the Tailed Beasts.
If things played out as they did in the original timeline, Gaara would be defeated and abducted by Deidara.
Though Gaara's power matched Deidara's, the environment put him at a severe disadvantage.
Their battle took place directly above the village. One misstep, and the resulting destruction would endanger innocent civilians and damage Sunagakure's infrastructure.
Because of that, Gaara held back, avoiding large-scale jutsu.
Deidara had clearly realized this. He rained clay bombs downward, forcing Gaara to divide his attention to protect the village.
Despite being surrounded by his subordinates, Gaara had no aerial support. Few shinobi in the world could fight effectively in the air.
Zenkichi observed the fight quietly, a faint smile playing on his lips. Then, in a flash, his body turned into golden light and shot upward.
A streak of brilliance pierced the dark sky, and Zenkichi materialized beside Deidara.
"Who the hell—!?"
Deidara's eyes narrowed as he glared at the man who had suddenly appeared.
Zenkichi hovered effortlessly mid-air and spoke calmly.
"Speed is weight. Ever been kicked at the speed of light, kid?"
He slowly raised his leg. The sole of his foot glowed with a radiant golden cross.
Boom!
With a single strike, Deidara was launched backward like a missile, crashing through multiple buildings in the Hidden Sand Village.
"…He defeated him?"Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Gaara's eyes widened in shock. Then he glanced at Zenkichi with a complicated mix of wariness and gratitude.
Though he didn't know who Zenkichi was or what he wanted, the man had just helped save his village.
"…No. He used a clay clone."
Zenkichi's tone was calm as he looked toward the massive clay bird.
Moments before the kick landed, Deidara had swapped himself out with a pre-prepared clone hidden inside the bird's body.
"Sharp eyes!"
Deidara burst from the bird's corpse, leaping into the sky as the bird exploded into countless white fragments.
"Be careful! Those are explosive!"
Gaara quickly shouted a warning.
"Hadō No. 63: Raikōhō!"
As the fragments surged toward him, Zenkichi raised his hand. A golden lightning cannon burst forth, detonating mid-air.
Deidara's clay had a critical weakness—it was highly susceptible to lightning. Even ordinary electricity, or chakra-generated lightning, could destabilize the bombs.
Zenkichi's thunder cannon engulfed the incoming projectiles and struck Deidara in mid-air.
"Ugh…"
Charred and smoking, Deidara's body fell limply from the sky.
Gaara extended his hand, sand forming beneath Deidara to catch him safely. The sand quickly wrapped around his body, sealing him tightly for interrogation.
"My friend, thank you for your assistance."
"If you don't mind, would you join me in my office?"
Gaara's voice was steady but respectful.
He was well aware that if Zenkichi hadn't stepped in, the outcome tonight could have been disastrous.
This mysterious man was powerful—clearly beyond the norm. Gaara had never heard of anyone by that name before. If Zenkichi was a rogue shinobi, perhaps he could be persuaded to join the village.
Having someone of that level would greatly benefit Sunagakure and strengthen Gaara's newly earned position as Kazekage.
Zenkichi accepted the invitation with a nod and followed Gaara to the top floor of the Kazekage Tower.
As soon as they landed, Gaara turned to his ANBU guards.
"Search the entire village. Double the patrols, and keep him under close observation."
He wasn't naïve. The fact that someone could infiltrate the village so easily meant the patrol system had flaws—and Zenkichi could be either a savior or a threat.
"Forgive me," Gaara said after a moment. "I don't believe I've heard your name before. I also don't recall any ninja as strong as you existing in the current world."
Zenkichi took a sip of the tea offered and replied casually.
"You haven't heard of me because the version of me in this world… died before he could grow."
Gaara stiffened. "…You died in this world? I don't understand. What do you mean?"
"It means I'm not from this world," Zenkichi said. "I come from another one."
"That world is much like this one, but also quite different."
"The key difference… is me."
"In that world, I didn't die in obscurity. I survived, I grew strong, and I ended the one-country, one-village system."
"There are no more wars there. No more divisions. All shinobi belong to a single organization. One united force."
"I came to save you. You can surrender to me, and together we'll build a better future. A unified shinobi world—under my leadership."
Zenkichi's words were clear and unwavering.
Gaara stared at him in stunned silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 101 - 101: Sasori
chapters.content:
The entrance to the Sand Hidden Village.
The Red Sand Scorpion sighed helplessly, "Deidara, it seems I can't wait for you to return this time."
After being defeated and captured, the Red Sand Scorpion had no intention of rescuing him.
Although he boasted of his strength, it was still insufficient against an entire ninja village.
Even the tank-like Third Raikage was killed after wrestling with 10,000 Shinobi for three days and nights.
Moreover, he was a relatively fragile puppet master. Facing swarming ninja troops, he would only perish.
The Puppet Master's defense and attack power were low; his damage mainly relied on poison.
"Found it!"
Just as the Red Sand Scorpion was about to retreat, Kankuro rushed over with ninja troops from Sunagakure Village.
They spotted the shape immediately—the strange red sand scorpion was definitely not a ninja from the Hidden Sand Village.
"Puppet show!"
Kankuro was excited to have found his enemy. Without hesitation, he unleashed his three puppets from their sealed scroll.
"Intruder, I will make you pay," Kankuro said proudly, not noticing the disappointment in the Red Sand Scorpion's eyes.
"After so many years, Sand Hidden Village's puppetry skills haven't improved at all."
"The puppets I created back then still haven't been eliminated."
The Red Sand Scorpion spoke slowly as the tail stabbed toward Kankuro.
Kankuro fought with his puppets but was defeated, laid out like a vegetable.
The puppets Kankuro used were all transformed from the Red Sand Scorpion. It was strange that someone could defeat him.
---
Kazekage Office
This time, although Sunagakure Village lost Deidara as a teammate, it brought back several former subordinates.
After dealing with them, the Red Sand Scorpion left with his men without hesitation.
When Kankuro rushed back to the street, he brought the others here.
The Hidden Sand Village ninjas did not last long.
The Red Sand Scorpion knew each of Kankuro's puppets' weaknesses and easily dismantled them.
"Kazekage-sama, Kankuro-sama is injured," a Sunagakure ninja reported, bringing Gaara back to his senses after confusion.
"Let's discuss this later."
"My brother is injured; I need to check on him," Gaara said solemnly to Zenkichi, then prepared to leave with the ninja who came in.
"You all, please entertain Mr. Zenkichi!"Follow current novels on N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Gaara called a few ANBU ninjas and asked them to stay and keep Zenkichi company.
After all, where Zenkichi was—the Kazekage office—was a place full of secrets.
Gaara would not feel at ease leaving Zenkichi there alone.
"I know some medical ninjutsu. Let me go with you!" Zenkichi said with a chuckle, uninterested in staying put.
"That's good!"
Thinking of Zenkichi's powerful skills, Gaara agreed.
---
Sunagakure Village Clinic
A group of medical ninjas were busy tending to unconscious Kankuro, collecting blood data and applying medical ninjutsu.
"Kankuro-sama has been poisoned by a powerful toxin. We can't resolve it here."
"But Kazekage-sama, don't worry, we've already sent for Chiyo and Ebizo."
After Gaara's capture in the original timeline, Chiyo and Ebizo took a long time to descend the mountain.
That was because no one dared to seek them without permission. But now, things were different.
Gaara, the Kazekage, was here; no one dared take his brother's injury lightly.
Without Gaara's orders, someone would have already requested Chiyo and Ebizo's help.
At this moment, two elderly walked in—it was Chiyo and Ebizo.
Chiyo approached Kankuro expressionless, examined his condition, then moved to a pile of medicinal herbs to prepare remedies.
After a while, Chiyo returned and placed a pill into Kankuro's mouth.
"My medicine treats symptoms but not the root cause," Chiyo said. "An excellent medical ninja is needed to detoxify him."
Gaara thought briefly before deciding, "An excellent medical ninja? Ask Konoha for help."
The best medical ninja in the world today was Tsunade, Konoha's Fifth Hokage.
Gaara and Naruto Uzumaki of Konoha were good friends. In such matters, he decisively sought help from Konoha.
After taking the pill, Kankuro slowly awoke.
As soon as he opened his eyes, he said to Gaara, "I discovered the invasion. The attacker was an accomplice of the killer, but i failed to defeat him, and the attacker escaped."
"But I got an important clue. The intruder seemed to be a rebellious ninja from Sunagakure Village. He personally told me that the three puppets I used were all modified by him."
"I didn't believe it at first, but seeing how easily he found and destroyed the weaknesses of my puppets, I do now. However, I don't know which puppet master modified those three puppets."
Chiyo asked, "Which models are the puppets?"
Kankuro named his three puppets, and Chiyo's face suddenly turned pale.
Gaara noticed and asked quickly, "Grandma Chiyo, did you recognize something?"
Chiyo hesitated before replying, "The one who modified those puppets was my grandson, Sasori. But he disappeared many years ago. I thought someone might be impersonating him."
Zenkichi said calmly, "As far as I know, the Red Sand Scorpion is not dead. In my world, he poisoned the Third Kazekage and transformed him into a human puppet…"
Before Zenkichi finished, everyone looked at him in horror.
"What did you say?" Chiyo stared at him seriously.
Ebizo looked at Zenkichi with a murderous glare and said, "Kazekage-sama, who is this person? We are discussing Sunagakure here. Not everyone should overhear important village matters."
Zenkichi smiled gently, "Don't bluff; that only exposes your guilty conscience and weakness. Don't threaten me; it won't scare me."
"If you wonder why… in my world, you were still in your prime and peak strength, yet you were easily killed by me."
"Now that you are old and frail, I can send you to meet the First Kazekage with just a few gestures. Your bravado seems ridiculous, so let's end this farce."
Zenkichi spoke calmly, but his words shocked everyone present.
"Kazekage-sama, what exactly is going on?" Chiyo suddenly turned to Gaara and asked sharply.
Gaara had no choice but to explain what Zenkichi had just said.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 102 - 102: Kyouka Suigetsu.
chapters.content:
"From another world?"
"Coming from 20 years ago, completely different from the past?"
Both Chiyo and Ebizo were stunned, disbelief written across their faces.
Gaara looked at Zenkichi solemnly and asked, "You said Elder Chiyo and Elder Ebizo were killed by you 20 years ago. Is that true?"
"If this is all true, your relationship with Sunagakure Village must be very hostile. Then why did you help me earlier?"
Zenkichi replied calmly, "I am helping you because you are still useful. I need you as a step to reach Sunagakure Village."
"To be honest, I bear no grudge against Sunagakure Village. I do not want you to be killed by me like in my world."
Chiyo snorted and punched Zenkichi unceremoniously. "Arrogant brat, let me teach you a lesson!"
Zenkichi stretched out his palms expressionless, releasing a powerful haki force that sent Chiyo flying before she even made contact.
"What?"
Chiyo's face turned to horror as she realized she was blown away by an invisible force.
Though a skilled puppet master, her physical abilities remained impressive.
Even in her old age, she had once subdued Uzumaki Naruto.
But now, facing Zenkichi, she was easily overpowered.
"So, you still want to stop me?"
"In that case, I have no choice but to ask you to die."
"What I intend to do cannot be stopped by you."
Zenkichi said coldly, summoning the Mirror Flower, Water Moon in his hand.
"Wait!"
Gaara shouted, glaring at Zenkichi.
"How can you call this annexation? Everything is for peace in the ninja world."
"After Sunagakure Village became the official ninja force of the Land of Wind, didn't it also absorb many ninja clans?"
"Those unwilling to join were either eliminated, expelled, or killed."
"I am doing to you what you once did to others."
"What slogan did you use then? That the existence of those clans hindered peace."
"You said top ninja clans plunged the world into war for their own gain. Isn't that what you are doing now?"
"The first generation Kage created the village for peace; later generations protected it for power."
"When the dragon is slain, its scales grow on the warriors who killed it."
"Today's Ninja Village leaders differ little from the old clan leaders. You are all destined for elimination."
"In that world, you fought me for power and were ultimately killed by me."
"Are you truly willing to repeat the same mistakes here?"
Zenkichi's expression softened. He pointed his Kyouka Suigetsu sword downward and called out, "Kyouka Suigetsu!"
The blade flashed blue, completing the hypnosis instantly.
Chiyo fell silent for a moment, then asked, "I have a question. Why was Sasori involved in that world? Is it because you killed me?"
"He defected and is no longer a ninja of Sunagakure. He should not fight you for his own rights, right?"
Zenkichi said calmly, "Sasoriof that world did defect. The reason he fought me... must be because of you."
Chiyo sighed, "That is a relief to hear."
"But even if you bring me such news, I will not give up Sunagakure."
"Sunagakure Village is the brainchild of generations of Kazekages, and it is our mission to protect it to the death."
Zenkichi said disdainfully, "Really? What a noble reason. Too bad the ninja clans wiped out by Sunagakure had even stronger beliefs."
"Sunagakure has only existed for a few decades, but the clans you destroyed may have existed for hundreds or thousands of years."
"They were the legacy of thousands, steeped in the blood and beliefs of their ancestors."
"You, Sunagakure, showed no mercy to those ninjas. Don't be naive enough to think I will show mercy to you."
Gaara's expression hardened, yellow sand swirling from the gourd behind him.
"Your idea is wrong. Unifying the ninja world through force is extreme. We will stop you."
Zenkichi responded calmly, "Is that so? That's fine. Whether the dust before me is one or two, I cannot tell, much less care."
"There are stumbling blocks in this world, but no stumbling dust. Still, I advise you not to insist too much, or you will truly die."
"Stepping over ants without killing them is a difficult skill to master. But the ants I stepped over before are now all dead. Want to take that chance?"
Zenkichi spoke quietly, as if discussing something trivial.
Ebizo could no longer tolerate it. He took out a scroll and quickly unfurled it.
A python-shaped puppet appeared before him.
"Boy!"
Ebizo roared, preparing to teach Zenkichi a lesson with his puppet technique. The python rushed toward Zenkichi.
Zenkichi moved fluidly, evading the python's attack.nᴇt
He appeared beside Gaara and launched an assault.
Gaara reacted quickly, urging sand to shield him, but Ebizo's puppet suddenly lunged at Gaara.
"Elder Ebizo, what are you doing?" Gaara shouted furiously.
"Arrogant brat, die!" Ebizo growled, controlling the puppet to attack Gaara.
Gaara formed an absolute defense with sand and fixed his gaze on Zenkichi.
Seeing Zenkichi's indifferent expression, he realized Ebizo had been tricked.
"Damn it! When did you put Ebizo under genjutsu?" Gaara yelled angrily.
"This isn't an illusion!"
"This is a powerful force beyond chakra, an ability you cannot resist."
"You companions must have never fought seriously before, right? No matter, I will erase your regrets now."
"Under the control of Kyouka Suigetsu, let's have a good fight!"
Zenkichi smiled. The ability to manipulate the five senses with Kyouka Suigetsu was terrifying.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 103 - 103: Zenkichi: Our relationship in the other world was close.
chapters.content:
Gaara fought Chiyo and Ebizo for a time, repeatedly trying to strike at the culprit, Zenkichi.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
However, Chiyo and Ebizo's fierce attacks left no opening to hit Zenkichi.
He tried several times to break the illusion trapping Chiyo and Ebizo, but failed.
"It's useless. I should have told you earlier—I am not using illusion."
Zenkichi stood nearby holding Kyouka Suigetsu, watching the battle with a smile.
He observed Gaara, Chiyo, and Ebizo's intense fight but soon lost interest.
Gaara's absolute defense was formidable, but the two puppet masters' offensive power was limited.
Though the venom-quenched puppet was lethal, lethality and attack power differed.
The puppet's strikes couldn't break Gaara's defense, and the poison couldn't invade his body.
"That's it!"
Zenkichi sighed faintly, watching the battle of these three shadow-level powerhouses.
When Kyouka Suigetsu was revealed, Chiyo and Ebizo broke into a cold sweat.
Because the one they attacked was none other than Gaara, the Fifth Kazekage of Sunagakure Village.
"How can the Fifth Kazekage be defeated like this?" Chiyo and Ebizo looked as if they saw a ghost, disbelief clear on their faces.
"Nothing is impossible. This is my ability," Zenkichi chuckled casually.
"But this fight feels dull and unexciting, like elemental body transformation."
Zenkichi sighed softly with a disappointed expression.
"What are you saying?"
Temari shouted from the side, swinging her iron fan.
Sharp wind blades cut toward Zenkichi.
Golden light flashed on Zenkichi's body.
The wind blades left marks but shattered into fragments against his golden glow.
His body reassembled perfectly, untouched.
"My elemental ability is powerful," Zenkichi said calmly.
"With this, I can ignore almost all attacks."
"The reason I unified the ninja world in my original world was because of this power."
Raising Mirror Flower, Water Moon in his hand, Zenkichi continued:
"Whether elemental transformation or illusions like Mirror Flower, Water Moon, this tricky style isn't what I prefer."
"Now, feel the power of despair!"
A surge of energy burst from Zenkichi's body.
He slashed at Gaara and the others, sword energy roaring like a tsunami.
The powerful force destroyed the Fengying Building instantly, turning countless buildings along the way to ruins.
"Ahem!"
Amid the dust and smoke, Gaara's dry cough was sharp.
Then footsteps approached.
Zenkichi walked slowly before Gaara.
"Should I kill you now?"
"What a vexing question."
Zenkichi looked down at the wounded Gaara casually.
"It's unbelievable you have such strength."
"Just one sword swing. Is this truly swordsmanship?"
Gaara looked at Zenkichi in despair, his worldview collapsing.
"Don't believe it? Fine."
"I will let you go this time, but you must spread my name throughout the ninja world."
"If you refuse, I will destroy Sunagakure Village."
"If you comply, I will make Sunagakure my final conquest."
Zenkichi smiled, not taking Sunagakure seriously.
"I will as you say."
Gaara gritted his teeth, resolved to spread word of Zenkichi's strength to the entire ninja world.
He felt compelled to convene a Five Kage summit to unite the five great ninja villages against Zenkichi.
"Really? Then I look forward to your efforts."
Zenkichi said calmly, then vanished into Sunagakure Village.
"Gaara!" Temari held her big iron fan, smiling wryly.
"There must be no chaos left in Sunagakure."
"Our losses are not great, so do not worry."
Gaara comforted Temari.
Temari was uneasy.
Her worry wasn't the current state of Sunagakure but what lay ahead.
Terumi Mei, the recently appointed Fifth Mizukage, examined information in front of her, confused.
What Zenkichi had done in Sunagakure, shamelessly aided by the village, spread rapidly throughout the ninja world.
Temari was deeply troubled.
She feared the future of Sunagakure.
Could they truly defeat Zenkichi?
"Could this information be false? It sounds exaggerated."
"Fifth Kazekage Gaara, Chiyo, and Ebizo—so many Kage-level powerhouses combined—couldn't kill Zenkichi with one sword?"
Terumi Mei's expression was full of disbelief.
"Impossible? Your vision is too narrow."
A voice interrupted: "Not impossible."
Zenkichi appeared, causing Mei Terumi's expression to shift. She looked up quickly.
In the Mizukage's office, Zenkichi sat calmly on the sofa, peeling an apple while holding a mirror.
"Are you... Zenkichi?"
Terumi Mei stood, narrowing her eyes at him.
The intelligence from Sunagakure included a description of Zenkichi's appearance.
Despite his infamous looks, Mei immediately guessed his identity.
He had infiltrated her office.
Only a few in the ninja world could do this.
"It's me."
Zenkichi tossed the peeled apple to Terumi Mei with a smile.
"What brings you to Kirigakure Village?"
Mei eyed him cautiously, hiding her suspicion.
Zenkichi chuckled.
"I'm a ninja of Kirigakure Village in another world and its Fourth Mizukage. Is it strange I'm here?"
Terumi Mei said flatly, "This is not your world, and you are not the Fourth Mizukage."
Zenkichi laughed.
"You fear I will take your position. How sad! Our relationship in the other world was very close."
Terumi Mei hummed, "How close?"
Zenkichi tapped his lower body and said seriously, "You have a mole here."

Terumi Mei glared at Zenkichi as if she wanted to bite him, ready to swallow him whole.
Zenkichi was momentarily stunned, then said apologetically, "Sorry, is it inappropriate to mention this?"

"Of course! If you want proof, I can help!"
"Is it because there is no me in this world? You're not married yet."
Terumi Mei slammed the table, blushing furiously. "No way! You don't have to worry about me getting married, you annoying fool."
Zenkichi smiled. "Annoying fool? Hehe! That's because you don't understand me yet. In the other world, you loved me to death."
Terumi Mei coughed dryly and felt this topic could not continue. She said seriously, "Let's get to the point. What do you want to do in Kirigakure Village?"
"Sunagakure Village released news that you want to unify the entire ninja world, and you have shown the strength to do so. Are you trying to replace me and do this using Kirigakure Village as your base?"
Zenkichi thought for a moment, shook his head and said, "Unifying the ninja world isn't difficult for me. But I don't want to do that now."
Terumi Mei asked curiously, "Can you tell me why?"
Zenkichi smiled, "The reason is simple—I need some experience points."
Terumi Mei blinked, puzzled, but Zenkichi didn't elaborate.
This was a new problem Zenkichi had discovered. He couldn't gain achievements after defeating Chiyo and Ebizo.
Defeating Gaara was an achievement, but unfortunately it unlocked only a low level.
Zenkichi realized the achievements he gained in the original Naruto world might not be possible again in this new Naruto world.
After all, although both were Naruto worlds, it was impossible to achieve the same accomplishments twice.
If so, unlocking Kyouka Suigetsu fully would be even harder.
Only the new generation leaders of the major ninja villages and a few people he hadn't personally attacked before could provide the necessary achievement unlock levels.
But even if Zenkichi eliminated all of them, it might still not be enough to unlock the entire Aizen template.
So he thought about training against candidates like Obito, Madara, and even Otsutsuki Kaguya.
With the fully unlocked Aizen and the infinitely evolving Hōgyoku, even Kaguya wouldn't pose a threat.
"Is this like imitating Aizen and cultivating opponents?"
"No, it's more like raising pigs."
"After all, I won't let them grow enough to threaten me. Their growth just provides me with more unlock levels."
"But practically speaking, it's best to forget this idea."
"This way, I can get more experience."
Zenkichi gave up on killing the Akatsuki immediately.
While Zenkichi lingered in Kirigakure, the entire ninja world was thrown into turmoil because of him.

The Rinnegan allowed him to easily kill the so-called demigod Hanzo.
All who opposed him were wiped out by the power of the Rinnegan.
Nagato moved smoothly with the Rinnegan's help, naively believing he would become the god who saved the ninja world.

Nagato said coldly, "Even if he's strong, he's still vulnerable to the Rinnegan."

chapters.title: Chapter 105 - 105: Six Paths of Pain.
chapters.content:
Outside Sunagakure Village
Under a sand dune, someone used earth-style ninjutsu to slip into a secret room.
Nagato sat here, with Konan standing guard beside him.
This location was relatively high, allowing Nagato to use the power of the Rinnegan to transmit chakra to the Six Paths Pain within Sunagakure Village.
Under Nagato's control, the Six Paths Pain had invaded Sunagakure.
Rockets appeared on Asura Path's body. As these rockets launched, flames engulfed the entire village.
"What's happening?"
Uzumaki Naruto, speaking with his close friend, was startled. Gaara stood up with a solemn expression.
"Unexpectedly, someone has invaded Sunagakure again!"
At that moment, Gaara was furious, his killing intent nearly tangible. He regained some of his former ruthless demeanor.
First Deidara, then Zenkichi, now someone else is here?.
With this current invasion, Sunagakure Village had endured three attacks within days.
All under his watch—it was a humiliating slap in the face.
Sunagakure was one of the Five Great Shinobi Villages and cared deeply about its reputation.
If Sunagakure was destroyed again, its status would be reduced to that of the small shinobi villages.
Though its strength ranked lowest among the five, it was still a great ninja village.
Gaara and Uzumaki Naruto prepared to go out and teach the intruders a lesson.
Then they saw numerous beasts with circular eyes wreaking havoc throughout the village. These were Beasts from the Six Paths Pain.
These monsters were many and powerful, immune to pain and death, and served as the spearhead of the assault.
Upon their arrival, these beasts drained 90% of Sunagakure's forces, forcing ninjas to focus on stopping them.
If left unchecked, Sunagakure would soon be destroyed by these creatures.
Moreover, the beasts' size and ferocity made them especially deadly to civilians.
And civilians were the foundation of Sunagakure.
"Damn it!"
Gaara's expression darkened. Without hesitation, he wrapped a psychic beast's head in sand.
Using force, he crushed the beast's skull, turning it into white mist.
"Rasengan!"
Naruto's anger surged as he saw his friend's village under attack. He formed a Rasengan and launched it at a beast.
"Found them!"
Three of Pain's Six Paths approached.
Deva Path, Preta Path, and Asura Path—all powerful Pain warriors skilled in melee—advanced toward Gaara.
"The Akatsuki cloaks... Are you all members of the Akatsuki?"
Gaara stared coldly at the five Pains and shouted.
"Unexpectedly, apart from the One-Tail, even the Nine-Tails' Jinchūriki are here."
"This is a surprise. I've been waiting for you."
Deva Path spoke indifferently. Asura Path immediately launched dense rockets toward the two Jinchūriki.
Absolute Defense!
Gaara used sand to form an absolute shield, barely blocking the rocket barrage.
The power of Asura Path's rocket attack was immense. Even Gaara struggled as a large section of his sand shield shattered.
"Be careful, this is not an easy opponent."
Gaara warned Naruto solemnly, fearing his friend might be caught off guard.
Naruto patted his chest confidently. "Don't worry, I'll definitely defeat him."
Naruto formed hand seals and activated his signature ninjutsu—the Multi Shadow Clone Technique.
Hundreds of Narutos appeared, roaring as they charged the three Pains.
Deva Path stepped forward, raising his palms toward the approaching clones.
Shinra Tensei!
A violent repulsive force burst forth, bombarding Naruto's clones.
The fragile shadow clones instantly shattered into white mist under the impact.
After destroying a group of shadow clones, the repulsive force weakened, lessening the attack on Gaara and Naruto.
Gaara's sand shield was destroyed by Shinra Tensei, and both he and Naruto were blown back.
At this moment, Hatake Kakashi led other Sunagakure ninjas rushing to aid them.
They had just defeated some beasts when they noticed the battle's fluctuations and hurried to support.
Meanwhile, countless white paper talismans condensed into small… kunai, flying toward Sunagakure's prison.
This Konan was not the true body but a clone.
Yet even as a clone, her near-elemental body allowed her to easily handle the guards.
Xiaonan wasted no effort, killing all Sunagakure ninjas on guard and found Deidara in dire condition.
"Konan? I didn't expect you to come save me. I thought I was abandoned!"
Deidara looked at Konan appearing before him in surprise. Konan released him expressionlessly.
"Pain is fighting outside. We should leave quickly."
Konan reminded Deidara, but he was reluctant.
"Pain is fighting. How can i run?"
"My clay should be nearby. I'll find it and assist Pain."
"I was attacked by some bastard last time. Sunagakure hasn't seen my art!"
Deidara shouted confidently and ran to find his clay.
Konan shook her head helplessly and followed him.
---
Outside Sunagakure Village
Villagers gradually fled as Sunagakure was reduced to a battlefield between Six Paths Pain and Gaara's forces.
Chiyo and Ebizo took action, but had no effective counter to Pain.Google seaʀᴄh Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
The Puppet Masters' main strength came from their poisons, but Pain was a puppet formed from six corpses.
Their poisons were useless against Pain, greatly reducing their threat.
Fortunately, their puppets were strong, with significant attack power.
Chiyo's Chikamatsu Ten Puppets and Ebizo's special puppets could all damage Pain's body.
This allowed them to maintain combat power when facing the Six Paths Pain.
But even so, they fought with great difficulty.

chapters.title: Chapter 106 - 106: Know Pain !
chapters.content:
"You should have noticed by now, right? Each of these people has a different ability."
Kakashi said to Gaara and the others with a serious expression, sensing that dealing with the Six Paths Pain was very difficult.
"If I'm not mistaken, their eyes carry a lot of history."
"The circular eyes are the eyes of the legendary Six Paths Sage—the Rinnegan!"
Chiyo spoke solemnly, feeling great pressure from the Rinnegan's presence.
"But their eyes cannot be true Rinnegan. There can't be three pairs of Rinnegan in one world."
"I suspect they are puppets, a very special kind of human puppets."
Ebizo studied the three Pains carefully and found many clues.
"Puppets? That shouldn't be possible!"
"If they are puppets, there should be chakra strings around them."
"My Sharingan can see chakra. But I don't see any chakra threads around them."
Kakashi, watching with his Sharingan eye, said with some confusion:
"Not all puppets are controlled with chakra threads."
"Besides, it wouldn't be surprising for an enemy to have the Rinnegan and some special abilities."
Chiyo shook his head, agreeing with Ebizo's speculation.
Gaara groaned in frustration. "Now is not the time to debate. Let's talk about how to kill them!"
His powerful sand control was almost useless against Pain.
"Kill them? Let me tell you, we should think about survival first! Their powers are too strong for us to handle."
"If there's a way to defeat them, it's to exhaust their chakra and win by attrition."
"The combination of these three is invincible to us."
Chiyo sneered, bluntly stating a harsh fact.
Deva Pain possesses the strongest ability; his Shinra Tensei deflects all attacks.
The Preta Path can absorb all chakra-based attacks.
And the Asura Path has terrifying close-combat power.
Controlled by a single mind, they share vision and coordinate perfectly.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
This is beyond what Gaara and the others can handle, especially since their powers are still somewhat restrained by Pain's control.
Pain said with an indifferent tone, "If you hand over the two Jinchūriki, we will leave immediately."
Hatake Kakashi responded coldly, "Don't even think about it! Even if you have the upper hand now, we will be the ones who win in the end."
"Otherwise, you wouldn't be rushing to negotiate peace with us. If you want the Jinchūriki, come and take them yourself."
Chiyo nodded slightly. "The One-Tail's Jinchūriki is the Kazekage of Sunagakure Village. No village hands over its Kage."
"If you can't protect your village's shadow, then what difference does your village have from not existing?"
Gaara spoke solemnly, "Why does the Akatsuki want to capture the Tailed Beasts?"
Deva Pain answered indifferently, "For peace."
Uzumaki Naruto roared angrily, "Are you joking? After destroying other villages like this, you still say it's for peace?"Deva Pain coldly replied, "Do you understand pain? Pain is the way! Only by making everyone feel pain can the world achieve peace."
"I was born in a weak country, often a battlefield for great nations like yours."
"Great nations inflict pain on small ones like mine. You cannot understand our suffering."
"That's why wars are waged recklessly, destroying hard-won peace."
"I am here to make you feel our pain, understand our pain, and experience our pain."
"Only when the whole world suffers pain can people understand each other and peace come."
Gaara asked solemnly, "What does this have to do with Akatsuki capturing the Tailed Beasts?"
Tendo Pain said, "We will use the Tailed Beasts to create a powerful weapon. This weapon can destroy a country instantly."
"The deterrent effect of such a weapon will bring the world peace, making those who crave war feel fear and pain."
Gaara sneered, "Before you arrived, a man named Zenkichi talked to me about peace."
"Compared to your nonsense, Zenkichi's ideas are more convincing. That is the true path to peace."
Deva Pain said coldly, "In that case, I have no choice but to send you to your death."
At that moment, a burst of arrogant laughter sounded.
Deidara appeared riding a large white bird, whistling from a distance, holding a white bomb.
He threw it at Gaara and the others.
"Sunagakure Village, feel my art!"
"Art is an explosion!"
Deidara's shouts echoed across Sunagakure as the bombs exploded one after another.
Gaara raised his sand shield Sunako, absorbing the white bombs' attacks to protect others.
Meanwhile, Deva Pain seized the opportunity created by Deidara and suddenly reached out to grab Gaara.
"Bansho Tenin!"
While Gaara was distracted dealing with Deidara, Tendo Pain captured him with Bansho Tenin.
Gaara was too slow. Controlling his sand, his body was forcibly pulled toward Deva Pain.
Asura Path quickly fired rockets at Gaara, blasting away all the sand defenses covering his body.
Gaara struggled to resist the rocket barrage, hoping to close in and attack suddenly, but the Preta Path stepped forward to block him.
The Preta Path's palm touched Gaara, and the chakra inside him flowed toward the Preta Path like a tide.
"Shukaku! If you won't help me, don't expect me to be gentle!"
"Don't forget, they are coming for you!"
Gaara helplessly scolded Shukaku.
In Gaara's mind, the One-Tail's sharp voice replied, "Help you? What a joke! I am immortal and fear nothing!"
One-Tail Shukaku snorted, allowing Gaara's chakra to be drained until he lost consciousness.
Tailed Beasts are immortal. Even if killed, they can be reborn.
Shukaku had been sealed by Sunagakure for too long and was willing to die once for freedom.
"One Tail secured, next is Nine Tails!"
Looking at Naruto and the others evading Deidara's attacks, Deva Pain sneered.
"Capture the Tailed Beasts? I'm no fool like Shukaku!"
The Nine-Tails inside Uzumaki Naruto noticed the chaos and sneered, red chakra surging into Naruto's body.
The Nine-Tails and One-Tail, In the same situation, they chose differently.
Naruto was furious seeing Gaara captured, and the Nine-Tails' chakra surged, bursting forth from its seal.

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - 107: Visiting Konoha.
chapters.content:
Uzumaki Naruto was furious when he saw his beloved Gaara captured and rendered unconscious by the enemy.
Fueled by anger and with the Nine-Tails' cooperation, he suddenly entered the Tailed Beast Chakra Mode.
The light red chakra of the Nine-Tails enveloped his body, greatly enhancing his combat ability.
Naruto charged toward Deva Pain like a wild beast, but Pain calmly raised his palm.
Shinra Tensei!Thɪs Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
A powerful repulsive force roared out, immediately knocking Naruto back.
Severely injured, Naruto's eyes burned fiercely, filled with the violent spirit of a beast.
Kyuubi!
Pain's previous attack had rendered Naruto unconscious, but now the Nine-Tails took control of his body.
This is the curse of the Jinchūriki: a dual existence that is hard to bear.
After the Jinchūriki falls, the Tailed Beast trapped inside immediately emerges to take over.
Once the Tailed Beast is defeated, the Jinchūriki regains consciousness and uses the leftover Tailed Beast chakra to keep fighting.
If both are strong, this cycle can be terrifying.
A brutal battle unfolded.
Hatake Kakashi, Chiyo, Ebizo, and the others quickly withdrew. This was no longer a fight they could join.
Moreover, since the Nine-Tails was not allied with them, they did not factor into their strategy.
"This is no longer a battle between ninjas, but between monsters," Chiyo said emotionally.
As puppet masters, she and Ebizo were powerless to intervene at this scale.
Just like the Nine-Tails in the original story, the Tailed Beast chakra within Naruto continued to overflow, the tails behind him growing, unleashing devastating power.
Unfortunately, Naruto's opponent was not just Deva Pain, but all members of Pain's Six Paths.
Among them, the Preta Path alone, with its chakra-absorbing ability, was enough to give the Nine-Tails a headache.
Soon after, shocking news spread across the ninja world.
Akatsuki, led by Pain, had attacked Sunagakure Village; the Fifth Kazekage Gaara was captured, Chiyo and Ebizo were severely injured, and over half the village was killed or wounded.
Uzumaki Naruto, the Nine-Tails Jinchūriki sent to support Sunagakure, had been captured.
Two Jinchūriki were now in Akatsuki's hands.
Terumi Mei looked shocked and said, "Is the Akatsuki Organization really that powerful? Kirigakure Village can't believe it."
The ninja world now regarded Akatsuki with serious concern.
Not only that, the Akatsuki members possessed the legendary Six Paths Sage's eyes — the Rinnegan — which instilled great fear.
Including the most powerful, the Nine-Tails.
"Since they are so powerful, why do they still control Kirigakure Village?"
The Fourth Mizukage Yagura was known to be under Akatsuki's influence — no secret to Kirigakure's senior leadership.
Terumi Mei and others had worked hard to reclaim Kirigakure from Akatsuki control.
"Pain himself took action?"
Zenkichi studied the information before him with interest and surprise.
Since those involved had the Rinnegan, there was no doubt Nagato had ordered the Six Paths Pain to attack Sunagakure.
This surprised Zenkichi.
Wouldn't Nagato be afraid that Akatsuki's exposure would prompt the major villages to prepare?
What Zenkichi did not realize was that Nagato's decision to stop hiding was largely because of him.
Zenkichi's bold approach deeply moved Nagato.
Nagato, who did not consider himself weaker than Zenkichi, naturally refused to be outdone.
Zenkichi, an ordinary man lucky enough to unify another ninja world, dared to be so arrogant toward the ninja world and its major villages.
Why should he, a god with the Rinnegan and a mission to save the world, be so modest?
"There is still one Six-Tails Jinchūriki left in Kirigakure. I don't know if the Three-Tails has been reborn."
"If Akatsuki's goal is to collect the Tailed Beasts, Kirigakure might not be able to stop them."
Terumi Mei glanced at Zenkichi meaningfully.
Zenkichi smiled and said, "You want me to help? Yes, but it will come at a price."
Terumi Mei sighed and half-smiled, "Kirigakure is poor. I'm afraid I cannot offer much money."
Zenkichi smiled ambiguously, "I don't want money. I want you."
Terumi Mei bit her lip, winked at Zenkichi, and chuckled, "If you can protect Kirigakure, what then?"
Zenkichi curled his lips and said, "Not sincere. You were more straightforward when you were younger. You know, you were the one who made the first move back then."
Terumi Mei was shocked. "I made the first move? No way! What do you mean? Are you saying I'm old?"
She stared at Zenkichi angrily, almost ready to snap at him.
"There might be trouble in Konoha. I want to go check it out."
"You don't have to worry about Kirigakure's safety. I'll protect it with a clone."
"As for the Tailed Beast... it's not my concern."
Zenkichi said casually, waving his hand as he prepared to leave.
"Wait, you're leaving a shadow clone here?"
Terumi Mei called out, stunned.
Zenkichi smirked, "What else? Nothing will happen to me while I'm gone. Wait for me to return."
"The shadow clone has its limits; it can only take so much damage."
Terumi Mei was embarrassed but shouted, "What are you thinking? I'm worried you won't protect this place."
Zenkichi replied calmly, "If it can't be protected, then it can't. This is not my village after all."
"I have a close bond with Terumi Mei from another world, but you're not really her."
Seeing Zenkichi leave without hesitation, Terumi Mei felt a sudden pain in her heart and became upset.
Finally meeting a suitable partner, yet you say you're so reserved!
And Zenkichi is so impatient. Doesn't he know how to deal with girls more patiently?
I really don't understand how my other-world self caught up with him!
Hmm...
You're so bold—you deserve someone like me!
---
Konoha Village
Tsunade was furious upon receiving news: Konoha's nuclear weapons had been lost.
This was no trivial matter.
Without nuclear weapons, Konoha was vulnerable to exploitation.
Fortunately, the current ninja world was unstable.
Visitors from other worlds and the Akatsuki had demonstrated they could suppress the overwhelming power of a single village.
This made other villages cautious, unwilling to act rashly and risk harming civilians — opportunities for others to take advantage.
"Tsunade, you seem distressed!"
Zenkichi's voice interrupted, and Tsunade's expression changed as a young man appeared in her office.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 108 - 108: New Mission.
chapters.content:
"Who are you?"
"I am a visitor from another world — Zenkichi."
After a brief conversation, Tsunade stared at Zenkichi with a wary expression.
Though Zenkichi's demeanor was gentle, Tsunade could not shake her unease.
"There are reports from Sunagakure Village that you once unified another ninja world."
"Chiyo and Ebizo from Sunagakure tried to stop you, but you defeated them."
"Is that true?"
Tsunade fixed Zenkichi with a sharp gaze.
"Of course it is. I'm not one to waste time with lies."
"You ask because you want to know if I've attacked Konoha in another world, right?"
"I invaded Konoha several times, eventually conquering it by force."
"Sarutobi Hiruzen, Jiraiya, and others were stubborn, trying to resist the flow of history."
"Shimura Danzo and others fought me for power, but I killed them all."
Zenkichi said this calmly, as if recounting an ordinary matter.
Tsunade clenched her fist and ground her teeth.
"Then are you here now to warn us to surrender quickly?"
Zenkichi caught her fist effortlessly, smiling gently.
"No, I have other plans."
Tsunade's eyes widened in shock.
She had struck with great force, and even a shadow-level powerhouse would struggle to catch it.
But Zenkichi blocked it as easily as swatting a fly.
She couldn't hide her surprise.
Zenkichi considered for a moment and said, "You know, the you from my world were actually friends with me. We even talked about reviving the Senju's Clan."
He continued casually, "I'm not joking. I know many secrets about you — your sleeping habits, even some personal preferences."
An embarrassed flash crossed Tsunade's face, and she snapped, "That's nonsense!"
Zenkichi smiled.
"The Senju clan is nearly extinct. Reviving it means increasing its population — producing future generations."
Tsunade asked, confused, "What do you mean by reviving the Senju clan with you?"
She raised an eyebrow, half-smiling, "Really? What an honor! I wonder how close our relationship is in the other world?"
Zenkichi looked at her gently and said softly, "Don't be nervous. I bear you no ill will. You in that world share a close bond with me."
The power Zenkichi displayed seemed capable of sweeping the ninja world.
…
Listening to Zenkichi's details, Tsunade frowned.
"I don't know who you are, so how can I tell if your words are true?"
She twitched her lips and scoffed, "You might fool some naive girls with that, but not me."
Zenkichi shrugged.
"My purpose in coming to Konoha is simple: I want to know Konoha's current situation. As Fifth Hokage, I don't want to see you in trouble."
Tsunade glared at him and grunted.
"You think that? I don't. We will discuss this, and I'll find your real reason for coming."
Zenkichi smiled strangely.
"Care to try? I'm offering help, free of charge."
---
"If I am truly that close to you in the other world, then I have questions I cannot answer."
"You clearly killed my teacher and comrades, destroyed the village where my grandfather left me. Why would the other me follow you?"
Zenkichi replied calmly, "Because I inherited your grandfather's, the First Hokage's, desire for peace, corrected his mistakes, and brought the ninja world to true peace."
"After several wars, you should realize how naive the First Hokage's methods were. The one-village-per-country system only escalates conflict."
"Only by uniting the ninja world can true peace be achieved. You in the other world recognized me, so we joined forces."
"Now that you are the Fifth Hokage, you know many secrets about Konoha. Is it truly as beautiful as it seems? How much darkness grows unseen beneath the surface?"
Tsunade was silent, feeling almost persuaded.
After gaining Aizen's template, Zenkichi's skill at deception seemed to have improved greatly.
Suddenly, the door to the Hokage's office opened.
An elderly man with white hair entered — Jiraiya.
He was startled briefly on seeing Zenkichi, then relaxed when he noticed Tsunade's calm reaction.
Jiraiya glanced at Tsunade and asked casually, "Who is this?"
Tsunade introduced Zenkichi's identity.
Jiraiya said in surprise, "A visitor from another world? Zenkichi? What brings you to Konoha?"
Zenkichi replied, "I heard Konoha's Jinchūriki was captured. What do you make of it?"
Jiraiya was silent for a moment.
"That's Konoha's secret."
Tsunade glanced at Zenkichi, then said slowly, "Jiraiya, tell him the truth."
Jiraiya looked at Tsunade, surprised and hesitant.
Tsunade said calmly, "Zenkichi is here to help us. No more tricks."
Tsunade was impressed by Zenkichi's ideas, but also knew winning him over now would be wise.
Jiraiya stared at Tsunade, hesitated, then sighed.
"I went to Mt. Myōboku and asked the toads for counter-spiritual techniques to heal Uzumaki Naruto, the Nine-Tails Jinchūriki. He's seriously injured."
---
Meanwhile, beneath a sand dune in the Land of Wind, an earthen palace appeared.
Deva Pain, channeling the spirit, arrived.
The Akatsuki held a meeting.
Together, they used the sealing technique Phantom Dragon Nine Seals to extract the One-Tails Shukaku from Gaara's body and placed it into the mouth of the Gedo statue.
Among it were already the Five-Tails and Seven-Tails.
Once sealed, Deva Pain channeled the Animal Path.
The Preta Path extended his hands, crimson chakra flowing into the demon's body.
Though the Nine-Tails Jinchūriki was restrained, the Nine-Tails chakra it absorbed remained.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
"This Nine-Tails chakra can only be used as a backup. The Nine-Tails will have to be captured again sooner or later."
Deva Pain spoke coldly, then gave the Akatsuki members a new tailed beast capture mission.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - 109: Three Tails.
chapters.content:
In a secret underground base,
Orochimaru lay weakly on a bed, leaning against the headboard.
This was the No. 2 Orochimaru in this world, his body close to collapse.
"It seems taking over another body must be prioritized. This body won't last much longer."
Orochimaru No. 2 murmured as he cast a glance at Orochimaru No. 1 nearby.
Orochimaru No. 1 was busy with experiments in his hands, not looking up as he said, "Are you still planning on Uchiha Sasuke?"
"In my opinion, your chances of success are almost zero. Since you've studied the Sharingan, you should understand its power."
"The Sharingan is an eye technique of the Yin Release type and uses spiritual energy."
"This means Uchiha Sasuke's spiritual energy is very powerful, likely stronger than yours now."
"Your soul has undergone many reincarnations, becoming extremely fragile."
"If you try to possess him, you might be swallowed by him instead."
Orochimaru No. 2 smiled weakly, speaking calmly, "How could I not know this?"
"Since I chose this path, I must be sure. Even if Uchiha Sasuke devours me, I still have a chance to come back."
"Because after devouring me, he will seek revenge against Uchiha Itachi. Itachi's strength is no joke; even if Sasuke wins, it will be a costly victory."
"At that time, exhausted and unable to suppress my chakra, I can turn the tables and devour his soul while he's weak."
Orochimaru No. 1 asked, "What if Itachi kills him?"
Orochimaru No. 2 smiled, "No, if his life is truly in danger, I will protect his body."
"When defeated, he must be chakra-exhausted. I can still take over his body then."
"Though regrettable — my apprentice Sasuke won't get his revenge with his own hands — it suits me, the teacher, to avenge him."
Orochimaru No. 1 shook his head, "I really don't understand your obsession with the Sharingan."
"Is it because your hands are sealed and you rely on ninjutsu like eye techniques?"
"No ninjutsu is invincible. No matter how strong the sealing, there are ways to break it. You're going down the wrong path."
Orochimaru No. 2 sneered, "Do you think I haven't considered this? No, everything is calculated."
"If I fail to seize Sasuke's body, you will release me from the curse seal."
"Then I will undo my seal and regain my hands."
Orochimaru No. 1 pondered, "The failure you mentioned — after the battle between Sasuke and Itachi?"
Orochimaru No. 2 nodded, "If I can't seize his body then, I won't wait any longer."
"Because if I wait, who knows how many years I'll have to wait to succeed. I don't have the patience or time."
Orochimaru No. 1 nodded, "No problem. Many have your cursed seal; just find one to release you."
"But if I help, you must reward me accordingly."
"I want all research materials on Hashirama cells, reincarnation, curse seals, and jutsu."
Orochimaru No. 2 said casually, "No problem. Once freed, I'll give you everything."
Orochimaru No. 1 sighed, "Then why the obsession with the Sharingan?"
"If it were the Rinnegan, I might understand. But just the three-magata Sharingan — even the Mangekyō Sharingan — isn't worth it."
Orochimaru No. 2 said helplessly, "You don't get it. It's an obsession. Success or failure, I have to try."
Orochimaru No. 1 frowned and looked outside the door.
Though closed tightly, he felt someone approaching — Uchiha Sasuke.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Sasuke is here. He's probably planning to strike first."
"I can sense his murderous aura from far away."
Orochimaru No. 1 smiled at Orochimaru No. 2.
Orochimaru No. 2 said solemnly, "You should leave. If Sasuke devours me, let him leave this place."
Orochimaru No. 1 nodded and left with a hand seal.
Then a fierce battle erupted in Orochimaru No. 2's room.
Three minutes later, the fighting stopped.
Two minutes later, Sasuke emerged refreshed.
Orochimaru No. 1 returned and saw the gruesome scene:
A huge python made of countless white snakes lay in pieces on the floor, with snake blood everywhere.
"Sure enough, you failed!"
Orochimaru No. 1 shook his head helplessly.
…
Above a vast lake,
A large white clay bird flew over, carrying two figures in Akatsuki uniforms.
The yellow-haired Deidara looked displeased at the cold young man beside him — Uchiha Itachi.
After sealing the One-Tails, Deva Pain adjusted Akatsuki pairs to capture the remaining tailed beasts quickly.
With help from Black Zetsu No. 1 and No. 2, who realized how powerful Zenkichi was, they informed Obito Uchiha.
Obito and Nagato agreed to speed up tailed beast collection.
Analyzing remaining targets, Akatsuki members were reassigned based on each tailed beast's weaknesses.
Deidara and Itachi were tasked with capturing the Three-Tails, sleeping in the lake below.
Displeased, Deidara took white clay from his backpack, ate some with his palm, turned it into tiny white fish, and released them.
The fish entered the water, becoming Deidara's eyes and ears to locate the Three-Tails.
Because of his unique abilities, Deidara was assigned this task.
Soon, the fish found the Three-Tails.
The fish swam near its head and exploded, waking the beast.
Furious, the Three-Tails surged out of the water, creating huge waves.
"How about it, can you handle this?"
"If not, move aside and watch my art."
"Hmm!"
Deidara said proudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - 110: Immortal Trio.
chapters.content:
Deidara looked at Uchiha Itachi provocatively, but Itachi always maintained a cold expression.
Deidara clenched his teeth silently. What annoyed him most was Itachi's icy demeanor.
Itachi did not respond to Deidara's words; his dark eyes turned cold as they fixed on the Three-Tails before them.
His eyes instantly shifted to scarlet, three black magatama spinning rapidly inside, forming a triangular pinwheel pattern in a blink.
Unlike Uchiha Obito, who struggles with genjutsu but can control the Nine-Tails with his Mangekyō Sharingan, Itachi is a genjutsu specialist with a pair of Mangekyō Sharingan, making it easy for him to control the Three-Tails.
Itachi glared, cast a Mangekyō Sharingan genjutsu, and immediately took control of the Three-Tails.
"Let's go," Itachi said coldly.
"Controlling the Three-Tails so easily?" Deidara's face twisted in disbelief. Is the Mangekyō Sharingan really that powerful?
This is true skill!
For a moment, Deidara was filled with envy for the Mangekyō Sharingan.
…
In a mountain forest, Kisame and Tobi tracked down the Four-Tails Jinchūriki, Roshi.
Kisame suspected Tobi's true identity was Uchiha Madara, but the man before him was actually Uchiha Obito with White Zetsu fused to his body.
"The Four-Tails Jinchūriki Roshi is mine to handle."
"Madara-sama, please rest here."
Kisame grinned, showing sharp teeth, and moved toward Roshi.
After a moment,
"Water Release: Water Blast!"
Kisame formed hand seals and unleashed a powerful water torrent from his mouth, instantly creating a lake.
"Lava Release: Lava!"
Roshi spat molten magma.
Kisame formed seals; the surrounding water rose into a dragon and slammed into Roshi.
The magma was swallowed by the water dragon, extinguished inside it, and then slammed back at Roshi.
Samehada, Kisame's shark-like sword, suddenly leapt from his hand and bit into Roshi.
A red-haired ape appeared, condensing a tailed beast jade and hitting Kisame heavily.
A roar shook the area, and Roshi collapsed weakly.
Kisame bit into Roshi with Samehada, draining his chakra.
Samehada grew rapidly and broke free from the bandages binding Roshi.
It began devouring Roshi's chakra wildly, causing the magma coating Roshi's body to vanish.
Despite this, Roshi's magma coat was perfect for close combat—both offensive and defensive—a nightmare for taijutsu fighters.
Streams of magma spread rapidly, enveloping Roshi.
Roshi roared, "Melting Chakra Mode!"
Kisame suppressed Roshi with Water Release and slashed with Samehada.
Surrounded by a lake, Roshi's Lava Release was heavily suppressed.
Though strong, Roshi's Lava Release was no match for Kisame's abnormal Water Release.
"Isn't that the small fish following the Three-Tails?"
Samehada's dazzling display caught the Four-Tails' attention.
"Seems Samehada likes your chakra very much!"
Kisame smiled up at the Four-Tails.
After swallowing the tailed beast jade, Samehada dove into the lake, disappearing like a fish.
Kisame released Water Release again, condensing a water dragon to attack the Four-Tails.
The Four-Tails couldn't react to Samehada's movement and smashed the water dragon with its fist.
It felt a painful bite on its foot; chakra was pulled away violently.
Soon, the Four-Tails fell backward as Samehada drained chakra, returning it to its jinchūriki to recover.
Kisame retrieved Samehada and approached Tobi.
…
Kirigakure Village.
Terumi Mei paced angrily in the Mizukage's office, while Zenkichi calmly sipped tea on the sofa.
"The Six-Tails Jinchūriki has defected. How could this happen?"
Terumi Mei muttered with disbelief.
"The Six-Tails Jinchūriki, Utakata, has always been loyal to the village."
"He respected his master deeply. Why would he betray us?"
"Not only did he kill his master, but he fled the village. What is he thinking?"
Terumi Mei was puzzled.
Zenkichi said calmly, "If you ask me, you are simply self-defeating. You tried to protect the Six-Tails Jinchūriki and planned to remove part of the Six-Tails from his body."
"Unfortunately, Utakata didn't understand. To him, he'd be dead without the tailed beast. That may have pushed him to rebel."
Terumi Mei sat down weakly, sighing softly.
"So, what should we do now?"
Zenkichi replied indifferently, "Do whatever you want, as long as Kirigakure isn't in danger. As long as I'm here, even the Sage of Six Paths can't do anything."
Terumi Mei glanced at Zenkichi helplessly.
She had battled Zenkichi's clone and lost badly, embarrassed as Mizukage.
Zenkichi defeated her effortlessly.
"Should I say he is worthy of unifying the ninja world?" she thought.
"Is there any way to capture Utakata?"
"If it were you, you'd do it easily, right?"
Terumi Mei looked at Zenkichi expectantly.
Zenkichi half-smiled, "Of course I can bring Utakata back. But what about Kirigakure?"
"My absence is enough time for the Akatsuki to destroy the village."
"If you ask me, let Utakata be. I want to see what the Akatsuki's ultimate weapon looks like."
Zenkichi had no attachment to Utakata , dead or alive.
But if the Akatsuki resurrect the Ten-Tails, that would be significant.
Without a Six Paths-level powerhouse to unlock the Aizen template, it's impossible.
Utakata, fleeing Kirigakure, encountered Akatsuki members at the Water Country border.
Kakuzu, Hidan, and Sasori — the near-immortal trio — waited.

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - 111: Sealing the tail beasts.
chapters.content:
At this moment, Kakuzu, Hidan, and Sasori all had strange expressions on their faces. Despite being members of the Akatsuki, getting along was never their strong suit.
Although they wore the same cloaks and shared the same goals, none of them were particularly easy to cooperate with.
Take Kakuzu for instance—he had already killed three or four of his own teammates.
So, when the trio met, they'd already "greeted" each other in their usual fashion.
The result? A stalemate. None of them could kill the others.
Kakuzu had five hearts—five lives. Neither Hidan nor Sasori could finish him off.
Hidan, a devout follower of Jashin, was immortal.
Sasori was even more troublesome. If his puppet body was damaged, he could replace it.
None of them were truly immortal, but none could be taken down easily either.
"Hey! Who's taking care of this Jinchūriki?" Sasori asked in his dry, hoarse voice, staring at Utakata.
"Leave him to me!" Hidan replied, brandishing his bloodstained scythe with a fanatical grin.
"A Jinchūriki—I must dedicate him to Lord Jashin!"
Kakuzu grunted. "Enough chatter, let's get this over with. Time is money!"
Utakata had already realized who he was facing—the black cloaks with red clouds made it obvious. Akatsuki.
He said nothing, simply retrieved a small horn from his robe and blew it sharply.
Utakata's Bubble Ninjutsu was unique. He fought using chakra-infused bubbles.
These weren't ordinary bubbles. Some trapped enemies, cutting off their chakra flow entirely.
Suddenly, Hidan's scythe sliced across Utakata's skin. Blood dripped down the blade as it returned to Hidan's hand.
He licked it.
This was Utakata's first encounter with this kind of ritualistic combat. He had been caught off guard, his skin torn by the curved edge of the scythe.
Hidan moved swiftly, each motion designed to draw blood with practiced efficiency. He spun the scythe, letting the rope whip it back and forth toward his prey.
But just then, a storm of senbon needles came flying through the air, shattering the chakra bubbles before they could land.
Without hesitation, Sasori had activated his hidden puppet mechanisms.
Still, this wasn't an easy fight.
Utakata's bubbles could expand and trap enemies within, crushing them as they popped.
"The ritual begins!" Hidan shouted, his body turning black and white in a ritual pattern. He drew a symbol on the ground using his own blood.
A sharp spear pierced his chest.
At that exact moment, Utakata screamed and collapsed, clutching his heart.
"Lord Jashin! Do you see my offering?!" Hidan howled like a lunatic—until Kakuzu kicked him out of the ritual circle.
Furious at the interruption, Hidan raised his scythe, ready to fight Kakuzu then and there.
Kakuzu scowled. "Who told you to strike his heart? He needs to stay alive until we extract the tailed beast."
Sasori muttered, "Let's go. Inform Pain to begin the sealing."
The three took Utakata's weakened body and moved to a nearby uninhabited island.
There, Kakuzu used Earth Release to construct a temporary underground palace. They carried the half-dead Jinchūriki inside.
Sealing a tailed beast required time—and total silence from outsiders.
Elsewhere, Pain's Deva Path stood atop a high peak, overseeing the planned assault on Kumogakure.
The Hidden Village was already under pressure; both the Two-Tails and Eight-Tails had been captured.
Inside the carved-out mountain, Nagato and Konan had established a temporary base of operations.
Once inside the palace, Kakuzu activated his Akatsuki ring, contacting Deva Path Pain.
"Did Kakuzu, Uchiha Itachi, and Kisame Hoshigaki all succeed?" Nagato asked, channeling his voice through Deva Path.
The holograms of Akatsuki members materialized atop the fingers of the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path.
Deva Path Pain said, "You all completed your missions?"
Uchiha Itachi replied coldly, "The Three-Tails is under my Mangekyō Sharingan control. We're within a secure mountain range."
Kisame grinned. "Rōshi is with me. Samehada drained all the chakra from him—and from the Four-Tails too."
Kakuzu added, "We've secured the Six-Tails' Jinchūriki, but he's barely alive. That idiot Hidan stabbed him in the vitals."
"What did you say, Kakuzu, you bastard?!" Hidan shouted. "That was a sacred sacrifice to Lord Jashin!"
Pain ignored the outburst. "Very well, let's begin the sealing. Itachi, Kisame—your Jinchūriki can wait in the back row, yes?"
Itachi nodded. "The Three-Tails won't wake for at least a month. My illusion is absolute."
Kisame smirked. "Samehada is keeping Rōshi nice and drained. No problem here."
"Good," Pain said. "Let's start."
Though the optimal order was from One-Tail to Nine-Tails, the Akatsuki didn't follow it strictly.
The Five-Tails and Seven-Tails had already been sealed before Shukaku.
This disorder made the process harder—but their power made up for it.
Pain's projection appeared next to Kakuzu via the Akatsuki ring. He summoned the Gedo Statue, and the others appeared on its fingers.
The members pooled their chakra, activating the statue.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Nine dragons made of chakra erupted from its mouth, spiraling through the air.
They roared forward, impaling Utakata.
The unconscious Jinchūriki screamed as red Six-Tails chakra flooded out of him and into the Gedo Statue.
The sealing lasted three days and nights.
"Take a break. Two more tailed beasts remain," Pain said stoically.
Behind the scenes, Nagato exhaled deeply, his thin body trembling.
He was emaciated—barely holding on.
"The invasion will have to wait… at least another two weeks," he thought.
The sealing took too long, and Nagato's condition was worsening. He needed help.
If only Madara Uchiha would take over… sealing tailed beasts would be effortless.
With the power of the Gedo Statue, it was like leashing monsters with chakra chains.
