chapters.title: Chapter 112 - 112: Orochimaru's New Goal.
chapters.content:
Thanks to the efforts of everyone in the Akatsuki organization, the Three-Tails, Four-Tails, and Six-Tails were successfully sealed into the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path.
After completing these tasks, Pain (Tendo) issued the next command, his face devoid of emotion.
"Next, we gather outside Kumogakure."
"Our mission is to capture the Two-Tails and the Eight-Tails possessed by Kumogakure."
Inside a cave, Uchiha Itachi and Deidara, who had been meditating cross-legged, both opened their eyes. They had been resting in a nearby town, preparing to move toward Kumogakure to participate in the upcoming battle.
Just as they were about to set off, a figure emerged beside Uchiha Itachi—it was White Zetsu.
With a smirk, White Zetsu said, "Your brother, Uchiha Sasuke, has killed Orochimaru. He's formed his own team—and is searching the world for you."Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on
Itachi's expression shifted slightly. He responded in a calm tone, "Tell the leader I have personal matters to attend to."
White Zetsu added, "Should I inform your brother of the time and place for your final battle?"
Itachi gave a small nod. "Yes. Tell him I'll be waiting at the Uchiha Clan's ancestral grounds."
Zetsu's body dissolved into the earth. "Understood."
Deidara, clearly irritated, scowled. "You're really going to fight your brother? What a waste. Try not to die."
"When you come back, I'll show you my art. It surpasses even the Mangekyō Sharingan."
"Hmph."
Itachi allowed a faint smile to touch his lips. "Is that so? I look forward to it."
Without another word, he turned and began his journey to the Uchiha ancestral land.
---
In a forest…
As Sasuke moved swiftly through the trees, his expression hardened. A white figure appeared atop a large branch before him.
"Uchiha Sasuke, I was sent by your brother," said White Zetsu.
"He asked me to tell you—he'll be waiting at the ancestral grounds of the Uchiha clan."
With a smile, Zetsu vanished into the tree trunk just in time to evade Sasuke's sword strike.
"Itachi…"
Sasuke's eyes burned with murderous intent. He clenched his teeth.
"Sasuke…" Suigetsu, Jugo, and Karin looked on with concern.
"I'm fine. Just… excited."
"The thought of finally killing him makes me tremble with anticipation."
With determination in his gaze, Sasuke surged forward, racing toward the Uchiha ancestral land.
Once Sasuke and his team were gone, Black Zetsu and Uchiha Obito emerged from the shadows of a nearby tree.
"Why are you allowing this?" Black Zetsu asked, visibly puzzled.
Obito sneered. "Uchiha Itachi isn't truly a traitor. He's Konoha's mole, placed inside Akatsuki."
"One of his conditions was that Akatsuki never move against Konoha."
"But after we conquer Kumogakure, the next target will inevitably be Konoha—for the Nine-Tails."
"This clash between brothers is unavoidable. And Itachi will die at Sasuke's hand."
"Itachi loved Sasuke more than anything. He destroyed the entire Uchiha Clan to save his younger brother's life."
"Their battle will be glorious—but the outcome is certain. Itachi will die."
"Then Sasuke will take his eyes, awakening the Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan."
"When the time comes, I'll tell Sasuke the truth about Itachi."
"I know him. He'll reject Itachi's ideals."
"There's a 90% chance he'll seek vengeance against Konoha. Then he'll join us."
"With his Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan, he'll be an invaluable asset in our plan to take the Nine-Tails."
Black Zetsu looked regretful. "But that means Itachi won't be part of the assault on Kumogakure. He's a critical asset—he has the Mangekyō Sharingan."
Obito shrugged. "It's just Kumogakure. Nagato and the others can handle it."
Black Zetsu chuckled. "Nagato's condition is worsening. He may not last much longer."
Obito smirked. "Then his mission is almost complete anyway."
---
Outside the Uchiha ancestral land, Orochimaru (No. 1) stood atop a tree, peering into the distance through a telescope.
The man who revered science dismissed the Hyūga's Byakugan as superstition—he believed in telescopic optics.
From his vantage point, he watched the fierce battle between Itachi and Sasuke unfold atop a crumbling structure. Their fire-style jutsu scorched the nearby forest, turning it into an inferno.
Eventually, Sasuke summoned his most powerful Lightning Release—Kirin—but Itachi shielded himself using Susanoo.
Exhausted, Sasuke's chakra collapsed, allowing the cursed remnants of Orochimaru (No. 2) to re-emerge within him. The second Orochimaru attempted to take control of Sasuke's body, only to be sealed away by Itachi's Totsuka Blade.
"So, it failed," Orochimaru No. 1 murmured with a sigh.
"Is there something wrong with me in this world?"
"My obsession with the Third Hokage led to the sealing of my arms…"
"My obsession with the Sharingan led to complete defeat…"
"Maybe I should take this as a lesson—not to follow the same path."
Setting aside his telescope, he turned to leave. He had sensed the chakra of others nearby, and it unsettled him. His obsession with the Sharingan had waned. Now, he had no reason to stay.
His true goal was to free Orochimaru No. 2 and retrieve his research data.
"In my world, the Rinnegan belonged to Uchiha Madara."
"Nagato was just its temporary holder."
"But in this world, things have yet to be revealed."
"If I can obtain the perfected Edo Tensei and summon Uchiha Madara…"
Orochimaru's eyes gleamed with fascination.
"I wonder if I could defeat Arakawa Zenkichi using the perfected Reanimation Jutsu."
"Compared to the Sharingan, Zenkichi's abilities interest me more. They're beyond even the Mangekyō Sharingan and Wood Release."
He muttered with a trace of obsession—his deepest desire now was Zenkichi's body.
Wasting no time, Orochimaru found one of his vessels. Using a cursed seal embedded in the subject, he released Orochimaru No. 2.
__

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 113: Akatsuki launches an attack.
chapters.content:
Orochimaru No. 1 tracked down a subordinate of Orochimaru No. 2, as the latter had implanted a cursed seal in the subordinate's body.
The cursed seal began to swell unnaturally, and moments later, a white snake burst forth from the distorted flesh. The snake opened its mouth, spitting out a soaked, weak Orochimaru No. 2.
Staring at Orochimaru No. 1 with a complex, melancholic expression, Orochimaru No. 2 muttered, "Looks like I failed."
"I've completed what you asked me to do," Orochimaru No. 1 replied flatly. "Now it's time for you to uphold your end of the deal."
Without further words, Orochimaru No. 2 handed over the long-sought research—an advanced version of the Edo Tensei technique.
"A fully perfected Reanimation Jutsu... finally," Orochimaru No. 1 whispered with a faint smirk, his eyes gleaming as he clutched the scroll.
"Next... are you planning to undo your hand seals?" he asked, glancing toward the weakened No. 2. "Want me to come along?"
"There's no need," Orochimaru No. 2 shook his head calmly. "I've got this."
---
Inside the Raikage's Office – Kumogakure
The Eight-Tails' jinchūriki, Killer Bee, and the Two-Tails' jinchūriki, Yugito Nii, were both staying in the Raikage's office for protection. Killer Bee, rapping in his usual rhythm, voiced his frustration.
"Bro, why we hidin'? Let's throw some fists and keep slidin'! This place ain't the Bee's style, y'know what I'm sayin'?"
They'd been living and eating inside the Raikage Building ever since news spread that the Akatsuki was hunting jinchūriki.
"I say we fight back," Bee continued. "Let's show 'em what Bee can do. Runnin' ain't gonna solve nothin'. Time to throw hands!"
Mabui nodded, her expression cold. "I agree. It's better to deal with the Akatsuki directly."
The Fourth Raikage scowled. "You think I don't want to? The problem is, we don't know where they are."
"If they dare come to Kumogakure, I'll crush them myself."
His assistant warned him, "Raikage sama, please don't underestimate the enemy. Even Sunagakure was directly attacked."
"Hmph, Sunagakure?" the Raikage scoffed. "That village has fallen far. They let someone kidnap the Kazekage—pathetic."
"And they let a child become the Fifth Kazekage. That village's decline is obvious."
"Chiyo and Ebizō may be respected, but they're relics of the past. Their strength has long faded."
"Kumogakure is now the most powerful of the Five Great Nations. Even Konoha can't compare."
"The way Sarutobi Hiruzen handled things left that village weak. I heard their Nine-Tails jinchūriki was captured... wonder if they've recovered him."
"But if they've given up on rescuing the Nine-Tails, it could benefit us."
"If we destroy the Akatsuki, we'll take the Nine-Tails and keep it in Kumogakure."
The Fourth Raikage boasted, unaware that elite members of the Akatsuki had already assembled outside the village.
Pain (Tendō), Konan, Kisame Hoshigaki, Deidara, Hidan, Kakuzu, and the Red Sand Scorpion had arrived—an overwhelming force even the Five Kage would struggle to match.
Tendō Pain stood at the front of the group, eyes cold. "Our target is the Two-Tails and the Eight-Tails of Kumogakure. Begin the operation."
Beast Path Pain formed a seal and summoned a massive, monstrous bird.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the
Konan spread wings made of paper and took flight alongside the other Paths of Pain, flying toward the village aboard the summoned creature.
Deidara pulled a clay bird from his pack. Tossing it in the air, it grew into a large rideable bird made of white explosive clay.
"Scorpion, come on!" Deidara called. But the Red Sand Scorpion shook his head.
"I can't fight in the air. I'll head in on the ground," Scorpion said coldly.
"I want to get up close anyway," Hidan chimed in, slinging his bloody triple-bladed scythe over his shoulder. "Can't offer sacrifices from the air."
"I want to stop by the treasury," Kakuzu added darkly. "Kumogakure might have valuables worth collecting."
Deidara pouted. "Geez, no one appreciates art..."
At that moment, Kisame stepped forward. "Deidara, mind if I join you?"
Deidara lit up. "Kisame senpai, you get it, don't you? You understand true art!"
He excitedly welcomed Kisame aboard the clay bird. With Samehada slung over his back, Kisame climbed up.
They flew forward as Deidara grinned. "You know what art is, Kisame san? It's...an explosion!"
Meanwhile, Deidara scattered small clay birds across Kumogakure. Each bird exploded with massive force upon impact, damaging buildings and sending Kumogakure ninja flying.
At the same time, summoned beasts with the Rinnegan eyes tore through the village. Giant white raptors swooped down on buildings, causing chaos. It was the Animal Path's strategy to split enemy forces and eliminate lower-ranked ninja.
Inside the Raikage's office, an explosion shook the room. Screams and distant crashes filled the air.
The Fourth Raikage's eyes widened in rage. Blue lightning crackled violently around him as he stormed out without hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 114: Kumogakure's Resistance.
chapters.content:
As soon as the Fourth Raikage stepped out, he saw the Rinnegan-summoned beasts rampaging through the Hidden Cloud Village.
Massive white birds flew swiftly above Kumogakure, launching suicide attacks on the village's ninja forces.
Furious, the Fourth Raikage's sharp gaze locked onto the members of the Akatsuki Organization.
Hovering in the sky was a colossal summoning beast with the Rinnegan. Six Paths Pain stood atop it, motionless.
Beside it, Konan floated gracefully, her wings formed from white paper sheets.
Compared to the calm presence of Konan, Deidara looked wild and manic. Standing on a giant white clay bird, he gleefully hurled bombs into the village below.
"Bastard!" the Fourth Raikage growled, his eyes burning with fury. Electric blue chakra danced violently over his body, intensifying by the second.
Just as the Raikage spotted them, Tendō Pain noticed him too. Three of the Six Paths Pain descended to confront the incoming threat. Tendō Pain spoke in a cold, mechanical tone.
"Fourth Raikage, hand over the Two-Tails and Eight-Tails Jinchūriki."
"Hmph! Don't get cocky, Akatsuki," the Raikage snapped back, filled with disdain. "This is Kumogakure, not some weak village like Sunagakure."
"You want the Tailed Beasts from our Hidden Cloud? Come and take them—if you're willing to die trying!"
Crackling with power, the Raikage surged forward in a bolt of lightning, punching directly at Tendō Pain with immense force.
Under the Lightning Release Chakra Mode, the Raikage's speed and defense were enhanced dramatically, turning his strikes into weapons of terrifying destruction. A casual blow could rival high-level jutsu.
"Shinra Tensei."
With a blank stare, Tendō Pain activated his repulsive force just as the Raikage closed in.
A thunderous impact followed as the opposing energies collided. The Raikage was ultimately thrown back—his strength unable to fully counter the Rinnegan's repulsion.
"Raikage-sama!"
"Brother!"
From behind, Killer Bee, the Eight-Tails Jinchūriki, and Yugito Nii, the Two-Tails Jinchūriki, appeared, stepping in to support the Raikage.
"Well, well..." Tendō Pain said in his usual flat tone. "So you two plan to resist. Are you surrendering peacefully, or do I have to subdue you?"
"Over my dead body," Yugito hissed. "I'm Yugito Nii of Kumogakure, and I'll stop you here!"
A red chakra shroud exploded from her body. In the blink of an eye, she fully transformed into the Two-Tails—Matatabi, a flaming blue feline.
Matatabi launched a massive fireball toward the enemy. Preta Path Pain jumped in front and extended his hands to absorb the fiery chakra attack.
"So, absorbing chakra is your ability?"
"The Sand Village provided us with all the intel we need. Ironically, their grudge with you is now helping us."
The Fourth Raikage's voice boomed as he struck. His blue-lightning-covered fist crashed down on the distracted Hungry Ghost Path.
Just then, Asura Path stepped forward, transforming his body into weaponized metal to shield Preta Path. The Raikage's punch detonated Asura Path's mechanical body.
"You fool! Your real enemy is Killer Bee!"
With his signature rap, Bee slashed Preta Path across the neck with his chakra-infused blade.
Though the chakra was absorbed, the physical strike was lethal. Hungry Ghost Path collapsed, decapitated.
Immediately, Tendō Pain countered with another Shinra Tensei, sending Bee flying.
"Eight-yo!"
Bee called out mentally to his Tailed Beast. Red chakra surged, wrapping around him to protect against the force of the attack.
Despite being blown back, both Bee and the Raikage recovered quickly, protected by their respective chakra cloaks.
"Those summons with the Rinnegan can share their vision," Raikage said, gritting his teeth. "That's a real problem."
"Still," he smirked, "we've taken out two of them. Four left. Not bad."
Just then, Animal Path Pain summoned two previously destroyed Paths. Naraka Path Pain emerged, calling forth the King of Hell.
The massive spectral head devoured the broken Pain bodies, chewed, and spat them out—fully restored.
Watching his defeated enemies return completely intact, even the Fourth Raikage's confident face darkened.
"What kind of monster is this guy…?" he muttered.
Still in her Tailed Beast form, Yugito growled, "Even with the Rinnegan, they're not invincible."
"No dojutsu can function without chakra. Bee and I both have massive reserves."
"Damn right!" the Raikage shouted. "Yugito's right—we're the ones who will win this battle."
"Conserve chakra. If we can't overwhelm them, we'll grind them down."
If it came down to stamina, the Raikage wasn't worried.
After all, his father—the Third Raikage—had fought 10,000 shinobi alone for three days and nights before collapsing.
Though not quite at his father's level, the Fourth Raikage could still fight for days.
He refused to believe this enemy could outlast him.
While the Raikage, Bee, and Yugito clashed with Six Paths Pain, battles raged across other parts of Kumogakure.
Kumo's ninja, led by their jōnin, fought desperately against the Akatsuki's elite: Kakuzu, Hidan, Sasori of the Red Sand, Deidara, and Kisame Hoshigaki had already entered the fray.

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 115: Naraka Path.
chapters.content:
Konohagakure.
Zenkichi was in the middle of a conversation with Tsunade when his expression suddenly shifted. A playful smile crept onto his face.
"What's with that look?" Tsunade asked, eyeing him curiously. She could tell something was off.
"Want to see an old teammate again?" Zenkichi said casually, his smile widening.
"Someone who's both your former comrade… and your master's killer."
Tsunade's eyes narrowed. "You're talking about Orochimaru?"
Zenkichi nodded. "He's returned to the village."Follow current novels on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Tsunade's expression immediately darkened, her tone turning cold. "He came back to Konohagakure? Why?"
"I sensed him," Zenkichi said calmly. "My perception abilities picked him up. He's in the outskirts — at the Uzumaki Clan's Namien Hall."
Tsunade stiffened. She knew what was kept there.
Zenkichi turned his gaze out the Hokage Office window, looking toward the hall where masks of the Uzumaki Clan were stored — among them, the Mask of the Reaper. He knew Orochimaru had come to undo the seal binding his arms.
"That bastard," Tsunade muttered. "What's he planning this time? Is he still after Konoha's destruction?"
Without waiting for an answer, she stood and ordered her ANBU to gather the village's elite: Jiraiya, Kakashi, Might Guy, and the others.
---
Uzumaki Clan's Namien Hall.
Orochimaru donned the Mask of the Reaper, summoning the shadow of the Shinigami itself.
In a grotesque ritual, he cut open his own stomach, offering himself as a sacrifice. From within the Reaper's belly, he released his sealed soul.
As the ritual ended, Orochimaru shed his outer skin, revealing his true form — the White Phosphorus Orochi. Slithering forward, he lunged toward a nearby White Zetsu.
Orochimaru had long since uncovered White Zetsu's secret, and he coveted that body — a vessel perfect for his pursuit of immortality. Still, he had delayed claiming it, not because he couldn't, but because he had greater priorities. The Sharingan was a rarer prize. Zetsu could be taken anytime — the Uchiha, not so much.
Now, he intended to take what was his.
---
"Orochimaru!"
Jiraiya's voice rang out as he arrived on the scene, witnessing White Zetsu's body mid-transformation.
"Well, if it isn't Jiraiya," Orochimaru replied smoothly. "What a nostalgic reunion."
Tsunade arrived behind Jiraiya, her expression hardened. "Why are you here, Orochimaru?"
"As Fifth Hokage of Konohagakure, I won't allow you to endanger the village again."
Orochimaru held up his hands in mock surrender. "No need to worry. I don't have hostile intentions… not this time."
"I'll disappear if that's what you want. Frankly, I didn't come back here willingly."
His calm, measured tone only fueled Tsunade's distrust.
"Are you the Orochimaru of this world?" Zenkichi asked as he stepped forward, his tone unreadable. "Then why come here? Why not complete your ritual elsewhere?"
The second Orochimaru — the newly formed one — responded cautiously, "I am indeed the Orochimaru of this world. And you… you must be Arakawa Zenkichi, from another world."
"I've heard the rumors. They say you unified an entire shinobi world. Is that true?"
"If you're so powerful, why not bring peace here too?"
Zenkichi withdrew the Mirrored Flowers and Water Moon from within his cloak, shaking his head. "Not your concern. Just step aside."
Orochimaru's lips curled into a snake-like smile. His tongue flicked out as he whispered, "I've heard about your strength. I've always been curious to see it up close."
Without warning, over a dozen venomous snakes erupted from Orochimaru's body, lunging toward Zenkichi with their fangs bared.
"Bakudō #81 — Dankū."
A shimmering barrier instantly appeared before Zenkichi, halting the serpents mid-air. They crashed against the wall and fell, dazed and confused.
In the blink of an eye, Zenkichi vanished — reappearing behind Orochimaru.
A flash of steel.
He drove his blade through Orochimaru's torso without hesitation.
"Ugh…"
Orochimaru staggered, eyes wide with shock. His modified body and strange substitution techniques usually protected him — but this pain was different.
This strike bypassed all his safeguards. The wound tore at his very soul.
"Move again," Zenkichi warned coolly, "and I'll sever your soul completely."
He turned to Tsunade, gesturing toward the immobilized Orochimaru. "Consider this a gift."
"Konoha's traitor. The man who killed the Third Hokage. Your former teammate."
"Seems fitting, doesn't it?"
Tsunade remained silent for a long moment, then gave a complicated nod. She signaled her ANBU to suppress Orochimaru's chakra and take him into custody.
---
Meanwhile — Kumogakure.
The battle had reached its conclusion.
Hidan's immortality and curse technique were terrifying on paper. But in large-scale combat, they were laughably inefficient.
He was torn apart — literally — by enemy forces. Though still technically alive, his body was shredded into so many pieces that not even the most skilled puzzle master could put him back together. Much of his body had been turned to dust.
Sasori fared even worse. His most prized puppets were shattered, and his core — the very essence of his being — was destroyed.
Their over-specialized abilities had made them easy to counter. They had been out-planned and out-fought.
Unlike Sunagakure, which had been caught off-guard, Kumogakure was prepared. There were no traitors within its ranks, and they had long since studied Sasori's abilities and crafted counter-strategies.
Even his Third Kazekage human puppet couldn't save him.
Kakuzu, with his years of experience and overwhelming arsenal, managed to survive. His wealth of jutsu and adaptability saw him through.
Kisame's Water Release and Deidara's explosives were at a disadvantage against Kumogakure's Lightning Release, but both managed to retreat with minimal losses thanks to their instincts and teamwork.
Still, the cost to Kumogakure was high. The battle had pushed both sides to their limits.
---
Elsewhere on the battlefield, the Fourth Raikage and his team faced the true terror — the Six Paths of Pain.
Despite his strength, the Raikage was defeated. The Naraka Path absorbed the chakra of the Two-Tails and Eight-Tails, rendering their jinchūriki too weak to continue.
The Raikage, frustrated and unwilling to accept defeat, could only grit his teeth.
But the outcome was inevitable.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 116: Edo Tensei.
chapters.content:
"Let's get out of here."
Tendo Pain's voice was emotionless as he assessed the battlefield and the losses they had sustained. Two of Akatsuki's core members — Hidan and Sasori of the Red Sand — were gone. But despite the sacrifice, they had acquired two tailed beasts. The price, he concluded, was acceptable.
Hidan's body had been destroyed beyond recognition. With his fragmented remains reduced to dust, Pain saw no point in recovering him. His curse technique, while odd, had limitations — mainly its range, and the dependency on a prepared ritual circle. A simple Earth Release jutsu could bury him alive, and a Water Release jutsu could wash away his circle. In the end, Hidan was disposable.
The Gedo Statue had now absorbed both the Two-Tails and the Eight-Tails, opening eight of its nine eyes. Only one remained.
"We head for Konohagakure next?" Kisame asked with a toothy grin, his Samehada resting against his shoulder.
---
Somewhere deep underground...
While the Akatsuki began the sealing ritual, Uchiha Obito met with Uchiha Sasuke in a shadowy cavern.
Sasuke, now aware of the truth behind the Uchiha Clan massacre, trembled with rage. His eyes flared red, the Mangekyō Sharingan activated in an instant.
"Unforgivable…" he growled. "Konoha must fall."
Dark chakra swirled around him, the weight of his hatred pressing down on the very air in the cavern.
Unlike the events of the original timeline, Sasuke now accepted Obito's offer without resistance. He agreed to transplant Uchiha Itachi's eyes, abandoning any delusions of mercy or reconciliation.
What changed his mind? The power of Pain.
The man had annihilated Sunagakure, one of the Five Great Nations, captured the Fifth Kazekage in plain sight, and extracted the One-Tail without resistance.
That kind of overwhelming strength made Sasuke realize — power was everything.
---
In a hidden base…
Orochimaru, sat alone, toying with the Impure World Reincarnation scroll. A twisted grin formed on his face.
"I wonder what will happen if I use this technique with life data from another world."
He activated the technique using genetic material from Uchiha Madara — though from a parallel world. The sacrifice he chose was weak by design. He didn't want Madara to return with his full power. After all, a poor-quality vessel weakened the resurrected shinobi significantly.
Moments later, Edo Tensei Madara emerged from the smoke — an aged man with long, silver-streaked hair and eyes filled with confusion.
"It worked," Orochimaru whispered, marveling at his creation. "But which version of Madara did I summon?"
He pressed his fingers together in a one-handed seal, snapping Madara fully into consciousness.
The revived Uchiha slowly opened his eyes, scanning his surroundings with wariness.
"Who are you? Where am I? Why was I brought here?"
He fired off his questions in a commanding tone, his voice firm despite his disorientation.
Orochimaru remained calm. "Enough with the trivial questions. I'll ask you this — do you know someone named Zenkichi?"
Madara's expression darkened. "Do you know who you're speaking to?"
Despite being bound by the reincarnation jutsu, Madara's pride was intact. He quickly recognized the technique — Impure World Reincarnation, the forbidden art developed by Tobirama Senju, whom he despised.
Without hesitation, Orochimaru formed another series of hand signs and used genjutsu to suppress Madara's will.
"You're too weak in your current state. Resistance is pointless," he sneered. "Now, tell me. Which world are you from?"
Trapped within the illusion, Madara divulged everything. He had never heard of Zenkichi, and explained his old plan — uniting Yin and Yang, absorbing the Ten-Tails, becoming like the Sage of Six Paths.
"So that's how you awakened the Rinnegan… by transplanting Hashirama's cells," Orochimaru mused, eyes gleaming.
He had long believed the Rinnegan was the natural evolution of the Sharingan. This revelation both fascinated and frustrated him.
"Still, your plan has more holes than a sieve," he scoffed. "You think absorbing the Ten-Tails guarantees godhood? You underestimate Obito and Nagato."
Orochimaru paused, pondering the implications. "No matter. Your dream of the Infinite Tsukuyomi bores me, but the power of the Sage… now that's worth pursuing."
He released the jutsu sealing Madara and immediately prepared a second round of resurrections.
This time, he didn't hold back.
He used multiple White Zetsu as sacrifices and summoned Senju Hashirama and others at full strength. To prevent them from breaking free, he stabbed each with specially prepared kunai designed to suppress their will — reducing them to nothing more than obedient puppets.
Though he respected their power, he feared their autonomy more.
Satisfied with their condition, Orochimaru turned his attention back to Madara.
"I won't settle for an old relic," he muttered. "Time to summon you in your prime."
Unlike his previous resurrection, this version of Madara was adjusted — rejuvenated physically, imbued with Hashirama cells, and granted the Rinnegan.
Just like Kabuto's enhanced Edo Madara in the original timeline, this Madara was a nightmare brought to life.
"I've heard Akatsuki is almost done collecting the Tailed Beasts," Orochimaru said with a wicked grin. "They've done all the hard work…"
"…and I'll be the one to reap the rewards."
---

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 117: Killing Kisame
chapters.content:
"Kumogakure Village… really was destroyed."
A shadow clone of Zenkichi walked across the ruins of Kumogakure, his gaze lingering on the devastation around him with a trace of emotion.
"Who… are you? Help me…"
A weak voice reached his ears.
Zenkichi turned and spotted Hidan, staring at him longingly.
At this point, Hidan had only his head left, yet he clung to life stubbornly.
"Hidan… the one who can't die."
Zenkichi paused in thought, then turned his palm over and drew Kyōka Suigetsu, slashing down at Hidan with the blade.
"You want to attack me too? I'm immortal! Long live Jashin-sama!"
Hidan sneered, laughing maniacally.
Zenkichi's expression remained stoic as he brought Kyōka Suigetsu down, severing Hidan's connection to the world by erasing his soul.
Though his body was immortal, his soul was not.
With a single strike, Hidan's soul was wiped away—he was completely and permanently dead.
"Hm, my level went up again. At least I gained something."
Zenkichi nodded casually as the clone dissipated in a puff of white smoke.
---
Konoha Village — Hokage's Office
In the Hokage's office, Zenkichi, drinking tea and reading papers, suddenly furrowed his brows and looked out the window.
Tsunade, seated nearby reviewing documents, looked up with concern. "The Akatsuki… are here?"
After hearing that Kumogakure had fallen to Akatsuki, Tsunade's heart grew heavy.
Their actions made it clear—they were determined to capture all the tailed beasts.
And now, with the Two-Tails and Eight-Tails in their possession, it was only a matter of time before they came for the Nine-Tails.
"The Akatsuki have arrived," Zenkichi said calmly.
"Should I handle them directly, or do you want to go through the formalities first?"ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ
"This is Konoha. It's our duty as its ninja to defend it."
"We'll protect it… at least until we can't."
Tsunade's tone turned solemn.
"And if you can't hold the line?" Zenkichi asked, smiling faintly.
"Then I'll ask for your help."
Zenkichi walked closer, his tone suddenly cool. "But you're not the Tsunade who's close to me in my world… so why should I help you?"
Tsunade's eyes widened. Her chest rose and fell with emotion, clearly upset by his words.
Zenkichi stepped forward with a smile and suddenly pressed his lips to hers. After a moment, they separated.
Tsunade's face turned red. She stared at him, flustered and uncertain.
"If this face of yours were to fall into another man's arms… I'd be pretty upset," Zenkichi said, gently holding her chin with a half-smile.
BOOM!
An explosion rocked the village—the Akatsuki's assault had begun.
From the sky, Deidara flew in atop a giant white clay bird, dropping explosive clay bombs onto Konoha's buildings.
Alarms blared. Konoha's defenses mobilized quickly.
Unlike Kumogakure, Konoha had air defense systems.
Sai unrolled a scroll and summoned an ink eagle using his Super Beast Imitating Drawing. He mounted the creature and flew straight at Deidara.
Below, the Nara clan used their Shadow Imitation Techniques to trap the massive clay bird's shadow, stopping its flight.
"Hmm?" Deidara frowned mid-bombing run. The bird beneath him suddenly wouldn't respond.
As Sai closed in, Deidara calmly jumped into the air, pulling out another clay bird from his bag.
But the Nara clan had anticipated that. The moment Deidara's shadow shifted from the first bird, they launched another Shadow Possession Technique—paralyzing him mid-air.
He began to plummet.
"Deidara?" Zenkichi observed from afar. "Another artist wannabe…"
In an instant, he fired a laser beam at Deidara's falling body.
Before Deidara could even perform his final art, his head was cleanly taken off.
Zenkichi's body dissolved into glowing particles and reappeared moments later in the heart of Konoha.
There, Kisame Hoshigaki was using Water Release techniques to overwhelm Konoha defenders.
As he was preparing to shift the battlefield, Zenkichi's particles coalesced into form before him.
"So you're Zenkichi… the one from another world, right? I've heard of you."
Kisame's expression was flat, his dead-fish eyes studying Zenkichi closely.
"No need to be tense. In the other world, you were my disciple. Even Samehada was a gift from me."
"That was another world," Kisame replied coolly. "If you came to recruit me, don't bother."
"Is that so? That's unfortunate."
Kyōka Suigetsu materialized in Zenkichi's hands.
"In that case, I'll send you to death myself."
"You don't think I came to recruit you because you're important, do you?"
"Don't be foolish. Your strength is beneath me."
Zenkichi appeared beside Kisame in a blur and slashed down with Kyōka Suigetsu.
Samehada, attempting to protect its master, was cleaved in half.
Kisame followed suit—cut down in a single stroke.
"One sword for one soul… such sincerity," Zenkichi said nonchalantly.
He turned his attention inward—his character template flickered before him.
Having killed Hidan, Kisame, and destroyed Samehada, his Aizen template had now unlocked to 60%.
"Next… Nagato."
Zenkichi's gaze turned toward the distance, where Pain's Six Paths were locked in battle with Konoha's defenders.
This invasion was different from the original timeline.
The Hyuga clan hadn't left on their diplomatic mission. Might Guy was still in the village. Jiraiya had survived.
With information on the Six Paths, Konoha had the upper hand this time.
But it wasn't just Pain attacking—others were lurking in the shadows, waiting for their turn.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - 118: Give me the Rinnegan.
chapters.content:
After Deidara and Kisame were killed by Zenkichi, the only Akatsuki members left attacking Konoha were Pain, Konan, and Kakuzu.
Kakuzu was an incredibly formidable opponent. The fact that he had managed to escape from the hands of Senju Hashirama already explained much about his resilience.
His willingness to join forces with the enemy despite being unable to defeat Six Paths Pain showed his pragmatic nature.
Kakuzu did not rush into battle but quietly observed Pain's fight.
The Akatsuki's numbers were dwindling. It was clear this would be their final battle.
Kakuzu thought if Pain prevailed, it would be the right moment to strike and finish things himself.
If Pain faltered, Kakuzu wouldn't hesitate to add insult to injury, after all, he's only in it for the money.
Facing Six Paths Pain were Might Guy, Tsunade, and Jiraiya.
Jiraiya summoned two toads from Mt. Myoboku, speaking seriously, "You two buy me some time, I want to enter Sage Mode."
Tsunade and Might Guy nodded and launched their attack on Six Paths Pain.
As before, the three Paths who were not skilled in combat stayed on the flying beast with the Rinnegan eye, overseeing the battle and providing a tactical overview.
When Asura Path Pain moved, various modern weapons appeared on his body—a chainsaw emerged from behind him, rotating and emitting a terrifying hiss, turning him into a deadly hedgehog.
Rockets launched from his arms in quick succession as he targeted Jiraiya.
One tracking rocket struck Jiraiya, forcing him to retreat silently.
Jiraiya could only move in Sage Mode, which differed from others' modes.
He summoned two toads but couldn't condense natural energy like others.
Sixth Gate—Open!
Green flames flickered on Might Guy's body as he unleashed a flurry of punches. The fiery bombs struck the Hungry Ghost Path Pain.
Toward the Preta Path!
Might Guy's physical attacks countered the chakra-absorbing Preta Path, a strategy planned long ago.
Pain raised his hand to fire Shinra Tensei, condensing a powerful repulsive shield to block the flame bombs.
"There's a limit to rebound attacks,"
Might Guy sneered and suddenly appeared behind the Preta Path.
"My physical attacks have no limits!"
A powerful whirlwind struck from Konoha.
One kick landed, destroying the Preta Path instantly.
Might Guy immediately followed with a backhand punch to the Deva Path.
His speed and close combat skills were unmatched. Deva Path flew back with a single hit.
However, Deva Path was different—Nagato infused him with Yahiko's will, hoping peace could be fulfilled even after death.
Nagato's determination kept Deva Path standing despite repeated attacks.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Chakra Path!
Might Guy attacked again, releasing dense flames and air bombs at Deva Path, who dodged while cooling his ultimate technique.
At the critical moment, Shinra Tensei's countdown ended, releasing a violent repulsive force.
Might Guy's eyes blazed with fighting spirit as he roared, "This is youth!"
Seventh Gate—Open!
Blue flames engulfed Might Guy, his momentum violent as he blocked Shinra Tensei's repulsion.
"Tch!"
Tsunade watched in shock, amazed by Might Guy's physical prowess.
Though she knew the Eight Gates were powerful, this was her first time seeing such skill.
Might Guy formed hand seals, punching the air to create a tiger-shaped chakra construct that roared and struck Deva Path.
Boom!
Shinra Tensei couldn't save him this time. Instead, the Asura Path saved Deva Path as he was sent flying skyward.
"One more!"
Might Guy yelled, sending another tiger-shaped attack into the sky, destroying the flying beast and seriously wounding several Paths aboard.
"Not destroyed yet?"
Might Guy frowned as several Paths fell but survived.
His chakra dropped suddenly as he closed the Eight Gates.
"Good job, Guy!" Jiraiya's voice called as the two toads appeared on his shoulders, helping him complete Sage Mode.
"We know a lot about Pain now. Illusions based on sound will work best against him!"
Jiraiya sneered, holding an auditory illusion technique.
"I don't know what's going on with you, but…"
"No matter what, I won't let you destroy Konoha!"
Jiraiya's eyes grew sad as he looked at Deva Path and Konan.
He had long suspected a connection between Akatsuki and his three former students but said nothing.
Since Deva Path attacked Konoha, there was no room for talk.
Deva Path had declared his will, and Jiraiya doubted his words could change their resolve.
So he acted decisively, knowing that in this battle, victory was the only way to speak.
Sage Art—Toad Song!
The two toads began an awkward duet. Their piercing croaks represented one of the strongest illusions in the ninja world.
Six Paths Pain was caught off guard and became immobilized, causing Nagato, controlling him from afar, to react.
"Six Paths Pain—the entire force wiped out?"
Nagato refused to accept his loss of power without Pain.
He had been hollowed out by outsiders, his legs disabled by fire release techniques.
"Nagato, shall we retreat?"
Konan asked with a serious face.
For some reason, her clone had also appeared nearby.
"No retreat necessary."
"Nagato, hand me the Rinnegan!"
A deep voice sounded as Uchiha Obito, masked, appeared before Nagato and Konan.
"Madara, what are your orders?"
Konan asked seriously.
"You said, give you the Rinnegan?"
Nagato frowned.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 119: Ten Tails Jinchūriki.
chapters.content:
Uchiha Obito spoke calmly, "That's right, return the Rinnegan to me. The Rinnegan belongs to me, and I entrusted it to you."
Konan stepped forward and said firmly, "Nonsense! The Rinnegan belongs to Nagato. It is a divine treasure given to the Land of Rain."
Obito's tone was cold and dismissive, "The Rinnegan is Nagato's? Stop joking. The Rinnegan is the eye of the Sage of Six Paths. Nagato is merely an Uzumaki orphan."
"What right does he have to wield these eyes? It was I who transplanted them."
"To upgrade them to their fullest potential, I placed them with Nagato."
"Nagato, thank you for being the vessel for my Rinnegan all these years, but now it's time to reclaim what's mine."
"You relied on the Rinnegan's power to declare yourself a god."
Obito's voice was cold as he moved towards Nagato.
Nagato's face twisted in anger, but he did not hesitate. He fired Shinra Tensei, yet Obito effortlessly dodged, moving like a blur.
"If the eyes belong to you, then what? Have you been deceiving me all along?" Nagato asked coldly.
"That's right," Obito said calmly. "You were under my control, a mere pawn."
"Yet your sacrifice was not in vain. Thanks to your efforts, the world will see true peace."ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Obito stared at Nagato with icy resolve and attacked again.
Evading Shinra Tensei, Obito reached out and grabbed one of Nagato's Rinnegan.
But at that moment, mechanical armor formed on Nagato's body. Asura manifested a sharp blade, piercing Obito's chest.
Blood spilled from Obito's mouth, but a proud smile remained on his face.
Nagato's eyes burned with hatred as he asked, "Why are you smiling?"
Obito did not reply; his form began to fade.
Izanagi.
Taking advantage of the moment, Obito seized one of Nagato's Rinnegan eyes and pulled it out.
Konan's face changed dramatically. She immediately dispelled her clone, and Nagato's body turned into smoke, vanishing.
Nagato reappeared in a large cave—Konan's true body nearby.
Her clone's intel had already informed her of the situation. Without hesitation, she used her sensory technique to summon Nagato.
This was a contingency she had prepared in case of Obito's interference.
Nagato covered his bleeding eye and smiled faintly, "I never expected my life to be arranged like this."
Konan looked worried, "Nagato, don't listen to his lies."
Nagato's tone was indifferent, "I'm fine. Even if Madara Uchiha controls me, he cannot change my desire for peace."
His focus shifted to the demonic creature before him—the Jinchūriki of the Tailed beasts,the Eight-Tails' chakra, and fragments of the Nine-Tails' power stored within.
"Though the Nine-Tails' chakra is limited, it should suffice."
Nagato murmured, forming hand seals to release his jutsu.
The demonic form roared and lunged at Nagato.
Its body spiraled, merging with Nagato's form.
He sought to become the Ten-Tails' Jinchūriki, wielding its power.
A powerful aura surged. His body lost its pale hue; two sharp horns grew from his head, and black Truth seeking orbs surrounded him.
His weakened body recovered fully, legs healed from previous fire damage.
"This vitality is intoxicating."
"Six Paths is nothing compared to this power."
Nagato marveled at his transformation.
Konan stared in shock.
"I am now the Ten-Tails' Jinchūriki, akin to the Sage of Six Paths."
"But unlike the Sage, I am still missing the full power of the Nine-Tails."
"Konan San, stay here and don't move."
"I will go to Konoha, capture the Nine-Tails, and use absolute power to enforce peace."
A cold determination flashed in Nagato's eyes as he leapt from the cave.
---
Nearby Konoha.
Nagato's location was close, and soon he returned.
Meanwhile, Konoha had sealed the Six Paths Pain and struggled to maintain order within the village.
Nagato, with white hair and a pair of Rinnegan eyes, approached with an indifferent gaze.
Tsunade's expression shifted suddenly, sensing the terrifying chakra surge.
Zenkichi smiled calmly, "The Six Paths Pain you defeated were just puppets. Now, their master has arrived."
Tsunade asked, confused, "What do you mean?"
Zenkichi said flatly, "Don't celebrate yet. A foe you cannot defeat has come."
---
Nagato frowned as he appeared before Kakuzu, who was attempting to flee.
"Running away?"
Nagato stared coldly. Such a man should not live.
"Who are you? How do you possess the Rinnegan?"
Kakuzu looked at Nagato cautiously.
"No need to know. Go to hell."
"Since you chose to fight, you won't survive."
Nagato's words enraged Kakuzu.
"Arrogant brat!"
Kakuzu roared and struck with a powerful punch.
Despite Nagato's overwhelming presence, Kakuzu was no stranger to battle, having tried to assassinate Senju Hashirama.
Fueled by rage, Kakuzu decided to trade blows before fleeing.
Though he might not win, he had five lives, and would use them recklessly.
Nagato watched expressionlessly as Kakuzu's fist, reinforced by Earth Release and bound with threads, slammed towards him like a chain hammer.
Trying to escape without a fight? That's cowardly.
"Go to hell."
Nagato flicked his finger, releasing a Truth seeking orb that solidified into a shield to block Kakuzu's attack.
Kakuzu's fist struck the Orb, but just like a mud cow lost at sea, it vanished into nothingness under the power of the Truth Seeking Orbs.

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 120: Speed Is Weight, Six Paths Nagato Vs Zenkichi.
chapters.content:
"What?"
Kakuzu's shock was palpable as he realized his arm had been completely severed.
"Impressive power," Nagato sneered, raising his hand and sending a Truth Seeking Orb hurtling toward Kakuzu. The destructive force instantly disintegrated Kakuzu's severed limb.
The power of the Orbs annihilated Kakuzu in an instant. No matter how formidable a secret technique is, it cannot withstand the Orbs destructive ability.
"Uchiha Madara, are you still there?" Nagato asked, his body flickering as he vanished from his hiding spot in a blink.
But there was no sign of Uchiha Obito, which left Nagato visibly displeased.
"Go to Konoha and retrieve the Nine Tails," he commanded himself firmly.
"At this point, I am invincible. There is nothing Uchiha Madara can do to stop me."
Nagato briefly contemplated but decided that securing the Nine-Tails was the priority.
Though Uchiha Madara harbored deep hatred toward him, Nagato doubted he could locate Madara.
Far from Konoha, atop a towering mountain, space twisted to form a portal. Uchiha Obito stepped out, touching his left eye socket where the Sharingan used during Izanagi had been removed.
In its place was the Samsara Eye, though Obito had yet to fully master its power.
"Once I get accustomed to this eye's power, I will summon the Gedo Statue here."
"Then I'll seize the Nine-Tails', become the Ten-Tails' Jinchūriki, and reign as god over this world!"Googlᴇ search NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
(He doesn't know that Nagato has become the Ten tails Jinchūriki)
Obito's thoughts bordered on madness, shouting wildly within.
"It was a mistake not letting Nagato use the Rinne rebirth to resurrect Uchiha Madara!"
Suddenly, Black Zetsu appeared before Obito, sighing with a strange expression.
"Fooling Nagato into sacrificing himself to revive Madara? Don't be foolish. Nagato's suspicion of me means he would never heed my words and resurrect another."
"My only option was to take back the Rinnegan . Only then can the Eye of the Moon plan be fulfilled."
Obito's expression remained unreadable; he did not truly intend to resurrect Madara.
Boom!
A terrifying aura erupted from Konoha Village, causing both Obito and Black Zetsu to tremble.
"That aura....Sage of Six Paths?" Black Zetsu murmured. "Should we investigate?"
Obito snorted, activating Kamui and entering his own space to swiftly head toward Konoha.
Meanwhile, Jiraiya stared at Nagato with disbelief. Nagato radiated an overwhelming aura of invincibility.
"Jiraiya-sensei!" Nagato said coldly. "Did you seal Yahiko's body because you intended to do something to it?"
"Konoha and Amegakure killed Yahiko and now refuse to even spare his body?" Nagato's tone was indifferent as he looked down on Jiraiya and the others.
"Nagato, what has happened to you? What caused the one who once longed for peace to become like this?" Jiraiya asked desperately, resorting to morality.
But as always, the weak find little refuge in words.
"Jiraiya Sensei, the ninjas of Konoha allied with Hanzo to destroy Akatsuki, killing Yahiko in the process."
"I have inherited Yahiko's dream of a peaceful world."
"To realize this, I need Konoha's Nine tails. Will you give it to me?"
"Even if you refuse, it makes no difference. I will take it myself."
"There is no difference between me now and the Sage of Six Paths."
"You will not be my match."
Nagato's voice was proud, his aura terrifying.
"Where is Danzo Shimura at a time like this?"
"I hear he commands a formidable force?"
"Tsunade sama, I don't mean you — you've always been exceptional."
"Danzo... If I were in charge, I would have already planted a tree on his grave."
At that moment, Zenkichi glanced at Tsunade, shaking his head.
"Shimura Danzo?"
A cold light flashed in Tsunade's eyes, followed by a helpless shake of her head.
"Even if Shimura Danzo and his men arrived now, it would not change the situation."
"If we survive this crisis, I will personally teach Danzo a lesson."
Zenkichi smiled. "You're a little too pessimistic. I told you I would help."
Tsunade frowned, eyes fixed on Nagato. "Judging by his aura, you might not be his match."
Zenkichi retorted, displeased. "Aren't you underestimating him too much?"
At that moment, the two toads next to Jiraiya spoke up.
"Young man, do not underestimate that red-haired youth."
"His eye is the legendary Rinnegan, Eyes of the Sage of Six Paths, and his current state is akin to that Sage."
"While he may not equal the true Sage of Six Paths, his power is nearly indistinguishable."
Zenkichi glanced at the toads and shook his head. "Is that all you know? What a disappointment."
"I know not only does he possess the Rinnegan, but he is now the Ten-Tails' Jinchūriki."
"As the Ten-Tails' Jinchūriki, he is immune to all ninjutsu, making him virtually invincible."
"After all, ninjutsu attacks manipulate chakra, and his body is immune to such chakra assaults."
"Only genjutsu or other forms of magic might affect him, but even those will have little impact."
Nagato sneered at Zenkichi, one eye flashing. "You seem knowledgeable, yet I do not understand what you mean."
"Perhaps you truly come from another world, full of things we know nothing about."
"If you surrender, I may spare your life. What do you say?"
Zenkichi responded calmly, "No, you are simply seeking death. I once wished to spare you, but now I believe you deserve to die."
Before anyone could react, Zenkichi vanished in a flash of light, appearing behind Nagato.
"Speed is weight," he declared.
"Ever been kicked at light speed?"
With a burst of power equivalent to 120% of Kizaru's strength, combined with his own power and Aizen's template, Zenkichi delivered a blazing kick of golden light.
Boom!
Nagato was launched like a cannonball. Immunity to chakra does not equal immunity to Devil Fruit powers.
"Is this a bluff?" the Konoha shinobi murmured, stunned.
They seized the opportunity to attack Nagato as he lay on the ground, launching thunder, lightning, wind blades, and other overwhelming techniques.
Yet, as the Ten-Tails' Jinchūriki, Nagato was immune to ninjutsu.
Lightning, wind blades, all were ignored by his defenses.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - 121: Orochimaru's New Goal.
chapters.content:
"I'm supposed to be immune to Ninjustu!"
"But why wasn't it immune to your Light technique?"
"Could it be… what you just used wasn't ninjutsu, but senjutsu?"
Nagato rushed toward Zenkichi, shouting coldly.
"There's more than just ninjutsu and senjutsu in this world. Things go far deeper than you think."
Zenkichi smirked as he raised his sword.
"Hado No. 63: Raikoho (Thunder Roar)!"
A golden bolt of thunder roared from his palm, striking the Six Paths Nagato head-on. The power behind it wasn't derived from chakra—it came from death itself. And that, Nagato couldn't defend against. He was blasted back.
"Your ability is strange," Nagato growled, stabilizing himself mid-air. "But you're still far from beating me!"
"I've gained more than just power. I've become nearly immortal!"
He laughed, pride surging in his voice—completely unaware of how close he was to defeat.
Zenkichi narrowed his eyes.
"Your weakness is obvious."
He vanished, his body turning into particles of light, and reappeared behind Nagato. The Rinnegan wielder barely managed to react, shielding himself with Truth-Seeking Orbs.
But Zenkichi wasn't done. The light scattered again, repositioning to a blind spot.
Nagato, unshaken, instantly activated Shinra Tensei.
This one, released by a Ten-Tails Jinchuriki, was far more terrifying than anything Pain had used before. The Konoha ninjas around them were swept away in seconds. Only legendary shinobi like Jiraiya and Tsunade managed to stay on their feet.
The once-great Konoha Village crumbled under the assault, reduced to a broken ruin.
"Is this really the power of a human being?" Tsunade muttered.
Jiraiya's face was grim. Both were high-level shinobi, but they looked like helpless children in the face of such overwhelming force.
"They're not ordinary," muttered one of the Toad Sages beside them. "That Rinnegan wielder is the Ten-Tails Jinchuriki, and Zenkichi... he's not even from this world."
"They're on a different level. Don't let this shake your spirit."

Kyoka Suigetsu shimmered into Zenkichi's hand. Without hesitation, he slashed.
"I'll help you end this."
Another clean strike—the soul of Uzumaki Nagato was destroyed.

Orochimaru's eyes lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 122: Interrogating Danzo.
chapters.content:
The coffins of the Edo Tensei opened one after another, and the reincarnated warriors with cracked bodies stepped forth.
Each one exuded a powerful aura—none were weak.
At the front stood Senju Hashirama and Uchiha Madara, stripped of their will by Orochimaru, left only with the instinct to fight.
With a single-handed seal, Orochimaru commanded the resurrected powerhouses.
"Go, retrieve Nagato's body for me. The Rinnegan and the Ten-Tails are the priority!"
He had already uncovered the truth behind both. Now, his ambition was to become the Ten-Tails' Jinchuuriki.
An overwhelming wave of Edo Tensei warriors surged toward Zenkichi, drawing the attention of everyone nearby.
"What is that? It's Edo Tensei!" Tsunade's expression shifted instantly.
She recognized the faces among them. "The First Hokage, the Second Hokage... the Third and the Fourth too…"
Nearby, a Konoha shinobi's face turned pale, having recognized fallen comrades among the summoned.
"Wood Release: Deep Forest Emergence!"
The First Hokage made no room for sentiment. Without hesitation, he unleashed his ultimate technique.
A vast surge of Wood Release chakra flooded the battlefield, tearing through the ground. Towering vines burst skyward, swallowing the land beneath them.
Tsunade's face paled. "Grandfather… Wood Release…"
She leapt back quickly, avoiding the relentless vines. As Hashirama's granddaughter, she knew better than anyone how devastating Wood Release could be—capable of reshaping the very terrain.
"Orochimaru…"
Zenkichi quickly assessed the situation, a faint smirk forming on his lips.
"As expected. Interested in the Rinnegan and the Ten-Tails, are you?"
But these cheap tricks—reanimated corpses—would never be enough to wrest them from his hands.
Raising Kyōka Suigetsu, he gently swung his blade. A tsunami of sword energy roared out, shredding several Edo Tensei bodies in its path.
They began to regenerate, slowly.
"Their regeneration is too slow," Zenkichi muttered coldly.
In a flash, he moved to their side. Without hesitation, Kyōka Suigetsu struck again—this time, the blade cleaving through their souls.
Once the soul was destroyed, Edo Tensei could no longer maintain them.
Suddenly, a kunai marked with the Senju Clan's crest flew toward Zenkichi.
Flying Thunder God Slash!
A white-haired man appeared at the kunai's location—the Second Hokage, Tobirama Senju.The source of thɪs content is N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Without pause, he stabbed at Zenkichi's neck with a gleaming blade.
Zenkichi simply stared him down.
A crushing wave of spiritual pressure burst forth, forcing Tobirama back.
In that instant, Kyōka Suigetsu flashed.
"The Second Hokage..."
Zenkichi's tone was cold—but amused. Killing these Edo Tensei spirits was unlocking greater and greater power within him.
Susanoo!
Uchiha Madara summoned his colossal blue warrior. The ethereal titan launched a punch toward Zenkichi.
Without even flinching, Zenkichi swung his sword.
The attack tore through Susanoo as if it were paper.
"You've got to be kidding me…" Sasuke's eyes widened. To him, Susanoo was nearly invincible—yet now, completely worthless against Zenkichi.
"Run. Run for your lives!" Orochimaru growled.
He had intended to take the Ten-Tails for himself. But now? That dream was better left forgotten.
The thought of immortality through becoming the Jinchuuriki was tempting.
But with Zenkichi standing in his way, it was likely he'd die long before reaching that goal.
"Now's my chance!" Uchiha Obito's eyes glinted with desperation.
Concealed within Kamui's dimension, he reached toward Nagato's body.
Zenkichi noticed—but didn't act.
He still needed more power to fully awaken his template. Sacrificing a Six Paths Obito wouldn't be so bad.
As Zenkichi stared down the reanimated Uchiha Madara, a flash of disdain crossed his face.
Without hesitation, he struck.
Tsunade, watching him eliminate enemy after enemy with ease, finally exhaled a long breath.
It was no wonder he'd unified his timeline ninja world.
With Madara's soul destroyed by Zenkichi's sword, even Obito could no longer use him.
Madara's essence shattered into countless fragments, impossible to revive.
Click!
"Nagato's body is missing!" Jiraiya suddenly shouted.
Tsunade's eyes went wide. "The Rinnegan and the Ten-Tails... this is bad!"
Zenkichi, still calm, replied, "Relax. It won't matter."
"Even if someone gets both, they won't be able to defeat me."
Then his gaze shifted. "Also... how much longer do you plan on hiding?"
"Come out, Uchiha brats."
From the shadows, Uchiha Sasuke stepped forward.
"Sasuke-kun!" Naruto called out with joy, visibly emotional.
But Sasuke remained silent, eyes locked on Zenkichi.
"What are you staring at me for? I have no interest in you," Zenkichi said, brushing him off.
"Uchiha Sasuke, you're a traitor to Konoha now," Tsunade said sternly. "Why did you come back?"
"I wanted to ask something," Sasuke replied coldly. "About Uchiha Itachi... and the Uchiha clan."
"Was it you? Did you order Itachi to slaughter our entire clan?"
Tsunade's face twisted in shock. The question cut deep.
"I wasn't Hokage at the time," she said. "I hadn't even returned to Konoha."
"But Shimura Danzō... he would know."
"Grandma Tsunade!" Naruto interrupted. "If what Sasuke said is true, we must help him get justice!"
The loss of his beloved, Gaara, still weighed heavily on him. He couldn't bear to lose anyone else.
"It just so happens," Tsunade said softly, "I've already been planning to bring Danzō to trial."
"You've arrived at the right time. We can interrogate him together."
---

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 123: Sasuke Vs Danzo.
chapters.content:
"He really lives up to the name... the Scheming King of Konoha."
Zenkichi stared at the pile of blackmail material related to Danzo laid out before him, shaking his head slightly.
"What do you plan to do with Danzo?" he asked, glancing at Tsunade with mild interest.
Tsunade answered without hesitation, "Shimura Danzo may be an elder, but he's committed far too many crimes."
"No matter what, I'll handle him according to Konoha's laws. I've wanted to act before, but never had a proper reason. Now is the perfect opportunity."
Just as she finished speaking, the doors to the Hokage's office swung open.
Koharu Utatane and Homura Mitokado, Konoha's senior advisors, slowly stepped in.
Koharu fixed her gaze on Tsunade and said sharply, "Tsunade, do you really intend to take action against Danzo? We oppose this."
"Konoha has just gone through a massive crisis. Now's not the time to shake up the village leadership."
"If you punish Danzo now, it'll cause unrest among the villagers."
Tsunade's lips curled into a cold smile. "That may be true, but I have one question."
"When Konoha was under attack... where was Danzo? Where were his men?"
"The fact that he stood by and did nothing while the village was in danger is treasonous. That alone is enough to have him executed."
"As for the public unrest, don't worry—I'll be turning all of Konoha's recent failures onto Danzo's head."
"By eliminating him, the people will have a scapegoat. It'll help restore faith in the village leadership."
Koharu and Homura faltered. They were close allies of Danzo, and if he fell, their influence would crumble too.
But the accusations were too substantial to refute—especially Danzo's inaction during Konoha's darkest hour.
After a moment of tense silence, Koharu finally said, weakly, "Even so, Danzo is a high-ranking elder. At least let him retain some dignity."
Off to the side, Zenkichi sneered in disdain. "You defend him only because his presence helps preserve your own power."
"In my world, you two were cowards, selling out your own village just to protect your influence. I killed you both."
"Seems your nature hasn't changed across worlds."
Koharu's face flushed with rage. She pointed a trembling finger at him. "This is Konoha's affair! You have no right to interfere!"
Zenkichi raised an eyebrow and smiled darkly. "You know, speaking to me like that... usually means you die."
In the blink of an eye, he appeared before her and drove his blade through her chest.
"You..."
Koharu's eyes widened in disbelief. This was Konoha. This was the Hokage's office.
How could Zenkichi have dared to kill her here?
"Can't believe it? Poor insect."
"In this world, only strength matters."
"Why do you think I wouldn't kill you?"
With a cold gaze, Zenkichi pulled his blade free. Koharu's lifeless body crumpled to the floor.
His gaze turned toward Homura. Frozen in fear, Homura tried to flee.
Zenkichi calmly pointed his finger, and a golden arrow of light pierced Homura's chest.
Tsunade, still watching, looked stunned. After a pause, she let out a bitter smile and shook her head. "You've really made a mess of things."
Zenkichi replied flatly, "You're too soft to be Hokage."
"If it were me, I'd have dealt with these two fossils long ago."
"And if they were like this... Danzo won't surrender easily either."
"If you want, I can take care of him too."
Tsunade paused, then shook her head. "Let Uchiha Sasuke do it."
"Itachi did a lot for Konoha, and Sasuke is now one of our top assets. If possible, I want him to return to the village properly."
Zenkichi grinned. "That so? Well, with his Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan, he should have no problem dealing with Danzo."
"Hm... sounds like an entertaining battle. Should we go watch? I'm curious."
Tsunade thought for a moment, then nodded. "I want to see how Danzo ends."
---
Later
Uchiha Sasuke was undergoing mental counseling from his good friend Uzumaki Naruto when he received Tsunade's order.
"Go to the Root division and eliminate Danzo."
"Hiruzen Sarutobi, Koharu, and Homura are already dead. That just leaves Shimura Danzo."
"Fine," Sasuke said coldly, crushing the mission scroll in his hand. "I'll kill him myself."
"Let me help!" Naruto offered, filled with righteous energy.
"Buzz off." Sasuke refused with a stern expression, gripping his Kusanagi sword as he turned toward Root's hidden base.
---
Meanwhile, in Root
Shimura Danzo read the order from Tsunade and sneered, tearing it to pieces.
"Tch... so she's finally making her move?"
"I've served Konoha faithfully. I've sacrificed for this village again and again."
"And now that yellow-haired girl dares to turn on me?"
His expression twisted into rage and madness.
"Everyone, prepare for battle! We'll show our dear Hokage just what it means to target the foundation of the village!"
Danzo clenched his fists tightly.
"Let's see if she's really willing to start a civil war right now."
He believed that with Root's elite at his command, Tsunade wouldn't risk dividing Konoha further.
But what he didn't account for... was that with Zenkichi backing her, Tsunade had already made up her mind.
---
Before long, Uchiha Sasuke arrived at Root.
Danzo's forces launched a coordinated assault, hurling kunai and shuriken in waves.
But none of it mattered.
Susanoo erupted around Sasuke, its purple armor deflecting everything like an impenetrable shell.
With a single punch, Susanoo shattered the Root headquarters' doors, and Sasuke strode inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 124: Kotoamatsukami.
chapters.content:
The Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan's power was nothing short of terrifying.
Having awakened these eyes, Uchiha Sasuke now stood firmly at the peak of Kage-level strength.
Unlike the standard Mangekyō, these eyes carried no risk of blindness and consumed minimal chakra during use. With a calm, cold demeanor, Sasuke summoned Susanoo, smashing through the entrance of the Root Division headquarters with a massive punch.
Every Root ninja who dared block his path was cut down with brutal efficiency—like weeds before a scythe.
"His Susanoo is just like Uchiha Shisui's!"
"Be careful! That defense is nearly impenetrable!"
"Wear him down. That jutsu can't last forever!"Thɪs updatᴇd by
The Root agents had faced Shisui's Susanoo before and assumed similar tactics would suffice.
But they couldn't have been more wrong.
Sasuke's Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan had far surpassed Shisui's, both in raw power and chakra control.
His Susanoo's defenses were impenetrable, and even the coordinated tactics of the Root shinobi couldn't make a dent. A single punch from his avatar shattered their entire defensive line.
---
"Shimura Danzo!"
Sasuke roared, cutting down the last obstacle in his path. He arrived at the deepest chamber of the Root hideout, face twisted with fury.
"So... it's you," Danzo muttered, visibly shaken.
"You didn't expect me, did you, Shimura Danzo?" Sasuke said, eyes blazing with hatred.
"Today, I avenge Uchiha Itachi."
Danzo scoffed, cold and unreadable. "Do you even realize what you're doing? You're attacking a senior official of Konoha."
"Itachi gave everything to protect this village. He'd be ashamed of what you've become. You're trampling on his sacrifice."
"You forced him to it!" Sasuke snarled, face contorted with rage. "He died with your blade in his back. You deserve nothing less than death."
Danzo snapped, "Even if I was wrong, that doesn't give you the right to pass judgment. I am part of Konoha's leadership! You have no such authority!"
He sneered, "Soon, the village will respond. The Hokage will arrive with reinforcements—along with that outsider who killed the Ten-Tails' Jinchuuriki. You won't make it out alive."
Sasuke smirked in contempt. "Authority? So that's all you rely on—your title?"
"Newsflash: you're not part of the leadership anymore."
"I'm here on the Hokage's direct orders."
Danzo's expression froze.
"That's right," Sasuke continued. "The same Hokage you once tried to manipulate. She sent me to make you pay for your crimes."
"So if you really love this village... then die for it."
Danzo's face darkened.
After a long silence, he spoke, "Is that so? I didn't expect this."
"If what you say is true, then summon Tsunade. Let me hear it from her. If she gives the order... I'll die where I stand."
Danzo's single eye narrowed as he prepared for a last gamble.
---
Sasuke narrowed his eyes. "Still trying to bargain?"
"Fine. I'll grant your final wish."
He stepped back. Killing Danzo outright felt too merciful. After everything, he wanted Danzo to feel the same despair he'd lived with for years.
At that moment, a calm voice echoed from the corridor.
---
"Is that really necessary, Danzo? I'm already here."
Tsunade entered the chamber with an unreadable expression. Her voice carried cold authority.
"Sasuke isn't lying. I ordered your execution myself."
"You've endangered Konoha time and time again. It's time to face the consequences."
Danzo's visible eye twitched as he spotted Arakawa Zenkichi standing calmly beside her.
He hesitated. The man beside Tsunade was more than just powerful—he was overwhelming.
Danzo weighed his options.
If he used Kotoamatsukami—the ultimate genjutsu of Shisui's stolen Mangekyō Sharingan—on Zenkichi, the risk was immense. If it failed, he'd die instantly.
But if it worked... he would gain control of the most powerful being in the world.
It was a high-stakes gamble.
Alternatively, he could target Tsunade. Controlling her would be easier, and it could buy him enough time to escape.
Low risk, low reward.
But greed overtook caution.
"I'll gamble it all," Danzo thought, gritting his teeth.
The Mangekyō eye beneath his bandages flared as he activated Kotoamatsukami—targeting Zenkichi.
---
"Hmph?"
Zenkichi raised an eyebrow. A ripple of spiritual pressure surged through the room as Danzo's genjutsu crashed into his mind like a wave.
But Zenkichi didn't flinch.
"...Pathetic," he muttered.
With a single word, his willpower shattered the illusion.
The spiritual energy coursing through him—bolstered by his fusion with the Aizen template—rendered genjutsu like Kotoamatsukami meaningless.
"You tried to control me with illusions?"
Zenkichi raised his hand. A concentrated laser beam pierced Danzo's shoulder, sending him sprawling to the floor.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
He continued firing—not to kill, but to torture. Each laser bolt left Danzo gasping in pain, his body riddled with precise, non-lethal wounds.
"I'm done," Zenkichi said, stepping back. "He's all yours."
---
"DANZO!"
Sasuke's voice echoed like a thunderclap.
His Susanoo roared as its giant fist came crashing down.
Danzo's body exploded in a mess of blood and bone, his last expression one of disbelief and horror.
Tsunade stood in silence, watching it all unfold with an unreadable expression.
She exhaled deeply.
So ended the reign of Konoha's Scheming King.
And now... came the task of salvaging whatever value remained from the wreckage he left behind.
---

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 125: New Template & World Hopping.
chapters.content:
"Konan, why are you here?"
Jiraiya's eyes widened as he saw her appear at the gate to Konoha.
Konan stood calmly. "I heard that Nagato was defeated by someone from Konoha. I'm here to retrieve his body."
Jiraiya sighed with a mix of guilt and helplessness. "Come with me. I'll take you to see the Hokage."
Konan nodded and followed him in silence. Her face remained expressionless as they made their way to the Hokage's office.
Jiraiya knocked.
After a brief pause, Tsunade's voice came from within—hoarse and clearly tired.
"I'm in the middle of something. Come back later."
A faint hum indicated that the room had been sealed with a barrier.
Jiraiya exchanged a glance with Konan and could only wait patiently.
Half an hour later, the barrier receded.
"Come in."
Inside, Tsunade was seated at her desk, flipping through paperwork with cold focus. Arakawa Zenkichi sat on the couch nearby, casually reading a newspaper, his face devoid of expression. The scene looked calm, but Jiraiya felt a strange unease.
---
"Did you kill Nagato?"
Konan's voice was quiet, her eyes locked onto Zenkichi. Hatred flickered in her gaze.
"Yes," Zenkichi replied calmly. "He had lost control. There was no other way."
He glanced at her. "It's a shame actually,maybe things could've gone differently."
Konan scoffed, "Then tell me, in your world... what became of the three of us?"
Zenkichi's tone remained steady. "Yahiko was moved by my vision of unifying the shinobi world. You and Nagato joined him. We fought together for peace."
A trace of longing flickered in Konan's eyes.
"That... sounds nice."
---
Elsewhere.
Uchiha Obito stood before the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path, adjusting the lone Rinnegan in his eye socket.
"What a pity," he muttered. "I can't sustain both Rinnegan."
Beside him, Black Zetsu hissed, "The Nine-Tails Jinchūriki is in Konoha... and with him, that outsider."
Obito shook his head. "I don't have enough chakra. The Nine-Tails' chakra is nearly half the Ten-Tails' total. I need it back."
Black Zetsu pressed, "So? Can we launch the Infinite Tsukuyomi now?"
After witnessing Madara's death at Zenkichi's hands, he knew Obito was the only one left who could awaken the moon and resurrect his "mother."
Obito had already torn out his own Sharingan and implanted the second Rinnegan. He managed to subdue the Ten-Tails, slipping into Six Paths Mode.
Black Zetsu grew increasingly nervous. Obito wasn't a sealing expert, and things weren't going smoothly.
Unlike Nagato, who had the natural talent to bear two Rinnegan and control the Ten-Tails effortlessly, Obito's will was now starting to falter. His eyes dulled. The Ten-Tails' power clawed at his mind.
Yet...
Obito completed the transformation.
